papers.title: Naju: A Native Discrete State-Space Model with Independent Retention and Writing for Long-Sequence Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-sequence memory tracking places two opposing demands on a recurrent state: near-lossless retention of stored bindings over long horizons, and active overwriting of stale ones. In our diagnostic suite, the strongest efficient baselines tend to solve only one side well. Continuous-time-parameterized state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba obtain their discrete recurrence by zero-order-hold discretization of a continuous-time system; we argue that this detour is unnecessary for memory tracking and parameterize the discrete transition directly. Naju (Native Adaptive Junction Unit) factorizes the recurrent update, schematically $x_n = f_n\odot x_{n-1} + i_n\odot(B_n u_n)$, into an explicit discrete pole (a learned forget gate $f_n$), an independent write gain $i_n$, and input-dependent write/read maps. Since the sigmoid pole satisfies $0<f_n<1$, each frozen local coordinate is Schur-stable by construction, and the full time-varying recurrence satisfies a fading-memory/BIBO bound under uniform boundedness assumptions, with no stability regularizer. We formalize the key structural limitation of coupled designs: any non-expansive complementary single-gate recurrence ties the effective retention $r$ and write gain $w$ through $|r|+w\le 1$, so near-complete retention forces weak writing; decoupling $f_n$ from $i_n$ removes this constraint. Empirically, Naju is the only evaluated model that remains strong on both retention and overwriting at 4x the training length. Beyond the diagnostic suite, we evaluate Naju on WikiText-103 language modeling, Long Range Arena, and multi-query associative recall. Across these settings, Naju consistently combines strong long-range memory with competitive or superior performance, outperforming the Mamba baselines in the principal comparisons while remaining competitive with the Transformer and preserving linear-time, linear-memory scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Naju（Native Adaptive Junction Unit），一种直接参数化离散状态转移的状态空间模型，通过解耦遗忘门和写入增益来同时实现长序列记忆的近无损保留和有效覆盖。理论分析和实验表明，Naju在诊断测试、WikiText-103语言建模、Long Range Arena和多查询关联召回等任务上均优于Mamba基线，并保持线性时间和内存复杂度。
Motivation: 现有高效基线模型（如Mamba）在长序列记忆跟踪中难以同时兼顾保留和覆盖能力，且连续时间离散化方法并非必要。耦合的门控设计导致保留率和写入增益存在约束，限制了记忆性能。
Method: Naju将循环更新分解为显式离散极点（遗忘门f_n）、独立写入增益i_n以及输入相关的读写映射，直接参数化离散状态转移，避免了连续时间离散化。通过解耦f_n和i_n，突破了耦合设计中|r|+w≤1的限制。
Result: 在诊断测试中，Naju是唯一在4倍训练长度下仍保持强保留和覆盖能力的模型。在WikiText-103、Long Range Arena和多查询关联召回上，Naju一致地结合了强长程记忆与竞争性或更优性能，在主要比较中优于Mamba基线，与Transformer竞争力相当。
Conclusion: Naju验证了解耦遗忘门和写入增益在长序列记忆中的有效性，为状态空间模型设计提供了新思路。方法具有线性时间和内存缩放特性，适合长序列应用。

papers.title: Workflow-Localized Mechanism Learning: Attribution-Guided Repair and Knowledge Reuse for Structured Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills package reusable procedural knowledge as external artifacts for frozen language-model agents, yet existing optimizers do not jointly resolve where a failure occurs in a workflow, which mechanism caused it, and how relevant knowledge from third-party Skills should be reused locally. We introduce Workflow-Localized Mechanism Learning (WML). Its Node--Mechanism Attribution identifies the failed workflow node, implicated mechanisms, and smallest valid edit target, routing single-mechanism defects to L3 resources and relational defects across mechanisms to L2 composition protocols. A six-module Workflow-Guided Skill Optimization (WGSO) loop then selects provenance- and scope-aware third-party knowledge, applies bounded patches, evaluates candidates, and stores verified outcomes in optimizer-side memory. On SpreadsheetBench, WML reaches 90.33 +/- 1.53 and 74.67 +/- 3.51 Hard Accuracy with DeepSeek and Qwen3.6-Flash, respectively; without additional optimization, the learned Skills transfer to WikiTableQuestions with 84.00 +/- 2.00 and 83.00 +/- 2.00 Denotation Accuracy. On Compiler-Supported50, WML attains both the highest hard-PASS rate and the lowest cost per successful task; compiled execution sharply reduces tokens and calls relative to a direct SkillAgent while retaining most of its successful tasks. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/xiaolin9595/workflow-localized-mechanism-learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出工作流局部化机制学习（WML），通过节点-机制归因（Node–Mechanism Attribution）定位工作流中的失败节点和导致问题的机制，并利用第三方技能的知识进行局部修复和重用。该方法包含一个六模块的工作流引导技能优化循环（WGSO），在多个基准上取得了良好性能。
Motivation: 现有代理技能优化器未能联合解决工作流中故障发生位置、导致故障的机制以及如何局部重用第三方技能中的相关知识的问题。
Method: 引入节点-机制归因，识别失败节点、相关机制及最小有效编辑目标；对单机制缺陷使用L3资源修复，对机制间关系缺陷使用L2组合协议。通过六模块WGSO循环选择具有来源和范围感知的第三方知识，应用受限补丁，评估候选方案，并将验证结果存储于优化器端记忆。
Result: 在SpreadsheetBench上，使用DeepSeek和Qwen3.6-Flash分别达到90.33±1.53和74.67±3.51的Hard Accuracy；在不额外优化的情况下，学到的技能迁移到WikiTableQuestions上分别获得84.00±2.00和83.00±2.00的Denotation Accuracy。在Compiler-Supported50上取得最高硬PASS率和最低单任务成功成本。
Conclusion: WML通过局部归因和知识重用有效修复代理工作流中的故障，并实现技能迁移，展示了结构化代理技能优化的可行性。

papers.title: Sparse Concept Channels in Frozen 3D CT Vision Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models are becoming increasingly dominant in 3D medical image interpretation, but we rarely know which internal units encode clinical findings or where that information lives in the representation. We first study this on a 3D chest vision-language model (Pillar-0) by probing its frozen vision embeddings. We show that (i) each radiological finding is encoded by a sparse set of ~10 vision-encoder channels that match full-feature classification performance and far exceed a zero-shot text prompting; (ii) turning off the channels tied to one finding, that finding's score collapses while unrelated labels stay stable; and (iii) the same sparse probe replicates on an architecturally unrelated 3D abdominal VLM (Merlin) suggesting a general property of frozen medical encoders. Our training-free concept channel probe (CCP) method, paired with a corpus-derived report template, outperforms published CT-CHAT on clinical efficacy and NLG metrics (F1 0.549 vs. 0.184; BLEU 0.483 vs. 0.373) at 22x lower latency. Our results provide a clear, reproducible characterization of how frozen medical encoders represent findings, demonstrating direct applicability across models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究冻结的3D CT视觉编码器内部表示，发现每个放射学发现由约10个视觉编码器通道稀疏编码，且该现象在不同架构的编码器（如Pillar-0和Merlin）中复现。提出无需训练的概念通道探针（CCP）方法，结合报告模板，在临床有效性和NLG指标上超越CT-CHAT，延迟降低22倍。
Motivation: 尽管大型视觉语言模型在3D医学图像解读中日益重要，但内部单元如何编码临床发现及其表示位置尚不清楚。
Method: 通过探针分析冻结的3D胸部视觉语言模型（Pillar-0），识别与每个放射学发现相关的稀疏通道集，并验证其在腹部模型（Merlin）上的可迁移性。提出训练无关的概念通道探针（CCP）方法。
Result: 每个放射学发现由约10个稀疏通道编码，性能与全特征分类相当，远超零样本文本提示；关闭相关通道后该发现分数骤降，无关标签稳定；CCP方法在F1上0.549 vs. 0.184，BLEU上0.483 vs. 0.373，延迟降低22倍。
Conclusion: 研究提供了冻结医学编码器表示发现的清晰、可重复的特征描述，展示了跨模型的可直接应用性。

papers.title: Latent Variable-Mediated Cross-Learning for Few-Shot Acoustic Impedance Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Acoustic impedance imaging is a fundamental yet severely ill-posed problem in subsurface analysis: the seismic wavelet is unknown, observations are band-limited, and labeled well-log samples are extremely scarce (typically <1% of all traces). Existing semi-supervised deep learning methods mitigate few-shot problem by incorporating forward modeling, yet they either rely on inaccurate prior wavelet assumptions or introduce auxiliary networks, leading to unstable optimization and degraded performance. We propose RD-SCL, a novel framework that integrates regularized deconvolution with semi-supervised cross-learning. At its core lies a differentiable, closed-form first-order Tikhonov deconvolution operator that dynamically estimates the latent wavelet in the frequency domain during training, providing stable physics-guided feedback without explicit auxiliary networks and fixed wavelet priors. Building on this operator, we design a symmetric cross-learning that enforces consistency between predictions on labeled and unlabeled data, thereby effectively exploiting abundant unlabeled traces. Extensive experiments on the SEAM and Marmousi 2 benchmarks demonstrate that RD-SCL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and semi-supervised methods, achieving substantial gains with lower computational cost. With only 56.5k learnable parameters and competitive runtime, RD-SCL offers a practical, physically consistent, and efficient solution for acoustic impedance imaging.
papers.comment: The manuscript is currently under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RD-SCL 框架，通过可微分的闭式一阶 Tikhonov 反褶积算子动态估计潜在子波，并结合半监督交叉学习，在少量标注数据下进行声阻抗成像，在 SEAM 和 Marmousi 2 基准上超越了现有方法。
Motivation: 声阻抗成像中地震子波未知、观测带限、标注井数据极少（通常<1%），现有半监督方法依赖不准确的先验子波假设或引入辅助网络，导致优化不稳定。
Method: 提出 RD-SCL 框架，核心是可微分的闭式一阶 Tikhonov 反褶积算子，在频域动态估计潜在子波，提供物理引导反馈，无需显式辅助网络和固定子波先验；并设计对称交叉学习强制标注与未标注数据预测一致性。
Result: 在 SEAM 和 Marmousi 2 基准上，RD-SCL 以仅 56.5k 可学习参数和较低计算成本，一致优于最先进的监督和半监督方法。
Conclusion: RD-SCL 为声阻抗成像提供了一种物理一致、高效实用的解决方案，尤其适用于少样本场景。

papers.title: HyWorldVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Hybrid World Modeling for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models augmented with world modeling represent a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving. While pixel-level future prediction enables fine-grained spatiotemporal reasoning, it compromises robustness in noisy driving scenarios. Conversely, latent-based world models alleviate this sensitivity but often incur limited interpretability and representational degradation due to absent pixel-level grounding. To reconcile this trade-off, we propose HyWorldVLA, a hybrid world-VLA framework that unifies pixel-level supervision and latent representation learning. In the pre-training stage, HyWorldVLA predicts video latents encoded by a pre-trained video VAE, while simultaneously reconstructing video frames to provide precise pixel-level grounding. During the subsequent co-fine-tuning phase, the model exclusively predicts latent features, which are fed into an action expert to generate trajectories. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM v1 and v2 benchmarks demonstrate that HyWorldVLA significantly outperforms both pixel-based and latent-based world model baselines. Notably, we present the first comprehensive qualitative and quantitative analysis of world model noise robustness in autonomous driving, establishing a new benchmark for evaluating future architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyWorldVLA 提出一种混合世界模型框架，统一像素级监督与潜在表示学习，用于端到端自动驾驶。预训练阶段同时预测视频潜在特征并重建视频帧，微调阶段仅预测潜在特征以生成轨迹。在 NAVSIM v1 和 v2 基准上，该方法显著优于纯像素或纯潜在的世界模型基线，并首次对自动驾驶中的世界模型噪声鲁棒性进行了定性和定量分析。
Motivation: 像素级未来预测能进行细粒度时空推理，但在噪声场景下鲁棒性差；而基于潜在的世界模型对噪声不敏感，但缺乏像素级定位，可解释性有限且表征退化。需要一种混合方法来平衡两者。
Method: 提出 HyWorldVLA，包含预训练和协同微调两阶段。预训练时预测预训练视频 VAE 编码的视频潜在特征，同时重建视频帧以提供像素级监督；微调时仅预测潜在特征，并输入动作专家生成轨迹。
Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 和 v2 基准上，HyWorldVLA 显著优于基于像素和基于潜在的世界模型基线。同时，该工作首次对自动驾驶世界模型的噪声鲁棒性进行了全面的定性与定量分析。
Conclusion: HyWorldVLA 通过混合世界建模有效调和了像素级监督与潜在表示学习的权衡，为端到端自动驾驶提供了一种鲁棒且可解释的框架，并建立了噪声鲁棒性评估的新基准。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Distribution-Alignment Bridge for Uncertainty-Aware Text-to-Video Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes the Distribution-Alignment Bridge (DAB), a framework that reconceptualizes text-to-video retrieval as a distribution alignment task rather than traditional deterministic point matching. By modeling both text and video embeddings as Gaussian distributions defined by mean and variance, DAB explicitly accounts for modality-specific uncertainty. We employ a deterministic, diffusion-inspired bridge to iteratively refine text distributions toward their target video distributions through a truncated refinement process. This approach unifies probabilistic embedding and distributional transformation into a cohesive, end-to-end trainable system. To optimize cross-modal similarity, we introduce a distribution-aware contrastive loss based on Kullback-Leibler divergence. Extensive evaluations on MSR-VTT, MSVD, and VATEX benchmarks confirm that DAB significantly outperforms existing probabilistic and diffusion-based baselines, while providing calibrated uncertainty-aware ranking through bridge-induced distributional margins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Distribution-Alignment Bridge (DAB)框架，将文本到视频检索重构为分布对齐任务，利用高斯分布建模模态不确定性，并通过扩散启发的桥梁进行迭代细化分布。在MSR-VTT、MSVD、VATEX基准上显著优于现有概率和扩散基线。
Motivation: 传统确定性点匹配忽视了模态内部的不确定性，导致检索鲁棒性不足。
Method: 将文本和视频嵌入建模为高斯分布（均值和方差），通过确定性扩散启发的桥梁迭代细化文本分布，并引入基于KL散度的分布感知对比损失。
Result: 在MSR-VTT、MSVD和VATEX基准上大幅超越现有概率和扩散方法，同时通过桥接产生的分布边际提供校准的不确定性感知排序。
Conclusion: DAB统一了概率嵌入和分布变换，实现了端到端训练，提升了跨模态检索的鲁棒性和不确定性估计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GuardianAgentBench: Where Agents Fail and How to Guard Them
papers.abstract_en: As large language model agents increasingly operate autonomously with access to tools and external environments, ensuring their safe and reliable behavior becomes critical. We present GuardianAgentBench (GABench), a benchmark of 580 scenarios across six domains evaluated on three production-ready frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Vectara. The benchmark incorporates rigorous multi-stage validation and five adversarial attack modes. Experiments with six state-of-the-art models reveal that even the strongest configuration achieves only 74.8% overall accuracy and expose two distinct failure regimes: stronger models under-call required tools, while weaker models mis-select and over-call tools. Performance degrades monotonically with both tool-set size and sequential turn depth, with long-horizon planning proving the steeper bottleneck. Our guardrail implementation consistently outperforms system-prompt-based defenses across all models, recovering 19.9% of failures at a false positive rate of just 0.5%. These results demonstrate that execution-time structural intervention improves safety without disrupting correct agent behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GuardianAgentBench (GABench) 是一个包含580个场景的基准测试，覆盖六个领域，用于评估AI agent在工具访问下的安全性和可靠性。实验在LangChain、LlamaIndex和Vectara三个生产框架上进行，测试了六种最先进模型，发现最强配置只有74.8%的准确率，且存在两种失败模式：强模型不足调用工具，弱模型错误选择和过度调用工具。提出的护栏实现比系统提示防御更有效，恢复了19.9%的失败，假阳性率仅0.5%。
Motivation: 大语言模型代理在自主操作时需确保安全可靠，但现有基准缺乏对工具调用场景的系统评估，且对抗攻击下性能未知。
Method: 构建包含多阶段验证和五种对抗攻击模式的基准GABench，测试多个框架和模型，并设计执行时结构性干预的护栏机制。
Result: 最强配置准确率仅74.8%；强模型欠调用工具，弱模型误选和过调用；性能随工具集大小和任务深度单调下降；长期规划是主要瓶颈；护栏恢复19.9%失败，假阳性率0.5%。
Conclusion: 执行时结构性干预（护栏）能有效提升agent安全性，且不干扰正确行为，优于系统提示防御。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Independent Optimization: Compression, MoE Routing, and Quantization Interactions in Multimodal Edge Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Efficient multimodal inference is increasingly constrained not only by model quality or FLOP count, but also by the cost of preserving, moving, routing, caching, and quantizing multimodal representations under latency, memory, and energy constraints. This paper reviews recent advances in efficient vision-language and multimodal large language models, covering visual token compression, video token management, KV-cache optimization, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing, low-bit quantization, edge deployment, and hardware-aware benchmarking. We argue that these techniques cannot be treated as independent optimizations. Visual token compression alters downstream feature distributions and MoE routing decisions, routing behavior affects expert utilization and quantization sensitivity, quantized router logits influence expert assignment, KV-cache policies determine retained multimodal evidence, and hardware constraints often transform computational savings into memory and communication bottlenecks. We organize the literature around these interactions and identify key design trade-offs, including accuracy versus token budget, static versus adaptive compression, sparse routing efficiency versus expert collapse, and low-bit inference versus modality-specific degradation. Finally, we introduce Temporal Routing Consistency as a diagnostic for video MoE models and highlight open research directions in routing-aware compression, cross-modal cache management, hardware-aware co-design, and unified benchmarking for multimodal edge intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了多模态边缘智能中视觉token压缩、视频token管理、KV缓存优化、MoE路由、低比特量化等技术的交互影响，指出这些优化不能独立看待，并提出了时序路由一致性作为视频MoE的诊断指标。
Motivation: 多模态推理的延迟、内存和能耗约束日益严格，但现有工作通常孤立处理压缩、路由、量化等技术，忽略了它们之间的相互影响。
Method: 综述性文章，系统梳理了视觉token压缩、视频token管理、KV缓存优化、MoE路由、低比特量化及边缘部署等领域的最新进展，并分析了各技术间的交互与权衡，同时提出时序路由一致性（Temporal Routing Consistency）用于诊断视频MoE模型。
Result: 识别出关键设计权衡，如精度与token预算、静态与自适应压缩、稀疏路由效率与专家崩溃、低比特推理与模态特定退化，并指出了开放研究方向。
Conclusion: 多模态边缘智能的优化需要跨技术协同设计，路由感知压缩、跨模态缓存管理、硬件感知协同设计和统一基准测试是未来重要方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unsupervised Metal Artifact Reduction in Dental CBCT using Fine-tuned Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks
papers.abstract_en: Metal artifacts generated by dental implants significantly degrade cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) volumes, obscuring critical anatomical structures and compromising diagnostic precision. To address this, an unsupervised deep learning framework has been proposed for Metal Artifact Reduction (MAR) utilizing a Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Network (CycleGAN) optimized for high-fidelity restoration. Unlike supervised methods that rely on unattainable voxel-aligned paired datasets, the proposed approach leverages an unpaired dataset of approximately 4,000 images, curated from the public ToothFairy dataset. The architecture integrates U-Net-based generators and PatchGAN discriminators, specifically tuned to mitigate generative hallucinations and preserve morphological integrity. Quantitative benchmarking on a held-out test set demonstrates a 34.6\% improvement in the Blind/Referenceless Image Spatial Quality Evaluator (BRISQUE) score, a substantial reduction in Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) from 207.03 to 157.04, and a superior Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) of 0.9105. The framework achieves real-time efficiency with a 3.03 ms inference time per slice, effectively suppressing artifacts while preserving anatomical detail. Expert validation confirms high fidelity; however, to ensure reliability in extreme cases, the architecture is recommended as a clinical decision-support tool under human-in-the-loop oversight. By enhancing diagnostic clarity via a scalable software pipeline, this study provides a robust solution for high-fidelity dental implant imaging.
papers.journal_ref: Chamika, T.; Dhanapala, S.N.A.; Nimalaweera, S.; Dissanayake, M.B.; Jayasinghe, R.D. Unsupervised Metal Artifact Reduction in Dental CBCT Using Fine-Tuned Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks. Digital 2026, 6, 31
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 CycleGAN 的无监督深度学习框架，用于减少牙科锥束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）中的金属伪影。该方法使用约 4000 张非配对图像，结合 U-Net 生成器和 PatchGAN 判别器，在 ToothFairy 数据集上训练。定量评估显示，BRISQUE 评分提升 34.6%，FID 从 207.03 降至 157.04，SSIM 达 0.9105，推理时间每层仅 3.03 毫秒。专家验证确认高保真度，但建议在极端情况下作为临床决策辅助工具。
Motivation: 牙科植入物产生的金属伪影严重降低 CBCT 图像质量，遮挡关键解剖结构，影响诊断准确性。监督方法需要难以获取的体素对齐配对数据，因此需要无监督方案。
Method: 采用 CycleGAN 架构，包含 U-Net 生成器和 PatchGAN 判别器，利用非配对图像进行训练，并通过微调减少生成幻觉，保持形态完整性。
Result: 在测试集上，BRISQUE 评分改善 34.6%，FID 从 207.03 降至 157.04，SSIM 达到 0.9105，推理时间每层 3.03 毫秒。
Conclusion: 该方法有效抑制伪影并保留解剖细节，但极端情况下需人工监督，建议作为临床决策支持工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Delivery, Not Storage: Cue-Anchored Working Memory as a Harness Property for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents ship with one kind of memory: documents. Instruction files, plan artifacts, and auto-written memory directories are deliberately authored and deliberately retrieved: the agent must choose to write them and choose to read them back. Human expertise runs on a second tier that never gets written down: situationally-bound operational facts (gotchas, locations, local conventions) encoded as a side effect of the work and retrieved involuntarily when the situation cues them. We argue this second tier is the load-bearing one for long-running agents and must be a harness property, not an agent choice. We contribute: (1) a two-tier design theory grounded in the cognitive literature on memory offloading, incidental encoding, and event-based prospective memory, each mapped to an architectural requirement; (2) a cue-anchored memory model where memories carry first-class trigger conditions over a composable vocabulary (path, symbol, semantic, event, temporal), evaluated deterministically by the harness, a composition no surveyed academic or shipped system provides; (3) a controlled evaluation on a real coding task showing that voluntary memory use is near zero even with a pre-seeded store (0 memory operations in 114 turns), that deterministic injection delivered in every seeded run with zero false alarms, and that 39% of intra-session re-reads re-buy content paid for before a compaction boundary; (4) a repeated-compaction decay probe: ten facts held only in conversation vanish at the first summary and stay absent from 106 of 108 compactions, and the deprived agent greps the harness's own session files to rebuild them, while the same facts injected from a harness-owned store arrive intact through all 138 compact-resumes as the final summary carries none. Delivery, not storage, is the product: the reliable memory channel for agents is the one the agent never has to think about.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出编码智能体（coding agents）需要第二层记忆——情境绑定的操作性事实，如潜在陷阱、位置和局部约定，这些记忆应作为系统属性而非智能体选择。作者基于认知科学中的记忆卸载、偶然编码和事件前瞻记忆理论，设计了一个双层记忆架构，并提出了线索锚定记忆模型（cue-anchored memory model），其中记忆带有由路径、符号、语义、事件和时间等可组合词汇构成的触发条件，由系统确定性地评估。实验表明，在真实的编码任务中，智能体主动使用记忆的次数几乎为零（114轮对话中0次记忆操作），而系统注入的记忆在每次运行中都正确触发且无假警报。此外，反复压缩对话历史会导致事实丢失，而系统拥有的记忆存储则能完好保留。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体只依赖显式文档记忆，但人类专家依赖的是未经书写的情境绑定操作事实，这些事实是长时间运行智能体的关键。如何让智能体可靠地获得这种记忆，成为亟待解决的问题。
Method: 提出双层设计理论，将记忆分为两层：显式文档层和隐式情境绑定层。构建线索锚定记忆模型，记忆附带可组合的触发条件（路径、符号、语义、事件、时间），由系统而不是智能体控制检索。通过对比实验，测量智能体主动使用记忆的频率和系统注入记忆的效果。
Result: 在编码任务中，智能体主动记忆使用为零（0次/114轮）；系统注入的记忆在每次运行中均正确触发，零假警报；39%的会话内重读内容是在压缩边界之前已支付的。重复压缩实验表明，仅存储在对话中的事实在第一次摘要后消失，108次压缩中106次缺失，而系统存储的事实经过138次压缩后仍然完整。

papers.title: From Scalars to Time Series: Rethinking Implicit Neural Representations for Time-Varying Volumetric Data
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) for time-varying volumetric data are typically trained using dense sampling over spatiotemporal coordinates, where each observation corresponds to a single point in space and time. This coordinate-wise formulation requires extensive sampling during optimization, leading to high computational cost and inefficient use of temporal structure. In this work, we revisit this design choice and show that dense spatiotemporal sampling is not necessary for learning time-varying fields. Instead, we represent the data as a collection of spatially indexed time series and train INRs using sequence-level supervision over each spatial location, rather than coordinate-wise scalar samples. This reformulation eliminates the need for dense spatiotemporal sampling and instead learns each spatial location from its full temporal evolution in a structured manner. We demonstrate that this representation is compatible with a range of existing INR architectures and consistently improves reconstruction quality, while significantly reducing training cost. Furthermore, we show that this formulation can be combined with mixture-of-experts architectures, and that our MoE instantiation further improves reconstruction quality compared to both the base reformulation and existing MoE-based INR methods, providing a stronger capacity allocation under heterogeneous temporal dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新思考用于时间变化体数据的隐式神经表示（INR），提出将数据表示为空间索引的时间序列集合，并采用序列级监督替代传统的坐标级标量采样。该方法不需要密集时空采样，与现有INR架构兼容，且可结合混合专家（MoE）架构，显著降低训练成本并提升重建质量。
Motivation: 传统INR在时间变化体数据上依赖密集时空坐标采样，计算成本高且未充分利用时间结构。需要一种更高效、利用时序结构的学习方式。
Method: 将数据表示为空间索引的时间序列集合，在每个空间位置上使用完整时间演化的序列级监督进行训练，而非坐标级标量样本。该方法兼容多种INR架构，并可扩展至MoE架构。
Result: 相比传统INR方法，该方法在保持或提升重建质量的同时显著降低训练成本；MoE实例化进一步优于现有MoE-INR方法，尤其是在异构时间动态下。
Conclusion: 重新设计INR的训练范式，从坐标采样转向序列监督，能更有效地利用时间结构，为时间变化体数据表示提供新的方向。

papers.title: FSB-Net: Frequency-Spatial Boundary Network for Brain Stroke Lesion Segmentation in Non-Contrast CT
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of brain stroke lesions in non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) scans is critical for rapid clinical decision-making, yet remains difficult due to the low contrast between lesion and normal brain tissue, heterogeneous lesion morphology across ischemic and hemorrhagic subtypes, and ambiguous boundaries caused by partial volume effects. Current deep learning approaches primarily optimize region-level overlap but lack explicit boundary modeling, leading to imprecise delineation that can affect volumetric assessment and treatment planning. We propose FSB-Net, a frequency-spatial boundary network that leverages frequency-domain analysis for boundary-aware stroke lesion segmentation. FSB-Net introduces three components: (i) a Wavelet Boundary Detection Head (WBDH) that applies the discrete wavelet transform to multi-scale encoder features, extracting high-frequency sub-bands as boundary representations; (ii) a Frequency-Spatial Cross-Attention Module (FSCAM) that performs bidirectional attention between wavelet boundary features and spatial decoder features for selective boundary enhancement; and (iii) a Spectral Boundary Loss that penalizes high-frequency discrepancies in the Fourier domain to optimize boundary sharpness. Built on a PVTv2-B2 encoder, FSB-Net is evaluated on a public Brain Stroke CT dataset containing both ischemic and hemorrhagic cases. Experimental results show that FSB-Net outperforms U-Net, UNet++, MANet, and DeepLabV3+ across all metrics, achieving state-of-the-art performance in mean Dice, mean IoU, and HD95.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FSB-Net，一种频率-空间边界网络，用于非对比CT脑卒中病变分割。该方法通过小波边界检测头、频率-空间交叉注意力模块和频谱边界损失来显式建模边界，在公共脑卒中CT数据集上优于U-Net、UNet++、MANet和DeepLabV3+，取得最先进的Dice、IoU和HD95性能。
Motivation: 非对比CT中卒中病变与正常组织对比度低、病变形态异质性强、部分容积效应导致边界模糊，现有深度学习方法缺乏显式边界建模，导致分割不精确。
Method: 提出FSB-Net，包含三个组件：(i) 小波边界检测头（WBDH）利用离散小波变换提取多尺度编码器特征的高频子带作为边界表示；(ii) 频率-空间交叉注意力模块（FSCAM）对小波边界特征与空间解码器特征进行双向注意力以实现选择性边界增强；(iii) 频谱边界损失在傅里叶域惩罚高频差异以优化边界锐度。编码器采用PVTv2-B2。
Result: 在包含缺血性和出血性病例的公共脑卒中CT数据集上，FSB-Net在平均Dice、平均IoU和HD95指标上均优于U-Net、UNet++、MANet和DeepLabV3+，达到当前最佳性能。
Conclusion: 显式边界建模和频率域分析能显著提升非对比CT中脑卒中病变分割的精确度，对临床决策有重要意义。

papers.title: The Weight of Silence: A Causal Case for Weights Over the Scratchpad in Latent Chess Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent, or silent, reasoning lets language models carry out intermediate computation in continuous vector space instead of words, and is widely assumed to function as an internal scratchpad the model actively consults during inference. Whether that assumption survives reinforcement learning has not been tested directly: existing causal analyses of latent reasoning are confined to math and logic tasks, and compare a model's reliance on its thoughts within a single checkpoint, never before and after an RL stage. We train a chess-playing model through a staged latent-reasoning curriculum followed by reinforcement learning, and find legality climbs monotonically to 61% (from a 48% pre-RL baseline) while checkmate confabulation is eliminated entirely. To locate this gain, we run a six-condition causal intervention suite on the same model before and after RL: substituting or adding matched noise to the latent thought vectors leaves performance unchanged, ablating them causes only mild degradation, and only exact-zero vectors cause collapse. This robustness gap is itself the finding: under exact-zero corruption, legality collapses to 1% pre-RL versus 9% post-RL, a gap that survives correction for testing across the full battery; milder conditions trend similarly without independently reaching significance. RL appears to add robustness to disruption, not reliance on thought content. These results push back against the field's default assumption that latent thoughts function as an actively consulted inference-time scratchpad, and instead indicate latent reasoning's principal effect here is shaping the model's parameters during training. We also demonstrate a working RL gain in chess, a domain outside the math and logic settings where multiple groups report the same latent-reasoning-plus-RL recipe failing to improve accuracy over SFT.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 5 figures, preprint also available at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/21454434
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过在国际象棋推理任务中训练语言模型，并对其进行因果干预实验，挑战了潜在推理（latent reasoning）作为内部草稿板（scratchpad）的普遍假设。研究发现，强化学习（RL）带来的性能提升主要归因于参数调整而非推理时对潜在思考向量的依赖，模型在大多噪声干扰下表现稳健，仅在零向量干扰下崩溃。这暗示潜在推理的主要作用是在训练中塑造参数。
Motivation: 现有因果分析局限于数学逻辑任务且仅在单个检查点内比较，未检验强化学习前后的变化。本文首次在象棋领域验证潜在推理在RL前后的因果作用。
Method: 采用分阶段训练：先通过潜在推理课程训练，再施加强化学习。设计六种因果干预条件（替换/添加噪声、消融、零向量等）比较RL前后模型行为。
Result: RL后合法移动率从48%提升至61%，彻底消除将死幻觉。因果干预显示：噪声替换/添加不影响性能，消融仅轻微下降，仅精确零向量导致崩溃（RL前1% vs RL后9%合规率）。RL增强了鲁棒性而非对思考内容的依赖。
Conclusion: 挑战潜在推理作为推理时主动咨询的草稿板的默认假设，表明其在训练中的作用是调整参数。在象棋领域展示了RL增益，而之前其他团队在数学逻辑任务中报告RL未提升准确率。

papers.title: Best-of-Evidence: Best-of-N Selection under Partial Verification
papers.abstract_en: BoN improves model outputs by sampling several candidates and selecting one with a proxy score, but it assumes that complete candidates can be evaluated reliably. Many vision-language tasks instead provide only partial verification: a finding, span, value, region, or relation may be checkable even when no dependable whole-response verifier exists. Moreover, the same claim may recur across candidates with opposing stances, allowing one observation to support part of the pool and contradict another. We introduce Best-of-Evidence (BoE), an inference-time selection framework that keeps the BoN candidate pool fixed, represents reusable claims with a signed candidate--factor graph, and allocates a limited budget to evidence actions that can change the final choice. BoE formalizes selection under partial verification and provides a practical score-based controller, with the zero-budget case recovering the underlying BoN decision. Theoretically, we show that residual evidence capacity limits any evidence-driven improvement and that shared factor queries can achieve an O(log K) versus Θ(K) query separation in a factor-code model. Common-ledger experiments on four medical VQA settings show that BoE can improve fixed-pool selection and rescue some BoN failures when evidence is reliable, contrastive, and decision-relevant, while also revealing the channel-quality and candidate-generation limits that prevent universal gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Best-of-Evidence (BoE)，一种在部分验证场景下的推理时选择框架。BoE 保持 Best-of-N 候选池固定，通过带符号的候选-因子图表示可复用声明，并分配有限的证据预算来改变最终选择。理论分析显示残差证据容量限制了证据驱动的改进，且共享因子查询可实现 O(log K) vs Θ(K) 的查询分离。在四个医学 VQA 任务上的实验表明，当证据可靠、对比且与决策相关时，BoE 能改善固定池选择并挽救部分 BoN 失败。
Motivation: 现有 Best-of-N (BoN) 方法假设完整候选可被可靠评估，但许多视觉-语言任务仅提供部分验证（如片段、值、区域、关系），且同一声明可能在不同候选中以对立立场出现，导致依赖完整验证器的 BoN 失效。
Method: BoE 框架固定候选池，构建带符号的候选-因子图，分配有限预算给证据动作（改变最终选择），并提供基于分数的控制器；零预算情形退化为底层 BoN 决策。
Result: 理论上证明残差证据容量限制任何证据驱动的改进，且共享因子查询在因子-代码模型中实现 O(log K) vs Θ(K) 的查询分离。实验上，在四个医学 VQA 设置中，BoE 在证据可靠、对比且决策相关时提升固定池选择质量并挽救部分 BoN 失败。
Conclusion: BoE 为部分验证下的选择提供了形式化框架，但实验结果也揭示了通道质量和候选生成限制会阻止普遍提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RECO: Region-Aware Compensation for Extrinsic Perturbations in Roadside 3D Detection
papers.abstract_en: In intelligent transportation systems, roadside 3D object detection provides wide-area perception crucial for traffic understanding, cooperative early warning, and safe autonomous driving. However, existing methods suffer from high sensitivity to camera extrinsics; even slight deviations (whether manifesting as transient jitter or persistent drift) can be significantly amplified by projective geometry. This cascade results in severe feature misalignment and degraded localization. To mitigate this limitation, we propose RECO, a region-aware extrinsic compensation framework that corrects extrinsics using piecewise 6-DoF pose offsets. RECO predicts a learnable range boundary to partition the scene into near and far regions, estimating region-specific pose corrections. A differentiable sigmoid gate then smoothly blends the two compensated geometries to preserve continuous BEV sampling and facilitate stable optimization. To supervise the refinement of extrinsics, we introduce an auxiliary reprojection loss that compares 2D bounding boxes projected from 3D ground truth against 2D annotations, optimizing it jointly with the standard detection objective. Extensive experiments on the DAIR-V2X-I and Rope3D benchmarks under extrinsic perturbations demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines across both yaw and $z$-axis deviations. RECO also generalizes from transient perturbations to persistent shifts, maintaining highly competitive performance under strict calibration uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RECO框架，针对路边3D检测中相机外参扰动（瞬态抖动或持续漂移）导致的特征错位和定位退化问题，通过区域感知的外参补偿方法，利用分段6-DoF姿态偏移校正外参。该方法学习可区分近远区域的范围边界，估计区域特定的姿态校正，并通过可微sigmoid门平滑混合补偿几何，辅助重投影损失进行联合优化。在DAIR-V2X-I和Rope3D基准上，该方法在外参扰动下优于现有基线，且能从瞬态扰动泛化到持续偏移。
Motivation: 现有路边3D检测方法对相机外参高度敏感，微小偏差经投影几何放大后导致严重特征错位和定位退化，这一关键问题尚未被有效解决。
Method: 提出RECO框架，预测可学习的范围边界将场景分为近远区域，为每个区域估计6-DoF姿态校正；通过可微sigmoid门平滑混合两个补偿几何以保持连续BEV采样；引入辅助重投影损失（将3D真值投影的2D框与2D标注比较）联合检测目标优化外参校正。
Result: 在DAIR-V2X-I和Rope3D基准上，RECO在yaw轴和z轴偏移扰动下均持续优于现有最先进基线，并能从瞬态扰动泛化到持续偏移，在严格标定不确定条件下保持高性能。
Conclusion: RECO通过区域感知的补偿框架有效缓解了外参扰动对路边3D检测的影响，具备良好的泛化能力，但未提及在多种天气条件下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: An Analytically Trained Variational Surrogate for Quantum Phase Estimation on NISQ Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) is a foundational algorithm for molecular ground-state energy estimation, but its deep circuit requirements make direct hardware execution impractical on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices. We present an analytically grounded variational surrogate framework in which a shallow Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) is trained to reproduce the QPE measurement distribution without any quantum circuit simulation. The training target is computed entirely classically via the Dirichlet kernel, evaluated directly from the Full Configuration Interaction (FCI) ground-state energy, the ancilla qubit count, and the time evolution parameter, eliminating the exponentially scaling simulation bottleneck of prior surrogate approaches. We apply this framework to the hydrogen molecule (H$_2$) with a symmetry-tapered Hamiltonian, conducting a four-stage experimental investigation on IBM Quantum hardware. Stage 1 compares linear and full entangler topologies for the $R_Y$-$R_Z$-$CZ$ ansatz, with and without XpXm Dynamical Decoupling (DD), across four distributional metrics (Hellinger distance, fidelity error, total variation distance, Jensen-Shannon divergence), identifying the linear entangler as optimal. Stage 2 varies VQC layers ($p=1$ to $5$) for the linear-entangler ansatz, identifying single-layer depth as optimal under hardware noise. Stage 3 applies this configuration to the reduced $R_Y$-$CZ$ ansatz, comparing ideal and noisy simulator-trained parameters. A supplementary noise analysis at $p \in \{8,64\}$ characterizes the depth-dependent interplay between circuit depth and DD effectiveness. The framework enables faithful QPE mimicry using a linearly scaling VQC, recovering the ground-state energy within the chemical accuracy threshold (1 kcal/mol), constituting a scalable, hardware-efficient paradigm for QPE-based molecular energy estimation on NISQ devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个解析基础的变分代理框架，通过浅层变分量子电路（VQC）模拟量子相位估计（QPE）的测量分布，无需量子电路模拟。训练目标由Dirichlet核经典计算得到，依赖于FCI基态能量、辅助量子比特数及时间演化参数。在H₂分子上使用IBM量子硬件进行四阶段实验，比较不同ansatz拓扑和层数，发现线性纠缠器与单层深度在噪声下最优，结合动态解耦恢复的基态能量达到化学精度（1 kcal/mol）。
Motivation: 量子相位估计（QPE）是分子基态能量估计的基础算法，但其深度电路需求在NISQ设备上不可行，现有变分代理方法面临指数级模拟瓶颈。
Method: 提出解析变分代理框架：训练一个浅层VQC以复制QPE测量分布，训练目标完全经典计算（Dirichlet核），无需量子电路模拟。应用于对称削减后的H₂哈密顿量，采用R_Y-R_Z-CZ ansatz及XpXm动态解耦，在IBM硬件上进行四阶段实验（比较纠缠拓扑、层数、噪声等）。
Result: 在H₂分子上，线性纠缠器拓扑与单层VQC在硬件噪声下表现最优；结合动态解耦，恢复的基态能量达到1 kcal/mol的化学精度阈值。补充噪声分析表明，深度p=8和64时电路深度与动态解耦效果存在交互。
Conclusion: 该框架通过线性缩放VQC忠实模仿QPE，为NISQ设备上基于QPE的分子能量估计提供了可扩展、硬件高效的范式。

papers.title: Ms. Forcing: Efficient Streaming Video Generation with Multi-Scale Patchification and Attention
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video diffusion models have made substantial progress toward interactive and dynamic world simulation, but the nested autoregressive and denoising loops of conventional next-frame generation hinder real-time deployment. Recent rolling-window methods pipeline denoising across multiple consecutive frames at different noise levels, improving throughput and long-horizon stability. However, they tokenize every state at the same fine spatial granularity, leaving substantial noise-dependent redundancy in the joint denoising window. We propose Ms.Forcing, an efficient streaming video generation paradigm that adapts spatial granularity to each state's noise level. Its Multi-Scale Patchification (MSP) assigns coarser patches to noisier states, reducing the active-window token count by 45%, while Multi-Scale Self-Attention (MSSA) matches the density of visible non-sink keys and values to each query scale to further reduce attention cost. Because both schedules are fixed by window position, Ms.Forcing retains a static, hardware-friendly computation graph. We further introduce Homogeneous-Noise-Level DMD (H-DMD), which assembles each fake video from clean predictions sharing the same source noise level, thereby reducing the mismatch between DMD training sequences and inference-time rollouts. The multi-scale design helps offset the additional training cost of backpropagating through overlapping windows. We include both quantitative and qualitative experiments to show that Ms.Forcing reaches 22.84 FPS on a single H200 GPU, 39.6% faster than Rolling Forcing, while significantly improving VBench scores in both short video and long video generation setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ms.Forcing，一种高效的流式视频生成范式。该方法通过多尺度分块 (MSP) 为噪声较大的状态分配更粗的 patch，将活动窗口 token 数量减少 45%；同时提出多尺度自注意力 (MSSA) 根据查询尺度调整可见非汇聚键值密度，降低注意力计算成本。此外引入同噪声级 DMD (H-DMD) 减少训练与推理的分布不匹配。实验表明，Ms.Forcing 在单块 H200 GPU 上达到 22.84 FPS，比 Rolling Forcing 快 39.6%，并在长、短视频生成中显著提升 VBench 分数。
Motivation: 现有流式视频生成方法对所有帧使用相同细粒度 token，忽略了不同噪声水平下状态的空间冗余，导致计算效率低下。
Method: 提出多尺度分块 (MSP) 为不同噪声状态的帧分配不同粒度的 patch，以及多尺度自注意力 (MSSA) 根据查询尺度调整键值数量；同时提出同噪声级 DMD (H-DMD) 来缓解训练与推理序列的不匹配。
Result: 在单个 H200 GPU 上达到 22.84 FPS，相比 Rolling Forcing 提升 39.6% 的速度，并在 VBench 指标上取得显著改进。
Conclusion: 多尺度设计有效降低了计算成本，并补偿了重叠窗口反向传播带来的额外训练开销，为实时流式视频生成提供了高效方案。

papers.title: Interaction Dynamics Modeling and Predictive Control for Safe Steerable Catheter--Tissue Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Safe steerable catheter control is fundamentally a problem of interaction dynamics: the tip must follow a planned motion, remain compliant against moving tissue, reject friction and hysteresis, and respect a clinically meaningful never-exceed contact-force bound. We formulate catheter--tissue interaction dynamics in the scalar tip-normal coordinate of a single-segment single-tendon catheter. A partial-physics feedforward cancels only the reliable nominal bending dynamics, exposing a configuration-invariant linear interaction-dynamics model whose input gain varies through the scalar catheter inertia. A predictive optimizer then regulates this interaction state subject to hard contact-force, tendon-force, and curvature constraints. An augmented Kalman filter compresses contact, friction, and modeling error into one sensor-free disturbance state, giving nominal offset-free regulation in free space while leaving force safety to the explicit constraint. The unconstrained and disturbance-free limit recovers classical catheter impedance as a special realization of the same interaction dynamics, rather than as the main design object. In a MuJoCo distributed-compliance simulation of an eight-link tendon-driven catheter, disturbance augmentation cuts free-space approach error by 90\%, and only the force-constrained predictive interaction-dynamics controller reconciles tracking with the 0.5\,N bound: the unconstrained controller drives contact force to 0.60\,N against a penetrating target, while the constrained one holds 0.47\,N at identical tracking. These results show that offset-free motion regulation and contact-force safety are coupled interaction-dynamics objectives, and that the explicit predictive constraint resolves their tension under stiff tissue contact. The bound also holds under $0.5$\,mm, $1.2$\,Hz cardiac motion. Hardware validation is future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于交互动力学建模与预测控制的可转向导管安全控制方法。该方法利用部分物理前馈、配置不变线性交互动力学模型、预测优化器以及增强卡尔曼滤波器，在硬约束下实现无偏移运动调节与接触力安全。MuJoCo仿真表明，扰动增强将自由空间接近误差降低90%，且约束控制器能在0.5N力界限下保持追踪性能。
Motivation: 可转向导管控制的关键挑战在于交互动力学：需要同时实现运动追踪、对移动组织的柔顺性、补偿摩擦和迟滞，并遵守临床不可超过的接触力界限。现有方法未能协调这些耦合目标。
Method: 建立单段单肌腱导管在尖端法向坐标下的交互动力学模型；设计部分物理前馈抵消可靠标称弯曲动力学，导出配置不变的线性交互模型；采用预测优化器在硬约束下调节交互状态；利用增强卡尔曼滤波器将接触、摩擦和建模误差压缩为无传感器扰动状态。
Result: 在MuJoCo分布式顺应仿真中，扰动增强将自由空间接近误差降低90%；无约束控制器在穿透目标时接触力达0.60N，而约束控制器在相同追踪下保持0.47N的力界限，约束也适用于0.5mm、1.2Hz心脏运动。
Conclusion: 无偏移运动调节与接触力安全是耦合的交互动力学目标，显式预测约束可以有效解决两者在硬组织接触下的冲突。硬件验证留作未来工作。

papers.title: Clustered Edge Intelligence: Beyond Just Convergence of Edge Computing and AI
papers.abstract_en: We are moving from an information age to the age of intelligence. A decade, or possibly less than that, data will not be the gold anymore rather the derived intelligence out of the data and the information we posses from the edge of the network. Existing Edge Intelligence research focuses mainly on two directions: using AI for edge resource management and deploying lightweight AI models on edge devices. However, existing edge computing research lacks an intelligence-centric framework in which derived intelligence is treated as a first-class, independently manageable entity that can be described, discovered, observed, shared, reused, and dynamically clustered across heterogeneous edge devices and applications. To address these research gaps, we introduced Clustered Edge Intelligence, a visionary intelligence-centric approach. The aim of CEI is to make intelligence a shareable and reusable first-class entity that can be independently represented, discovered, observed, exchanged, and managed across the distributed edge-cloud continuum. We present a three layer CEI architecture and examine enabling technologies and research dimensions, including intelligence inventories, semantic knowledge representation, communication, discoverability, observability, lifecycle automation, clustering mechanisms, marketplaces, interoperability, and standardization.
papers.comment: This is not survey or position paper. 28 Pages, 10 figures, 4 Tables, 108 references, Under review, submitted to Information Fusion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出集群边缘智能（Clustered Edge Intelligence, CEI）框架，将派生智能视为可独立管理、共享和复用的实体，在异构边缘设备间实现智能的描述、发现、观察、交换和动态集群。文章设计了三层CEI架构，并探讨了使能技术和研究维度，包括智能库存、语义知识表示、通信、可观察性、生命周期自动化、聚类机制、市场及标准化等。
Motivation: 现有边缘智能研究主要关注用AI管理边缘资源或部署轻量级AI模型，缺乏将派生智能作为一等实体的框架，导致智能无法被独立描述、发现、共享和跨设备重用。
Method: 提出CEI架构，包含三层（智能实体层、集群管理层、应用编排层），并定义智能实体的表示、发现、观察、交换、聚类等机制，结合语义知识表示和生命周期自动化。
Result: 论文为概念性框架，未提供具体实验结果。
Conclusion: CEI旨在使智能成为边缘-云连续体中可共享和可复用的实体，需进一步研究智能聚类、互操作性和标准化等方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出CEI架构，包含三层（智能实体层、集群管理层、应用编排层），并定义智能实体的表示、发现、观察、交换、聚类等机制，结合语义知识表示和生命周期自动化。
summary_sections.result: 论文为概念性框架，未提供具体实验结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: CEI旨在使智能成为边缘-云连续体中可共享和可复用的实体，需进一步研究智能聚类、互操作性和标准化等方向。

papers.title: SciExplore: Evaluating Autonomous Agents from Scientific Navigation to Information Integration
papers.abstract_en: Scientific research involves complex information-seeking and reasoning workflows across heterogeneous sources. However, existing benchmarks primarily emphasize general-domain retrieval or static scientific question answering, and therefore fail to assess key capabilities required in realistic scientific research workflows. We introduce SciExplore, a benchmark designed to evaluate scientific information-seeking and reasoning capabilities of LLMs and agents. SciExplore comprises four task types covering 103 expert-curated tasks across more than ten scientific disciplines: scientific database navigation, ambiguous literature retrieval, missing reference completion, and cross-source structured knowledge synthesis, which probe progressively higher-level abilities from entity-level reasoning and document-level identification to evidence-level grounding and domain-level synthesis. We evaluate over ten state-of-the-art LLMs and autonomous agents on SciExplore, revealing substantial performance gaps with performance degrading sharply as task complexity increases and extremely low accuracy on the most challenging structured synthesis tasks. These results highlight significant limitations of current models and agents in realistic scientific information-seeking scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciExplore 是一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）和自主智能体在科学研究信息搜寻与推理能力上的基准测试。它包含四大类任务（科学数据库导航、模糊文献检索、缺失引用补全、跨源结构化知识综合），覆盖十个以上学科，共103个专家策划任务。评估表明，现有模型和智能体在任务复杂度增加时性能急剧下降，最具挑战性的结构化综合任务准确率极低，凸显了当前模型在真实科学研究信息场景中的显著局限。
Motivation: 现有基准主要侧重通用领域检索或静态科学问答，无法评估真实科研工作流程中所需的关键能力，如跨异构源的信息搜寻与推理。
Method: 提出了 SciExplore 基准，包含四个递进难度的任务类型：实体级推理（科学数据库导航）、文档级识别（模糊文献检索）、证据级定位（缺失引用补全）和领域级综合（跨源结构化知识合成）。
Result: 在十多个最先进的 LLM 和自主智能体上评估，发现性能随任务复杂度增加而急剧下降，最困难的结构化综合任务准确率极低。
Conclusion: 现有模型和智能体在真实科学信息搜寻场景中存在显著能力缺陷，尤其在需要高级综合的任务上。

papers.title: Representing Entity Importance in AI Knowledge Systems: A Dual-Signal Framework of Audience Evaluation and Structural Authority
papers.abstract_en: AI knowledge systems require representations of entity importance for retrieval, recommendation, evidence selection, and knowledge-intensive reasoning. Yet importance is often reduced to a single score derived from either human response or graph structure. Such compression may discard distinctions that matter when an AI system must choose among entities for different tasks. This study introduces an interpretable dual-signal representation in which each entity is characterized by an audience-evaluation dimension and a structural-authority dimension. The framework is evaluated using movie entities as an empirical validation domain. IMDb non-commercial datasets provide a rating-based audience ranking, Wikidata supports entity alignment, and English Wikipedia hyperlinks form the knowledge network on which PageRank estimates structural authority. Experiments on 482 entities and 13,690 directed relationships reveal a statistically significant but weak association between the two dimensions (Spearman rho = 0.2275, p < 0.001). Their overlap is only 10% in the top 10 and 34% in the top 100, while entity-level divergence occurs in both directions. The results show that audience evaluation and structural authority are non-redundant signals and should not automatically be collapsed into a single scalar notion of importance. The contribution is not a new ranking algorithm or learned embedding, but a minimal knowledge-representation framework and an empirical test of its dimensional necessity. The findings support task-aware AI knowledge systems that preserve distinct importance signals before applying context-specific selection or aggregation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI知识系统中实体重要性表示的问题，提出一个可解释的双信号框架，将每个实体表征为受众评价维度和结构权威维度。使用IMDb、Wikidata和Wikipedia数据对482个电影实体及13690条有向关系进行实验，发现两个维度之间存在统计显著但微弱的相关性（Spearman rho=0.2275, p<0.001），在前10和前100实体中重叠率分别仅为10%和34%。结果表明受众评价和结构权威是非冗余信号，不应自动压缩为单一重要性分数。
Motivation: 现有AI知识系统常将实体重要性简化为单一分数（来自人类响应或图结构），这种压缩可能丢弃任务相关的区分信息。
Method: 提出双信号表示框架：受众评价维度基于IMDb评分排序，结构权威维度基于Wikipedia超链接网络上的PageRank。通过实体对齐和跨数据源实验检验两个维度的关联性。
Result: 在482个电影实体和13690条关系上，两维度呈弱相关（Spearman rho=0.2275, p<0.001）；前10实体重叠10%，前100重叠34%，且存在双向实体级分歧。
Conclusion: 受众评价和结构权威是非冗余信号，AI知识系统应在保留不同重要性信号后再进行上下文选择或聚合。

papers.title: MagicMakeup: A Region-Controllable Diffusion Transformer for High-Fidelity Makeup-Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Makeup-transfer applies the reference makeup to the source face while preserving the source identity. Despite advances in full-face editing by diffusion-based methods, strong regional controllability, makeup fidelity, and identity preservation remain challenging. The reasons are (i) pixel-to-attention misalignment that causes spillover into non-target areas and weakens regional control; (ii) unclear transfer/preservation concept separation under two-image conditioning, leading to coupling between makeup attributes and identity; and (iii) the lack of a high-resolution dataset that is identity-consistent and region-labeled for fine-grained supervision. In this paper, we propose MagicMakeup, a diffusion transformer-based framework for region-controllable and high-fidelity makeup transfer, built on spatial constraints and concept disentanglement. To enable precise region-specific editing while preserving identity, we propose Token-Aligned Region Gating, which aligns pixel masks with attention and applies region-specific logit gating. To clarify the concepts of transfer and preservation, we further introduce Cross-Modal Perception Guidance, which aligns text and image features to enhance cross-modal concept perception. We also design a pipeline for the generation of 1024 x 1024 data pairs through region-specific makeup removal and establish a unified benchmark in synthetic and real settings. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments show that MagicMakeup improves regional controllability, makeup fidelity, and identity preservation, with strong robustness across styles, races, and poses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MagicMakeup，一种基于扩散 Transformer 的框架，用于高保真、区域可控的化妆迁移。通过 Token 对齐区域门控和跨模态感知引导，解决了像素-注意力错位、概念耦合以及缺乏高分辨率数据集的问题。实验表明，该方法在区域可控性、化妆保真度和身份保持方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散方法在化妆迁移中面临区域控制弱、化妆属性与身份耦合、以及缺乏高分辨率标注数据等问题，难以同时实现精细区域编辑和身份保持。
Method: 提出 Token 对齐区域门控（Token-Aligned Region Gating），将像素掩码与注意力对齐并应用区域逻辑门控；引入跨模态感知引导（Cross-Modal Perception Guidance），对齐文本与图像特征以增强跨模态概念感知；并设计 1024x1024 数据对生成管道，建立统一基准。
Result: 在多种风格、种族和姿态下，MagicMakeup 在区域可控性、化妆保真度和身份保持方面均取得提升，定量和定性实验验证了其鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过空间约束和概念解耦，实现了高保真区域可控的化妆迁移，但主要针对人脸化妆场景，未来可探索其他图像编辑任务。

papers.title: Scientific exploration, collaboration and labor division in the large language model era
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly and significantly entered scientific workflows, but it remains unclear how their diffusion is associated with changes in scientists' strategies in research directions and team building. We link PubMed Central full text with OpenAlex publication and collaboration histories for 775,323 scientists and analyze CRediT contribution statements from 137,120 multi-author papers. After 2022, scientists increasingly published across more intellectually distant fields and entered fields in which they had not previously worked. These increases in interdisciplinarity and exploration were especially pronounced among established scientists and scientists from non-English-speaking low- and middle-income countries. Authors with stronger AI-writing signals were already more interdisciplinary and exploratory before the widespread adoption of LLMs, and the gap widened further after 2022 compared with authors with weaker AI-writing signals. Scientists' collaboration networks also became more interdisciplinary after 2022. Yet, among authors with stronger AI-writing signals, research interdisciplinarity was less closely tied to the disciplinary diversity of their collaborators. The division of labor within research teams also became more differentiated. Contributors on papers published after 2022 reported narrower role sets on average, coauthors shared fewer roles in common, and their role profiles became less rigid and more fluid. Software and validation roles increased, while conceptual and management roles decreased. These patterns suggest that team members are taking on more distinct responsibilities and may rely less on one another to perform research tasks. Overall, this study indicates that the LLM era coincides with a broader reorganization of scientific exploration, collaboration, and the division of labor.
papers.comment: Main text: 21 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary materials: 25 pages, 13 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究分析了大型语言模型（LLM）时代科学家在研究方向、团队合作和劳动分工方面的变化。基于 PubMed Central 全文和 OpenAlex 数据，发现 2022 年后科学家更倾向于跨学科研究，尤其是在资深科学家和非英语中低收入国家科学家中更为明显。同时，合作网络更加跨学科，团队内部分工更加细化，角色集更窄，验证和软件角色增加，管理和概念角色减少。
Motivation: LLM 已快速进入科学工作流，但其对科学家研究策略和团队建设的影响尚不清楚。
Method: 利用 PubMed Central 全文与 OpenAlex 的发表和合作历史数据（775,323 名科学家），以及 137,120 篇多作者论文的 CRediT 贡献声明，分析跨学科性、探索性、合作网络和劳动分工的变化。
Result: 2022 年后，科学家的跨学科性和探索性增加，尤其体现在资深科学家和非英语中低收入国家；AI写作信号强的作者本就更跨学科，且差距进一步扩大。合作网络也更跨学科，但AI信号强的作者其跨学科性与合作者多样性关联变弱；团队内角色集更窄，共同角色减少，软件和验证角色增加，概念和管理角色减少。
Conclusion: LLM 时代与科学探索、合作和劳动分工的广泛重组相关，表明团队可能更依赖独立任务分工而非互依协作。

papers.title: FA-LAM: Focus-Aware Large Avatar Model for One-Shot 4D Animatable Gaussian Head
papers.abstract_en: We propose FA-LAM, a Focus-Aware Large Avatar Model for one-shot animatable Gaussian head creation, while simultaneously enabling static 3D and dynamic 4D full-head recovery. The core of our method lies in a thorough analysis of the attention mechanisms and the entangled reconstruction and animation training pipeline adopted by prior state-of-the-art approaches. Our analysis identifies two main factors that compromise the quality of 3D full-head generation: (1) incorrect and noisy attention activations, and (2) conflicts between the tasks of reconstruction and animation. To address the first issue, we introduce a symmetric and semantic attention regularization strategy that leverages the inherent semantics and structural symmetry of human heads. To disentangle the objectives of reconstruction and animation, we develop a novel dual-phase training pipeline that separates the model's capabilities for large-view hallucination and animation into distinct modules. Moreover, we enhance our model to support multi-view and streaming 4D reconstruction in an efficient and memory-friendly manner through a core autoregressive modification with tailored visibility-aware token fusion. Collectively, these innovations enable FA-LAM to reconstruct animatable Gaussian full heads with superior quality, particularly in fine facial regions and large viewing angles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FA-LAM，一种面向一次性可动画化高斯头像生成的焦点感知大模型，同时支持静态3D和动态4D全头重建。核心是分析现有方法的注意力机制和重建-动画联合训练中的问题，提出对称语义注意力正则化来抑制噪声激活，并设计双阶段训练管道分离重建与动画目标，还通过自回归修改和可见性感知标记融合支持高效多视角流式4D重建。该方法在精细面部区域和大视角下实现了更高质量的头像重建。
Motivation: 现有一次性可动画化头像方法在3D全头生成质量上受限于两个因素：注意力激活不正确且带有噪声，以及重建与动画任务的冲突。
Method: 提出对称语义注意力正则化利用人头的内在语义和结构对称性；设计双阶段训练管道将大视角幻觉和动画能力分离到不同模块；通过核心自回归修改和可见性感知标记融合实现高效多视角和流式4D重建。
Result: 在精细面部区域和大视角下，FA-LAM 重建的可动画化高斯头像质量优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 通过解耦注意力噪声和任务冲突，FA-LAM 在一次性4D可动画化头像生成上取得了更高质量，尤其在细粒度面部和大视角场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OPOD: On-Policy Omni Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal models can handle text, images, and audio in one system, but improving all of these abilities together remains difficult. Training a single model on pooled multimodal data often fails to match models specialized for individual modalities. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a way to combine such specialists: the student generates a response, and a teacher evaluates that same response, so the student learns directly from behaviors it actually produces. Yet using several teachers can introduce competing guidance and improve one modality at the expense of another. We present On-Policy Omni Distillation (OPOD), which routes each student response to the matching text, image, or audio teacher. OPOD keeps teacher guidance only on tokens where the teacher assigns a higher probability than the student, adjusts the influence of each modality teacher independently during training, and asks the routed teacher to assess both the final answer and whether the reasoning supports the correct answer. Across twelve benchmarks and three backbone sizes, OPOD achieves the best average score at every scale, reaching 70.8, 51.7, and 46.2 and exceeding the strongest comparator by 2.1, 1.8, and 1.7 points. On the 30B model, it outperforms both the base model and a counterpart post-trained jointly on pooled multimodal data on all twelve benchmarks, and ranks first or second on eleven even when the individual specialists are included. The specialists are discarded after training, leaving one deployable omni-modal model. These results show that coordinating modality-specific teachers is an effective way to improve a shared model while maintaining cross-modal balance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OPOD（On-Policy Omni Distillation），一种面向全模态模型（文本、图像、音频）的在线蒸馏方法。通过路由学生模型的生成响应到对应的模态专家教师，并基于教师概率高于学生的token进行指导，同时独立调整各模态教师的影响，最终在12个基准测试和三种模型规模上取得最佳平均分（30B模型达46.2），超过最强对比方法1.7分。
Motivation: 全模态模型需要同时提升多种能力，但 pooled multimodal data 训练难以匹敌单模态专家；多教师蒸馏会导致竞争性指导，提升一种模态却损害另一种。
Method: OPOD 将学生响应路由至匹配的文本、图像或音频教师；仅在教师概率高于学生的token上施加指导；独立调整各模态教师的影响；教师评估最终答案及推理支持的正确性。
Result: 在12个基准和三种骨干规模上，OPOD 均取得最佳平均分（70.8、51.7、46.2），超过最强对比方法2.1、1.8、1.7分。30B模型在所有基准上优于基线和联合训练模型，并在包含单模态专家的对比中排名第一或第二。
Conclusion: 协调模态特定教师是提升共享模型并保持跨模态平衡的有效方式，训练后丢弃专家，得到一个可部署的全模态模型。

papers.title: Traceable Scholarship: Page Anchors and Ariadne's Thread for Humanistic Inquiry in the Age of Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI lets large language models produce scholarly-looking text within seconds, yet fluency does not equal valid explanation. The deepest risk is not factual error alone but the appearance that an explanation is already established without clear sources, page numbers, editions, or evidence. We liken the page anchor to Ariadne's thread: within the labyrinth of generative fluency, it is the thread that leads the scholar back to the source. This paper proposes Traceable Scholarship as the minimum normative condition for AI-assisted humanistic research, situating it across the three revolutions of knowledge infrastructure: print, digital, and generative AI. We introduce page anchors, dual page numbers, citation-first generation, NO_EVIDENCE, human verification, four-level compliance, and Scope Contract, and present AIH-Infra as a three-layer reference implementation: Contexture (document structuring), Open WebUI AIH-Infra (traceable knowledge base), and AIH-Infra MCP Server (agent gateway). A case study on a 29-volume Kant Akademie-Ausgabe knowledge base illustrates how traceability supports retrieval correction, evidence grading, and judgment downgrading. Traceability is not a software feature; it is the condition under which humanistic research can remain public and refutable in the age of generative AI.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 8 tables. This paper proposes a normative and infrastructural framework for traceable, AI-assisted humanistic research and presents an auditable Kant case study
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可追溯学术（Traceable Scholarship）作为生成式AI辅助人文研究的最低规范性条件，并引入页面锚点、双页码、引用优先生成、无证据标记、人工验证、四级合规和范围契约等概念。作者还提出了AIH-Infra三层参考实现，并在29卷康德学院版知识库上进行了案例研究，展示了可追溯性如何支持检索纠正、证据评级和判断降级。
Motivation: 生成式AI可以快速生成看似学术的文本，但流畅性不等于有效解释。最深的风险不仅是事实错误，而是没有明确来源、页码、版本或证据的陈述被当作已确立的解释。因此需要可追溯性作为人文研究在AI时代保持公共性和可反驳性的条件。
Method: 提出了可追溯学术框架，包括页面锚点、双页码、引用优先生成、NO_EVIDENCE标记、人工验证、四级合规和范围契约，并构建了AIH-Infra三层参考实现：Contexture（文档结构化）、Open WebUI AIH-Infra（可追溯知识库）和AIH-Infra MCP Server（代理网关）。
Result: 通过一个29卷康德学院版知识库的案例研究，展示了可追溯性如何支持检索纠正、证据评级和判断降级。
Conclusion: 可追溯性不是一个软件特性，而是生成式AI时代人文研究能够保持公共性和可反驳性的条件。

papers.title: Three-Pronged Spectral Control for Federated Parameter Efficient Fine Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables communication-efficient adaptation of large pretrained models on decentralized edge data, but it remains fragile under non-IID client heterogeneity. In low-rank adaptation (LoRA), different clients may learn locally useful but spectrally misaligned update subspaces, causing high-variance aggregation and poor global transfer. We propose TRISHUL, a spectral-control framework for robust federated PEFT. TRISHUL follows the FL no-raw-data-sharing setting but does not itself provide formal privacy guarantees. TRISHUL uses shared frozen multi-head low-rank bases to obtain algebraically exact aggregation of compact core updates, applies nuclear norm proximal shrinkage to suppress client-specific high-rank spectral components before upload, and allocates adaptation heads non-uniformly across layers using a concave water filling budget rule derived from pretrained layer capacity. Because shrinkage is performed only on small core matrices, TRISHUL adds negligible computation and no extra per-round communication over the underlying multi-head PEFT protocol. Across vision and language benchmarks, including CIFAR-100, SVHN, 20 Newsgroups, MRQA, and GLUE with LLaMA3.2-1B, TRISHUL improves convergence, stability, and final performance over federated LoRA baselines, with greater gains under stronger heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦参数高效微调（PEFT）中客户端数据异质性导致的子空间不匹配问题，提出TRISHUL光谱控制框架。TRISHUL通过共享冻结的多头低秩基、核范数近端收缩以及凹水填充分配规则，实现紧凑核心更新的精确聚合。在图像和语言基准上，TRISHUL相比联邦LoRA基线提升了收敛速度、稳定性和最终性能，且在强异质性下增益更明显。
Motivation: 联邦PEFT在非独立同分布客户端异质性下脆弱，不同客户端在低秩适配（LoRA）中学习到局部有用但光谱不一致的更新子空间，导致高方差聚合和差全局迁移。
Method: 提出TRISHUL框架：1）共享冻结的多头低秩基，实现紧凑核心更新的代数精确聚合；2）上传前对核心矩阵施加核范数近端收缩，抑制客户端特定的高秩光谱成分；3）基于预训练层容量导出的凹水填充预算规则，非均匀分配适配头。
Result: 在CIFAR-100、SVHN、20 Newsgroups、MRQA、GLUE（LLaMA3.2-1B）等视觉和语言基准上，TRISHUL改善了收敛、稳定性和最终性能，强异质性下增益更显著。
Conclusion: TRISHUL不提供正式隐私保证，但通过光谱控制有效提升了联邦PEFT的鲁棒性，且仅增加可忽略的计算开销，无额外通信成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Source-Prior-Driven Selective Adaptation for Efficient Diffusion Model Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning large diffusion models for new domains or styles involves a trade-off: improving target-specific generation often degrades the pretrained model's broad generative capability. Existing full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods typically handle this trade-off only implicitly. In this work, we propose a novel source-prior-driven selective adaptation method to efficiently fine-tune diffusion models, achieving a favorable trade-off. Our method relies on two key observations: (1) the loss of general generative capability is highly inconsistent across pretrained parameters, and (2) parameters that have a relatively small impact on the model's general generative capability remain structurally inconsistent across layers and parameter types. Motivated by these observations, we first learn a static mask to explicitly identify parameters better suited for downstream adaptation, and then construct structured update strategies for the selected subset. Experiments show that our method achieves a better adaptation-retention trade-off than existing strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种源先验驱动的选择性适应方法，用于高效微调扩散模型，在保持预训练模型通用生成能力的同时提升目标域生成质量。方法基于两个观察：通用生成能力的损失在预训练参数上高度不一致，且对通用能力影响较小的参数在层间和参数类型间存在结构不一致。通过学习静态掩码选择更适合下游适应的参数，并构建结构化更新策略。实验表明比现有基线取得更好的适应-保留权衡。
Motivation: 微调大型扩散模型时，提升目标域生成能力往往会损害预训练模型的广泛生成能力，现有方法大多隐式处理这一权衡。
Method: 提出源先验驱动的选择性适应方法：首先学习一个静态掩码，显式识别对下游适应更合适的参数；然后为选中的参数子集构建结构化更新策略。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在适应性和保留预训练能力之间取得了比现有强基线更好的权衡。
Conclusion: 本文提出的选择性适应方法能有效改善扩散模型微调中的适应-保留权衡。

papers.title: RadioTrace: Transmitter-Aware Diffusion for Radio Map Estimation without Deployment-Time Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Radio map (RM) estimation aims to reconstruct the spatial distribution of wireless signal characteristics, such as received signal strength (RSS), from sparse measurements, a task that is critical for spectrum management, interference mitigation, and localization in modern wireless networks. Traditional approaches, including interpolation and deep learning, either struggle to capture complex propagation effects or require large-scale retraining for each new sampling pattern, which limits their generalization. More recently, prior-based methods have combined pre-trained generative models with measurements to reduce the need for deployment-time model fine-tuning, but they typically treat the prior as a simple regularizer and lack explicit transmitter-aware integration. In this paper, we propose RadioTrace, a novel RM estimation framework without deployment-time fine-tuning that tightly integrates sparse RSS measurements with a frozen pre-trained diffusion prior. RadioTrace incorporates transmitter (Tx) location estimation directly into the denoising loop, iteratively refining Tx coordinates based on reconstruction quality to guide the generative process. To further enhance robustness, we introduce a propagation-guided K-means initialization that mitigates poor local minima in the Tx update and provides a geometry-consistent starting point. Moreover, we provide a stochastic stability analysis for the Tx-coordinate refinement component, showing that the Tx update remains stable under perturbations induced by diffusion sampling and Tx-map relaxation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RadioTrace achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art learning-based methods under random sampling, and maintains strong reconstruction quality under restricted-area sampling, highlighting its adaptability, robustness, and practical relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RadioTrace，一种无需部署时微调的无线电地图估计框架，将稀疏接收信号强度测量与冻结的预训练扩散先验紧密结合，并通过发射机位置估计和传播引导的K-means初始化提升鲁棒性和重建质量。实验表明其在随机采样和受限区域采样下均能取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有无线电地图估计方法或难以捕捉复杂传播效应，或需要针对每个新采样模式进行大规模重训练，泛化能力有限。基于先验的方法将先验作为简单正则化项，缺乏显式的发射机感知集成。
Method: RadioTrace将发射机位置估计直接融入去噪循环，根据重建质量迭代优化发射机坐标以引导生成过程；并引入传播引导的K-means初始化避免局部最优，提供几何一致的起始点。此外给出发射机坐标精化组件的随机稳定性分析。
Result: 在随机采样下，RadioTrace取得与最先进的基于学习方法相当的性能；在受限区域采样下仍保持强重建质量，展示了其适应性、鲁棒性和实际相关性。
Conclusion: RadioTrace无需部署时微调，通过紧密集成发射机位置估计与扩散先验，在多种采样场景下实现稳健的无线电地图估计，具有实用价值。

papers.title: Multi-turn RL with Structural and Performance Aware Rewards for CUDA Kernel Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful technique to enhance the reasoning capacity of LLMs for optimized code generation. However, existing RLVR approaches primarily rely on outcome-based signals such as correctness and speedup, overlooking performance-critical structural properties of programs that are essential for generating optimized code. In this work, we propose CudaPerf, a reflective RL framework that incorporates both verifiable execution rewards and structural code-aware rewards derived from parallelization features (e.g., memory coalescing, occupancy, Arithmatic Intensity, and synchronization patterns). CudaPerf operates in two stages: (1) an offline pairwise ranking module that learns to distinguish strong and weak program candidates via contrastive comparisons, and (2) an online RL training phase that jointly optimizes for correctness, performance, and structural efficiency through a unified reward signal. To further enhance learning, CudaPerf utilizes iterative refinement using execution feedback enabling progressive improvement of generated candidates. We also introduce a dataset comprising 2.9k C to CUDA and 1k PyTorch to CUDA programs, each paired with diverse input configurations and multiple CUDA implementations encompassing diverse optimization strategies. CudaPerf is evaluated across multiple benchmarks comprising both C to CUDA and PyTorch to CUDA transformations. Empirical findings suggest that CudaPerf significantly outperforms strong baselines, including Qwen-3-32B (for C to CUDA) and CUDA Agent (for PyTorch to CUDA) by achieving up to 5X & 3.32X improvements in speedup, and 17% & 7% improvements in correctness, respectively.

papers.title: Sidewalk Moments: Are Richer Representations Always More Human-Aligned? Evidence from City-Walk Videos
papers.abstract_en: We examine whether richer visual representations yield more human-aligned measures of urban engagement, using 61 first-person city-walk videos from YouTube segmented into over 50,000 ten-second clips and represented across four modalities: spatiotemporal video features, temporally averaged images (TAIs), audio embeddings, and text-based semantic descriptions. Spearman correlation analysis reveals the expected ordering along the temporal-richness continuum, with video features showing the strongest continuous alignment. However, this ordering breaks down under binary classification of high- versus low-engagement moments (the paradigm most commonly used to train perceptual scoring models), where TAIs consistently match or outperform video across most classifiers and quantile thresholds. An independent two-alternative forced-choice study on Amazon Mechanical Turk confirms that this parity reflects human judgment: participants identified engaging moments with comparable accuracy from TAIs and full video clips, while text performed substantially worse and audio remained near chance. Gap analysis reveals a functional dissociation: video features are advantaged in activity-driven scenes with dynamic content, whereas TAIs better align with human judgments in composition-driven scenes dominated by stable spatial structure. These findings challenge the assumption that richer representations are inherently more human-aligned, and suggest that perceptually grounded temporal compression can be a principled alternative to full video encoding.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 18 figures. Under review at Scientific Reports
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究更丰富的视觉表示是否更符合人类对齐，使用61段第一人称城市步行视频，通过四种模态（时空视频特征、时间平均图像、音频嵌入、文本描述）分析。Spearman相关分析显示视频特征沿时间丰富度连续体有最强对齐，但在二元分类任务中，时间平均图像（TAI）的表现匹配或超过视频。人工验证确认了这种等价性。结果挑战了“更丰富表示更对齐”的假设。
Motivation: 挑战直觉假设——更丰富的视觉表示（如完整视频）一定比压缩表示更符合人类判断，特别是在城市参与度（urban engagement）的衡量上。
Method: 使用61段YouTube城市步行视频，分割成超过5万个10秒片段，提取四种表示：时空视频特征、时间平均图像（TAI）、音频嵌入、文本语义描述。进行Spearman相关分析和二元分类实验，并通过亚马逊土耳其机器人进行人类判断实验。
Result: 在连续对齐上视频特征最强，但在二元分类（高/低参与度）中TAI匹配或超越视频；人类判断实验确认TAI与全视频准确性相当，文本更差，音频接近随机；差距分析显示视频在活动驱动场景中占优，TAI在构成驱动场景中更对齐。
Conclusion: 研究发现更丰富的表示不一定更符合人类对齐，感知驱动的时间压缩（如TAI）可以是全视频编码的原则性替代。

papers.title: Anti-Goal Reasoning: Rethinking the Theory of Goal Reasoning in Non-Axiomatic Logic
papers.abstract_en: Goal reasoning in Non-Axiomatic Logic (NAL) explains how an adaptive system derives means for realizing desired events under insufficient knowledge and resources. However, the representation of avoidance is less clear. A common convention is to express ``avoid $G$'' as the goal sentence ``$\neg G!$'', but this notation conflates two different readings: pursuing the negated event $\neg G$, and avoiding the positive event $G$. This paper shows that the conflation can produce a paradoxical case in which an avoidance intention is converted into a positive goal to act merely because acting is usually followed by the absence of hurt. Starting from NAL's basic definition of goals, the framework is extended with a corresponding definition of anti-goals, so that avoidance can be represented without treating it as the pursuit of a negated event. Finally, a mental operation, $\op{prevent}$, is introduced to connect anti-goal reasoning with ordinary goal reasoning in cases of active prevention. Four minimal case studies check that the resulting rules distinguish pursuit, passive avoidance, active prevention, and withholding action to preserve a desired event.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在非公理逻辑（NAL）中重新审视目标推理理论，指出将“避免G”表示为“¬G!”会混淆追求否定事件与避免肯定事件，并导致悖论。作者扩展了NAL的目标定义，引入反目标（anti-goal）和预防操作（prevent），并通过四个案例验证了新框架能正确区分追求、被动避免、主动预防和保留行动。
Motivation: 在非公理逻辑的目标推理中，避免（avoidance）的表示存在模糊性，将“避免G”简单地表示为追求¬G会导致矛盾，即把避免意图转化为追求行动。
Method: 从NAL的基础目标定义出发，扩展出对应的反目标定义，使避免不再被视为追求否定事件；并引入心理操作prevent，将反目标推理与普通目标推理在主动预防场景中联系起来。
Result: 通过四个最小案例研究验证，新规则能区分追求、被动避免、主动预防以及为保留期望事件而抑制行动。
Conclusion: 该框架解决了目标表示中的悖论，为NAL中的避免行为提供了更清晰的理论基础，但案例规模较小，需进一步扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DINO-VPT: Hierarchical Visual Prompt Tuning for Joint Physical-Digital Face Anti-Spoofing
papers.abstract_en: With the increasing diversity of spoofing attacks, there is a growing demand for unified Face Anti-Spoofing (FAS) models capable of detecting both physical and digital threats. While existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate high generalization in this context, they heavily rely on complex multimodal fusion and external text encoders. In this paper, we propose DINO-VPT, a lightweight, vision-only framework leveraging hierarchical visual prompt tuning. By dynamically injecting prompts conditioned on input features via a Prompt Routing Network (PRN), our method effectively disentangles diverse spoofing artifacts without requiring multimodal fusion. Evaluations on the UniAttackData benchmark demonstrate that DINO-VPT achieves higher accuracy than state-of-the-art VLM-based methods. Our results indicate that a properly structured vision-only architecture can achieve state-of-the-art performance in unified FAS without the need for multimodal supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DINO-VPT，一种轻量级纯视觉框架，通过层次化视觉提示调优（visual prompt tuning）实现联合物理-数字人脸防伪（Face Anti-Spoofing, FAS）。方法利用提示路由网络（PRN）根据输入特征动态注入提示，无需多模态融合，在UniAttackData基准上达到了比现有基于VLM的方法更高的准确率。
Motivation: 现有统一人脸防伪模型多依赖复杂的多模态融合和外部文本编码器，存在计算开销大的问题，且面对物理与数字攻击的多样性时泛化能力受限。
Method: 提出DINO-VPT框架，基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的视觉编码器DINOv2，引入层次化视觉提示调优：通过提示路由网络（PRN）根据输入特征动态生成条件提示，逐层注入以解耦不同欺骗伪影，完全摒弃多模态融合。
Result: 在UniAttackData基准上，DINO-VPT取得了比现有最先进的基于VLM的方法更高的准确率，表明纯视觉架构在统一人脸防伪中能够达到与多模态方法相当甚至更优的性能。
Conclusion: 结果表明，通过精心设计的纯视觉架构（如层次化视觉提示调优）可以在统一人脸防伪任务中达到最先进性能，无需多模态监督。

papers.title: MAGE-Vein: Multi-Instance Age and Gender Estimation from Finger Vein Images
papers.abstract_en: Age estimation from finger vein images has been widely considered impractical due to severe demographic biases in public datasets and physiological confounding factors like gender. To overcome these limitations, we propose MAGE-Vein, a novel multi-instance, multi-task learning framework. Our approach extracts robust structural aging signs by employing a hybrid feature-level fusion of three fingers, effectively suppressing local imaging noise. Furthermore, simultaneous optimization of gender classification conditions the network to effectively eliminate gender-specific vascular variations. Evaluated on a demographically balanced dataset of 402 subjects, MAGE-Vein achieves a mean absolute error of 6.12 years and a correlation of 0.880. Our results not only overturn the conventional consensus regarding the limitations of the finger vein modality but also demonstrate that previous estimation failures were primarily artifacts of biased public datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/gsisaoki/MAGE-Vein.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAGE-Vein，一种多实例多任务学习框架，用于从手指静脉图像估计年龄和性别。通过融合三个手指的特征并联合优化性别分类，有效抑制局部噪声和性别特异性血管变异。在平衡数据集上，年龄估计平均绝对误差为6.12年，相关性0.880，表明手指静脉模态可用于年龄估计，以往失败主要由于数据集偏差。
Motivation: 手指静脉图像的年龄估计被认为不可行，因为公开数据集存在严重人口统计偏差和性别等生理混淆因素。
Method: 采用多实例、多任务学习框架，对三个手指进行特征级融合，同时优化性别分类以消除性别特异性血管变化。
Result: 在402名受试者的平衡数据集上，年龄估计平均绝对误差为6.12年，相关系数0.880。
Conclusion: 研究颠覆了手指静脉模态无法用于年龄估计的传统观点，并指出先前失败主要源于偏差的公开数据集。

papers.title: HierarchicalDAEW: Domain-Aware Edge-Weighted Graph Convolution with Evidential Uncertainty for Multi-Section Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from H&E Histology
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics assays remain costly and technically demanding, restricting transcriptome-wide profiling to specialist settings and preventing routine clinical deployment. Predicting spatially resolved gene expression from H&E histology could close this gap, yet current methods largely ignore the underlying tissue architecture and rarely quantify how their predictions can be trusted. We introduce HierarchicalDAEW, a dual-graph architecture that addresses both gaps. On the spot graph, a Domain-Aware Edge-Weighted convolutional operator learns separate projections for inter-domain, intra-domain, and boundary edges derived from Leiden clustering, allowing the model to treat tissue heterogeneity as an explicit structural signal rather than an implicit one. A second gene-level graph then fuses protein-protein interaction priors from STRING-DB with tissue-specific co-expression through learned attention gating, propagating predictions from a landmark gene set to a broader gene panel. Reliability is handled through evidential uncertainty estimation, which produces far better calibrated confidence intervals than Monte Carlo dropout under identical conditions. Across six human Visium sections spanning breast, colorectal, prostate, and cerebellar tissue, and against thirteen published baselines, HierarchicalDAEW achieves the strongest correlation with ground-truth expression, with gains that hold up under multi-seed reproducibility checks and negative controls that rule out positional shortcuts. Ablations further confirm that both the domain-aware edge typing and the hierarchical depth are necessary to this improvement, and calibrated uncertainty estimates identify low-confidence predictions for pathologist review before clinical action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HierarchicalDAEW，一种双图架构，用于从H&E组织学图像预测空间基因表达。该方法通过域感知边缘加权卷积处理组织异质性，并利用证据不确定性估计提供校准的置信区间。在六个Visium切片上，与十三个基线相比，取得了与真实表达最强的相关性，并验证了域感知边缘类型和层次深度的必要性。
Motivation: 空间转录组学成本高且技术要求高，限制了其临床部署。现有预测方法忽视组织架构，且缺乏预测可信度量化。
Method: 提出HierarchicalDAEW：在点图上使用域感知边缘加权卷积，区分域间、域内和边界边；在基因图上融合STRING-DB蛋白互作先验和组织特异性共表达；通过证据不确定性估计提供校准的置信区间。
Result: 在六个Visium切片（乳腺、结直肠、前列腺、小脑）上，与十三个基线相比，取得与真实表达最强的相关性，多种子可重复性检查和阴性对照验证了鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 域感知边缘类型和层次深度对性能提升必要，校准的不确定性估计可识别低置信度预测以供病理学家审查。

papers.title: Is Deep Research Reliable? Misleading Knowledge Induces False Conclusions
papers.abstract_en: Deep Research agents extend LLM-based assistants into long-horizon workflows involving planning, retrieval, evidence synthesis, and report generation, yet their reliability in open information environments remains underexplored. A key concern is whether apparently credible but factually misleading knowledge encountered in such environments can propagate through these workflows and be adopted as false conclusions in final reports. To study this failure mode, we introduce MisKnow-Agent, a framework for constructing and validating misleading knowledge for Deep Research tasks. MisKnow-Agent generates misleading instances with controllable authority levels and styles, yielding 5,933 quality-controlled instances built on DeepResearch Benchmark tasks. Extensive experiments across open-source and closed-source Deep Research agents show that even limited exposure to misleading knowledge can induce false-conclusion adoption in final reports, revealing a broad reliability vulnerability in current Deep Research agents. Although search-enabled verifier models consistently identify the retained instances as misleading during focused corpus validation, the same instances can still be adopted during long-horizon research, revealing a disconnect between focused verification and workflow-level evidence use. Finally, we evaluate pre- and post-research defenses, both individually and in combination, finding that all three configurations mitigate but do not fully prevent false-conclusion adoption. Our findings suggest that reliable Deep Research requires evidence verification and correction capabilities at both the model and framework levels, beyond improvements in planning, retrieval, evidence integration, or report-generation abilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Deep Research智能体在开放信息环境中的可靠性，发现即使少量误导性知识也会导致最终报告采用错误结论。作者提出MisKnow-Agent框架生成可控的误导实例，并通过实验揭示当前智能体存在广泛漏洞。搜索增强验证模型虽能在聚焦验证时识别误导，但在长周期工作流中仍可能被采用。
Motivation: Deep Research智能体在开放环境中可能遇到看似可信但事实错误的信息，这些信息如何通过规划、检索、证据合成等流程传播并最终导致错误结论尚不清楚。
Method: 提出MisKnow-Agent框架，用于构建和验证Deep Research任务中的误导性知识，生成5,933个质量受控的实例，并在开源和闭源Deep Research智能体上进行实验。
Result: 实验表明，即使少量误导性知识也会导致最终报告采用错误结论；搜索增强验证模型在聚焦语料验证时能识别误导，但在长周期研究中仍可能被采用；三种防御配置（单独及组合）能缓解但不能完全防止错误结论。
Conclusion: 可靠的Deep Research需要在模型和框架层面具备证据验证与纠正能力，而不仅是改进规划、检索、证据整合或报告生成能力。
