papers.title: NeuraLSP: A Neural Spectral Preconditioner for Accelerating PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Solving large-scale sparse linear systems originating from partial differential equations (PDEs) is a fundamental topic in high-performance scientific computing, where preconditioners are crucial. Multigrid methods are among the most effective preconditioners, yet their performance is dictated by the accurate construction of grid transfer operators. Current neural multigrid methods learn such operators with graph neural networks (GNNs), typically by extracting connectivity from discretized system matrices. While effective, these graph-based constructions suffer from rank inflation, resulting in unnecessarily large coarse spaces and slower convergence. To ameliorate, this paper advocates NeuraLSP, a new neural multigrid preconditioner that replaces graph aggregation with a fixed low-rank spectral representation derived from the left singular subspace of near-nullspace components. At the network design level, NeuraLSP is trained with a novel subspace loss function, which preserves the error modes most relevant to multigrid convergence while suppressing rank inflation. This paper's grand innovation hinges upon both theoretical guarantees and empirical robustness to rank inflation, affording up to a 53% speedup over SOTA neural preconditioners across a variety of PDE families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NeuraLSP，一种新的神经多网格预条件子，用低秩谱表示替代图聚合，解决现有神经预条件子的秩膨胀问题，在多种PDE族上相比SOTA神经预条件子实现最高53%的加速。
Motivation: 现有神经多网格预条件子使用图神经网络学习网格传输算子，但图结构导致秩膨胀，粗空间过大，收敛变慢。
Method: NeuraLSP从近零空间分量的左奇异子空间构造固定低秩谱表示，并采用新的子空间损失函数训练，保留对多网格收敛关键的错误模式，抑制秩膨胀。
Result: 在多种PDE族上，NeuraLSP相比SOTA神经预条件子实现高达53%的加速，且具有理论保证和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: NeuraLSP通过谱方法替代图聚合，有效缓解秩膨胀，为加速PDE求解器提供新的神经预条件子设计思路。

papers.title: Knowledge-Guided Time-Varying Causal Inference for Arctic Sea Ice Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying the causal relationship between sea ice thickness and sea surface height (SSH) is essential for understanding the mechanisms driving polar climate dynamics. Conventional deep learning models often struggle with treatment effect estimation in climate settings due to time-varying confounding and the lack of physical constraints. To address these challenges, we propose the Knowledge-Guided Causal Model Variational Autoencoder (KGCM-VAE) to quantify the effect of SSH on sea ice thickness. The framework leverages established physical relationships between SSH and surface velocity to generate physically grounded, time-varying continuous treatments, where each treatment value can change at every time step within a sequence. The model also incorporates Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to balance treated and control distributions in the latent space, mitigating observed confounding bias. Using synthetic data, we evaluated the model's ability to predict sea ice thickness responses under hypothetical SSH forcing scenarios, demonstrating that KGCM-VAE achieves lower PEHE compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Ablation studies further confirm that MMD consistently enhances treatment effect estimation over the base model. Additionally, we conducted a real-world case study to examine the sensitivity of sea ice thickness to SSH forcing and validate our findings against existing physical modeling results.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication at ECML PKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识引导因果模型变分自编码器 (KGCM-VAE)，用于量化海面高度 (SSH) 对海冰厚度的因果效应。模型利用 SSH 与表面速度的物理关系生成时变连续处理，并采用最大均值差异 (MMD) 平衡潜在空间中的处理组与对照组分布，以减轻时变混杂偏差。在合成数据上，KGCM-VAE 的 PEHE 优于基线；消融实验证实 MMD 的提升效果。真实案例研究验证了海冰厚度对 SSH 强迫的敏感性。
Motivation: 传统深度学习模型在气候环境中估计处理效应时，难以处理时变混杂和缺乏物理约束，导致因果推断不准确。
Method: 提出 KGCM-VAE，利用 SSH 与表面速度的物理关系生成时变连续处理，并使用 MMD 平衡潜在表示中的分布，从而消除观测混杂。
Result: 在合成数据上，KGCM-VAE 的 PEHE 低于多个基线；消融实验表明 MMD 一致提升了处理效应估计。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效量化海冰厚度与 SSH 的因果关系，且与现有物理建模结果一致。

papers.title: Non-Stationary Functional Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Functional bilevel optimization (FBO) provides a powerful framework for hierarchical learning in function spaces, yet current methods are limited to static offline settings and perform suboptimally in online, non-stationary scenarios. We propose SmoothFBO, the first algorithm for non-stationary FBO with both theoretical guarantees and practical scalability. SmoothFBO introduces a time-smoothed stochastic hypergradient estimator that reduces variance through a window parameter, enabling stable outer-loop updates with sublinear regret. Importantly, the classical parametric bilevel case is a special reduction of our framework, making SmoothFBO a natural extension to online, non-stationary settings. Empirically, SmoothFBO consistently outperforms existing FBO methods in non-stationary hyperparameter optimization and model-based reinforcement learning, demonstrating its practical effectiveness. Together, these results establish SmoothFBO as a general, theoretically grounded, and practically viable foundation for bilevel optimization in online, non-stationary scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳函数双层优化（Functional Bilevel Optimization, FBO）问题，提出SmoothFBO，首个同时具备理论保证和实际可扩展性的算法。通过引入时间平滑的随机超梯度估计器，利用窗口参数降低方差，实现外环更新的亚线性遗憾（sublinear regret）。实验在非平稳超参数优化和基于模型的强化学习中优于现有FBO方法。
Motivation: 现有函数双层优化方法局限于静态离线设置，无法有效应对在线非平稳场景，性能次优。
Method: 提出SmoothFBO算法，通过时间平滑随机超梯度估计器（带窗口参数）降低方差，支持稳定外环更新，并证明亚线性遗憾界。经典参数化双层优化是该框架的特例。
Result: 在非平稳超参数优化和基于模型的强化学习任务中，SmoothFBO持续优于现有FBO方法，验证了实际有效性。
Conclusion: SmoothFBO为非平稳函数双层优化提供了通用、有理论依据且实用的基础。

papers.title: Backpropagation-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Lightweight EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) face significant deployment challenges due to inter-subject variability, signal non-stationarity, and computational constraints. While test-time adaptation (TTA) mitigates distribution shifts under online data streams without per-use calibration sessions, existing TTA approaches heavily rely on explicitly defined loss objectives that require backpropagation for updating model parameters, which incurs computational overhead, privacy risks, and sensitivity to noisy data streams. This paper proposes Backpropagation-Free Transformations (BFT), a TTA approach for EEG decoding that eliminates such issues. BFT applies multiple sample-wise transformations of knowledge-guided augmentations or approximate Bayesian inference to each test trial, generating multiple prediction scores for a single test sample. A learning-to-rank module enhances the weighting of these predictions, enabling robust aggregation for uncertainty suppression during inference under theoretical justifications. Extensive experiments on five EEG datasets of motor imagery classification and driver drowsiness regression tasks demonstrate the effectiveness, versatility, robustness, and efficiency of BFT. This research enables lightweight plug-and-play BCIs on resource-constrained devices, broadening the real-world deployment of decoding algorithms for EEG-based BCI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对脑电信号（EEG）解码中的测试时自适应（TTA）问题，提出无需反向传播的变换方法（BFT）。BFT通过样本级的变换生成多个预测分数，并使用学习排序模块进行加权聚合，从而抑制不确定性。在五个EEG数据集（运动想象分类和驾驶员困倦回归）上的实验证明了其有效性、鲁棒性和效率。
Motivation: 现有TTA方法依赖反向传播更新模型参数，计算开销大、有隐私风险且对噪声敏感，不适合资源受限的脑机接口（BCI）部署。
Method: 提出BFT方法，对每个测试样本应用多种知识引导的增强或近似贝叶斯推断变换，生成多个预测分数，再通过学习排序模块优化加权聚合，无需反向传播。
Result: 在五个EEG数据集上的实验表明，BFT在运动想象分类和驾驶员困倦回归任务中有效、鲁棒且高效。
Conclusion: BFT实现了轻量级即插即用的BCI，适用于资源受限设备，扩大了EEG解码算法的实际部署范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vision-Language-Policy Model for Dynamic Robot Task Planning
papers.abstract_en: Bridging the gap between natural language commands and autonomous execution in unstructured environments remains an open challenge for robotics. This requires robots to perceive and reason over the current task scene through multiple modalities, and to plan their behaviors to achieve their intended goals. Traditional robotic task-planning approaches often struggle to bridge low-level execution with high-level task reasoning, and cannot dynamically update task strategies when instructions change during execution, which ultimately limits their versatility and adaptability to new tasks. In this work, we propose a novel language model-based framework for dynamic robot task planning. Our Vision-Language-Policy (VLP) model, based on a vision-language model fine-tuned on real-world data, can interpret semantic instructions and integrate reasoning over the current task scene to generate behavior policies that control the robot to accomplish the task. Moreover, it can dynamically adjust the task strategy in response to changes in the task, enabling flexible adaptation to evolving task requirements. Experiments conducted with different robots and a variety of real-world tasks show that the trained model can efficiently adapt to novel scenarios and dynamically update its policy, demonstrating strong planning autonomy and cross-embodiment generalization. Videos: https://robovlp.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的机器人动态任务规划框架VLP模型，通过微调真实世界数据，使机器人能够理解自然语言指令并推理当前场景，生成行为策略以完成任务。实验表明该模型能高效适应新场景并动态更新策略，展现强规划自主性和跨实体泛化能力。
Motivation: 传统机器人任务规划方法难以连接低级执行与高级任务推理，且无法在指令变化时动态更新任务策略，限制了其适应性和通用性。
Method: 提出Vision-Language-Policy (VLP)模型，基于视觉-语言模型在真实世界数据上微调，可解释语义指令并整合当前场景推理，生成控制策略；同时能动态调整任务策略以响应任务变化。
Result: 在多种机器人及真实世界任务中，VLP模型能高效适应新场景并动态更新策略，展示了强规划自主性和跨实体泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该框架弥合了自然语言指令与自主执行之间的鸿沟，实现了动态任务规划。

papers.title: Trainable Log-linear Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) set the state of the art in visual generation, yet their quadratic self-attention cost fundamentally limits scaling to long token sequences. Recent Top-K sparse attention approaches reduce the computation of DiTs by compressing tokens into block-wise representation and selecting a small set of relevant key blocks, but still suffer from (i) quadratic selection cost on compressed tokens and (ii) increasing K required to maintain model quality as sequences grow. We identify that their inefficiency is due to the single-level design, as a single coarse level is insufficient to represent the global structure. In this paper, we introduce Log-linear Sparse Attention (LLSA), a trainable sparse attention mechanism for extremely long token sequences that reduces both selection and attention costs from quadratic to log-linear complexity by utilizing a hierarchical structure. LLSA performs hierarchical Top-K selection, progressively adopting sparse Top-K selection with the indices found at the previous level, and introduces a Hierarchical KV Enrichment mechanism that preserves global context while using fewer tokens of different granularity during attention computation. To support efficient training, we develop a high-performance GPU implementation that uses only sparse indices for both the forward and backward passes, eliminating the need for dense attention masks. We evaluate LLSA on high-resolution pixel-space image generation without using patchification and VAE encoding. LLSA accelerates attention inference by 28.27x and DiT training by 6.09x on 256x256 pixel token sequences, while maintaining generation quality. The results demonstrate that LLSA offers a promising direction for training long-sequence DiTs efficiently. Code is available at: https://github.com/SingleZombie/LLSA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Log-linear Sparse Attention (LLSA)，一种可训练的分层稀疏注意力机制，用于扩散 Transformer (DiT) 中极长序列的高效处理。LLSA 通过分层 Top-K 选择和层级 KV 增强，将选择与注意力计算复杂度从二次降至对数线性。在高分辨率像素空间图像生成任务中，LLSA 在 256x256 像素序列上实现注意力推理加速 28.27 倍、训练加速 6.09 倍，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 的自注意力计算量随序列长度二次增长，现有 Top-K 稀疏注意力方法在压缩 token 后仍存在二次选择成本，且随序列增长所需 K 值增大，效率下降。
Method: 提出 LLSA，利用分层结构进行分层 Top-K 选择，逐步采用上层索引进行稀疏选择；引入分层 KV 增强机制，在注意力计算中使用不同粒度且更少的 token 保留全局上下文；开发高性能 GPU 实现，仅使用稀疏索引进行前向和反向传播。
Result: 在 256x256 像素序列上，LLSA 加速注意力推理 28.27 倍，训练 6.09 倍，且生成质量保持。
Conclusion: LLSA 为高效训练长序列扩散 Transformer 提供了有前景的方向。

papers.title: Boltzmann generators for amorphous particle systems
papers.abstract_en: Sampling configurations in thermodynamic equilibrium is a long-standing challenge in statistical physics. Boltzmann generators address this problem by employing generative models to propose independent configurations, which are then reweighted via importance sampling using exact likelihood evaluations. Recent Boltzmann Generators based on continuous normalizing flows and flow matching have achieved significant success for particle systems and biomolecules. However, these approaches have not been extended to amorphous materials (glasses), for which equilibrium sampling is notoriously slow. Because of their disordered structure, the invariances and geometrical constraints of amorphous materials differ from those of crystals and biomolecules, preventing the direct use of existing generative models. Here, we develop Boltzmann Generators tailored to amorphous materials by building the required equivariances directly into Riemannian stochastic interpolants. Our framework incorporates periodic boundary conditions and particle symmetries using equivariant graph neural networks. Numerical experiments demonstrate that enforcing physical symmetries significantly improves the accuracy of Boltzmann Generators, but also reveal an intrinsic limitation of the continuous-flow formulation: accumulated numerical errors during likelihood integration break time-reversibility, compromising exact thermodynamic reweighting. These results reveal a fundamental challenge for continuous-flow generative models in statistical mechanics and call for alternative approaches that preserve exact thermodynamic consistency.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 10 figures. V2 considerably expands the results compared to v1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非晶材料（如玻璃）中热力学平衡采样的缓慢问题，将玻尔兹曼生成器扩展到非晶粒子系统。通过构建黎曼随机插值（Riemannian stochastic interpolants）并融入等变图神经网络来满足周期性边界条件和粒子对称性。实验表明引入物理对称性能显著提升生成器精度，但也揭示了连续流公式的固有局限：似然积分中的累积数值误差破坏时间可逆性，从而损害精确热力学重加权。
Motivation: 非晶材料（玻璃）的平衡采样在统计物理中极具挑战，现有基于连续归一化流和流匹配的玻尔兹曼生成器适用于晶体和生物分子，但因非晶材料的无序结构和不同的几何约束无法直接使用。
Method: 提出针对非晶材料的玻尔兹曼生成器：将所需等变性直接构建到黎曼随机插值中，并使用等变图神经网络处理周期性边界条件和粒子对称性。
Result: 数值实验证明强制物理对称性显著提升了玻尔兹曼生成器的精度，但同时发现连续流公式中似然积分的数值误差破坏了时间可逆性，导致无法进行精确热力学重加权。
Conclusion: 揭示了连续流生成模型在统计力学中面临的基本挑战——保持精确热力学一致性，呼吁开发替代方法。

papers.title: SuperFlow: Training Flow Matching Models with RL on the Fly
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in flow-based generative models and reinforcement learning (RL) has improved text-image alignment and visual quality. However, current RL training for flow models still has two main problems: (i) GRPO-style fixed per-prompt group sizes ignore variation in sampling importance across prompts, which leads to inefficient sampling and slower training; and (ii) trajectory-level advantages are reused as per-step estimates, which biases credit assignment along the flow. We propose SuperFlow, an RL training framework for flow-based models that adjusts group sizes with variance-aware sampling and computes step-level advantages in a way that is consistent with continuous-time flow dynamics. Empirically, SuperFlow reaches promising performance while using only 5.4% to 56.3% of the original training steps and reduces training time by 5.2% to 16.7% without any architectural changes. On standard text-to-image (T2I) tasks, including text rendering, compositional image generation, and human preference alignment, SuperFlow improves over SD3.5-M by 4.6% to 47.2%, and over Flow-GRPO by 1.7% to 16.0%.
papers.comment: This article is withdrawn because it was submitted to arXiv without obtaining the consent of all listed authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SuperFlow，一个用于流模型的强化学习训练框架，通过方差感知采样调整组大小和计算与连续时间流动力学一致的步级优势，解决GRPO风格训练中的低效采样和信用分配偏差问题。摘要报告SuperFlow在标准文本到图像任务上提升显著，同时大幅减少训练步骤和时间。注意：本文已被撤回，因为未经所有列名作者同意提交到arXiv。
Motivation: 当前流模型的强化学习训练存在两个问题：固定每提示组大小忽略不同提示的采样重要性差异，导致低效采样和慢训练；轨迹级优势被复用为逐步估计，造成信用分配偏差。
Method: 提出SuperFlow框架，采用方差感知采样动态调整每提示的组大小，并计算与连续时间流动力学一致的步级优势，避免偏差。
Result: 使用原训练步骤的5.4%至56.3%即达到有竞争力性能，训练时间减少5.2%至16.7%。在文本渲染、组合图像生成和人偏好对齐等标准文本到图像任务上，相比SD3.5-M提升4.6%至47.2%，相比Flow-GRPO提升1.7%至16.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SuperFlow在无需架构改动下显著提升训练效率和性能，但论文已被撤回。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Critical Thinking in Generative Artificial Intelligence Use: Development, Validation, and Correlates of the Critical Thinking in AI Use Scale
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI tools are increasingly embedded in everyday work and learning, yet their fluency, opacity, and propensity to hallucinate mean that users must critically evaluate AI outputs rather than accept them at face value. The present research conceptualises critical thinking in AI use as a dispositional tendency to verify the source and content of AI-generated information, to understand how models work and where they fail, and to reflect on the broader implications of relying on AI. Across six studies (N = 1341), we developed and validated the 13-item critical thinking in AI use scale and mapped its nomological network. Study 1 generated and content-validated scale items. Study 2 supported a three-factor structure (Verification, Motivation, and Reflection). Studies 3 and 4 confirmed the higher-order model, demonstrated strong factor loadings, internal consistency, sex invariance, convergent and discriminant evidence for validity, and showed that critical thinking in AI use was positively associated with openness, extraversion, positive trait affect, and frequency of AI use. Study 5 supported the scale's test-retest reliability. Lastly, Study 6 demonstrated criterion evidence of validity for the scale, with higher critical thinking in AI use scores predicting more frequent and diverse verification strategies, greater veracity judgement accuracy in a novel and naturalistic GPT-powered AI chatbot fact-checking task, and deeper reflection about responsible AI. The current work clarifies why and how people exercise oversight over generative AI outputs and provides a validated scale and ecologically grounded paradigm to support theory testing, cross-group, and longitudinal research on critical thinking in AI use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发并验证了AI使用中的批判性思维量表（13项），包含验证、动机和反思三个因子。通过六项研究（N=1341）证明量表具有良好的信效度，与开放性、外向性、积极情绪和AI使用频率正相关，并能预测更频繁的验证策略和更准确的事实判断。
Motivation: 生成式AI工具虽广泛应用，但其流畅性、不透明性和幻觉倾向要求用户进行批判性评估，而现有缺乏系统测量该能力的工具。
Method: 通过六项研究开发和验证量表：项目生成与内容验证（研究1）、因子结构探索（研究2）、高阶模型确认及信效度检验（研究3-4）、重测信度（研究5）、以及标准关联效度（研究6，含GPT事实核查任务）。
Result: 量表具有三因子结构，因子载荷高，内部一致性良好，性别不变性成立；与开放性、外向性、积极情绪和AI使用频率正相关；高分者使用更多验证策略，在事实核查任务中准确性更高，对负责任AI的反思更深。
Conclusion: 研究提供了理解用户如何监督AI输出的框架，并提供了一个经过验证的量表和生态范式，支持后续理论检验、跨群体和纵向研究。

papers.title: Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding for Error Span Detection in Reference-Free Automatic Machine Translation Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Error Span Detection (ESD) extends automatic machine translation (MT) evaluation by localizing translation errors and labeling their severity. Current generative ESD methods typically use Maximum a Posteriori (MAP) decoding, assuming that the model-estimated probabilities are perfectly correlated with similarity to the human annotation, but we often observe higher likelihood assigned to an incorrect annotation than to the human one. We instead apply Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding to generative ESD. We use a sentence- or span-level similarity function for MBR decoding, which selects candidate hypotheses based on their approximate similarity to the human annotation. Experimental results on the WMT24 Metrics Shared Task show that MBR decoding significantly improves span-level performance and generally matches or outperforms MAP at the system and sentence levels. To reduce the computational cost of MBR decoding, we further distill its decisions into a model decoded via greedy search, removing the inference-time latency bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无参考机器翻译评估中的错误跨度检测（Error Span Detection, ESD）任务，提出使用最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）解码替代传统的最大后验（MAP）解码。MBR解码通过句子级或跨度级相似度函数选择与人工标注更接近的假设，在WMT24 Metrics Shared Task中显著提升跨度级性能，并在系统和句子级匹配或优于MAP。为降低计算开销，作者进一步将MBR决策蒸馏到贪心搜索解码的模型中。
Motivation: 现有生成式ESD方法使用MAP解码，但模型估计的概率与人工标注的相似度并非完美相关，导致高似然假设反而错误。
Method: 将MBR解码应用于生成式ESD，采用句子或跨度级别的相似度函数作为风险度量，选择与人工标注近似度最高的候选假设。并利用知识蒸馏，将MBR解码结果转移至贪心搜索模型以降低推理成本。
Result: 在WMT24 Metrics Shared Task上，MBR解码相比MAP在跨度级性能上有显著提升，在系统和句子级效果相当或更优；蒸馏模型消除了MBR的推理延迟瓶颈。
Conclusion: MBR解码是生成式ESD中优于MAP的解码策略，且可通过蒸馏实现高效推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exploiting the Alternatives: Coordinated Learning via Hierarchical RL for Dynamic VNEAP
papers.abstract_en: Virtual Network Embedding (VNE) is a key enabler of network slicing, yet most formulations assume that each Virtual Network Request (VNR) has a fixed topology. Recently, VNE with Alternatives (VNEAP) was introduced to capture malleable VNRs, where each request can be instantiated using one of several functionally equivalent topologies that trade resources differently. This flexibility can improve embedding feasibility, but only if the orchestrator can jointly select suitable alternatives and embed them under dynamic arrivals. This paper proposes HRL-VNEAP, a hierarchical reinforcement learning approach for dynamic VNEAP. A high-level policy selects the most suitable alternative topology (or rejects the request), and a low-level policy embeds the chosen topology onto the substrate network. Experiments on realistic substrate topologies under varying arrival rates show that naive exploitation strategies provide only modest gains, whereas HRL-VNEAP outperforms state of the art approaches, improving acceptance ratio by up to 22%, and net profit by up to 20%. An offline MILP upper bound is also used on tractable instances to quantify the remaining optimality gap.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态虚拟网络嵌入中的替代拓扑选择问题，提出分层强化学习框架 HRL-VNEAP。高层策略选择最佳替代拓扑，低层策略将所选拓扑嵌入底层网络。在现实拓扑和变化到达率下，HRL-VNEAP 相比现有方法将接受率提升最高 22%，净利润提升最高 20%。还通过离线 MILP 上界量化了最优性差距。
Motivation: 传统 VNE 假设固定拓扑，但实际请求可能有多个功能等效但资源消耗不同的替代拓扑（VNEAP），需要联合选择与嵌入。
Method: 提出分层强化学习（HRL-VNEAP），高层策略负责选择替代拓扑或拒绝请求，低层策略执行嵌入。
Result: 在现实拓扑和变化到达率下，HRL-VNEAP 相比现有方法将接受率提升最高 22%，净利润提升最高 20%。离线 MILP 上界用于量化最优性差距。
Conclusion: 论文表明，简单的利用策略收益有限，而分层 RL 能有效利用替代拓扑灵活性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Black box behavioural modelling: Predicting human activity schedules with a deep conditional generative approach
papers.abstract_en: Modelling the complexity and diversity of human activity scheduling behaviour is inherently challenging. We demonstrate ActVAE, a deep conditional-generative machine learning approach for the modelling of activity schedules. Suitable for application in activity-based demand modelling frameworks, schedules are modelled as conditional on individual, household and schedule information, such as age, income, and access to public transit. We demonstrate the rapid generation of precise, realistic and diverse schedules dependent on input labels. We extensively evaluate and compare model capabilities against baseline models using a joint-density estimation framework. In addition to providing a novel alternative to existing scheduling approaches, our work highlights the value of explicitly modelling the randomness of complex and diverse human behaviours.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ActVAE，一种深度条件生成方法，用于建模人类活动日程的复杂性和多样性。该方法以个人、家庭和日程信息为条件，生成精确、现实且多样的活动日程，适用于基于活动的需求建模框架。通过联合密度估计框架评估，与基线模型相比，ActVAE 能有效生成多样化的日程。
Motivation: 传统的人类活动日程建模方法难以捕捉行为的复杂性和多样性，需要一种能够显式建模随机性的新方法。
Method: ActVAE 是一种深度条件生成变分自编码器，将活动日程建模为个体、家庭和日程信息（如年龄、收入、公共交通可达性）的条件概率分布。
Result: 摘要中未提供具体的量化结果，但声称能快速生成精确、现实且多样化的日程，并通过联合密度估计框架与基线模型进行了比较。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种替代现有日程建模方法的新途径，并强调了显式建模人类行为随机性的价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compiling to recurrent neurons
papers.abstract_en: Discrete structures are currently second-class in differentiable programming. Since functions over discrete structures lack overt derivatives, differentiable programs do not differentiate through them and limit where they can be used. For example, when programming a neural network, conditionals and iteration cannot be used everywhere; they can break the derivatives necessary for gradient-based learning to work. This limits the class of differentiable algorithms we can directly express, imposing restraints on how we build neural networks and differentiable programs more generally. However, these restraints are not fundamental. Recent work shows conditionals can be first-class, by compiling them into differentiable form as linear neurons. Similarly, this work shows iteration can be first-class -- by compiling to linear recurrent neurons. We present a minimal typed, higher-order and linear programming language with iteration called $\textsf{Cajal}\scriptstyle(\mathbb{\multimap}, \mathbb{2}, \mathbb{N})$. We prove its programs compile correctly to recurrent neurons, allowing discrete algorithms to be expressed in a differentiable form compatible with gradient-based learning. With our implementation, we conduct two experiments where we link these recurrent neurons against a neural network solving an iterative image transformation task. This determines part of its function prior to learning. As a result, the network learns faster and with greater data-efficiency relative to a neural network programmed without first-class iteration. A key lesson is that recurrent neurons enable a rich interplay between learning and the discrete structures of ordinary programming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将离散编程结构（如迭代）编译为可微分的线性循环神经元，从而在可微分编程中实现迭代的一等公民地位。作者设计了最小化类型化高阶线性编程语言Cajal，证明其程序能正确编译为循环神经元，并通过实验表明，将迭代作为一等公民的神经网络在图像变换任务中学习更快、数据效率更高。
Motivation: 当前可微分编程中离散结构（如条件、迭代）缺乏显式导数，限制了梯度下降在神经网络中的使用范围，使得许多算法无法直接表达为可微形式。
Method: 提出编译迭代为线性循环神经元的方法，设计类型化高阶线性编程语言Cajal，并提供正确性证明。通过将循环神经元与神经网络耦合，实现预定义迭代功能的可微化。
Result: 实验表明，在迭代图像变换任务中，利用编译后的循环神经元预置部分功能，相比不使用一等迭代的神经网络，学习更快且数据效率更高。
Conclusion: 循环神经元可以弥合离散编程结构与可微学习之间的鸿沟，实现编程的灵活性与学习的表达能力之间的更丰富交互。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TeaRAG: A Token-Efficient Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) utilizes external knowledge to augment Large Language Models' (LLMs) reliability. For flexibility, agentic RAG employs autonomous, multi-round retrieval and reasoning to resolve queries. Although recent agentic RAG has improved via reinforcement learning, they often incur substantial token overhead from search and reasoning processes. This trade-off prioritizes accuracy over efficiency. To address this issue, this work proposes TeaRAG, a token-efficient agentic RAG framework capable of compressing both retrieval content and reasoning steps. 1) First, the retrieved content is compressed by augmenting chunk-based semantic retrieval with a graph retrieval using concise triplets. A knowledge association graph is then built from semantic similarity and co-occurrence. Finally, Personalized PageRank is leveraged to highlight key knowledge within this graph, reducing the number of tokens per retrieval. 2) Besides, to reduce reasoning steps, Iterative Process-aware Direct Preference Optimization (IP-DPO) is proposed. Specifically, our reward function evaluates the knowledge sufficiency by a knowledge matching mechanism, while penalizing excessive reasoning steps. This design can produce high-quality preference-pair datasets, supporting iterative DPO to improve reasoning conciseness. Across six datasets, TeaRAG improves the average Exact Match by 4% and 2% while reducing output tokens by 61% and 59% on Llama3-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/TeaRAG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TeaRAG，一个token高效的agentic RAG框架，通过压缩检索内容和推理步骤来减少token开销。方法包括：使用简洁的三元组进行图检索构建知识关联图，结合Personalized PageRank突出关键知识以压缩每次检索的token数；以及提出Iterative Process-aware Direct Preference Optimization (IP-DPO)，通过知识匹配机制评估知识充分性并惩罚过多推理步骤，从而生成高质量偏好数据对进行迭代优化。在六个数据集上，TeaRAG在Llama3-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct上分别平均提升Exact Match 4%和2%，同时减少输出token 61%和59%。
Motivation: 现有的agentic RAG方法通过强化学习提升了准确性，但往往产生大量token开销（来自搜索和推理过程），在精度和效率之间权衡不佳，需要一种更高效的方案。
Method: 提出的TeaRAG包含两个主要组件：1) 检索内容压缩：通过基于简洁三元组的图检索替代纯语义检索，构建知识关联图（基于语义相似度和共现），并利用Personalized PageRank突出关键知识，减少每次检索的token数。2) 推理步骤减少：提出IP-DPO，其奖励函数通过知识匹配机制评估知识充分性，同时惩罚过多的推理步骤，从而产生高质量偏好对，支持迭代DPO以提升推理简洁性。
Result: 在六个数据集上，相比基线，TeaRAG在Llama3-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct上分别平均提升Exact Match 4%和2%，同时减少输出token 61%和59%。
Conclusion: TeaRAG在保持或提升精度的同时大幅减少token消耗，实现了agentic RAG的效率和准确性平衡，验证了检索内容压缩和推理步骤优化的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Focus on What Matters: Constraining Spatial-Temporal Attention via Action-Units for Noise-Resilient AQA
papers.abstract_en: The core challenge in Action Quality Assessment (AQA) lies in extracting fine-grained motion features from redundant and complex video backgrounds. Existing global feature learning methods are constrained by extremely low "signal-to-noise ratios", making it difficult to distinguish intrinsic actions from background clutter. To address this, we propose a Pose-Guided Intrinsic Motion Distillation Framework that explicitly enforces physical constraints to focus on motion subjects and decouple motion execution from environmental outcomes. First, we design an Action-Unit Parser that constructs dynamic regions of interest (ROIs) using human pose topology as prior knowledge. This functions as a spatial hard-attention filter that physically removes background noise at the input stage, forcing the model to learn appearance and geometric features only from pure body regions. Second, to resolve factor entanglement, we introduce a dual-stream decoupling mechanism: the Motion Parser focuses on capturing purified joint motion details, while the Condition Parser independently processes non-body-related environmental feedback (e.g., splash in diving) to create two orthogonal evaluation dimensions in feature space. Finally, adaptive weight modules integrate these decoupled features to generate final scores. Experimental results on large-scale datasets including FineDiving, FineDiving-HM, and MTL-AQA demonstrate that this method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in both action segmentation and scoring accuracy, validating the effectiveness of "noise suppression focusing" and "motion disentanglement" strategies in fine-grained action evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种姿态引导的内在运动蒸馏框架，用于动作质量评估（AQA）。通过动作单元解析器构建动态ROI作为空间硬注意力滤波器去除背景噪声，并设计双流解耦机制将关节运动与环境反馈分离，最后自适应融合特征输出分数。在FineDiving、FineDiving-HM和MTL-AQA数据集上取得SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有全局特征学习方法在AQA中受限于极低的信号噪声比，难以从复杂背景中区分内在动作。
Method: 提出Pose-Guided Intrinsic Motion Distillation Framework，包含三个模块：Action-Unit Parser利用人体姿态拓扑作为先验构建动态ROI进行空间硬注意力滤波；双流解耦机制分别处理纯净关节运动（Motion Parser）和环境反馈（Condition Parser）；自适应权重模块融合特征生成最终分数。
Result: 在FineDiving、FineDiving-HM和MTL-AQA数据集上，该方法在动作分割和评分准确性方面均达到SOTA。
Conclusion: 验证了“噪声抑制聚焦”和“运动解耦”策略在细粒度动作评估中的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence in Bioinformatics: A Systematic Review of Models, Applications, and Methodological Advances
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is transforming bioinformatics by advancing genomics, proteomics, transcriptomics, structural biology, and drug discovery. Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses framework, this review addresses six research questions to evaluate influential GenAI strategies in terms of methodological innovation, predictive performance, specialization, limitations, and data use. RQ1 shows that GenAI supports sequence analysis, molecular design, and integrative data modelling, often outperforming traditional methods through improved pattern recognition and generation. RQ2 finds that specialized architectures generally outperform general-purpose models because of domain-specific pretraining and context-aware design. RQ3 identifies benefits in molecular analysis and biological data integration, including improved accuracy and reduced analytical error. RQ4 reports advances in structural modelling, functional prediction, and synthetic data generation, supported by established benchmarks. RQ5 highlights key limitations, including poor scalability, data bias, and restricted generalizability, and recommends stronger evaluation and biologically grounded modelling. RQ6 shows that molecular datasets, including UniProtKB and ProteinNet12, cellular datasets, including CELLxGENE and GTEx, and textual resources, including PubMedQA and OMIM, support model training and generalization. Overall, this review demonstrates the growing potential of GenAI to advance computational biology through more accurate, specialized, and integrative bioinformatics analysis.
papers.comment: Accepted: Archives of Computational Methods in Engineering Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于生成式人工智能在生物信息学中的系统综述，覆盖基因组学、蛋白质组学、转录组学、结构生物学和药物发现等任务。基于PRISMA框架回答六个研究问题，评估模型方法创新性、预测性能、专业化和局限性。
Motivation: 生物信息学领域需要系统评估生成式人工智能的现状和方法进展，以指导未来研究。
Method: 采用系统综述方法，遵循PRISMA框架，从方法创新性、性能、专业化、局限性和数据使用五个维度分析文献。
Result: 摘要指出：专用架构通常优于通用模型；GenAI在分子分析、数据集成中提高准确性并减少误差；在结构建模、功能预测和合成数据生成方面有进展；但存在可扩展性差、数据偏差和泛化性受限等局限。
Conclusion: 生成式人工智能在计算生物学中具有潜力，能够实现更准确、专业化和整合的生物信息学分析，但仍需更强评估和生物基础建模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Limit Theorems for Stochastic Gradient Descent in High-Dimensional Single-Layer Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the high-dimensional scaling limits of online stochastic gradient descent (SGD). Building on the work of Ben Arous, Gheissari, and Jagannath on the effective dynamics of SGD, we study the critical scaling regime of the step size for single-layer networks. Below this regime the effective dynamics are governed by deterministic (ballistic) limits, whereas at the critical scale a correction term emerges that changes the phase diagram. Near the fixed points of these dynamics, we show that the diffusive (SDE) limit of the rescaled correlation is an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. More precisely, it is mean-reverting whenever the information exponent is at least three. At information exponent two the drift has no universal sign, and the fixed point may become repelling; we show this explicitly for phase retrieval, where the sign is determined by the step size and the noise level. These results illustrate the limitations of deterministic scaling limits in capturing stochastic fluctuations in high-dimensional learning dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了高维单层神经网络中在线随机梯度下降（SGD）的标度极限。基于Ben Arous等人的工作，分析了步长的临界标度区域，低于该区域时动力学由确定性极限主导，而在临界尺度下会出现修正项改变相图。在固定点附近，重标度相关性的扩散极限是Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程；当信息指数至少为3时具有均值回复性，而信息指数为2时漂移无通用符号，固定点可能变为排斥的。
Motivation: 现有确定性标度极限无法捕捉高维学习动力学中的随机波动，本研究旨在揭示临界步长下随机效应的涌现机制及其对固定点稳定性的影响。
Method: 基于Ben Arous等人的有效动力学框架，推导单层网络SGD的临界步长标度，通过重标度相关性分析，将扩散极限刻画为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程，并针对相位检索问题显式分析信息指数为2时的符号行为。
Result: 在信息指数≥3时，扩散极限是均值回复的；信息指数为2时，漂移符号依赖于步长与噪声水平，固定点可能变为排斥（以相位检索为例）。
Conclusion: 确定性标度极限在高维学习动力学中不足以描述随机涨落，临界标度下的扩散修正对理解SGD行为至关重要。

papers.title: Structure-Preserving Physics-Informed Neural Network for the Korteweg--de Vries (KdV) Equation
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a flexible framework for solving nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs), yet conventional implementations often fail to preserve key physical invariants during long-term integration. This paper introduces a \emph{structure-preserving PINN} framework for the nonlinear Korteweg--de Vries (KdV) equation, a prototypical model for nonlinear and dispersive wave propagation. The proposed method embeds the conservation of mass and Hamiltonian energy directly into the loss function, ensuring physically consistent and energy-stable evolution throughout training and prediction. Unlike standard \texttt{tanh}-based PINNs~\cite{raissi2019pinn,wang2022modifiedpinn}, our approach employs sinusoidal activation functions that enhance spectral expressiveness and accurately capture the oscillatory and dispersive nature of KdV solitons. Through representative case studies -- including single-soliton propagation (shape-preserving translation), two-soliton interaction (elastic collision with phase shift), and cosine-pulse initialization (nonlinear dispersive breakup) -- the model successfully reproduces hallmark behaviors of KdV dynamics while maintaining conserved invariants. Ablation studies demonstrate that combining invariant-constrained optimization with sinusoidal feature mappings accelerates convergence, improves long-term stability, and mitigates drift without multi-stage pretraining. These results highlight that computationally efficient, invariant-aware regularization coupled with sinusoidal representations yields robust, energy-consistent PINNs for Hamiltonian partial differential equations such as the KdV equation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结构保持的物理信息神经网络（PINN）用于求解KdV方程，通过将质量守恒和哈密顿能量守恒嵌入损失函数，并使用正弦激活函数增强谱表达能力，成功模拟了单孤子传播、双孤子相互作用等非线性动力学行为，并保持了长期稳定性。
Motivation: 传统PINN在长时间积分中难以保持物理不变量，导致解偏离物理实际。
Method: 将质量守恒和哈密顿能量守恒作为约束加入损失函数，并用正弦激活函数代替tanh激活函数。
Result: 数值实验表明该方法能准确再现KdV方程的孤子传播、弹性碰撞和非线性色散破碎等行为，且消融研究显示结合守恒约束与正弦特征映射加速收敛、提高长期稳定性。
Conclusion: 该工作表明将不变量感知的正则化与正弦表示结合，能够为哈密顿偏微分方程（如KdV方程）构建鲁棒、能量一致的PINN。

papers.title: Statistical physics of deep learning: Optimal learning of a multi-layer perceptron near interpolation
papers.abstract_en: For four decades statistical physics has been providing a framework to analyse neural networks. A long-standing question remained on its capacity to tackle deep learning models capturing rich feature learning effects, thus going beyond the narrow networks or kernel methods analysed until now. We positively answer through the study of the supervised learning of a multi-layer perceptron. Importantly, (i) its width scales as the input dimension, making it more prone to feature learning than ultra wide networks, and more expressive than narrow ones or ones with fixed embedding layers; and (ii) we focus on the challenging interpolation regime where the number of trainable parameters and data are comparable, which forces the model to adapt to the task. We consider the matched teacher-student setting. Therefore, we provide the fundamental limits of learning random deep neural network targets and identify the sufficient statistics describing what is learnt by an optimally trained network as the data budget increases. A rich phenomenology emerges with various learning transitions. With enough data, optimal performance is attained through the model's "specialisation" towards the target, but it can be hard to reach for training algorithms which get attracted by sub-optimal solutions predicted by the theory. Specialisation occurs inhomogeneously across layers, propagating from shallow towards deep ones, but also across neurons in each layer. Furthermore, deeper targets are harder to learn. Despite its simplicity, the Bayes-optimal setting provides insights on how the depth, non-linearity and finite (proportional) width influence neural networks in the feature learning regime that are potentially relevant in much more general settings.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 20 figures + appendix. This submission supersedes both arXiv:2505.24849 and arXiv:2501.18530. v4 implements minor improvements
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用统计物理框架分析深度多层感知机在插值区间（参数数与数据量相当）的监督学习。研究发现模型存在多种学习相变，最优性能需要网络“特化”到目标函数，但该特化过程不均匀且易陷入次优解。该工作为特征学习机制下的深度学习提供了理论基础。
Motivation: 长期以来统计物理方法仅能处理窄网络或核方法，无法分析具有丰富特征学习能力的深度学习模型。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用匹配的教师-学生设置，分析宽度与输入维度成比例的深层感知机在插值区间的贝叶斯最优学习，推导其基本极限和充分统计量。
Result: 发现网络特化过程在层间和层内神经元间不均匀，浅层先于深层特化；更深的目标更难以学习；训练算法易被理论预测的次优解吸引。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯最优设置揭示了深度、非线性及有限宽度在特征学习机制中的影响，这些洞察可能适用于更一般的场景。

papers.title: From Checklists to Clusters: A Homeostatic Account of AGI Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary AGI evaluations report multidomain capability profiles, yet they typically assign symmetric weights and rely on snapshot scores. This creates two problems: (i) equal weighting treats all domains as equally important when human intelligence research suggests otherwise, and (ii) snapshot testing can't distinguish durable capabilities from brittle performances that collapse under delay or stress. I argue that general intelligence -- in humans and potentially in machines -- is better understood as a homeostatic property cluster: a set of abilities plus the mechanisms that keep those abilities co-present under perturbation. On this view, AGI evaluation should weight domains by their causal centrality (their contribution to cluster stability) and require evidence of persistence across sessions. I propose two battery-compatible extensions: a centrality-prior score that imports CHC-derived weights with transparent sensitivity analysis, and a Cluster Stability Index family that separates profile persistence, durable learning, and error correction. These additions preserve multidomain breadth while reducing brittleness and gaming. I close with testable predictions and black-box protocols labs can adopt without architectural access.
papers.comment: I no longer endorse the central argument that general intelligence is a homeostatic property cluster. The paper infers a cluster-maintaining mechanism from behavioural stability, and builds two AGI-evaluation measures on it (a centrality-prior domain weighting and a Cluster Stability Index family). A stable aggregate score does not establish such a mechanism
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批评当前AGI评估中对多领域能力指标的对称权重和快照测试方法，认为通用智能（人类和机器）应理解为稳态属性簇（一套能力加上在扰动下维持这些能力共存的机制）。据此提出两个与现有电池兼容的扩展：基于因果中心的领域加权评分（采用CHC权重和敏感性分析）以及一组簇稳定性指数（区分概要持久性、持久学习和纠错）。作者呼吁采用会话间持久性证据，并给出了可测试预测和黑盒协议。
Motivation: 当前AGI评估存在两大问题：对称权重忽略领域重要性差异，快照测试无法区分持久能力与脆弱表现。
Method: 提出将通用智能视为稳态属性簇，据此设计两种评估扩展：(1) 基于因果中心性的加权评分，采用CHC（人认知能力层级）权重并进行敏感性分析；(2) 簇稳定性指数族，分别测量概要持久性、持久学习和纠错能力。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数值，但声称这些扩展能保持多领域广度同时减少脆弱性和对抗性操纵。
Conclusion: 作者强调稳定聚合分数本身并不能证明簇维持机制存在，但所提方法允许实验室在不获取架构访问权限的情况下采用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Neural Guided Sampling for Quantum Circuit Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Translating a general quantum circuit on a specific hardware topology with a reduced set of available gates, also known as transpilation, comes with a substantial increase in the length of the equivalent circuit. Due to decoherence, the quality of the computational outcome can degrade seriously with increasing circuit length. Thus, there is major interest to reduce a transpiled quantum circuit to an equivalent circuit which is in its gate count as short as possible. This is, what we call quantum circuit reduction: Finding a quantum circuit with a reduced amount of gates without changing its unitary. One method to address efficient transpilation, e.g. as a post-transpilation process, is based on approaches known from stochastic optimization, e.g. by using random sampling and local resynthesis strategies. Here, a core challenge is that these methods can suffer from sampling efficiency, causing long and energy consuming optimization time. As a remedy, we propose in this work 2D neural guided sampling. Thus, given a 2D representation of a quantum circuit, a neural network predicts groups of gates in the quantum circuit, which are likely reducible. It leads to a sampling prior which can heavily reduce the compute time for quantum circuit reduction. In several experiments, we demonstrate that our method is superior to results obtained from different qiskit or BQSKit optimization levels.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 9 Figures; v2: 18 pages, 14 Figures, improved explanations and experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子电路编译后门数过多导致退相干加剧的问题，提出2D神经引导采样方法。该方法将量子电路表示为2D结构，训练神经网络预测可能可约减的门组，将其作为采样先验以加速电路简化过程。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上优于qiskit和BQSKit的优化水平，显著缩短了计算时间。
Motivation: 现有基于随机采样和局部综合的量子电路简化方法（如作为后编译过程）采样效率低，导致优化时间长、能耗高。
Method: 提出2D神经引导采样：将量子电路表示为2D表示，训练神经网络预测电路中可能可约减的门组，生成采样先验以加速随机搜索过程。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在多种量子电路优化任务上优于qiskit和BQSKit的不同优化级别，显著降低了电路简化的计算时间。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该2D神经引导采样可作为后编译过程有效加速量子电路简化，提高编译效率。

papers.title: torchsom: The Reference PyTorch Library for Self-Organizing Maps
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces torchsom, an open-source Python library that provides a reference implementation of the Self-Organizing Map (SOM) in PyTorch. This package offers three main features: (i) dimensionality reduction, (ii) clustering, and (iii) friendly data visualization. It relies on a PyTorch backend, enabling (i) fast and efficient training of SOMs through GPU acceleration, and (ii) easy and scalable integrations with PyTorch ecosystem. Moreover, torchsom follows the scikit-learn API for ease of use and extensibility. The library is released under the Apache 2.0 license with 90% test coverage, and its source code and documentation are available at https://github.com/michelin/TorchSOM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 torchsom，一个基于 PyTorch 的自组织映射（SOM）开源库，提供降维、聚类和数据可视化功能。该库利用 PyTorch 后端实现 GPU 加速，并遵循 scikit-learn API，易于集成。代码以 Apache 2.0 许可证发布，测试覆盖率达 90%。

papers.title: Spectral functions in Minkowski quantum electrodynamics from neural reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We study neural reconstructions of quenched rainbow quantum electrodynamics (QED) Dyson--Schwinger benchmarks in Minkowski-related kinematics. Using the dispersive formulation as motivation, we separate the Euclidean Fukuda--Kugo equation, the spectral unitary equations, and the modified unitary equations. The Fukuda--Kugo benchmark is solved directly and shows the expected zero crossing above the critical region $α_c=π/3$. Neural reconstructions with free output reproduce this behavior, while positivity-constrained ansätze fail in the supercritical regime. Thus, spectral positivity should be treated as a diagnostic of the Lehmann representation, not imposed blindly as a neural constraint.

TL;DR: 本文使用神经网络重构闵可夫斯基量子电动力学中的谱函数，基于色散关系将Fukuda-Kugo方程、谱幺正方程和修正幺正方程分离。直接求解Fukuda-Kugo基准显示在临界区域α_c=π/3以上出现零交叉，神经网络自由输出再现该行为，而正性约束的ansatz在超临界区域失败。因此谱正性应作为Lehmann表示的诊断工具，不应盲目施加为神经约束。
Motivation: 在闵可夫斯基量子电动力学中，谱函数的计算面临解析延拓和正性约束的挑战，现有神经网络方法可能强制引入不合理的正性假设。
Method: 利用色散形式分离不同的方程（Fukuda-Kugo、谱幺正、修正幺正），并用神经网络重建谱函数，比较自由输出与正性约束输出的结果。
Result: 直接求解Fukuda-Kugo方程显示在α>π/3时出现零交叉；神经网络自由输出成功再现，而正性约束的ansatz在超临界区域失败。
Conclusion: 谱正性应作为诊断工具而非约束条件，神经网络在重构谱函数时应避免强制正性假设。

papers.title: Simple Policy Gradients for Reasoning with Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) represent a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs; however, the lack of effective post-training techniques, including reinforcement learning (RL), remains a key challenge for dLLMs, especially for downstream applications. Existing approaches often rely on a sequence-level view that requires biased likelihood approximations. In this work, we propose Amortized Group Relative Policy Optimization (AGRPO), a policy gradient algorithm that leverages the Markovian nature of dLLMs, optimizing individual denoising steps rather than full sequences. Our approach improves alignment between the trained policy and the inference process and also admits efficient, unbiased gradient updates via a novel timestep estimation scheme. We demonstrate AGRPO's effectiveness on different math and reasoning tasks, achieving absolute accuracy gains of +59.4\% and +69.7\% on Countdown and Sudoku over the base LLaDA model, exceeding comparable methods such as diffu-GRPO. Code is available at https://github.com/probablyabot/agrpo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Amortized Group Relative Policy Optimization (AGRPO)，一种针对扩散语言模型(dLLMs)的策略梯度算法。AGRPO利用dLLMs的马尔可夫性质，优化单个去噪步骤而非整个序列，并通过新颖的时间步估计方案实现无偏梯度更新。在数学和推理任务（Countdown, Sudoku）上，AGRPO相比基准LLaDA模型取得绝对准确率提升+59.4%和+69.7%，超越diffu-GRPO等方法。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型(dLLMs)缺乏有效的后训练技术（包括强化学习），现有方法通常依赖序列级视角，需要有偏似然近似，限制了其在推理等下游任务中的性能。
Method: 提出AGRPO算法：基于dLLMs的马尔可夫性质，优化单个去噪步骤（而非完整序列）的策略梯度；通过新型时间步估计方案实现高效、无偏的梯度更新。
Result: 在Countdown和Sudoku任务上，AGRPO在基础LLaDA模型上分别取得+59.4%和+69.7%的绝对准确率提升，优于diffu-GRPO等对比方法。
Conclusion: AGRPO通过优化去噪步骤而非完整序列，显著提升dLLMs在推理任务上的对齐效果，提供了一种有效的后训练方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MO-GRPO: Mitigating Reward Hacking of Group Relative Policy Optimization on Multi-Objective Problems
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been shown to be an effective algorithm when an accurate reward model is available. However, such a highly reliable reward model is not available in many real-world tasks. In this paper, we particularly focus on multi-objective settings, in which we identify that GRPO is vulnerable to reward hacking, optimizing only one of the objectives at the cost of the others. To address this issue, we propose MO-GRPO, an extension of GRPO with a simple normalization method to reweight the reward functions automatically according to the variances of their values. We first show analytically that MO-GRPO ensures that all reward functions contribute evenly to the loss function while preserving the order of preferences, eliminating the need for manual tuning of the reward functions' scales. Then, we evaluate MO-GRPO experimentally in four domains: (i) the multi-armed bandits problem, (ii) simulated control task (Mo-Gymnasium), (iii) machine translation tasks on the WMT benchmark (En-Ja, En-Zh), and (iv) instruction following task. MO-GRPO achieves stable learning by evenly distributing correlations among the components of rewards, outperforming GRPO, showing MO-GRPO to be a promising algorithm for multi-objective reinforcement learning problems.
papers.comment: Accepted by TACL (pre-MIT Press publication version)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多目标强化学习中GRPO算法易出现奖励破解（reward hacking）的问题，即只优化其中一个目标而牺牲其他目标，提出MO-GRPO扩展，通过基于奖励值方差的自动归一化方法重新加权奖励函数。理论分析表明该方法保证所有奖励函数对损失函数贡献均匀，同时保持偏好顺序，无需手动调整奖励尺度。实验在四个领域（多臂老虎机、Mo-Gymnasium控制、WMT机器翻译、指令遵循）上验证，MO-GRPO比GRPO更稳定地学习，均匀分布奖励组件间的相关性。
Motivation: 多目标设置下GRPO算法容易陷入奖励破解，只优化单一目标而忽略其他，且实际任务中难以获得高度可靠的奖励模型。
Method: 提出MO-GRPO，在GRPO基础上引入基于各奖励函数值方差的自动归一化方法，重新加权奖励函数以平衡贡献。
Result: 在四个领域（多臂老虎机、Mo-Gymnasium、WMT En-Ja/En-Zh机器翻译、指令遵循）中，MO-GRPO实现稳定学习，均匀分布奖励组件相关性，性能优于GRPO。
Conclusion: MO-GRPO是一种有前景的多目标强化学习算法，能自动处理奖励尺度问题，消除手动调整需求。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Student-Centered Distillation Narrows the Agentic Gap Between Small and Large LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model agents achieve strong performance on multi-step reasoning and tool-use tasks, but their impressive capabilities typically rely on extremely large backbones. Existing distillation approaches train smaller students to imitate full teacher trajectories, yet reasoning and knowledge gaps between the teacher and student can cause compounding errors. We propose SCoRe, a student-centered framework in which the student generates training trajectories and the teacher corrects only the earliest error, producing training data matched to the student's abilities and exposing specific weaknesses. The student is first fine-tuned on corrected trajectories. Subsequently, short-horizon reinforcement learning starts from the verified prefix preceding the earliest error, with target rewards assigned at that step. This design enables the student to solve problems through unconstrained RL exploration rather than teacher imitation, while the short-horizon setup improves training stability. On 12 challenging benchmarks, a 7B-parameter student distilled with SCoRe closes the agentic performance gap with a 72B-parameter teacher.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. The title has been changed from "From Correction to Mastery: Reinforced Distillation of Large Language Model Agents" to "Student-Centered Distillation Narrows the Agentic Gap Between Small and Large LLMs"; the camera-ready version has been uploaded
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出学生中心蒸馏框架SCoRe，通过让学生生成轨迹、教师仅纠正最早错误，并配合短视强化学习，缩小了小模型与大模型在智能体任务上的性能差距。实验表明，7B参数学生模型经SCoRe蒸馏后，在12个挑战性基准上接近72B教师模型的表现。
Motivation: 现有蒸馏方法让学生模仿完整教师轨迹，但推理和知识差距导致复合错误，限制了小模型在复杂智能体任务中的能力。
Method: SCoRe框架：学生生成训练轨迹，教师仅纠正最早错误，生成匹配学生能力的训练数据；随后在验证前缀上进行短视强化学习，减少训练不稳定并鼓励自由探索。
Result: 在12个挑战性基准上，7B学生模型经SCoRe蒸馏后，与72B教师模型的智能体性能差距显著缩小。
Conclusion: 学生中心蒸馏通过纠正最早错误和短视强化学习，有效缩小了大小模型在智能体任务上的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DCVC-MV: Deep Contextual Multiview Video Compression with Efficient Inter-View Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Multiview video is a key format for 3D applications such as free-viewpoint broadcasting and virtual reality, yet its large data volume poses significant challenges for efficient storage and transmission. As deep contextual video compression matures and moves toward standardization, extending such learned codecs to multiview scenarios has become essential for practical deployment---yet this direction remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose DCVC-MV, a novel deep contextual multiview video compression framework that satisfies three fundamental requirements. First, it maintains backward compatibility, ensuring that the primary view's bitstream can be decoded independently by a single-view decoder without being affected by other views. Second, it supports random-access capability, enabling flexible switching between different viewing perspectives. Third, it effectively exploits inter-view correlations to achieve high compression efficiency. This is realized through four dedicated components: (1) an inter-view motion feature propagation method, which propagates decoded independent-view motion features as conditions to promote dependent-view motion encoding; (2) an inter-view motion conditional entropy model designed to learn motion conditional priors across views for more accurate probability estimation of motion latent representations; (3) an implicit inter-view context prediction method, which predicts inter-view contexts from low-resolution independent-view content features without explicit disparity estimation; and (4) an inter-view contextual conditional entropy model that learns contextual conditional priors across views to further enhance content compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DCVC-MV，一种深度上下文多视图视频压缩框架，满足后向兼容性、随机访问能力和高效的视图间预测。通过四个专用组件实现：视图间运动特征传播、运动条件熵模型、隐式视图间上下文预测和上下文条件熵模型，有效利用视图间相关性提升压缩效率。
Motivation: 多视图视频数据量大，现有深度学习视频压缩方法尚未充分扩展到多视图场景，缺乏后向兼容性、随机访问能力和高效的视图间预测。
Method: 提出DCVC-MV框架，包含四个组件：1）视图间运动特征传播；2）视图间运动条件熵模型；3）隐式视图间上下文预测（无需显式视差估计）；4）视图间上下文条件熵模型。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称满足三个基本需求并实现高压缩效率。
Conclusion: DCVC-MV为多视图视频压缩提供了可行的深度学习方案，兼顾兼容性、灵活性和压缩性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DynaMark: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Dynamic Watermarking in Industrial Machine Tool Controllers
papers.abstract_en: Industry 4.0's highly networked Machine Tool Controllers (MTCs) are prime targets for replay attacks that use outdated sensor data to manipulate actuators. Dynamic watermarking can reveal such tampering, but current schemes assume linear-Gaussian dynamics and use constant watermark statistics, making them vulnerable to the time-varying, partly proprietary behavior of MTCs. We close this gap with DynaMark, a reinforcement learning framework that models dynamic watermarking as a Markov decision process (MDP). It learns an adaptive policy online that dynamically adapts the covariance of a zero-mean Gaussian watermark using available measurements and detector feedback, without needing system knowledge. DynaMark maximizes a unique reward function balancing control performance, energy consumption, and detection confidence dynamically. We develop a Bayesian belief updating mechanism for real-time detection confidence in linear systems. This approach, independent of specific system assumptions, underpins the MDP for systems with linear dynamics. On a Siemens Sinumerik 828D controller digital twin, DynaMark achieves a reduction in watermark energy by 70% while preserving the nominal trajectory, compared to constant variance baselines. It also maintains an average detection delay equivalent to one sampling interval. A physical stepper-motor testbed validates these findings, rapidly triggering alarms with less control performance decline and exceeding existing benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering (T-ASE)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对工业机床控制器中动态水印的局限性，本文提出DynaMark，一个基于强化学习的框架，将动态水印建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），在线学习自适应策略以调整水印协方差，无需系统模型知识。在西门子Sinumerik 828D数字孪生上，与恒定方差基线相比，水印能量降低70%且保持标称轨迹，平均检测延迟为一个采样间隔，物理步进电机测试台验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有动态水印方案假设线性高斯动力学并使用恒定统计数据，无法适应工业机床控制器的时间变化和专有行为，易受重放攻击。
Method: 将动态水印建模为MDP，通过强化学习在线学习自适应策略，动态调整零均值高斯水印的协方差，同时利用可用测量和检测器反馈，并设计平衡控制性能、能耗和检测置信度的奖励函数，以及用于实时检测置信度的贝叶斯信念更新机制。
Result: 在西门子Sinumerik 828D数字孪生上，与恒定方差基线相比，水印能量降低70%且保持标称轨迹，平均检测延迟为一个采样间隔；物理步进电机测试台验证了快速触发警报且控制性能下降更少，超越现有基准。
Conclusion: 该方法不依赖特定系统假设，适用于线性动力学系统，并在数字孪生和物理平台上验证了有效性和效率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法不依赖特定系统假设，适用于线性动力学系统，并在数字孪生和物理平台上验证了有效性和效率。

papers.title: Drive As You Like: Multi-Head Diffusion with Reinforcement Learning for Personalized Driving
papers.abstract_en: Despite significant progress, imitation learning-based autonomous driving planners remain largely restricted to reproducing high-frequency biased behaviors, overlooking the inherent behavioral diversity of human driving. Moreover, existing systems struggle to understand user intent from human interactions and environmental contexts. In real-world advanced deployment, motion planning must accommodate diverse, context-dependent user preferences to support heterogeneous driving services, requiring the ability to interpret human intent and adapt behavior accordingly. However, existing approaches lack such user-oriented capabilities, as they neither explicitly model user intent nor enable flexible policy adaptation. To bridge this gap, we propose an RL-guided multi-strategy framework with a diffusion-based multi-head planner(M-Diffusion Planner) integrated with LLM-based semantic understanding, enabling dynamic perception of user intent and generation of diverse, preference-aligned trajectories. To balance trajectory quality and strategy alignment, we adopt a two-stage training paradigm: first, imitation learning ensures each policy head achieves safe and high-quality planning; second, constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) further aligns each head with user preferences. Experiments on the nuPlan benchmark, under both open-loop and closed-loop settings, demonstrate competitive performance while meeting real-time planning requirements and effectively aligning with user intent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于强化学习的多策略扩散规划框架(M-Diffusion Planner)，结合大语言模型的语义理解，用于个性化自动驾驶轨迹生成。通过两阶段训练（模仿学习+约束GRPO），使多个策略头对齐用户偏好。在nuPlan基准上，开环和闭环设置下均达到竞争性能，满足实时规划需求并有效对齐用户意图。
Motivation: 现有模仿学习的自动驾驶规划器仅能复现高频偏差行为，无法理解用户意图和适应多样化的驾驶偏好。缺乏用户导向的个性化能力，亟需一个能动态感知用户意图并生成对齐偏好的轨迹的框架。
Method: 提出RL引导的多策略框架，包括扩散模型的多头规划器(Diffusion-based Multi-head Planner)和LLM语义理解模块。采用两阶段训练：第一阶段模仿学习确保安全高质量规划；第二阶段使用约束的群体相对策略优化(Constrained GRPO)进一步对齐每个策略头与用户偏好。
Result: 在nuPlan基准的开环和闭环设置下，该方法在满足实时规划要求的同时，有效对齐用户意图，并取得有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了自动驾驶中个性化运动规划的空白，通过LLM语义理解和RL对齐实现多策略适应。摘要未提及局限性，但方法依赖预训练LLM和扩散模型，可能对计算资源有较高需求。

papers.title: Overcoming the Communication-Performance Tradeoff in LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Communication-efficient distributed training algorithms (e.g., DiLoCo) have received considerable interest due to their benefits for training large language models (LLMs) in bandwidth-constrained settings, such as across datacenters and over the internet. While these local-update methods achieve communication reduction through reduced synchronization, they still require communicating dense model-sized pseudo-gradients, resulting in a communication bottleneck even for cross-datacenter links. While quantization is often applied to reduce the pseudo-gradient's size, in the context of LLM pre-training, existing approaches have not been able to leverage sparsification without incurring significant performance degradation. In this work, we introduce SparseLoCo, a communication-efficient training algorithm for LLMs that can effectively leverage Top-k sparsification and 2-bit quantization to reach extreme sparsity in the communicated pseudo-gradient, as high as 97-99%, while achieving lower final loss than dense DiLoCo. In our empirical study of language model pre-training, we demonstrate that SparseLoCo's improvements over DiLoCo in performance and pseudo-gradient compression are maintained across dense model scales (178M-2B), an MoE transformer (645M-A273M), increasing the number of workers, and increasing communication intervals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SparseLoCo，一种面向大语言模型（LLM）预训练的通信高效训练算法，通过 Top-k 稀疏化和 2-bit 量化，在通信伪梯度中达到 97-99% 的稀疏度，同时实现比稠密 DiLoCo 更低的最终损失。实验覆盖 178M-2B 稠密模型和 645M-A273M MoE 模型，验证了跨模型规模、工人数和通信间隔的改进。
Motivation: 现有通信高效分布式训练算法（如 DiLoCo）虽减少同步频率，但仍需传输稠密伪梯度，成为带宽瓶颈；而量化未能结合稀疏化而不损失性能。
Method: SparseLoCo 将 Top-k 稀疏化与 2-bit 量化结合，对伪梯度进行极端压缩，同时保持训练质量优于稠密 DiLoCo。
Result: 在 178M-2B 稠密模型和 645M-A273M MoE 模型上，SparseLoCo 达到 97-99% 的伪梯度稀疏度，且最终损失低于稠密 DiLoCo；该优势在更多工人数和更长通信间隔下保持。
Conclusion: SparseLoCo 有效克服了通信效率与模型性能之间的权衡，适用于跨数据中心等带宽受限场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multivariate Planar Curves: A Statistical Framework for Shape Analysis in Images
papers.abstract_en: Recent developments in computer vision have made segmented images widely available across many domains, such as medicine, where segmented radiographs play an important role in diagnosis. As prediction problems are common in image analysis, this work explores the use of the object contours highlighted by such images as predictors in a supervised classification context. To this end, we develop a new statistical learning framework that accounts for the joint shape of the multiple objects contained in an image. We introduce a formalism that extends the study of a single random planar curve to the joint analysis of several planar curves, referred to as a multivariate planar curve. Modeling the contours jointly, rather than separately, preserves the inter-component information, such as their relative position, scale, and orientation, which is often essential to the analysis. Based on this model, we propose a joint alignment procedure and we extend core inferential tools to multivariate shapes: shape dissimilarity, Fréchet mean estimation, and tangent-space representation. These tangent coordinates are then used as predictors in standard functional classification models. A simulation study shows accurate recovery of deformation parameters over increasing noise levels. Then, through a cardiomegaly detection problem on segmented chest X-rays, we show that jointly modeling the contours is robust to misalignment and improves classification accuracy over both a contour-wise univariate analysis and a naive approach based on the raw curves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学图像中多个对象轮廓的联合形状分析，提出多元平面曲线（multivariate planar curve）统计框架。该框架将图像中多个对象的轮廓视为一个多元随机曲线，通过联合对齐、形状差异度量、Fréchet均值估计和切空间表示等工具，保留轮廓间的相对位置、尺度和方向信息，并用于监督分类。在心影增大检测任务上，联合建模方法提升了分类准确率，且对未对齐更鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有形状分析方法多独立处理每个对象的轮廓，忽略了多个对象之间的空间关系（如相对位置、尺度和方向），而这些信息对于医学影像等领域的分类任务至关重要。
Method: 提出多元平面曲线形式化定义，将图像中多个对象的轮廓建模为一个整体随机曲线；开发联合对齐算法，并扩展单曲线的形状差异、Fréchet均值和切空间表示到多元情形；将切空间坐标作为函数分类模型的预测变量。
Result: 模拟实验表明该方法能在递增噪声下准确恢复变形参数；在分割胸部X光片的心影增大检测任务中，联合建模提高了分类准确率，且比单变量轮廓分析和原始曲线方法更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合建模多个对象轮廓能够保留组件间信息，提升分类性能，但方法在更多类型图像和更复杂变形上的适用性需要进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MELLA: Bridging Linguistic Capability and Cultural Groundedness for Low-Resource Language MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) perform strongly in high-resource languages, yet often produce fluent but culturally "thin" descriptions in low-resource settings. We argue that this failure is not merely a linguistic limitation: culture-specific visual knowledge depends on native visual-textual alignments that translation-centric pipelines rarely provide. We present MELLA, a multimodal dataset across eight low-resource languages, designed to support linguistic fluency and cultural groundedness. MELLA uses a dual-source strategy that combines native web image-alt-text pairs for culture-grounded supervision with generated-and-translated image descriptions for linguistically rich supervision, explicitly separating two learning signals often conflated in multilingual multimodal data. Through controlled diagnostic fine-tuning on multiple MLLM backbones, we show that MELLA mitigates cultural hallucination by helping models recognize and articulate culturally specific entities overlooked by translation-based adaptation. Our findings highlight data alignment, rather than model modification alone, as a path toward culturally grounded multimodal understanding in low-resource languages. The dataset is available at https://opendatalab.com/applyMultilingualCorpus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低资源语言多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中文化知识缺失的问题，提出MELLA数据集。该数据集覆盖八种低资源语言，采用双源策略：本地网络图像-alt文本对提供文化基础监督，生成并翻译的图像描述提供语言丰富监督，明确分离语言与文化学习信号。在多个MLLM主干上的诊断微调表明，MELLA能缓解文化幻觉，帮助模型识别并表达文化特定实体。论文强调数据对齐而非仅模型修改是实现文化基础多模态理解的关键。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在低资源语言中虽能生成流畅描述，但缺乏文化具体性，这是由于翻译为中心的管线无法提供文化特定的视觉-文本对齐。
Method: 提出双源数据策略：1) 本地网络图像-alt文本对提供文化基础监督；2) 生成并翻译的图像描述提供语言丰富监督，从而在数据层面分离语言流畅性与文化对齐两种学习信号。
Result: 在多个MLLM主干上进行的诊断微调实验中，MELLA数据集有效缓解了文化幻觉，提升了模型对文化特定实体的识别与表达能力。
Conclusion: 数据对齐（而非仅修改模型架构）是实现在低资源语言中文化基础多模态理解的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fragile Preferences: A Deep Dive Into Order Effects in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in decision-support systems for high-stakes domains such as hiring and university admissions, where choices often involve selecting among competing alternatives. While prior work has noted position biases in LLM-driven comparisons, these biases have not been systematically analyzed or linked to underlying preference structures. We present the first comprehensive study of position biases across multiple LLMs and two distinct domains: resume comparisons, representing a realistic high-stakes context, and color selection, which isolates position effects by removing confounding factors. We find strong and consistent order effects, including a quality-dependent shift: when all options are high quality, models favor the first option, but when quality is lower, they favor later options. We also identify a previously undocumented bias: a name bias, where certain names are favored despite controlling for demographic signals. To separate superficial tie-breaking from genuine distortions of judgment, we extend the rational choice framework to classify pairwise preferences as robust, fragile, or indifferent. Using this framework, we show that order effects can lead models to select strictly inferior options. These results indicate that LLMs exhibit distinct failure modes not documented in human decision-making. We also propose targeted mitigation strategies, including a novel use of the temperature parameter, to recover underlying preferences when order effects distort model behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在决策支持系统中的顺序偏差（position bias），发现模型在比较不同选项时存在强烈的顺序效应，包括质量依赖的转换：当所有选项高质量时，模型偏好第一个；当质量较低时，偏好后面的。还发现未记录的名字偏差（name bias）。通过扩展理性选择框架，将成对偏好分类为稳健、脆弱或无关，并表明顺序效应可能导致模型选择严格劣质的选项。提出缓解策略，包括温度参数的新用法。
Motivation: LLM越来越多地用于高风险的决策支持系统（如招聘、大学录取），但先前仅注意到位置偏差，未系统分析或关联到潜在偏好结构。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 对多个LLM在两个领域（简历比较——现实高风险场景，颜色选择——去除混淆因素）进行系统的位置偏差研究。提出扩展理性选择框架，将偏好分类为稳健、脆弱或无关，并分析顺序效应是否导致劣质选择。
Result: 发现强烈且一致的顺序效应，包括质量依赖的转换（高质量时偏好第一，低质量时偏好后面）以及名字偏差。顺序效应可导致模型选择严格劣质的选项，表明LLM存在人类决策中未记录的失败模式。
Conclusion: LLM在比较判断中存在广泛的顺序效应，需针对性缓解（如温度参数调整）。框架有助于区分真实偏好与偶然偏差。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: LLM在比较判断中存在广泛的顺序效应，需针对性缓解（如温度参数调整）。框架有助于区分真实偏好与偶然偏差。

papers.title: Tackling Heterogeneity in Federated Learning via Variance-Reduced Boltzmann Sampling within Homogeneous Social Coalitions
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative model training, but its effectiveness is often limited by client data heterogeneity. We introduce a client-selection algorithm that (i) dynamically forms nonoverlapping coalitions of clients based on asymptotic agreement and (ii) selects one representative from each coalition to minimize the variance of model updates. Our approach is inspired by social-network modeling, leveraging homophily-based proximity matrices for spectral clustering and techniques for identifying the most informative individuals to estimate a group's aggregate opinion. We provide theoretical convergence guarantees for the algorithm under mild, standard FL assumptions. Finally, we validate our approach by benchmarking it against three strong heterogeneity-aware baselines; the results show higher accuracy and faster convergence, indicating that the framework is both theoretically grounded and effective in practice.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中的数据异质性，提出一种基于社交网络建模的客户端选择算法，通过同质性近邻矩阵进行谱聚类形成同质联盟，并从每个联盟中选出一个代表客户端以减少模型更新的方差，理论收敛性和实验表明该方法优于异质性感知基线。
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端数据异质性严重制约模型训练效果，现有方法在应对异质性时收敛慢或精度低，亟需一种高效且理论保证的客户端选择策略。
Method: 基于社交网络模型，利用同质性近邻矩阵进行谱聚类动态形成无重叠的客户端联盟，然后从每个联盟中选出信息最丰富的客户端作为代表，最小化模型更新的方差。
Result: 在多个异质性感知基线上，该方法实现了更高的准确率和更快的收敛速度，理论分析给出了在标准FL假设下的收敛保证。
Conclusion: 该框架在理论上有据可依，在实践中有效，能显著缓解联邦学习中的数据异质性问题。

papers.title: Gibbs randomness-compression proposition
papers.abstract_en: A proposition that connects randomness and compression is put forward via Gibbs entropy over set of measurement vectors associated with a lossy compression process. In building this connection, we use a performance of a learning task as a probe of compression in iterative compress-train cycles. This can be thought as iterative coarse-graining from statistical mechanics perspective using thermodynamic efficiency as a probe. We formulate this connection via comonotonic relationship within a very small decrease in compression ratio and the performance. We have showcase the validity of this proposition with a canonical vision task in deep learning with three different model compression processes as {\it a baseline model}. We use the following, simpler to more complex model compression approaches: (1) random pruning,(2) magnitude pruning, and (3) a more complex compression by using dual tomographic compression, which utilizes compressed sensing in dual fashion which is introduced as a new method. We use remaining weights of deep learning network as a measurement vector where we measure the Gibbs entropy. We show case the idea that there is an inherent computable connection between compression probed by performance and randomness from an entropy measure on the learned model.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个命题，通过损失压缩过程中的测量向量集的吉布斯熵来联系随机性与压缩，并使用学习任务的性能作为压缩探针，在迭代压缩-训练循环中验证。在深度学习视觉任务上使用三种模型压缩方法（随机剪枝、幅度剪枝、双断层压缩）展示了该命题的有效性。
Motivation: 试图建立随机性与压缩之间固有的可计算联系。
Method: 利用吉布斯熵在测量向量集上，通过学习任务性能作为压缩探针，提出共单调关系（comonotonic relationship）在压缩比与性能的微小下降之间。
Result: 在深度学习视觉任务上，使用三种压缩方法（包括新提出的双断层压缩）验证了命题的有效性。
Conclusion: 存在一种固有的可计算联系，即通过性能探测的压缩与基于学习模型熵度量的随机性之间的联系。

papers.title: Enhancing Membership Inference Attacks on Diffusion Models from a Frequency-Domain Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved tremendous success in image generation, but they also raise significant concerns regarding privacy and copyright issues. Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) are designed to ascertain whether specific data was utilized during a model's training phase. As current MIAs for diffusion models typically exploit the model's image prediction ability, we formalize them into a unified general paradigm that computes the membership score for membership identification. Under this paradigm, we empirically find that existing attacks overlook the inherent deficiency in how diffusion models process high-frequency information. Consequently, this deficiency leads to member data with more high-frequency content being misclassified as hold-out data, and hold-out data with less high-frequency content tends to be misclassified as member data. Moreover, we theoretically demonstrate that this deficiency reduces the membership advantage of attacks, thereby interfering with the effective discrimination of member data and hold-out data. Based on this insight, we propose a plug-and-play high-frequency filter module to mitigate the adverse effects of the deficiency, which can be seamlessly integrated into any attacks within the general paradigm without additional time costs. Extensive experiments corroborate that this module significantly improves the performance of baseline attacks across different datasets and models. Code is available at https://github.com/poetic2/FreMIA.
papers.comment: Accepted to Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从频域视角增强扩散模型的成员推理攻击。当前攻击统一范式下，扩散模型处理高频信息有缺陷，导致成员数据被误判。作者提出可插拔的高频滤波器模块来缓解该缺陷，并显著提升基线攻击性能。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型成员推理攻击忽略了模型处理高频信息的固有缺陷，导致成员数据与留出数据难以有效区分，降低攻击的成员优势。
Method: 形式化现有攻击为统一范式，理论证明高频处理缺陷降低成员优势，并提出一个可插拔的高频滤波器模块，可无缝集成到任何范式内的攻击中，无需额外时间成本。
Result: 大量实验表明该模块在不同数据集和模型上显著提升基线攻击性能。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该模块是即插即用的，能有效提升成员推理攻击的准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SESaMo: Symmetry-Enforcing Stochastic Modulation for Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative models have recently garnered significant attention across various fields, from physics to chemistry, where sampling from unnormalized Boltzmann-like distributions represents a fundamental challenge. In particular, autoregressive models and normalizing flows have become prominent due to their appealing ability to yield closed-form probability densities. Moreover, it is well-established that incorporating prior knowledge - such as symmetries - into deep neural networks can substantially improve training performances. In this context, recent advances have focused on developing symmetry-equivariant generative models, achieving remarkable results. Building upon these foundations, this paper introduces Symmetry-Enforcing Stochastic Modulation (SESaMo). Similar to equivariant normalizing flows, SESaMo enables the incorporation of inductive biases (e.g., symmetries) into normalizing flows through a novel technique called stochastic modulation. This approach enhances the flexibility of the generative model, allowing to effectively learn a variety of exact and broken symmetries. Our numerical experiments benchmark SESaMo in different scenarios, including an 8-Gaussian mixture model and physically relevant field theories, such as the $φ^4$ theory and the Hubbard model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对称性强制随机调制（SESaMo），通过在归一化流（normalizing flows）中引入随机调制技术，使模型能够灵活地学习精确或破缺的对称性。实验在8-高斯混合模型以及物理相关场论（如φ⁴理论和Hubbard模型）上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 在物理和化学等领域，从非归一化玻尔兹曼分布采样是基本挑战。将对称性等先验知识嵌入深度生成模型可以显著提升训练性能，但现有方法在灵活处理精确与破缺对称性方面仍有局限。
Method: SESaMo通过随机调制（stochastic modulation）技术将对称性等归纳偏置注入归一化流，增强模型灵活性，使其同时适用于精确对称和对称破缺场景。
Result: 在8-高斯混合模型和物理相关场论（φ⁴理论、Hubbard模型）上的数值实验表明，SESaMo能够有效学习多种对称性模式。
Conclusion: SESaMo为在归一化流中灵活引入对称性归纳偏置提供了一种新途径，有望进一步推动物理科学中生成模型的应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Concept Concentration for Faithful Representation Intervention
papers.abstract_en: Representation intervention aims to localize and modify the representations that encode the underlying concepts in large language models (LLMs) to elicit the aligned and expected behaviors. Despite the empirical success, it has never been examined whether one could localize the faithful concepts for intervention. In this work, we explore the question in safety alignment. If the interventions are faithful, the intervened LLMs should erase the harmful concepts and be robust to both in-distribution adversarial prompts and the out-of-distribution (OOD) jailbreaks. While it is feasible to erase harmful concepts without degrading the benign utility of LLMs in linear settings, we show that it is infeasible in the general non-linear setting. To tackle the issue, we propose COncept ConcentrAtion (COCA). COCA refactors the training data with an explicit reasoning process, which first identifies the potential unsafe concepts and then decides the responses. Essentially, COCA simplifies the decision boundary between harmful and benign representations, enabling more effective linear erasure. Extensive experiments with multiple representation intervention methods and model architectures demonstrate that COCA significantly reduces both in-distribution and OOD jailbreak success rates, and meanwhile maintaining strong performance on regular tasks such as math and code generation. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tmlr-group/COCA .
papers.comment: ICML'26; Hongzheng and Yongqiang contributed equally; project page: https://causalcoat.github.io/coca
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型安全对齐中的表示干预忠实性问题，发现非线性设定下无法在不降低良性效用前提下擦除有害概念。作者提出概念集中（COCA）方法，通过重构训练数据引入显式推理过程，先识别潜在不安全概念再决定响应，从而简化有害与良性表示的决策边界，实现更有效的线性擦除。实验表明COCA能显著降低分布内和分布外越狱成功率，同时保持数学和代码生成等常规任务性能。
Motivation: 现有表示干预方法无法保证干预的忠实性，即在擦除有害概念的同时无法稳健应对分布外攻击，且非线性设定下线性擦除不可行。
Method: 提出COCA方法，重构训练数据加入显式推理过程，先识别不安全概念再决定响应，本质上简化有害与良性表示的决策边界，使线性擦除更有效。
Result: 结合多种表示干预方法和模型架构的实验表明，COCA显著降低分布内和分布外越狱成功率，同时维持常规任务性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过重构数据推理过程简化决策边界，可以在非线性设定下实现更有效的有害概念擦除，提升安全对齐的忠实性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PreMoE: Proactive Inference for Efficient Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer dynamic computation, but are typically deployed as static full-capacity models, missing opportunities for deployment-specific specialization. We introduce PreMoE, a training-free framework that proactively compiles sparse MoE variants for targeted deployment scenarios. At its core is Predicted Expert Utility (PEU), a robust metric for estimating expert importance from router logits through high-confidence threshold filtering and logit transformation, which together stabilize utility estimation under aggressive sparsity. Using PEU scores computed on a small calibration set, PreMoE produces domain-aware expert rankings that can be used to compile either domain-specific specialists or high-efficiency multi-domain generalists, without any retraining. Across MoE models ranging from 30B to 718B parameters, PreMoE achieves up to 50\% sparsity with nearly no performance loss. It further exposes a practical deployment trade-off: specialists maximize in-domain efficiency, while synthesized generalists retain broader cross-domain capability at the same sparsity budget. Code: https://github.com/JarvisPei/PreMoE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PreMoE，一种无需再训练即可为混合专家模型生成稀疏变体的框架。核心是基于路由 logits 的预测专家效用 (PEU) 指标，通过高置信度阈值过滤和 logit 变换稳定稀疏估计。在 30B 到 718B 参数的 MoE 模型上，PreMoE 可实现高达 50% 稀疏性且几乎无性能损失，并展示了领域专家与多领域通用模型间的部署权衡。
Motivation: MoE 模型通常以静态全容量模式部署，未能利用部署场景特定的专业化机会，造成计算浪费。
Method: 提出训练无关的 PreMoE 框架：通过 PEU 指标（基于路由 logits 的高置信度阈值过滤与 logit 变换）在小型校准集上估计专家重要性，生成领域感知的专家排名，用于编译领域专用或高效多领域的稀疏 MoE 变体。
Result: 在 30B-718B 参数的 MoE 模型上，PreMoE 达到 50% 稀疏性且几乎无性能损失；领域专家最大化域内效率，合成通用模型保留跨域能力。
Conclusion: PreMoE 提供了一种无需重新训练即可实现 MoE 模型稀疏化和专业化的方法，揭示了稀疏预算下专业模型与通用模型之间的部署权衡。
Relevance: 5
