papers.title: Transition-Related Potentials as Markers of Narrative Comprehension in Continuous EEG
papers.abstract_en: Harnessing the potential of electroencephalography (EEG) for brain research is fundamentally limited by intrinsic noise and the diffuse projection of brain-generated activity over the scalp. The standard event-related potential (ERP) paradigm addresses this limitation by relying on repeated independent trials, albeit at the cost of moving away from naturalistic experimental conditions. As a more naturalistic alternative, we collected continuous EEG while participants watched short films and extracted potentials aligned to sharp cinematic transitions (cuts). We demonstrate that such transition-related potentials (TRPs) exhibit canonical ERP-like temporal structure associated with significant information processing. By comparing coherent films with scene-scrambled versions containing matched post-cut sensory input, we find that these responses are systematically shaped by narrative context. We then show that the cut-related EEG signature can be recovered directly from group-averaged continuous recordings with a compact deep neural network (DNN). The detector generalized across films and subject groups, and the resulting TRPs reproduced the main context-dependent effects observed for manually annotated cuts. These results indicate that narrative context leaves a measurable signature in EEG responses, that this signature can be detected directly in continuous recordings, and that such detections provide a semi-automated framework for analyzing how viewers process and understand film narratives. We propose that the method outlined here can be adapted to parse EEG responses to other forms of continuous stimulation, providing a general tool for probing experimental conditions that are closer to natural human experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用连续脑电图（EEG）记录，提取与电影剪辑（cuts）相关的过渡相关电位（TRPs），发现这些电位具有类事件相关电位（ERP）的时间结构，并受叙事语境影响。研究还训练了深度神经网络从连续数据中直接检测剪辑相关的EEG信号，为分析观众理解电影叙事提供半自动化框架。
Motivation: 标准ERP范式依赖重复试验，远离自然实验条件；本文旨在利用连续EEG在自然观影条件下提取叙事理解的神经标记。
Method: 收集参与者观看连贯短片和场景打乱版本的连续EEG，提取时间对齐到剪辑点的过渡相关电位（TRPs），并使用紧凑深度神经网络（DNN）从组平均连续记录中检测剪辑相关EEG信号。
Result: TRPs表现出典型ERP样时间结构，且叙事语境系统性地塑造这些响应；DNN检测器在不同电影和受试组中泛化，再现了手动标注剪辑的主要语境依赖效应。
Conclusion: 叙事语境在EEG中留下可测量的特征，该方法可推广到其他连续刺激条件，为自然实验条件下的脑信号分析提供通用工具。

papers.title: Spatial Generalization Tests for Machine Learning-based Weather Models to Assess Physical Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based weather prediction is revolutionizing weather forecasting by learning from weather data in present-day climate. However, generalization to other climates remains a major challenge. With melting sea ice, land-use change, and increasing ocean temperatures, boundary conditions are changing. Therefore, generalization in time depends on generalization in space. Here, we present three test cases to evaluate whether machine learning-based weather and climate models generalize in space and apply them to GraphCast and NeuralGCM. We reverse or rotate the planet in longitude or latitude under the model's coordinate system and adapt all boundary conditions and forcings accordingly. Physics-based general circulation models simulate a rotated/reversed planet with only rounding errors, but GraphCast and NeuralGCM fail these tests. The analyses furthermore revealed unphysical variable mappings based on correlation rather than causation. We argue that machine learning-based climate models should be designed to pass generalization tests to prevent overfitting on present-day regional climate.
papers.comment: 23 pages (double-spaced), 7 figures in the main text; 14 pages, 4 figures in supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出三个空间泛化测试案例，用于检验机器学习天气和气候模型的物理一致性。通过反转或旋转地球经度/纬度并调整边界条件，发现基于物理的环流模型仅出现舍入误差，而GraphCast和NeuralGCM均失败。分析还揭示了模型存在基于相关性而非因果关系的非物理变量映射。
Motivation: 机器学习天气模型在当今气候数据上表现良好，但泛化到其他气候（如海冰融化、土地利用变化）时面临挑战。时间泛化依赖于空间泛化，现有模型可能过拟合当前区域气候。
Method: 设计三个测试：反转经度、反转纬度、旋转世界，同时调整所有边界条件和强迫。将GraphCast和NeuralGCM与物理模型对比，评估空间泛化能力。
Result: 物理模型仅产生舍入误差，而GraphCast和NeuralGCM均无法通过这些测试，并显示出基于相关性而非因果关系的非物理变量映射。
Conclusion: 机器学习气候模型应设计为通过此类泛化测试，以避免对当前区域气候的过拟合。
Relevance: 75

papers.title: High Minima of Gaussian Processes: Overshoots and Minimizer Locations
papers.abstract_en: Let $X(t)$, $t\in K$, be a centred Gaussian process with continuous sample paths on a compact metric space $K$, and let $M=\min_{t\in K}X(t)$. Let $σ_*^2$ denote the minimum covariance energy associated with $X$, and assume that $σ_*^2>0$. Motivated by the results of \cite{chakrabarty2018asymptotic} for smooth Gaussian processes, we show that, conditionally on $M>u$, the scaled overshoot $u(M-u)$ converges, as $u\to\infty$, to an exponential random variable with mean $σ_*^2$. Moreover, every weak subsequential limit of the conditional law of a measurable minimizer of $X$ is an optimal covariance-energy measure. In particular, if this measure is unique, then the conditional law converges weakly to it. The results are illustrated by stationary Gaussian processes, fractional Brownian motion, and fractional Brownian sheet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究紧度量空间上中心高斯过程在最小值超过高阈值时的过冲分布和最小化子条件分布。证明条件于 M>u 时，缩放过冲 u(M-u) 收敛到均值为 σ_*^2 的指数分布；最小化子的条件分布弱收敛到最优协方差能量测度（若唯一）。
Motivation: 在光滑高斯过程极值理论基础上，推广到一般紧度量空间上的高斯过程，揭示高阈值下最小值过冲和最小化子的渐近行为。
Method: 基于最小协方差能量 σ_*^2 和高斯过程样本路径连续性，采用极值理论和弱收敛方法推导过冲分布和最小化子测度收敛。
Result: 过冲 u(M-u) 条件于 M>u 收敛到均值为 σ_*^2 的指数分布；最小化子的条件分布收敛到最优协方差能量测度。
Conclusion: 给出了高斯过程高最小值行为的统一渐近结果，并通过平稳过程、分数布朗运动等实例验证。

papers.title: NVIDIA-labs OO Agents: Native Python Object-Oriented Agents
papers.abstract_en: Traditional agent development is split across prompt templates, tool schemas, callback code, and workflow graphs. We present NVIDIA Object-Oriented Agents (NOOA), a model-agnostic Python framework for building reliable AI agents. NOOA takes a simpler approach: an agent is a Python object. Its methods are the actions the model can take, fields are its state, docstrings are its prompts, and its type annotations are contracts. A method whose code body consists of "..." is completed at runtime by an LLM-driven agent loop, while methods with normal bodies remain standard deterministic Python. This gives developers and agents the same interface, so agent behavior can be tested, traced, refactored, and improved just like other software. This paper makes three contributions. (1) We present the agent-as-a-Python-object programming model and the design principles behind it. Where Python has existing abstractions, we adopt them directly. Agent-specific capabilities--context, events, state rendering, long-term memory, and validated LLM loops--are exposed through simple Pythonic APIs, so both developers and agents share one familiar programming model. (2) We identify six model-facing ideas that NOOA is, to our knowledge, the first to combine on a single surface: typed input/output, pass-by-reference over live objects, code as action, programmable loop engineering, explicit object state, and model-callable harness APIs for context and events. We find the community already converging on several of these ideas--often as experimental or partial features--and present the comparison to encourage further adoption. (3) We demonstrate that current models use this interface effectively, both in targeted capability tests and on agentic and reasoning benchmarks such as SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 and ARC-AGI-3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NVIDIA Object-Oriented Agents (NOOA)，一个模型无关的Python框架，将AI智能体直接表示为Python对象：方法作为动作，字段作为状态，文档字符串作为提示，类型注解作为契约。方法体为'...'的方法在运行时由LLM驱动完成，而普通方法保持确定性。该框架使得智能体行为可以像常规软件一样测试、跟踪、重构和改进。论文在SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0和ARC-AGI-3等基准上展示了当前模型能有效使用该接口。
Motivation: 传统智能体开发分散在提示模板、工具模式、回调代码和工作流图中，缺乏统一且可维护的编程范式。
Method: 提出智能体即Python对象的编程模型，直接复用Python现有抽象，并通过简单的Pythonic API暴露智能体特定能力（上下文、事件、状态渲染、长期记忆、验证LLM循环），使开发者和智能体共享同一编程模型。同时识别并组合了六个模型面向的核心理念：类型化输入/输出、对活跃对象的引用传递、代码即动作、可编程循环工程、显式对象状态、可被模型调用的harness API。
Result: 论文在能力测试以及SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0和ARC-AGI-3等智能体与推理基准上展示了当前模型能有效使用该接口。
Conclusion: 论文认为社区已在多个理念上趋于一致，提出此对比以鼓励进一步采用该框架。

papers.title: Perspective Latents as an Architectural Condition for Causal Emergence in Active Inference Agents
papers.abstract_en: A recent line of work measures causal emergence in reinforcement learning agents through Integrated Information Decomposition, reporting that $Φ_r$ grows with training and tracks reward improvement. For active inference, this raises the question of how reward-free predictive organization relates to such information-theoretic signatures. I test this within an active inference agent whose architecture separates a fast perception latent $z$ from a slow global latent $g$, where $g$ is driven by prediction error and structurally decoupled from policy gradients. In a reward-free environmental regime-switching protocol, $Φ_r$ concentrates in $g$; its aggregate magnitude is largely architectural and decreases with training. The substantive effect of learning becomes legible only at the atom-compositional level: decoupling flips sign from negative to positive and becomes regime-invariant under environmental change, while downward causation carries the regime-dependent adjustment. These results identify $g$ as the architectural locus of $Φ_r$-relevant temporal organization in an active inference agent, and argue against reading scalar $Φ_r$ as a direct index of learned integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究主动推理智能体中的因果涌现，通过综合信息分解测量Φr。智能体架构分离快速感知潜变量z和慢速全局潜变量g，g由预测误差驱动且与策略梯度解耦。在无奖励的环境切换实验中，Φr主要集中在g中，其大小主要由架构决定并随训练下降，学习效果仅在原子组合层面可辨。
Motivation: 现有研究通过综合信息分解测量强化学习智能体中的因果涌现，发现Φr随训练增长并跟踪奖励改善。对于主动推理，该问题将其无奖励的预测组织与信息论特征联系起来，但具体机制尚不明确。
Method: 采用主动推理智能体，其架构将快速感知潜变量z与慢速全局潜变量g分离；g由预测误差驱动且与策略梯度在结构上解耦。在无奖励环境切换协议下，通过综合信息分解评估Φr的分布与变化。
Result: Φr在g中聚集，其大小主要由架构决定且随训练下降；学习效果仅在原子组合层面显现：解耦使Φr符号从负变为正，并在环境变化下保持稳定，而下向因果携带依赖于环境的调整。
Conclusion: g是主动推理智能体中Φr相关时间组织的架构位置，反对将标量Φr直接视为学习整合程度的指标。

summary_sections.result: Φr在g中聚集，其大小主要由架构决定且随训练下降；学习效果仅在原子组合层面显现：解耦使Φr符号从负变为正，并在环境变化下保持稳定，而下向因果携带依赖于环境的调整。
summary_sections.conclusion: g是主动推理智能体中Φr相关时间组织的架构位置，反对将标量Φr直接视为学习整合程度的指标。

papers.title: U-CFR: Uncertainty-Guided Cascade Forward Refinement for Interactive Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive image segmentation is critical for efficient image annotation; however, existing methods often require many corrective clicks or rely on passive refinement schemes that converge slowly. We propose Uncertainty-Guided Cascade Forward Refinement (U-CFR), a novel inference-time framework that enables models to autonomously self-correct after each user interaction. U-CFR introduces a boundary-aware uncertainty score that fuses segmentation uncertainty, contour gradients, and explicit edge predictions to guide the placement of internal pseudo-clicks. These self-generated clicks target the most ambiguous boundary regions, providing strong corrective signals without additional manual input. To support this process, we design a dual-head network with a shared encoder-decoder backbone: a segmentation head ensures region consistency, while an edge head sharpens boundary alignment. In inference, U-CFR launches a cascade of refinement steps, where each stage leverages the uncertainty-driven pseudo-clicks to refine the mask progressively. Experiments on standard benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed U-CFR improves click efficiency, initial mask quality, and boundary accuracy. It reduces the required clicks by over 10% on challenging datasets like Berkeley and offers a more intelligent and efficient interactive annotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出不确定性引导级联前向细化（U-CFR）框架，用于交互式图像分割。该框架在推理时引入边界感知的不确定性分数，融合分割不确定性、轮廓梯度和边缘预测，自动生成内部伪点击，引导模型逐步修正掩码。实验表明，在Berkeley等数据集上，U-CFR将所需点击次数减少超过10%，同时提升了初始掩码质量和边界精度。
Motivation: 现有交互式分割方法通常需要大量用户纠正点击，或依赖被动细化方案，导致收敛缓慢，效率低下。
Method: 提出U-CFR框架，包含双头网络（分割头和边缘头）共享编码器-解码器骨干。推理时，利用边界感知不确定性分数自动生成伪点击，定位最模糊的边界区域，执行级联细化步骤，无需额外人工输入。
Result: 在标准基准数据集上，U-CFR提高了点击效率、初始掩码质量和边界精度。在Berkeley等具有挑战性的数据集上，所需点击次数减少超过10%。
Conclusion: U-CFR提供了一种更智能、高效的交互式注释方案，使模型能够在用户每次交互后自主纠正，显著降低人工成本。

papers.title: A Framework for Reputation Aware Uninorm-driven Consensus Algorithms for Blockchain Networks
papers.abstract_en: The operation of blockchain is governed by consensus algorithms (CA). Several consensus mechanisms require significant computational power, while others necessitate high amounts of stakes to select the participant to validate and verify the transactions in the block, leading to centralisation of power and participant exclusion. This paper proposes a novel methodology to address these issues in reputation-based consensus algorithms by studying the reputation behaviour of the validator using intuitionistic fuzzy sets (IFSs) and uninorm aggregation operations (UAOs). Our approach uses IFSs to express the "reputation" because the reputation values in a consensus algorithm eventually imply uncertainty, and IFSs facilitate the representation of a lack of precise knowledge about reputation. Moreover, this methodology utilises uninorm aggregation operations to monitor reputation over time and reinforces the importance of negative and positive reputation. Consequently, this solution allows validators to rectify past failures in subsequent verification processes and foster an equitable consensus algorithm design. The proposed framework maintains linear computational complexity and does not introduce additional communication overhead beyond the underlying consensus protocol. Supported by experimental results, our methodology demonstrates improved performance and evaluation, promising advancements in blockchain network fairness and inclusivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对区块链共识算法中计算开销大、权益集中导致参与排除的问题，提出一种基于声誉的共识算法框架。该框架利用直觉模糊集（IFSs）表示声誉的不确定性，并采用一致和算子（uninorm）聚合操作随时间监控声誉，允许验证者纠正过去的失败，促进公平的共识算法设计。实验表明该方法保持线性计算复杂度且不增加额外通信开销，在区块链网络公平性和包容性方面有改进。
Motivation: 现有共识机制要么需要大量计算资源，要么要求高额权益，导致权力集中和参与者排除，缺乏对声誉不确定性及正负声誉动态平衡的恰当处理。
Method: 提出使用直觉模糊集（IFSs）表达声誉值以处理不确定性，并利用一致和算子（UAOs）聚合声誉更新，使验证者能够通过后续正确行为弥补之前的失败，同时保持线性计算复杂度。
Result: 实验结果显示该框架在区块链网络公平性和包容性方面性能提升，且不引入超出底层共识协议的额外通信开销，计算复杂度保持线性。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个基于声誉的、支持纠正机制的共识算法设计，有望促进区块链网络的公平性和包容性，但未讨论实际部署环境中的安全假设或激励兼容性。

papers.title: CEDAR: Causal Edge Discovery for Autoregressive Processes
papers.abstract_en: We propose CEDAR (Causal Edge Discovery for Autoregressive Processes), a constraint-based method for lagged causal edge discovery in sparse autoregressive time series. CEDAR screens candidate cross-variable lags using AR(1)-residualized, U-centered distance correlation, then applies two targeted conditional-independence tests per significant cross-variable lag candidate and accepts at most one lag per ordered pair. A stable MCI pruning step removes indirect edges, and optional deterministic C-nodes adjust for specified trend-like nonstationarity. In sparse regimes where few lags survive screening, CEDAR requires $O(d^2)$ CI tests after screening while retaining edge-level interpretability. CEDAR is most effective when data are scarce and variables exhibit lag-1 self-dynamics; methods with richer conditioning sets become preferable as $T$ grows or when higher-order autoregressive or simultaneous multi-lag effects are common.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CEDAR 方法，一种基于约束的稀疏自回归时间序列滞后因果边发现算法。通过 AR(1) 残差化 U 中心距离相关筛选候选滞后，再对每个显著交叉变量滞后执行两次条件独立性检验，并接受每对有序变量最多一个滞后。使用稳定 MCI 剪枝去除间接边，可选确定性 C 节点处理趋势型非平稳性。在稀疏场景下，筛选后仅需 O(d^2) 次 CI 测试。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在高维时间序列中计算成本高，且在数据稀缺或自回归动力学简单时效率不足。需要一种在稀疏自回归过程中高效且可解释的滞后因果边发现方法。
Method: CEDAR 算法：先用 AR(1) 残差化的 U 中心距离相关筛选候选交叉变量滞后，再对每个候选滞后执行两个目标条件独立性检验，每对有序变量最多接受一个滞后。随后通过稳定 MCI 剪枝移除间接边，并可选择加入确定性 C 节点处理非平稳性。
Result: 在稀疏场景下（少量滞后通过筛选），CEDAR 仅需 O(d^2) 次 CI 测试，且保持边级别的可解释性。该方法在数据稀缺且变量具有滞后-1自动力学时最有效。
Conclusion: CEDAR 适用于稀疏自回归时间序列的因果发现，尤其当数据量少且变量主要受自身滞后影响时。随着时间点 T 增加或高阶自回归/多滞后效应普遍存在，其他使用更丰富条件集的方法更优。

papers.title: Attribution Markets: A Fisher-Market Formulation for Fractional Credit Assignment Between Planned Tasks and Performed Actions
papers.abstract_en: Personal and organizational planning systems maintain two records that drift apart: what was planned (a task's effort budget) and what was done (a logged action's duration and description). Existing systems bridge them with an exclusive, all-or-nothing link that strands genuinely related but unlinked effort and reports false stalls on active goals. We formulate the bridge as a quasi-linear Fisher market: planned tasks are budget-constrained buyers, performed actions are divisible goods, and a fused text/structural/temporal signal sets each buyer's valuation. Two market instruments - a seller reserve price and a buyer cash option - yield conservation, a hard budget cap, and a provable junk filter as theorems. We extend the market with a concave completion utility discounting progress as a task nears its plan; standard convergence theory for the market's algorithm does not transfer here, resolved by a satiation-threshold fixed point with existence (Brouwer) and local uniqueness under an explicit diagonal-dominance condition, validated empirically on random and adversarial instances. A de-circularized, multi-seed benchmark - observed affinity corrupted independently of the scored ground truth - surfaces a genuine weak spot: the market's sharp, zero-entropy equilibrium is more sensitive to affinity noise than entropy-regularized optimal transport's permanently smoothed one. We resolve this with a one-parameter entropy-regularized generalization unifying the two, plus a noise-adaptive rule for its regularization strength. We report full reproducibility parameters, discuss limitations candidly, and relate the result to multi-touch attribution, optimal transport, and online Fisher-market algorithms.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 3 figures. Companion technical report with extended treatment of dynamic/forward-looking markets and reinforcement-learning extensions available separately
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于准线性 Fisher 市场的归因市场框架，用于在计划任务与执行动作之间进行分数信用分配。计划任务作为预算受限的买方，执行动作作为可分割商品，通过融合文本、结构和时序信号的估值函数连接二者。市场引入卖方保留价和买方现金选项，实现预算上限与垃圾过滤功能；扩展模型包含凹完成效用折扣，并通过饱和阈值不动点保证均衡存在性与局部唯一性。实验表明，零熵均衡对亲和性噪声敏感，因此提出熵正则化泛化版本及噪声自适应规则。
Motivation: 现有计划与执行记录系统使用排他性全有或全无的链接，导致真正相关的未链接努力被忽略，且对活跃目标报告虚假停滞。需要一种更精细的信用分配机制。
Method: 将归因问题形式化为拟线性 Fisher 市场：计划任务是买方（预算约束），执行动作是卖方（可分割商品），估值函数融合文本、结构和时序信号。引入卖方保留价和买方现金选项实现保守性、硬预算上限和垃圾过滤。扩展模型包括凹完成效用折扣，通过饱和阈值不动点（Brouwer）和显式对角占优条件保证均衡存在性与局部唯一性。进一步提出熵正则化泛化版本，统一零熵均衡与熵正则化最优传输，并给出噪声自适应正则化强度规则。
Result: 在随机和对抗性实例上验证了均衡存在性与局部唯一性。去循环多种子基准测试显示，零熵均衡对亲和性噪声的敏感性高于熵正则化最优传输的永久平滑解。熵正则化泛化版本解决了此弱点。
Conclusion: 论文公开了完全可复现参数，坦率讨论了局限性，并将结果与多触点归因、最优传输和在线 Fisher 市场算法联系起来。

papers.title: DS@GT ARC at ImageCLEFmed GANs 2026: Geometric Filtering for Privacy-Preserving CT Slice Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present a privacy-preserving framework for synthetic lung CT slice generation developed for the Image-CLEFmed GANs 2026 challenge. The approach combines Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching with privacy-oriented training and a post-generation "Supervisor" pipeline that filters generated candidates in learned geometric latent spaces using autoencoder embeddings, Determinantal Point Processes, and Stein Kernel Thinning. Official results show a strong realism-privacy trade-off, with the best-performing model achieving a Privacy Preservation Score of 0.549 and competitive visual fidelity with an FID of 0.3290. While the proposed geometric filtering substantially reduces nearest-neighbor memorization and membership-inference leakage, persistent patient re-identification scores indicate that preventing direct image copying is not sufficient to remove deeper patient-specific anatomical identity, highlighting an important frontier for future privacy-preserving medical image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 ImageCLEFmed GANs 2026 挑战赛，提出一个隐私保护的肺 CT 切片合成框架。方法结合最优传输条件流匹配 (Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching) 与隐私导向训练，并引入后生成的“监督器”流水线，通过自编码器嵌入、行列式点过程 (Determinantal Point Processes) 和 Stein 核细化 (Stein Kernel Thinning) 在学习到的几何隐空间中过滤生成候选。官方结果显示最佳模型达到隐私保护分数 0.549 和 FID 0.3290。尽管几何过滤显著降低了最近邻记忆和成员推断泄露，但患者重识别分数仍表明防止直接图像复制不足以消除深层解剖特征，指出未来隐私保护医学图像生成的重要方向。
Motivation: 生成对抗网络 (GANs) 在医学图像合成中面临隐私泄露风险，现有方法在保持图像真实性的同时难以有效防止患者身份重识别。
Method: 采用 Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching 生成候选图像，后接“监督器”流水线：利用自编码器嵌入构建几何隐空间，结合行列式点过程和 Stein 核细化进行候选过滤，以筛选出隐私风险低的样本。
Result: 最佳模型在挑战赛上取得隐私保护分数 0.549 和 FID 0.3290，几何过滤降低了最近邻记忆和成员推断泄露。

papers.title: Spatially Grounded Concept Bottleneck Models for Trustworthy Breast Ultrasound Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models provide interpretable-by-design predictions by mediating diagnosis through human-understandable concepts, but in medical imaging, their trustworthiness is often limited by the quality and granularity of available supervision. In particular, predicted concept activations can be driven by irrelevant regions, leading to spatially unfaithful explanations. We study a data-centric spatially grounded Concept Bottleneck Model (SG-CBM) that leverages coarse lesion delineations as weak supervision to encourage anatomically plausible concept evidence. For breast ultrasound, we derive two clinically motivated zones from each lesion mask: (i) an in-lesion region of interest for morphology-related concepts and (ii) a posterior acoustic band for posterior phenomena. We train concept maps using a grouped spatial grounding objective and preserve semantic faithfulness with a linear bottleneck classifier. Across five-fold stratified group cross-validation, the proposed SG-CBM improves diagnostic AUROC and concept macro-AUROC while markedly increasing spatial alignment of concept evidence. We also perform a Train-corrupt/Test-clean annotation-quality stress test to quantify the impact of supervision quality on diagnosis and spatial faithfulness. Overall, the results underscore the need for data-quality-aware supervision design and systematic trustworthiness validation for deployable healthcare AI systems.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Data Quality Aware, High-Performance, and Trustworthy AI Systems for Healthcare at IEEE/ACM CHASE 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种空间引导的概念瓶颈模型（SG-CBM），通过在乳腺超声图像中利用粗病灶标注作为弱监督，鼓励概念证据的解剖学合理性，从而提升模型的可信度和解释性。实验表明，该方法在诊断AUROC和概念宏AUROC上均有提升，并显著改善了概念证据的空间对齐。

Conclusion: 强调了数据质量感知的监督设计和系统性可信度验证对可部署医疗AI系统的必要性。

papers.title: Seasonality of hail outbreaks in the United States and its link to weather regimes
papers.abstract_en: Hailstorms in the United States produce immense economic losses and have an occurrence frequency that appears to have a long-term positive trend. Here we contribute an updated examination of such hail activity and the relevant environmental parameters over the period 1990--2024. We define a hail outbreak as any day with $\gt 6$ significant hail reports ($hail\geq 2$'' diameter) and find a positive trend in hail outbreaks since 1990 ($slope=0.8$ days $yr^{-1}$) with the largest increases occurring in May and June and in the Southern Great Plains. Analysis of environmental parameters shows that the long-term increase in hail outbreaks correlates with a long-term increase in the significant hail parameter (SHIP, $cc=0.67$, $p\lt 0.01$). The interannual variability and long-term trend of SHIP are driven both by thermodynamic and kinematic processes, though kinematic processes play a more important role than thermodynamic processes in the interannual variability of hail outbreaks. Using warm-season (April--July) weather regimes (WRs), we find that large-scale circulation modulates the interannual variability of hail outbreak frequency. An empirical model using WR frequency captures the interannual variability in warm-season hail outbreaks reasonably well ($cc=0.38$, $p=0.03$). Our study is the first to relate hail activity to WRs and presents a better understanding of the trend and year-to-year variability of hail outbreaks.
papers.comment: 30 pages including title page and supplementary figures, 6 manuscript figures, 9 supplemental figures, submitted to AMS Journal of Climate and has not yet been peer-reviewed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文更新了1990-2024年美国冰雹爆发活动的分析，定义冰雹爆发日为一天内超过6次显著冰雹报告（直径≥2英寸）。研究发现冰雹爆发的长期正趋势（斜率0.8天/年），尤其在5-6月和南部大平原增幅最大。环境参数分析显示显著冰雹参数（SHIP）与冰雹爆发长期相关（相关系数0.67，p<0.01），且运动学过程比热力学过程在年际变化中更重要。首次将冰雹活动与天气型（WR）关联，基于WR频率的统计模型能较好地捕捉暖季冰雹爆发的年际变化（相关系数0.38，p=0.03）。
Motivation: 冰雹在美国造成巨大经济损失且发生频率呈长期上升趋势，但现有研究对冰雹爆发的季节性和年际变化机制理解不足，尤其缺乏与天气型的关联分析。
Method: 基于1990-2024年冰雹报告定义冰雹爆发日，分析环境参数（如SHIP）的长期趋势和相关性，并利用暖季（4-7月）天气型（WR）建立统计模型，研究大尺度环流对冰雹爆发频率的调制作用。
Result: 冰雹爆发呈显著正趋势（0.8天/年），与SHIP长期相关（cc=0.67），运动学过程主导年际变化；WR模型可解释暖季冰雹爆发年际变化（cc=0.38，p=0.03）。
Conclusion: 本研究首次建立冰雹活动与天气型的联系，提供了对冰雹爆发趋势和年际变率的新理解，但模型解释力有限，且未涉及预报或同化应用。

papers.title: Explanation-Based Runtime Verification for Trustworthy ML-driven Optical Networks
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) models are increasingly integrated into optical network automation frameworks to support tasks such as failure management, performance monitoring and resource allocation. In these environments, ML-driven predictions may be directly coupled with control-plane actions where incorrect decisions can immediately impact service quality, resource efficiency, and network stability. As automation levels increase, ensuring the reliability of individual decisions at deployment time becomes a critical requirement. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques have emerged to improve transparency by highlighting the factors influencing ML predictions. In addition to identifying influential features, they provide insights into the underlying reasoning process of the model, revealing how different input variables contribute to the final outcome and how feature interactions shape the decision boundary. In this work, we introduce explanation-based runtime verification, an approach that exploits model explanations to assess the soundness of individual ML decisions before they are executed in the network control loop. The proposed approach evaluates explanation coherence and physics grounding consistency at runtime, enabling the system to defer or reject decisions flagged as uncertain. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on a representative use case of lightpath quality of transmission classification. Experimental results show that explanation-based verification can intercept a significant fraction of erroneous decisions while preserving high automation rate.
papers.comment: 6 Pages, 2 Figures. Accepted and presented at the 30th International Conference on Optical Network Design and Modelling (ONDM 2026), Munich, Germany, 12-15 May 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于解释的运行时验证方法，利用模型解释（XAI）在光网络控制环路中评估机器学习决策的合理性，在光通路质量分类任务上拦截大量错误决策的同时保持高自动化率。
Motivation: 光网络中ML驱动的决策直接影响服务质量、资源效率和网络稳定性，现有方法缺乏对单个决策在部署时刻的可靠性保障。
Method: 利用模型解释（如特征重要性、推理过程）在运行时评估解释一致性和物理基础合理性，对不确定的决策进行延迟或拒绝。
Result: 在光通路质量分类用例中，验证方法能拦截显著比例的错误决策，同时保持高自动化率。
Conclusion: 基于解释的运行时验证可有效提升ML驱动光网络的决策可靠性，但需进一步评估在不同任务和场景下的泛化能力。

papers.title: End-to-End Learning of Safe Optimal Feedback Control in High Dimensions with Control Barrier Function Layers
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of learning high-dimensional semi-global feedback controllers under hard safety constraints enforced by control barrier functions (CBFs). Incorporating CBFs into end-to-end policy training requires embedding a quadratic-program-based safety filter as an optimization layer, but computational and differentiation bottlenecks have largely restricted prior approaches to low-dimensional systems, typically with at most 16 state dimensions. We address this limitation by combining operator splitting with the recently developed Jacobian-Free Backpropagation (JFB) method to enable scalable end-to-end training while preserving hard safety guarantees through the CBF safety filter. We justify this training methodology theoretically using nonsmooth analysis techniques and demonstrate its effectiveness on high-dimensional multi-agent nonlinear control problems with state and control dimensions up to 1200 and 400, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种端到端学习方法，将控制障碍函数（CBF）安全滤波器作为优化层嵌入策略训练中，结合算子分裂与雅可比自由反向传播（JFB），实现高维安全最优反馈控制。在状态和控制维度分别高达1200和400的多智能体非线性控制问题中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法因计算和微分瓶颈，难以将CBF安全滤波器扩展到高维系统（通常最多16维），限制了其在大规模控制问题中的应用。
Method: 利用算子分裂加速二次规划求解，并结合雅可比自由反向传播（JFB）实现可扩展的端到端训练，同时通过CBF安全滤波器保证硬安全约束。
Result: 在高维多智能体非线性控制问题（状态维度1200，控制维度400）上展示了有效性，实现了安全约束下的可行控制。
Conclusion: 该方法理论上有非光滑分析支持，实践上可扩展至高维系统，为安全关键控制中的端到端学习提供了新途径。

papers.title: ODeform: Learning Continuous 4D Motion for Shape Deformation with Neural ODEs
papers.abstract_en: Modeling continuous object deformation is important for many computer vision and robotics tasks, such as manipulation and simulation. Existing approaches rely on learning-based methods or physics simulators to model shape deformations. However, these approaches either use discrete time steps or are too computationally intensive for real-time applications. We present ODeform, a novel extension of Neural Ordinary Differential Equations to continuous 4D dynamics of deformable objects in 3D space. Our method transforms 3D point clouds and physical conditions (like material properties) into a unified latent space. By solving the resulting ordinary differential equations over time, we model deformations as continuous flows within this learned embedding, eliminating the need for discrete time steps while maintaining computational efficiency. We evaluate our approach on unseen physical parameter configurations, showing improved motion prediction accuracy over baseline methods. Our experiments further demonstrate a successful transfer to real 3D captured objects with novel shapes, along with effective interpolation and extrapolation of the learned dynamics. Our code and data will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ODeform，将神经常微分方程（Neural ODEs）扩展到可变形物体的连续4D动力学建模。该方法将3D点云和物理条件（如材料属性）编码到统一潜空间，通过求解ODE在时间上建模连续变形流，避免了离散时间步长的需要，同时保持计算效率。在未见物理参数配置和新形状的真实3D对象上，运动预测精度优于基线方法，并展示了有效的插值和外推能力。
Motivation: 现有基于学习或物理仿真的变形建模方法要么使用离散时间步长导致不连续，要么计算量过大无法实时应用。需要一种既能处理连续变形又保持计算高效的方法。
Method: 将3D点云和物理条件映射到统一潜空间，利用神经ODE对潜空间中的连续时间动力学进行建模，通过求解ODE得到连续变形流。
Result: 在未见物理参数配置上运动预测精度优于基线；成功迁移到真实3D捕获的新形状，并能有效插值和外推动力学。
Conclusion: ODeform为连续变形建模提供了新的框架，结合了神经ODE的连续性和计算效率，在机器人操作和仿真等任务中有应用潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Agent Failures to Text Policies: What Works and What Breaks
papers.abstract_en: TextGrad improves language-model systems by revising text from feedback. Its core thesis is that natural-language feedback can act as a gradient for optimizing text components without changing model weights. Applying it to agents is harder because feedback arrives only after a sequence of actions, making it difficult to identify which decision caused failure. We study this problem by separating the ability to follow a useful policy from the ability to learn that policy from experience. Our main finding is a clear gap between these two abilities. Human-written policies improve two frozen 7B agents on TextWorldExpress by 5.0 success points, showing that useful policy text exists. However, policies generated from agent trajectories do not reliably outperform fixed prompting, even with richer traces, counterfactual evidence, or iterative GEPA search. The main challenge for agent-level TextGrad is therefore not executing textual policy updates, but reliably generating and selecting them from experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将TextGrad（通过自然语言反馈优化文本）应用于智能体（agent）的挑战。实验发现，人类编写的策略能显著提升两个冻结7B智能体的任务成功率（5.0个成功点），但基于智能体轨迹自动生成的策略无法稳定超越固定提示。主要瓶颈不在于执行策略更新，而在于从经验中可靠地生成和选择策略。
Motivation: TextGrad在语言模型系统中有效，但应用于智能体时，反馈仅在动作序列结束后才到达，难以定位具体决策错误。论文旨在分离“遵循有用策略”与“从经验学习策略”两种能力，并揭示其中的差距。
Method: 在TextWorldExpress环境中，分别使用人类编写策略和基于智能体轨迹（包括更丰富的轨迹、反事实证据或迭代GEPA搜索）自动生成的策略，比较两种能力。
Result: 人类编写的策略使两个冻住的7B智能体的成功点数提升5.0，而自动生成的策略无法可靠地优于固定提示。
Conclusion: 智能体级别TextGrad的主要挑战不在于执行文本策略更新，而在于从经验中可靠地生成和选择策略。

papers.title: Cross-Domain Generalization in Optical Networks via Joint Contrastive and Classification Learning
papers.abstract_en: The robustness of machine learning techniques across heterogeneous network domains remains an open challenge in optical networks. Models trained on data from a specific topology or operational configuration often exhibit degraded performance when deployed in unseen networks. In this work, we address this challenge by proposing a representation learning technique aimed at capturing task-relevant relationships that remain stable across domains. The proposed technique is based on a novel joint contrastive and classification learning approach in which representation learning and task optimization are performed simultaneously, allowing both objectives to shape the latent space. Experimental results on a representative use case, namely, lightpath quality of transmission estimation, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach compared to baseline approaches, and highlight its capacity for rapid adaptation, providing excellent performance even with limited fine-tuning.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted and presented at the 30th International Conference on Optical Network Design and Modelling (ONDM 2026), Munich, Germany, 12-15 May 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对光网络中机器学习模型在不同网络域间泛化能力差的问题，提出联合对比与分类学习（joint contrastive and classification learning）的表示学习技术，同时进行表示学习和任务优化，使潜在空间同时被两个目标塑造。在光路传输质量估计任务上验证了有效性，并表明即使只有少量微调也能快速适应。
Motivation: 光网络中基于特定拓扑或配置数据训练的模型在未见过的网络中性能下降，跨域泛化是开放挑战。
Method: 提出联合对比学习和分类学习的方法，在学习表示的同时优化任务目标，使潜在空间同时反映对比相似性和任务相关性。
Result: 在光路传输质量估计任务上，该方法优于基线方法，且具有快速适应能力，少量微调即可取得优秀性能。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效捕获跨域稳定的任务相关关系，实现跨域泛化。

papers.title: Axolotl3D: a Unified Framework for Faithful 3D Shape Completion
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D generative models produce high-quality geometry from a single image using large-scale priors and diffusion architectures. However, they assume complete visibility and single-view inputs, limiting applicability in multi-view, occluded, or editing scenarios. Although prior works address these challenges individually, they lack a unified framework for controllable 3D completion under diverse conditioning signals. We present Axolotl3D, a multi-modal and occlusion-aware 3D generation model that jointly conditions on images, visibility masks, camera parameters, and a partial point cloud. The point cloud serves as a geometric anchor promoting faithful shape completion, while camera parameters ensure consistent multi-view alignment in a shared 3D coordinate system. A unified training strategy synthesizes diverse conditioning regimes from large-scale 3D data, enabling robust cross-modal reasoning. Experiments on Toys4K and OmniObject3D demonstrate state-of-the-art performance under both clean and occluded settings, as well as strong results in real-world reconstruction and geometry-consistent editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Axolotl3D，一个多模态、遮挡感知的3D生成模型，联合处理图像、可见性掩码、相机参数和部分点云，实现忠实形状完成。通过统一训练策略从大规模3D数据合成多样条件，在Toys4K和OmniObject3D上取得最优性能，并在真实重建和几何一致编辑中表现强劲。
Motivation: 现有3D生成模型假设完全可见性和单视图输入，在多视图、遮挡或编辑场景中受限，缺乏统一框架。
Method: 提出Axolotl3D，联合条件于图像、可见性掩码、相机参数和部分点云，点云作为几何锚点，相机参数保证多视图对齐；通过统一训练策略从大规模3D数据合成多样条件，实现跨模态推理。
Result: 在Toys4K和OmniObject3D上，干净和遮挡设置下均达到最先进性能；在真实世界重建和几何一致编辑任务中表现强劲。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了跨模态稳健推理和忠实形状完成，适用于多视图、遮挡及编辑场景。

papers.title: Writhe-Based Polymer Link Classification Using Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Unique and rapid classification of knots and links is an open mathematical problem that is relevant to a range of (bio)physical systems, including polymer melts, DNA, and proteins. In this paper, we explore a data-driven approach to the classification problem of link topology. Extending the framework introduced in Ref. 1 (Sleiman et al, 2024 Soft Matter, 20(1), pp.71-78), we show that a feedforward neural network trained on the writhe density matrix classifies thermally equilibrated configurations of the first six prime links with 97% accuracy. We demonstrate that this accuracy remains high across a range of temperatures and lengths of link components, while rapidly deteriorating with the addition of topology-altering Gaussian noise; a result consistent with the writhe density matrix containing features sensitive to topology. Our results show that neural networks based on the writhe density matrix efficiently classify two-component links, establishing machine learning as a promising tool for rapid classification of more complex link topologies, e.g. Borromean rings and multi-component links, as the computational cost of exact numerical calculation of topological invariants becomes prohibitive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索用数据驱动方法分类链接拓扑，扩展Sleiman等人的框架，使用扭率密度矩阵训练前馈神经网络，对前六个素链接的热平衡构型实现97%的分类准确率。该方法在跨温度和链长下保持高精度，但添加拓扑改变高斯噪声后性能迅速下降，表明扭率密度矩阵包含拓扑敏感特征。结果表明基于扭率密度矩阵的神经网络能有效分类双组分链接，为更复杂链接拓扑（如博罗米恩环）的快速分类提供了机器学习工具。
Motivation: 结和链的唯一快速分类是开放数学问题，对聚合物熔体、DNA和蛋白质等（生物）物理系统重要，但精确计算拓扑不变量成本高昂。
Method: 使用前馈神经网络，输入为扭率密度矩阵（源自Ref.1），对热平衡的六种素链接构型进行分类。
Result: 对前六个素链接的分类准确率达97%；该精度在多种温度和链长下保持，但加入高斯噪声后迅速下降。
Conclusion: 基于扭率密度矩阵的神经网络能高效双组分链接分类，为更复杂拓扑（如博罗米恩环）的快速分类提供了可行方向，尤其在精确计算拓扑不变量成本过高时。

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Horizon Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Effective decision-making in complex and changing environments requires balancing short-term and long-term consequences. In reinforcement learning (RL), this trade-off is typically controlled through a fixed discount factor, which imposes a single exponentially discounted temporal horizon. However, biological agents exhibit flexible and adaptive temporal discounting, suggesting that effective planning requires multiple timescales. Here, we propose a multi-horizon approach that adaptively selects and combines temporal horizons, enabling robust adaptation to changes in reward structure without manual discount-factor tuning. This flexibility makes the method particularly suitable for continual learning scenarios involving task switches and varying environmental configurations. Empirically, we demonstrate that our approach identifies effective discount factors across a range of MiniGrid environments, including continual settings composed of three sequentially changing tasks. These results suggest that adaptive temporal discounting can improve parameter efficiency and enhance adaptability in both artificial and biologically inspired learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应多时间视界强化学习方法，通过自适应选择和组合多个时间折扣因子来平衡短期与长期回报，无需手动调参。实验在MiniGrid环境（包括连续任务切换场景）中验证了该方法能有效识别合适的折扣因子，提升参数效率和适应性。
Motivation: 标准强化学习依赖单一固定折扣因子，无法灵活适应奖励结构变化，而生物智能体表现出自适应时间折扣。现有方法在任务切换或环境变化时表现不佳，需要手动调参。
Method: 提出一个多时间视界框架，动态选择和组合多个折扣因子，通过一种自适应机制调整各时间视界的权重，从而在不调整超参数的情况下适应变化的环境。
Result: 在MiniGrid环境中，包括三个连续任务切换的持续学习场景，该方法能自动识别有效折扣因子，性能优于固定折扣因子baseline。
Conclusion: 自适应时间折扣有望提升参数效率和适应性，适用于人工和类脑学习系统，尤其是持续学习场景。

papers.title: SalesLoop: Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback for Sales Lead Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Lead ranking in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems faces a persistent challenge: models achieving high offline accuracy often underperform in production. We identify three fundamental gaps responsible for this disconnect: offline-online metric mismatch, pointwise-listwise objective misalignment, and temporal distribution drift. To address these gaps, we propose SalesLoop, a reinforcement learning framework that establishes a closed feedback loop between model predictions and real-world business outcomes. Our approach introduces (1) a performance-aware reward that encodes conversion outcomes weighted by ranking position and conversion velocity, and (2) Discriminative GRPO, a listwise optimization objective that adapts Group Relative Policy Optimization to discriminative ranking models. SalesLoop improves NDCG@K by +7.9\% and P@K by +15.8\% over the strongest static baseline. A 160-day production A/B test at a New Energy Vehicle manufacturer, spanning 16.5M leads and 280 sales specialists across two provincial markets, validates statistically significant cumulative lift of +4.7\% ($p=0.047$) and +8.7\% ($p=0.002$). In production, the ranking backbone achieves Top-10\% recall of 44.1\% and surfaces high-intent leads at $2.3\times$ the conversion rate of specialist baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CRM系统中销售线索排序模型离线准确率高但在线表现差的问题，提出SalesLoop强化学习框架。该框架通过性能感知奖励和判别式GRPO优化目标，在NDCG@K和P@K上分别提升+7.9%和+15.8%，并在某新能源汽车制造商16.5M线索的160天A/B测试中取得统计显著的累计提升。
Motivation: 现有线索排序模型存在离线-在线指标不匹配、pointwise-listwise目标不一致以及时间分布漂移三大差距，导致高离线准确率无法转化为生产环境中的实际效果。
Method: 提出SalesLoop框架，包含(1)性能感知奖励函数，根据转化结果、排序位置和转化速度加权；(2)Discriminative GRPO，将Group Relative Policy Optimization适配为判别式排序模型的列表式优化目标。
Result: NDCG@K提升+7.9%，P@K提升+15.8%（vs.最强静态基线）。160天生产A/B测试验证累计提升+4.7%（p=0.047）和+8.7%（p=0.002）。生产环境中Top-10%召回率44.1%，高意向线索转化率为专家基线的2.3倍。
Conclusion: SalesLoop通过闭环反馈有效弥合了离线-在线性能差距，在真实业务场景中取得显著且统计可靠的提升。

papers.title: PhysCoRe: Physics-Corrected Residual World Models for Material-Aware Deformable Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Predicting how deformable objects evolve under robotic manipulation is a longstanding challenge. Existing approaches typically rely on per-object optimization to fit material parameters, which can be slow and cannot generalize, while end-to-end learned alternatives extrapolate poorly and often violate basic physical structure. We present PhysCoRe, a physics-corrected residual world model that couples a differentiable Material Point Method (MPM) simulator with two feed-forward neural networks. A material refinement module, Material from Motion (MfM), infers per-particle elasticity from visual observations, grounding the simulator in object-specific physics. A residual correction module, Residual from Dynamics (RfD), learns the discrepancy and predicts corrections to the simulator's internal dynamics, absorbing systematic biases that the analytical model cannot capture. This design also supports online material identification on novel objects. MfM adapts from limited interactions, and its predictive uncertainty steers further exploration toward the regions where its estimate is least confident. Experiments on real deformable-object manipulation sequences show that PhysCoRe outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in prediction accuracy, and that its predicted confidence forms a reliable distribution across the object's geometry, providing a natural signal for future confidence-guided exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出PhysCoRe，一种物理校正残差世界模型，将可微分物质点法（MPM）模拟器与两个前馈神经网络耦合。材料细化模块（MfM）从视觉观测推断每粒子弹性，残差校正模块（RfD）学习并校正模拟器内部动力学的系统偏差。在真实可变形物体操作序列上，PhysCoRe在预测精度上优于现有基线，且其预测置信度在物体几何上形成可靠分布，为未来置信度引导的探索提供信号。
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖每对象优化拟合材料参数，速度慢且无法泛化，要么端到端学习外推能力差且常违反物理结构。需要一种既能适应新物体又能保持物理合理性的可变形动力学预测方法。
Method: 耦合可微分MPM模拟器与两个前馈网络：MfM从视觉观测推断每粒子弹性参数以接地物理模拟，RfD学习模拟器内部动力学的残差并预测校正，吸收分析模型无法捕获的系统偏差。支持在线材料辨识，利用预测不确定性引导探索。
Result: 在真实可变形物体操作序列上，PhysCoRe的预测精度优于现有基线，且预测置信度在物体几何上形成可靠分布。
Conclusion: 摘要强调物理校正残差世界模型结合物理模拟与数据驱动校正可有效预测可变形动力学，并提供不确定性信号用于主动探索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Interpretable Transformers with Parity Bottleneck Layers
papers.abstract_en: Language models are thought to exhibit the phenomenon of superposition, representing many more features than dimensions in their residual streams. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are designed to recover such features post-hoc, but training models that are interpretable by construction has remained impractical, as a per-layer over-complete bottleneck is prohibitively expensive in both memory and compute. To overcome this issue, we introduce the ParityTransformer, a GPT-2-scale architecture whose intermediate representations are efficient and wide / sparse by design. At each layer, a Deep Parity Bottleneck (DPB) replaces a learned over-complete basis with a parameter-free algebraic dictionary, providing a deterministic incoherence guarantee and eliminating the memory requirements that have prevented per-layer interpretable bottlenecks at scale. A DPB is a hierarchically structured sparse bottleneck which efficiently enforces sparsity using a multi-level mixture-of-experts approach: a hardware-aware implementation that closes the cost gap between activation sparse and dense training to a manageable interpretability tax. Empirically, ParityTransformers perform at least as well as post-hoc SAEs on sparse probing tasks, while out-performing on measures of feature absorption, steering effectiveness, and fine-grained causal interventions. Because subsequent computation acts only on features that survive the sparse bottleneck, the ParityTransformer's features are native to the model's forwards pass by construction, addressing the question of whether SAEs probe features the model actually uses during computation. We see this as a step toward training models whose internal representations are interpretable by design rather than recovered post hoc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ParityTransformer，一种使用深度奇偶瓶颈层（Deep Parity Bottleneck）替代传统过完备瓶颈的GPT-2规模架构，通过参数无关的代数字典实现确定性不相干保证，并利用多级混合专家方法高效强制执行稀疏性。实验表明，ParityTransformer在稀疏探针任务上不逊于事后稀疏自编码器（SAE），在特征吸收、引导有效性和细粒度因果干预方面表现更优，其特征天生属于模型前向传播过程。
Motivation: 现有语言模型表现出叠加现象，即残差流中表示的特征数远多于维度数。事后训练的SAE虽能恢复特征，但逐层过完备瓶颈在内存和计算上代价高昂，无法实际训练内建可解释性的模型。
Method: 引入Deep Parity Bottleneck（DPB），用无参数的代数字典替换学习的过完备基，提供确定性不相干保证，消除内存需求；采用硬件感知的多级混合专家方法实现高效稀疏性，使激活稀疏训练与密集训练之间的成本差距降至可管理的可解释性税。
Result: ParityTransformer在稀疏探针任务上至少与事后SAE表现相当，在特征吸收、引导有效性和细粒度因果干预指标上更优。
Conclusion: 该工作朝着训练内建可解释性（而非事后恢复）的模型迈出一步，其特征天然存在于模型前向传播中，回答了SAE是否探测到模型实际使用的特征的问题。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Frontier Financial Judgement: Can agents tell what might move a stock?
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Frontier Financial Judgement, a challenging new benchmark developed in collaboration with professional equity analysts to assess agents' ability to replicate expert human judgements. Rapidly identifying new information, evaluating its implications and determining its valuation impact is one of the most time-consuming and challenging aspects of real-world equity coverage. This is becoming ever more difficult and important as AI rapidly increases the quantity of new information to process. The strongest agent we evaluate on Frontier Financial Judgement matches all expert labels in only 52.4% of cases. We also find significant divergence in estimated false-positive rates among frontier agents, ranging from ~1% for GPT-5.6 Sol to ~32% for Claude Sonnet 4.6. To construct the benchmark and make it representative of real-world settings, we combine human-designed and labelled synthetic articles with live news articles and historical documents, creating 656 items for assessment. The resulting task requires agents to distinguish genuinely new, valuation-relevant financial information from stale, immaterial or misleading news under realistic conditions. We find substantial trade-offs among agent accuracy, cost, false positives and reliability that continue to hinder the reliable deployment of news-flow filtering in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了 Frontier Financial Judgement 基准，与专业股票分析师合作构建，用于评估AI代理复制专家判断的能力。最强代理仅匹配52.4%的专家标签，且不同代理的假阳性率差异大（从~1%到~32%）。基准包含656个条目，要求代理区分真正具有估值影响的新信息与陈旧、无关或误导性新闻。实验发现准确性、成本、假阳性率和可靠性之间存在显著权衡，阻碍了新闻流过滤的实际部署。
Motivation: 快速识别新信息、评估其含义并确定估值影响是实际股票覆盖中最耗时和挑战性的方面之一，随着AI增加信息处理量，这一问题变得更加困难和重要。
Method: 结合人工设计和标注的合成文章、实时新闻文章和历史文档，构建包含656个条目的基准，要求代理在现实条件下区分真正新的、与估值相关的金融信息与陈旧、无关或误导性新闻。
Result: 最强代理仅在52.4%的情况下匹配所有专家标签，估计的假阳性率范围从GPT-5.6 Sol的~1%到Claude Sonnet 4.6的~32%。
Conclusion: 代理准确性、成本、假阳性率和可靠性之间存在显著权衡，这些权衡继续阻碍新闻流过滤在实际中的可靠部署。

papers.title: Masked Topology Modeling for Self-Supervised Learning on Parametric CAD
papers.abstract_en: Computer aided design (CAD) is ubiquitous: virtually any modern object was designed using editable CAD tools. However, with the shortage of available CAD datasets in its native editable and parametric format, boundary representation (B-Rep), it is ever more important to develop data-efficient methods for this domain. We present a new self-supervised pretraining task, Masked Topology Modeling (MTM), that leverages the face-adjacency graph, an induced structure unique to B-reps that the encoder can be asked to reconstruct. MTM masks a fraction of edges and trains a small head to predict each masked edge's convexity and curve type from the encoder's post-message-passing face features. We combine MTM with a MoCo-style momentum-queue contrastive learning over B-rep-aware augmentations, a BFS-connected face-region masked-reconstruction objective, and pretraining on the ABC dataset and our new procedurally generated dataset to show strong performance on a number of benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对参数化CAD模型的自监督预训练任务Masked Topology Modeling (MTM)，通过掩码面邻接图的边并预测其凸性和曲线类型，结合MoCo风格的对比学习和BFS连通面区域掩码重构，在ABC数据集和新生成的数据集上预训练，在多个基准上取得了强性能。
Motivation: CAD数据集稀缺且难以获取原生可编辑参数化格式，需要数据高效的方法来学习B-Rep表示。
Method: 提出MTM任务，掩码面邻接图的边，训练小头从编码器消息传递后的面特征预测掩码边的凸性和曲线类型；联合MoCo风格的动量队列对比学习（B-Rep感知增强）和BFS连通面区域掩码重构目标。
Result: 在多个基准上展示了强性能。
Conclusion: MTM结合对比学习和区域重构能有效利用CAD结构进行自监督预训练。

papers.title: One Round Is All You Need: Analytic Federated Learning for Task-Heterogeneous Multi-Label Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple clinical institutions to collaboratively train a shared disease classifier without centralizing patient data. In practice, however, each institution annotates only the pathologies within its area of expertise, so the federation operates under task heterogeneity: each client holds labels for a strict subset of the target disease categories while the remaining classes are entirely unobserved at that site. Existing gradient-based FL methods fail under this setting because they require hundreds of communication rounds to converge and because missing class labels introduce systematic false-negative bias that the model cannot correct without a principled mechanism. We propose an analytic federated learning framework for multi-label medical image classification under task heterogeneity. The proposed method replaces iterative gradient optimization with three closed-form operations: a balanced label projection that neutralizes class-imbalance bias by normalizing positive and negative contributions to equal total mass; a per-class absolute aggregation law that independently assembles the optimal ridge-regression classifier for each disease category from the sufficient statistics uploaded by its annotating clients; and an optional analytic pseudo-label refinement round that propagates missing-class knowledge from a confidence-filtered teacher classifier to non-annotating clients. The entire procedure requires at most two communication rounds, irrespective of the degree of task heterogeneity or the number of participating clients. Experiments on ChestXray14 under four progressively severe missing-class configurations demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art federated multi-label method FedMLP by up to 18.44 BACC points and 13.24 AUC points, while reducing the communication.
papers.comment: The 14th IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对任务异质性的多标签医学图像分类的解析联邦学习框架，仅需至多两轮通信，通过闭合形式操作替代迭代梯度优化。在ChestXray14上的实验表明，该方法在多种缺失标签配置下优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习方法在任务异质性（各客户端仅标注部分疾病类别）下需要大量通信轮次，且缺失标签引入系统性假阴性偏差。
Method: 提出三种闭合形式操作：平衡标签投影（消除类别不平衡偏差）、按类绝对聚合（独立组装每类的岭回归分类器）、以及可选的解析伪标签精炼轮次（将置信过滤后的教师分类器知识传播给非标注客户端）。整个流程最多两轮通信。
Result: 在ChestXray14上，与FedMLP相比，BACC最高提升18.44点，AUC最高提升13.24点，同时降低通信量。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限性，但指出该方法有效解决任务异质性和通信效率问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WaveformQA: Benchmarking LLM Temporal Reasoning on Digital Waveforms
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation and reasoning, yet their ability to perform temporal reasoning over digital waveform data remains largely unexplored. Although reasoning over digital waveforms is a critical bottleneck in design verification, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate hardware description language (HDL) code generation and use waveforms only as supplementary context. This paper presents WaveformQA, an open-source question-answering benchmark for evaluating LLM temporal reasoning over digital waveforms. The benchmark comprises 360 questions with programmatically generated ground truths across eight categories of varying difficulty, including questions targeting multi-signal correlation and event ordering. Waveforms are generated from open-source design implementations, ensuring reproducibility and grounding the benchmark in real hardware behavior. Evaluation of frontier LLMs reveals that while models achieve reasonable accuracy on simple queries, performance degrades due to context window limitations and reasoning difficulties on complex temporal and multi-step questions. In addition, we show that an event-time JSON representation of waveforms improves LLM reasoning accuracy versus the standardized value change dump (VCD) format. The open-source framework supports extending to new question categories and importing new waveform sources, enabling researchers to rapidly prototype temporal reasoning experiments.
papers.comment: 10 pages; abridged version published in IEEE International Conference on LLM-Aided Design (ICLAD), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WaveformQA，一个用于评估大语言模型 (LLM) 在数字波形上进行时序推理能力的开源问答基准。基准包含 360 个问题，涵盖多信号关联和事件排序等难度等级，波形来自开源设计实现以确保可重复性。评估前沿 LLM 发现，模型在简单查询上表现合理，但在复杂时间问题和多步推理上因上下文窗口限制和推理困难而性能下降；事件时间 JSON 表示比 VCD 格式能提升推理准确率。
Motivation: 数字波形上的时序推理是设计验证中的关键瓶颈，但现有基准主要评估 HDL 代码生成，仅将波形作为辅助上下文，缺乏专门针对波形时序推理的评估。
Method: 构建包含 360 个问题的问答基准，问题分八类难度，波形由开源设计实现自动生成，并提供事件时间 JSON 表示格式以替代 VCD 格式。
Result: 前沿 LLM 在简单查询上准确率合理，但在复杂时序和多步问题上性能下降；事件时间 JSON 表示相比 VCD 格式能提升推理准确率。
Conclusion: WaveformQA 为评估 LLM 在数字波形上的时序推理提供了标准化基准，框架支持扩展新问题类别和导入新波形源。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 前沿 LLM 在简单查询上准确率合理，但在复杂时序和多步问题上性能下降；事件时间 JSON 表示相比 VCD 格式能提升推理准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: WaveformQA 为评估 LLM 在数字波形上的时序推理提供了标准化基准，框架支持扩展新问题类别和导入新波形源。

papers.title: Algorithmic Approaches to Sequential Decision-Making and Social Epistemology
papers.abstract_en: As humans, we face many decisions that require us to choose between sticking to something and giving up. This thesis uses algorithmic tools to derive insights about such decision-making problems in theoretical models, studying both near-optimal methods and outcomes of social and behavioral influences. Along the way, this thesis sheds light on what we gain and what we lose as we move from a messy and complex real world setting to a very general abstract model by studying various points along this spectrum. In Part I, we study algorithms for sequential decision-making in the improving multi-armed bandits problem. We provide nearly matching upper and lower bounds in the general case. Then, we then ask what is possible if we have access to similar instances to the one we wish to deploy our algorithm on. To that end, we provide guarantees in the data-driven algorithm design framework, showing that a polynomial number of samples is sufficient for learning good algorithms from a class of algorithms. In Part II, we study algorithmic approaches for problems in social epistemology. We start by analyzing what role theoretical models can play in the study of social problems. We then study social and behavioral influences in decision-making requiring investment. First, we provide mathematical formalism in which to study the formation of pessimism traps, a phenomenon identified by philosophers in which agents are influenced by their predecessors to engage in less-ambitious goals. We develop financial interventions to sustainably shift communities out of these traps. The second problem we study is the influence of grit as a behavioral trait in ambitious decision-making. Overall, these works seek to theoretically model phenomena in social epistemology and provide a framework for intervening algorithmically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是博士论文，利用算法工具研究序列决策（如改进的多臂老虎机问题）和社会认识论中的决策（如悲观主义陷阱和毅力）。第一部分给出改进多臂老虎机问题的近乎匹配上下界，并证明数据驱动算法设计中多项式样本足以学习好算法。第二部分建立数学模型分析社会影响导致的悲观主义陷阱，提出可持续的金融干预，并研究毅力作为行为特质对雄心决策的影响。
Motivation: 人类常面临坚持与放弃的决策，论文旨在通过算法模型为这类决策问题提供理论理解，并探讨社会和行为因素如何影响结果。
Method: 采用算法分析框架：在改进多臂老虎机问题中推导上下界，利用数据驱动算法设计进行样本复杂度分析；在社会认识论部分建立形式化模型（如悲观主义陷阱的动态过程）并设计干预策略。
Result: 摘要报告在一般情形下改进多臂老虎机问题达到近乎匹配的上下界；在数据驱动框架中多项式样本足够学习好算法；针对悲观主义陷阱提出可持续金融干预；毅力被建模为影响投资决策的行为特质。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过抽象模型理解现实决策中的社会与行为现象，为干预提供算法框架。但未给出具体实验数值或真实数据验证。

papers.title: Demonstrating GenDB: Instance-Optimized and Customized Query Processing Code Generation via LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Traditional query processing engines require continuous development and extensions to support new techniques and user requirements, and in some cases, entirely new systems must be built from scratch. However, these engines are difficult to extend due to their internal complexity, and building new systems demands significant engineering effort and cost. To address this, we demonstrate GenDB, a generative query engine that shifts query processing from manually engineered systems to query processing code generation driven by Large Language Models (LLMs). An early prototype of GenDB uses LLM agents to generate instance-optimized query execution code tailored to specific data, workloads, and hardware resources. This prototype suits offline code generation for repetitive, templated queries, since the upfront generation cost amortizes over many executions and correctness can be ensured through extensive fuzz testing and manual inspection. For ad-hoc queries, GenDB can work with a traditional DBMS in a hybrid architecture: the DBMS handles one-off queries, while GenDB speeds up frequent SQL templates. Our demonstration allows users to (1) visually and interactively explore how GenDB analyzes workloads, profiles hardware resources and underlying data, produces query plans, generates code based on them, and finally uses an optimizer to iteratively achieve a correct and efficient implementation; (2) use visual inspection and analysis to gain qualitative insights into why GenDB produces code that achieves significantly better performance than state-of-the-art query engines on two benchmarks: TPC-H and a newly constructed benchmark designed to reduce potential data leakage from LLM training data; and (3) upload their own data and queries to explore GenDB with different LLMs and query patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GenDB，一种基于LLM的生成式查询引擎，通过LLM代理为特定数据、工作负载和硬件资源生成实例优化的查询执行代码。原型系统适用于重复模板化查询的离线代码生成，并可与传统DBMS混合架构使用，加速频繁的SQL模板。在TPC-H和新构建的基准测试上，GenDB生成的代码性能优于现有查询引擎。
Motivation: 传统查询处理引擎内部复杂，难以扩展，且构建新系统需大量工程成本。
Method: 利用LLM代理分析工作负载、硬件资源和数据，生成查询计划并基于计划生成代码，再通过优化器迭代优化以实现正确且高效的实现。
Result: 在TPC-H和新建基准测试中，GenDB生成的代码性能显著优于现有查询引擎。
Conclusion: GenDB展示了LLM在查询处理代码生成中的潜力，可实现实例优化和定制化。

papers.title: RealVDeblur: One-Step Diffusion for Generalizable Real-World Video Deblurring
papers.abstract_en: Real-world video deblurring remains challenging due to diverse motion patterns, complex degradations, and the scarcity of realistic training data, yet robust restoration is critical for downstream pipelines such as mobile imaging and 3D reconstruction. This work presents \textbf{RealVDeblur}, an efficient generative framework designed to improve in-the-wild robustness under diverse real capture conditions. First, a large-scale, physically grounded blur synthesis pipeline is constructed from scene-level 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assets and high-frame-rate videos, providing realistic training data covering both camera-induced and object-motion blur. Second, a video diffusion prior is leveraged for restoration; to better accommodate frame-dependent blur variations, temporal compression in the VAE is disabled and a frame-wise encoding scheme is adopted. For practical deployment on long videos, multi-step diffusion sampling is distilled into an efficient one-step generator, and a training-free Temporal Window Mask stabilizes inference beyond the training horizon with constant memory usage. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world benchmarks demonstrate strong perceptual quality, semantic fidelity, and temporal consistency on unseen videos, as well as improved robustness in downstream 3D reconstruction under severe motion blur. Project page: https://rbjin.github.io/RealVDeblur
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RealVDeblur，一个基于单步扩散的高效生成式视频去模糊框架，旨在提升真实世界场景下的鲁棒性。通过构建基于3D高斯泼溅的大规模物理模糊合成管线生成逼真训练数据，并利用视频扩散先验结合帧级编码和时域压缩禁用策略进行恢复，最终将多步扩散蒸馏为单步生成器，并引入无训练时域窗口掩码实现长视频稳定推理。在多个真实世界基准上展示了优越的感知质量、语义保真度和时间一致性，以及在下游3D重建中的鲁棒性提升。
Motivation: 真实世界视频去模糊面临运动模式多样、退化复杂以及缺乏真实训练数据的挑战，现有方法在wild条件下鲁棒性不足，影响移动成像和3D重建等下游任务。
Method: 提出 RealVDeblur 框架：1) 基于场景级3D高斯泼溅和高帧率视频构建大规模物理准确的模糊合成管线；2) 利用视频扩散先验，禁用VAE时域压缩并采用帧级编码以处理帧间模糊变化；3) 将多步扩散采样蒸馏为单步生成器以支持长视频部署；4) 引入无训练时域窗口掩码，在恒定内存下稳定超训练时长的推理。
Result: 在多个真实世界基准上，该方法在感知质量、语义保真度和时间一致性上优于现有方法，并在严重运动模糊下的下游3D重建中展现了更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: RealVDeblur 提供了一个高效且泛化性强的真实世界视频去模糊方案，单步生成和时域窗口掩码使其适用于实际长视频场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Are Single-Token Sparse Autoencoder Features Causally Necessary? Layer-Depth and SAE-Family Effects
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are used to interpret and steer large language models, yet whether a feature's causal role is stable across SAE families remains untested. Single-token features that activate on one vocabulary item provide the diagnostic case where ground truth permits direct comparison. We analyze 3.9M features across six models and three SAE families using zero-ablation at full layer depth. Single-token features cluster 4.7x tighter in decoder space and concentrate in early layers (Layer 0 in GPT2-Small; L0-L4 in Gemma). Ablating them yields Benjamini-Hochberg-significant logit reductions in 178 of 208 full-layer conditions, with depth controlling whether damage cascades downstream or shapes the output directly. Cross-family causal differences exceed within-family scale effects: on the same base model, GemmaScope and BatchTopK features remain causally anchored, while LlamaScope features are locally redundant. The target token's rank recovers to within 2x baseline 96-98% of the time after the same ablation, and a controlled activation-function comparison reverses sign within the same model, leaving training recipe as the residual candidate. Cross-family interpretability claims are therefore sensitive to training methodology, not just activation function or scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征在大语言模型中的因果必要性，聚焦于单token特征。通过零消融实验，分析了3.9M特征在六个模型和三个SAE族中的表现，发现单token特征在解码器空间聚集更紧密（4.7倍），集中在浅层；消融后在208个全层条件中有178个产生显著logit减少；跨SAE族的因果差异大于族内规模效应，训练方法而非激活函数或规模是关键因素。
Motivation: SAE特征用于解释和引导大语言模型，但不同SAE族之间特征的因果角色是否稳定未经测试。单token特征提供了可直接比较的基准案例。
Method: 使用零消融（zero-ablation）在完整层深度上分析3.9M特征，跨越六个模型和三个SAE族（GemmaScope、BatchTopK、LlamaScope），并采用Benjamini-Hochberg显著性检验。
Result: 单token特征在解码器空间聚集更紧密（4.7倍），集中在早期层；消融后在208个全层条件中178个logit显著降低；跨族因果差异大于族内规模效应；目标token排名在消融后96-98%恢复到2倍基线内；激活函数对比在同一模型内符号反转，暗示训练方法是残留变量。
Conclusion: 跨SAE族的可解释性声明对训练方法敏感，而不仅是激活函数或规模。需要关注训练方法对因果稳定性的影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Recurrence Become an Algorithm? Convergence Selection in Weight-Tied Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: When does a weight-tied looped transformer -- one block applied T times -- implement an actual algorithm? We answer with four findings from controlled populations on group word problems. (1) The budget law: free training installs a linear computation frontier, a mechanism that solves v positions per loop, whose speed is priced by the training contract: v ~ n_train/T_train (exponent 0.98 +/- 0.04, R^2=0.99), exactly unity under T=n training. SGD selects a frontier matching the minimum the contract demands; granting more test-time loops than ever trained rescues late positions at fixed input length, yielding a principled halting rule T* = ceil(n / v-hat). (2) Architecture prior, not expressivity, picks the algorithm: standard-depth transformers learn parallel scans on this family; weight tying flips the selection to the serial frontier, even when positional addressing for a log-depth scan is supplied. At matched depth and parameters, untied models extrapolate worst and fail to learn A5 at all. (3) The walls are not where circuit complexity says: NC1-completeness costs nothing (A5 generalizes fully), while group order does (S5's 120x120 operator deadlocks joint learning) -- and an operator-first curriculum dissolves the wall in every seed. (4) Mechanisms are portable, not mandatable: warm-starting across budget contracts transfers the algorithm in every seed, re-pricing its speed, while imposing seriality through the input schedule fails where free training succeeds. These results are invisible to standard instruments, which provably saturate at the fixed points trained loops converge to. We introduce a head instrument, the convergence-time scaling tau(n,i), validate it causally via damage cones whose slope reproduces v, and show in-distribution head measurements predict out-of-distribution fate where tail metrics do not. Results replicate on the public easy-to-hard benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究权重共享的循环 Transformer（同一模块重复 T 次）何时能真正实现一个算法。通过群体单词问题上的受控实验，得出四个主要发现：预算定律（训练时学习到的线性计算边界，速度 v ~ n_train/T_train，指数 0.98）；架构先验而非表达性决定算法（标准深度 Transformer 学习并行扫描，权重共享则选择串行边界）；计算复杂度墙不在于电路复杂度（NC1-完备问题 A5 可完全泛化，但群阶 S5 的 120x120 算子导致死锁）；机制可移植但不可强制（通过预热启动可迁移算法，但输入调度强制串行化失败）。引入头部测量工具收敛时间标度 tau(n,i)，因果验证其预测分布外表现的能力。
Motivation: 现有循环 Transformer 的研究多关注其表达能力或训练动态，但未能解释何时这些循环结构真正实现了算法（而非仅仅是固定点迭代）。标准工具（如 loss 或 accuracy）在训练收敛的固定点处饱和，无法区分算法行为。
Method: 在群体单词问题（group word problems）上进行受控实验，通过改变训练循环次数 T_train、测试循环次数 T_test、架构类型（标准深度 vs. 权重共享循环）、输入长度等，分析算法的涌现条件。引入新的分析工具——收敛时间标度 tau(n,i)，即头部（head）收敛到最终值所需的时间，并通过损伤锥（damage cones）因果验证其与计算速度 v 的关系。
Result: 预算定律成立：训练中学习到的计算速度 v 与 n_train/T_train 成正比（指数 0.98，R²=0.99），当 T=n 时恰好为线性。权重共享强制选择串行计算边界，即使提供了 log 深度扫描的位置寻址。NC1-完备问题 A5 可完全泛化（群论中的交错群 A5），但群阶 S5（120x120 矩阵乘法）导致学习死锁，而通过算符优先课程（operator-first curriculum）可解除死锁。机制可通过预热启动跨预算合同迁移，并重新定价速度。
Conclusion: 标准仪器（如 loss、accuracy）在训练的固定点饱和，无法揭示上述现象；而头部测量工具 tau(n,i) 可预测分布外命运。这些结果表明，深度学习中的算法选择受训练预算和架构先验的严格控制，而非仅由表达性或电路复杂度决定。

papers.title: STeMP: Spatio-Temporal Modelling Protocol
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal machine-learning modelling is an important tool in environmental research. However, machine-learning models are highly sensitive to both the characteristics of the training data, such as its distribution, and methodological choices, including the cross-validation strategy. Each decision has impact and implications on the model itself as well as the estimation of the model quality and applicability for certain purposes. Taking into account the large role of machine-learning based maps of the environment in science and their transfer into practice, transparent reporting of spatio-temporal models, ideally using standardized model protocols, is essential to enable trust, transparency and comparability. However, such protocols are currently lacking for spatio-temporal modelling. We propose STeMP (Spatio-Temporal Modelling Protocol) to fill this gap by serving two purposes: standardized reporting to understand the model functioning as well as providing guidance during the modelling process by pointing at critical decisions and parameters. The protocol is structured in three sections: Overview, Model and Prediction. The Overview section contains metadata, while the Model and Prediction sections go into detail, describing predictors, evaluation and software, and further relevant elements of the modelling workflow. The protocol definition is hosted on GitHub and accompanied by an R-package (https://github.com/LOEK-RS/STeMP). The R-package contains a web application that can be used to fill the protocol either manually or in a semi-automated way from provided modelling objects. Warnings are returned from the protocol when common pitfalls are encountered, which may help authors as a guide through the modelling process but also support reviewers in the assessment of modelling studies. Via GitHub, incorporation of contributions and feedback from the community is encouraged.

papers.title: Detecting Neural Network Failures through Spectral Analysis of Internal Activations
papers.abstract_en: Neural network misclassifications exhibit characteristic spectral instability in internal activations that is invisible at the output layer. This phenomenon is identified and formalized as Spectral Drift -- the frequency-domain distance between consecutive layer activations -- with empirical validation showing that failures exhibit significantly higher drift than correct predictions (1.9% increase, p<0.001). This spectral signature emerges during internal processing but becomes masked in final outputs, explaining why confidence-based detection methods struggle. This work introduces Self-Detecting Neural Networks (SDNN), a framework that monitors spectral dynamics across network depth using Short-Time Fourier Transform, wavelet decomposition, and statistical moments to capture multi-scale spectral features. A lightweight detector network (5% parameter overhead) learns to identify failure-indicative patterns via curriculum learning on progressively challenging distributions: natural misclassifications, distribution shifts, and adversarial perturbations. Experiments on CIFAR-10 demonstrate that SDNN achieves 79.0 +/- 25.3% AUROC across three seeds, substantially outperforming confidence-based baselines including MaxSoftmax (50.5%) and Energy Score (52.9%) by approximately 25-30 percentage points. Ablation studies reveal that wavelet decomposition and statistical features make consistent contributions, while STFT's role remains unclear. This work establishes spectral analysis of internal activations as a promising direction for neural network reliability, revealing diagnostic information inaccessible to output-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现神经网络误分类在内部激活中表现出特征性的频谱不稳定性（Spectral Drift），且该信号在最终输出层被掩盖。基于此，提出自检测神经网络（SDNN），利用短时傅里叶变换、小波分解和统计矩提取多尺度频谱特征，通过课程学习训练轻量检测器（5%参数开销）。在CIFAR-10上，SDNN的AUROC达79.0%，显著优于MaxSoftmax（50.5%）和Energy Score（52.9%）。
Motivation: 基于置信度的故障检测方法效果有限，因为误分类的判别信号在输出层被掩盖；而内部激活的频谱特性尚未被有效利用。
Method: 提出Spectral Drift概念（逐层激活的频域距离），并构建SDNN框架：对内部激活进行STFT、小波分解及统计矩提取，结合课程学习（自然误分类→分布偏移→对抗扰动）训练轻量检测网络。
Result: 在CIFAR-10上，SDNN的AUROC达79.0±25.3%，比MaxSoftmax（50.5%）和Energy Score（52.9%）提升约25-30个百分点；小波分解和统计特征贡献稳定，STFT作用不明确。
Conclusion: 内部激活的频谱分析为神经网络可靠性提供了输出层无法获取的诊断信息，是值得探索的新方向。

papers.title: SPECTRA: State-Space Exogenous Context and Temporal-Frequency Resolution Architecture for Probabilistic Energy Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Modern power systems increasingly require probabilistic forecasts amid interacting uncertainties from renewable intermittency, flexible demand, market volatility, and weather-dependent generation. However, existing methods often treat multi-scale decomposition, exogenous-variable alignment, and probabilistic output as separate steps, obscuring how predictable structures and uncertainty-bearing fluctuations jointly shape the forecast distribution. This paper proposes a state-space exogenous-context and temporal-frequency resolution architecture for general probabilistic energy forecasting. Its central premise is that trend-periodic components primarily determine the baseline trajectory, whereas high-frequency residuals and external perturbations govern the spread and asymmetry of forecast uncertainty. Accordingly, the architecture adaptively separates deterministic and residual streams, aligns exogenous context with both, refines the deterministic backbone through multi-resolution spectral-temporal state-space modeling, and estimates ordered quantile boundaries from their complementary representations. Experiments on load, price, solar, and wind forecasting achieve the best continuous ranked probability score in 14 of 18 settings, reducing average CRPS by 5.74\% and upper-tail quantile risk by 7.27\% over the strongest baselines. These results support deterministic-stochastic separation as an effective design principle for general probabilistic energy forecasting.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Power Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPECTRA架构，用于概率性能源预测，通过自适应分离确定性趋势和随机残差，结合多分辨率谱-时状态空间建模和外生上下文对齐，在负荷、价格、太阳能和风能预测中取得了最佳连续排序概率评分（CRPS）在18个设置中的14个，平均CRPS降低5.74%，上尾分位数风险降低7.27%。
Motivation: 现有概率性能源预测方法通常将多尺度分解、外生变量对齐和概率输出视为独立步骤，未能有效建模可预测结构与不确定性波动对预测分布的联合影响。
Method: 提出状态空间外生上下文和时间-频率分辨率架构，自适应分离确定性流和残差流，对齐外生上下文，通过多分辨率谱-时状态空间建模优化确定性主干，并从互补表示估计有序分位数边界。
Result: 在负荷、价格、太阳能和风能预测实验中，在18个设置中的14个取得最佳CRPS，平均CRPS降低5.74%，上尾分位数风险降低7.27%。
Conclusion: 确定性-随机分离作为通用概率性能源预测的有效设计原则得到实验支持。

papers.title: Exact ReLU realization of affine one-dimensional refinement iterates via residual memory and offset frames
papers.abstract_en: We study vector-valued affine refinement operators of the form [ (Wγ)(t)=\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} A_jγ(Mt-j)+B(t), ] with finitely supported matrix mask and compactly supported continuous piecewise linear input and forcing data. Building on the homogeneous realization theorem for (B\equiv 0), we prove that, for (M\ge 3), every finite affine iterate (W^nγ) admits an exact fixed-width ReLU realization whose depth is (O(n)). The main new ingredient is a residual memory controller. It replaces the noninvertible residual dynamics by an injective skew-product and permits exact backward replay of the residual states required by a Horner-type evaluation of the affine forcing sum. Offset frames align the forcing atoms away from residual seams, allowing complementary loop readouts to recover their values exactly. The remaining branch-selection ambiguity occurs only where the accumulated affine state has already vanished. For (M\ge 3), the result applies to arbitrary compactly supported continuous piecewise linear forcing terms. For (M=2), the same construction applies to ordinary-frame seam-separated forcing. We also prove a stage-dependent extension for forcing terms in a fixed finite-dimensional continuous piecewise linear span and record the resulting linear-depth upgrade for open-curve, finite-state, and Hilbert- and Morton-type recursive constructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究向量值仿射细化算子 (Wγ)(t)=∑A_j γ(Mt−j)+B(t) 的精确 ReLU 实现，其中输入和强制项为紧支撑连续分段线性函数。通过引入残差记忆控制器和偏移帧，证明对于 M≥3，每个有限仿射迭代 W^nγ 均存在深度 O(n) 的固定宽度 ReLU 实现。
Motivation: 针对仿射细化算子的 ReLU 网络实现，现有理论通常局限于齐次情形 (B≡0)。本文旨在为一般分段线性强制项提供精确的固定宽度神经网络构造。
Method: 提出残差记忆控制器，将非可逆残差动态替换为单射斜乘积，实现残差状态的反向回放；同时采用偏移帧对齐强制原子，避免残差接缝处的取值歧义。
Result: 对于 M≥3，该构造适用于任意紧支撑连续分段线性强制项；对于 M=2，同样适用于普通帧接缝分离的强制项。此外，还给出阶段依赖扩展，适用于开曲线、有限状态及 Hilbert/Morton 型递归结构。
Conclusion: 本文结果将齐次细化算子的 ReLU 实现理论推广至仿射情形，为递归神经网络的精确深度表示提供了新工具。

papers.title: Machine-Learned Compact Subspace Generation for Quantum Selected Configuration Interaction within Density Matrix Embedding Framework
papers.abstract_en: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD), an extension of Quantum Selected Configuration Interaction (QSCI), has emerged as a promising hybrid quantum-classical paradigm for computing molecular ground state energies. By leveraging quantum sampling instead of variational optimization, QSCI avoids barren plateaus and enables direct reconstruction of correlated electronic wavefunctions. However, existing configuration recovery techniques primarily enforce symmetry constraints without guaranteeing optimal selection of the most physically relevant configurations, often leading to unnecessarily large subspaces and increased classical diagonalization costs. In this work, we introduce a machine-learned compact subspace generation protocol based on Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), termed QSCI-RBM, and integrate it within the Density Matrix Embedding Theory (DMET) framework. The RBM is trained on quantum-sampled configurations to learn the underlying probability distribution of dominant determinants, enabling the targeted generation of high-probability configurations. We apply this framework to the simulation of a protein-ligand complex involving the inhibitor Carmofur bound to the SARS-CoV-2 main protease ($M^{\text{pro}}$). Our results demonstrate that DMET-QSCI-RBM achieves energies within the chemical accuracy threshold by accessing only approximately 4% of the configuration subspace. In contrast, standard DMET-SQD simulations failed to reach chemical accuracy while accessing up to 20% of the subspace, even as the chemical potential itself nearly converged. These findings highlight that RBM-assisted configuration generation produces significantly more compact subspaces while preserving physical accuracy, thereby reducing classical computational overhead and enabling the scalable quantum embedding simulation of complex biological systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）的机器学习紧致子空间生成协议（QSCI-RBM），并将其集成到密度矩阵嵌入理论（DMET）框架中，用于量子选组态相互作用（QSCI）。该方法通过训练RBM学习量子采样构型的概率分布，生成高概率构型，从而在模拟SARS-CoV-2主蛋白酶与抑制剂Carmofur的蛋白质-配体复合物时，仅访问约4%的构型子空间即可达到化学精度，而标准DMET-SQD方法在访问20%子空间时仍未达到化学精度。
Motivation: 现有量子选组态相互作用（QSCI）方法中的构型恢复技术主要依赖对称性约束，无法保证最优选择最物理相关的构型，导致子空间过大、经典对角化成本高。
Method: 提出QSCI-RBM协议：使用受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）训练量子采样构型，学习主导行列式的概率分布，从而针对性生成高概率构型，并集成到密度矩阵嵌入理论（DMET）框架中。
Result: 在SARS-CoV-2主蛋白酶与Carmofur的蛋白质-配体复合物模拟中，DMET-QSCI-RBM仅访问约4%的构型子空间即可达到化学精度，而标准DMET-SQD在访问20%子空间时仍未能达到化学精度。
Conclusion: RBM辅助的构型生成能产生更紧致的子空间并保持物理精度，减少了经典计算开销，使复杂生物系统的可扩展量子嵌入模拟成为可能。

papers.title: Foundation-model-guided radiogenomic discovery linking cancer genomes to cancer scans
papers.abstract_en: The function of many genes is still unknown, and conventional driver-discovery methods, which rely on how frequently a gene is mutated, cannot assess genes that are only rarely affected. Here we pair Evo~2-based genome analysis with routine clinical imaging to identify gene--phenotype associations at genome-wide scale. For every somatic mutation across three TCGA cohorts (cRCC=clear cell renal cell carcinoma, HCC=hepatocellular carcinoma, and BC=breast cancer; $n = 340$ total), Evo~2 predicts a severity score, with no task-specific training. Per-gene severity summaries are then correlated with radiomic features extracted from paired tumor segmentations, controlling for total mutation burden. In TCGA-cRCC ($n = 162$), this sweep recovers established renal-cancer drivers and identifies 46 additional genes reaching false discovery rate (FDR) significance absent from curated cancer-gene panels, several of which are Mendelian ciliopathy and cytoskeletal-disease genes. These results demonstrate that pairing a genomic language model with widely available clinical imaging can serve as a hypothesis-free discovery tool for gene--imaging associations invisible to conventional approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将基于Evo~2的基因组分析（预测突变严重性评分）与常规临床影像（放射组学特征）配对，在全基因组规模上发现基因-表型关联。在三个TCGA队列（cRCC、HCC、BC，共340例）中，该方法在cRCC队列（n=162）中恢复已知肾癌驱动基因，并识别出46个FDR显著的额外基因，其中多个为孟德尔纤毛病和细胞骨架疾病基因。
Motivation: 许多基因功能未知，传统驱动发现方法依赖突变频率，无法评估罕见突变基因。
Method: 使用Evo~2预测每个体细胞突变的严重性评分（无需任务特定训练），按基因汇总严重性，并与配对的肿瘤分割放射组学特征进行相关性分析，控制总突变负荷。
Result: 在TCGA-cRCC中，恢复已知肾癌驱动基因，并识别46个FDR显著的额外基因，这些基因未出现在标准癌症基因面板中，包括与纤毛和细胞骨架疾病相关的孟德尔基因。
Conclusion: 配对基因组语言模型与临床影像可作为无假设发现工具，揭示传统方法无法检测的基因-影像关联。
