papers.title: Chronofy: A Temporal-Logical Decay Architecture for Information Validity in Time-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems retrieve and integrate external knowledge to ground large language model (LLM) outputs. However, current RAG architectures treat all retrieved facts as equally valid regardless of temporal provenance, leading to temporal hallucination, where plausible but obsolete facts corrupt the output. A clinical lab reading from yesterday is actionable; the same reading from six months ago is noise. We present Chronofy, a three-layer neuro-symbolic framework implementing the Temporal-Logical Decay Architecture (TLDA) that embeds temporal validity directly into the representation, retrieval, and reasoning layers of RAG systems. Layer 1 reserves a dedicated temporal subspace within Matryoshka embeddings to make fact age structurally irremovable from the representation. Layer 2 integrates learnable exponential decay functions into graph-based retrieval, where the decay coefficient $β_j$ is grounded in Bayesian decision theory as an approximation of twice the latent process mean-reversion rate. Layer 3 applies Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness functions to evaluate the temporal validity of retrieved knowledge, not LLM output confidence, and enforces the possibilistic weakest-link principle to bound output confidence by the most decayed evidence in the reasoning chain. We evaluate Chronofy on temporal knowledge graph forecasting benchmarks, the TimE temporal QA benchmark, and a domain-specific sensitivity analysis, demonstrating that explicit temporal decay modeling improves retrieval precision, reduces temporal hallucination, and enables principled data re-acquisition triggers when temporal context is insufficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Chronofy，一个三层神经符号框架（TLDA），将时间有效性直接嵌入RAG系统的表示、检索和推理层。通过保留时间子空间的Matryoshka嵌入、基于贝叶斯决策理论的可学习指数衰减图检索以及信号时序逻辑（STL）鲁棒性函数，Chronofy在时间知识图谱预测和TimE时间QA基准上提升了检索精度并减少了时间幻觉。
Motivation: 当前RAG系统将所有检索事实视为同等有效，忽略时间来源，导致时间幻觉——过时但看似合理的事实污染输出。
Method: Chronofy包含三层：1）在Matryoshka嵌入中保留时间子空间，使事实年龄在表示中不可移除；2）图检索中集成可学习指数衰减函数，衰减系数β_j基于贝叶斯决策理论近似为潜在过程均值回复率的两倍；3）应用STL鲁棒性函数评估知识时间有效性，并执行可能弱连接原则，以推理链中最衰减的证据约束输出置信度。
Result: 在时间知识图谱预测、TimE时间QA基准和领域特定敏感度分析上，明确的时间衰减建模提高了检索精度，减少了时间幻觉，并在时间上下文不足时触发了原则性的数据重获取机制。
Conclusion: Chronofy展示了显式时间衰减建模对时间感知RAG的必要性，可以通过在表示、检索和推理中嵌入时间有效性来减少时间幻觉。

papers.title: Joint Utilization of Geospatial and census proxies for Autoencoder-Assisted Downscaling (JUGAAD) of socioeconomic indicators in India
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring poverty and food security indicators is imperative for addressing socioeconomic challenges in developing nations. A limitation is mismatches in scale between data sources: census data provide geographic coverage, while socioeconomic indicators are derived from infrequently conducted surveys at coarse resolutions, posing a methodological challenge. This study introduces a deep learning framework, JuGAAD, using Indian census and survey data from 2001 and 2011 as a case study. We employ a three-step process: census and geospatial data are averaged into intermediate village-cluster-scale tessellations to reduce noise and regularize administrative boundary changes; an autoencoder compresses high-dimensional National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) data into a low-dimensional latent representation; and a regression model maps upscaled census and geospatial data to this representation. This function is applied to fine-grained census data to generate high-resolution predictions, validated against ground-truth district-level NSSO indicators. Results confirm the methodology predicts socioeconomic indicators at fine scales with strong accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JUGAAD框架，利用印度2001和2011年的人口普查和地理空间数据，通过自编码器降维和回归模型映射，实现社会经济指标从粗分辨率到细粒度的降尺度预测，验证显示较高精度。
Motivation: 监测贫困和粮食安全指标在发展中国家至关重要，但数据来源尺度不匹配：普查数据提供地理覆盖，而社会经济指标来自不频繁的粗分辨率调查，带来方法学挑战。
Method: 采用三步流程：将普查和地理空间数据平均到中间村庄-群集尺度网格以减少噪声；自编码器将高维的NSSO数据压缩到低维潜在表示；回归模型将升尺度后的普查和地理空间数据映射到该表示，然后应用到细粒度普查数据生成高分辨率预测。
Result: 在印度地区使用2001和2011年数据验证，该方法在精细尺度上预测社会经济指标具有强准确性。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限，但整体表明该框架能有效弥合尺度不匹配问题。

papers.title: StabilityBench: Benchmarking Instability in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: AI Assistants are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, such as healthcare or government services. Yet their real-world behavior remains poorly understood due to strong context dependence. Current evaluation protocols follow a defense-in-depth paradigm with compounding layers of safeguards, ranging from traditional benchmarks to live or adversarial testing. Such benchmarks remain largely static and single-turn, limiting their ability to capture real-world variability in conversational settings. We propose StabilityBench, a principled, general and model-agnostic benchmark operator that transforms single-turn benchmark queries into multi-turn interaction histories. StabilityBench augments existing benchmarks by injecting realistic user simulations, through demographic proxies or sycophantic baits, while preserving original task intent. We apply StabilityBench to four benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, health question-answering and safety, and evaluate nine large language models under these conditions. Our results show that model performance is consistently unstable under these injections, with considerable performance degradations on three out of four benchmarks studied. These highlight important limitations of static evaluations and motivate more realistic evaluation settings. To this end, we propose StabilityBench-Mini: a size-preserving variant of StabilityBench that samples across diversification axes, enabling more realistic evaluation without increasing costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StabilityBench 是一个将单轮基准查询转化为多轮交互历史的基准转换器，通过注入人口统计代理或谄媚诱饵等用户模拟，评估 LLM 在真实对话环境中的稳定性。在四个基准上测试九个模型，结果显示模型性能在注入条件下持续不稳定，表明静态评估存在局限。
Motivation: 当前 LLM 评估协议多为静态单轮，无法捕捉对话设置中的现实可变性，尤其在高风险场景下（如医疗、政府服务），模型实际行为难以理解。
Method: 提出 StabilityBench，一种模型无关的基准算子，通过注入多种用户模拟（人口统计代理、谄媚诱饵）将单轮查询扩展为多轮对话历史，同时保持原始任务意图。
Result: 在四个基准（数学推理、健康问答、安全）上测试九个 LLM，模型性能在注入条件下持续不稳定，其中三个基准出现显著性能下降。
Conclusion: 静态评估存在重要局限性，需要更现实的评估设置；StabilityBench-Mini 作为规模保持变体，可在不增加成本下实现更现实评估。

papers.title: Monkey King Bang: A Unified Scientific Multimodal Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery is increasingly shifting from isolated disciplines to multi-domain reasoning, and AI for science faces a similar transition. Existing systems are either specialised for individual domains or unify scientific data mainly through text tokenisation and prompt-based interfaces, limiting their ability to handle diverse scientific inputs, produce modality-native outputs, and support joint understanding, reasoning, and generation across scientific domains. We introduce MKB, a unified scientific multimodal model for both understanding and generation, built around a shared Transformer backbone and modality-tailored encoders, adapters, and decoders. MKB covers six scientific branches, including DNA, RNA, proteins, small molecules, earth science, and medical images, and supports native outputs such as biological sequences, molecular strings, meteorological fields, and segmentation masks. Training follows a two-stage modality-then-language curriculum: Stage 1 aligns modality-specific components with the frozen backbone, and Stage 2 consolidates them with the language backbone using mixed scientific and general corpora. Experiments show that MKB achieves competitive scientific understanding across biological and molecular benchmarks, produces high-fidelity native outputs for weather forecasting, biological generation, and medical-image segmentation, and largely retains the general capabilities of its Qwen3-VL backbone. These results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed paradigm, suggesting that shared-backbone models with modality-tailored components can provide a promising foundation for future cross-domain scientific multimodal exploration. The model and code are publicly available at https://github.com/Shanghai-Academy-of-AI-For-Science/MKB and https://huggingface.co/sais-org/MKB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MKB（Monkey King Bang），一个统一的多模态科学基础模型，支持理解与生成。模型基于共享 Transformer 骨干网络和模态专用编码器、适配器与解码器，覆盖 DNA、RNA、蛋白质、小分子、地球科学和医学图像六个科学分支，能输出生物序列、分子字符串、气象场和分割掩码等原生格式。训练采用两阶段课程：先对齐模态组件，再与语言骨干联合训练。实验表明 MKB 在生物和分子基准上取得竞争性能，在天气预报、生物生成和医学图像分割中产生高保真原生输出，并基本保留 Qwen3-VL 骨干的通用能力。
Motivation: 现有 AI for Science 系统要么专精于单个领域，要么主要通过文本分词和提示接口统一科学数据，难以处理多样化的科学输入并产生模态原生输出，且缺乏跨领域的联合理解、推理与生成能力。
Method: 构建围绕共享 Transformer 骨干和模态专用编码器、适配器、解码器的统一架构。训练分两阶段：第一阶段冻结骨干，对齐模态专用组件；第二阶段将模态组件与语言骨干在混合科学和通用语料上联合调优。
Result: 在生物和分子基准上达到竞争性能；在天气预报、生物生成和医学图像分割任务中产生高保真原生输出；通用能力基本保持 Qwen3-VL 水平。
Conclusion: 该范式证明共享骨干加模态专用组件的模型能为未来跨领域科学多模态探索提供有前景的基础。模型和代码已开源。
Relevance: 50

papers.title: KeySI: An Interaction Framework for Tuning Text Embeddings Based on Human Feedback
papers.abstract_en: In large-scale text analysis tasks, pre-trained language models are often used to embed text corpora for downstream analysis. However, such models may struggle to capture domain-specific semantics and adapting them typically requires large amounts of labeled data and technical expertise to implement training pipelines. Recent approaches have demonstrated how visual interactions in document projections can capture human feedback as training signals for model tuning. However, these methods operate on document-level feedback, which requires users to open and assess individual documents in order to provide effective feedback. In this paper, we propose KeySI, an interaction framework that enables feature-level feedback through keyword-based concept specification. Users specify feedback by organizing extracted keywords into groups representing concepts, which KeySI translates into document-level supervision for subsequent tuning. By operating on keywords as the primary interaction medium, KeySI reduces the need for manual document inspection and labeling and lowers the barrier to adapting embedding models. We present a prototype implementation that, given a corpus, curates representative keywords, visualizes keywords and document embeddings via dimensionality reduction, allows interactive specification of keyword groups, and supports iterative refinement through system feedback. We evaluate KeySI through a user study, usage scenarios, and quantitative experiments demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing user intent and improving embedding alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出KeySI框架，允许用户通过关键词分组提供特征级反馈以微调文本嵌入模型，无需大量标注数据和技术知识。
Motivation: 预训练语言模型在领域特定语义上表现不佳，且适配需要大量标注数据和技术知识；现有基于文档级反馈的方法需要用户打开和评估文档。
Method: KeySI框架允许用户通过组织关键词成概念组来提供特征级反馈，系统将其转化为文档级监督信号用于后续微调；原型实现包括关键词提取、降维可视化、交互分组和迭代优化。
Result: 通过用户研究、使用场景和定量实验证明KeySI能有效捕获用户意图并改善嵌入对齐。
Conclusion: KeySI降低了适配嵌入模型的障碍，通过关键词交互减少手动文档检查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Through-the-Earth Magnetic Induction Communication and Networking: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic induction (MI) communication (MIC) has emerged as a promising candidate for underground communication networks due to its excellent penetration capabilities. Integration with Space-Air-Ground-Underground (SAGUI) networks in next-generation mobile communication systems requires a well-defined network architecture. A recent discovery in MIC research, MI fast fading, remains in its early stages and presents unique challenges. This paper provides a comprehensive survey on through-the-earth (TTE) MIC, covering MI applications, channel modeling, point-to-point MIC design, relay techniques, network frameworks, and emerging technologies. We compare various MIC applications to highlight TTE-specific challenges and review the principles of channel modeling, addressing both MI slow fading and MI fast fading, along with its potential impact on existing MIC theories. We conduct a fine-grained decomposition of MI channel power gain into four distinct physical parameters, and propose a novel geometric model to analyze MI fast fading. We also summarize MI relay techniques, examine crosstalk effects in relay and high-density networks, and explore key research tasks within the OSI framework for a holistic MI network protocol in SAGUI. To bridge the gaps identified, we propose a MIC framework that supports TCP/IP and Linux, enabling full implementation of existing and emerging MIC solutions. This framework empowers researchers to leverage Linux resources and deep learning platforms for accelerated development of MIC in SAGUI networks. Remaining research challenges, open issues, and promising novel techniques are further identified to advance MIC research.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted by the IEEE Communications Surveys & Tutorials (COMST) for publication. The final published version will be available on IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文全面综述了穿透地层的磁感应通信（MIC）技术，涵盖应用、信道建模（包括慢衰落和快速衰落）、点对点设计、中继技术、网络框架及新兴技术。作者将MI信道功率增益分解为四个物理参数，并提出了分析MI快速衰落的新几何模型，同时设计了支持TCP/IP和Linux的MIC框架。
Motivation: 磁感应通信因其卓越的穿透性成为地下通信网络的候选技术，但集成到空天地海一体化（SAGUI）网络需要明确的架构，且MI快速衰落尚未被充分研究。
Method: 采用综述方法，系统比较MIC应用，分析信道建模原理（涵盖慢衰落和快衰落），分解信道功率增益为四个物理参数，提出几何模型分析快速衰落；总结中继技术，探讨中继和高密度网络中的串扰效应，并在OSI框架内研究协议设计；最后提出支持TCP/IP和Linux的MIC实现框架。
Result: 提出了分析MI快速衰落的几何模型，并设计了可加速MIC在SAGUI网络中发展的框架。
Conclusion: 论文指出MIC领域仍存在研究挑战和开放问题，并展望了有前途的新兴技术以推动未来研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Double-Scoring: Reliable Extraction of Strong Lottery Tickets
papers.abstract_en: The lottery ticket hypothesis proposes that large random neural networks contain sparse subnetworks that can match the performance of dense models after comparable training. A stronger version asserts that sufficiently overparameterized random networks contain subnetworks that are already accurate before any weight training. Existing theory establishes that such strong lottery tickets exist, but reliable extraction remains difficult. We revisit edge-popup, a frozen-weight score-training method for extracting strong tickets, and identify layerwise sparsity selection as a central bottleneck. We introduce double-scoring, an augmented score-space parameterization that replaces a layerwise sparsity search with optimization over enlarged score tensors. We prove that fixed-density masking in an augmented score space preserves access to all original-coordinate masks, and we show that the resulting method can be interpreted as edge-popup on a zero-augmented network. In controlled experiments, double-scoring substantially improves strong-ticket extraction over fixed-density edge-popup and pruning-at-initialization baselines, improves on the performance of rewound sparse-training topologies, and exhibits markedly lower sensitivity to sparsity hyperparameters. Ablations show that the gain is not merely due to additional trainable score parameters, but is tied to the augmented score-space competition that induces the effective original sparsity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强彩票假说（strong lottery ticket hypothesis）中可靠提取稀疏子网络的问题，提出双评分（double-scoring）方法，通过在增广评分空间中优化而非逐层稀疏度搜索，显著提升了强彩票的提取质量。实验表明，该方法在多个基线上取得改进，且对稀疏度超参数更不敏感。
Motivation: 现有强彩票提取方法（如edge-popup）受限于层间稀疏度选择这一瓶颈，导致可靠提取困难。
Method: 提出双评分方法，将原始评分张量扩充为增广评分空间，通过优化增广评分张量替代逐层稀疏度搜索，并证明固定密度掩码在增广空间中仍能访问所有原始坐标掩码。
Result: 在控制实验中，双评分方法在强彩票提取上显著优于固定密度edge-popup和初始化剪枝基线，甚至优于重绕稀疏训练拓扑，且对稀疏度超参数敏感性大幅降低。消融实验表明增益不仅来自额外可训练参数，更源于增广评分空间竞争诱导的有效原始稀疏性。
Conclusion: 双评分方法提供了一种更可靠、超参数鲁棒的强彩票提取方式，可解释为零增广网络上的edge-popup。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI-Driven Multi-Hop Relay Selection for Smart Urban NR-V2X Networks via Learning-to-Optimize Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Reliable and low-latency NR-V2X communications are essential for smart mobility in dense urban environments. However, limited Road-Side Unit (RSU) density, frequent non-line-of-sight conditions, and highly dynamic vehicular topologies often prevent many Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs) from maintaining stable single-hop connectivity. Although multi-hop relay-assisted communication can extend infrastructure coverage, selecting relay links in real time under practical flow, capacity, and connectivity constraints remains challenging. Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) yields optimal multi-hop relay decisions, but its computational complexity scales sharply with network density, limiting real-time applicability. To address this, we propose a Learning-to-Optimise (L2O) framework based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for real-time NR-V2X relay selection. Vehicular communication states are modeled as attributed graphs, where CAVs and RSUs are nodes and candidate radio links are enriched with propagation-aware features. An offline MILP oracle provides optimal supervision, while an edge-aware Graph Isomorphism Network (GINE) approximates oracle decisions with near-constant inference latency. Experiments on large-scale urban datasets generated by an integrated SUMO--GEMV2 simulation pipeline show that the proposed approach achieves connectivity comparable to that of the MILP oracle while reducing execution time by orders of magnitude. The framework enables cost-effective enhancement of urban V2X connectivity by leveraging existing vehicular assets and supporting scalable, real-time NR-V2X operation in smart city environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对城市密集环境中NR-V2X通信的多跳中继选择问题，提出一种基于图神经网络（GNN）和学习优化（L2O）的实时框架。将车辆通信状态建模为属性图，利用离线MILP最优解监督训练边缘感知图同构网络（GINE），实现接近最优的连通性，同时推理时间降低数量级。
Motivation: 城市环境中RSU密度有限、非视距条件频繁、车辆拓扑高度动态，导致许多CAVs无法维持稳定的单跳连接；多跳中继选择在实时性要求下计算开销大，传统MILP方法难以实用。
Method: 提出L2O框架：将通信状态建模为属性图，节点为CAVs和RSUs，边为候选链路并包含传播感知特征；通过离线MILP最优解作为监督，训练GINE网络近似中继选择决策。
Result: 在SUMO-GEMV2模拟的大规模城市数据集上，该方法达到与MILP oracle相当的连通性，执行时间降低数量级。
Conclusion: 该框架利用现有车载资产，实现成本有效的城市V2X连通性增强，支持可扩展、实时的NR-V2X操作。

papers.title: CMI-Mem: Toward Generalizable Long-Term Memory Management via CMI-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Memory Manager models are pivotal in agent systems. Existing methods rely predominantly on LLM-judged synthetic question-answer (QA) pairs, making memory valuation dependent on sampled queries and the downstream reader. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{CMI-Mem}, a reinforcement learning(RL)-based lightweight memory manager model with a hybrid reward that combines downstream QA correctness and intrinsic Conditional Mutual Information (CMI). CMI evaluates the information contributed by new conversational inputs relative to the current memory state without conditioning on a sampled QA query, thereby complementing rather than replacing QA grounding. Our codes are available at: https://github.com/Wyb0627/CMIMem , and the CMI-Mem-4B model checkpoint is available at: https://www.modelscope.cn/models/wyb0627/CMIMem-4B
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有记忆管理器依赖LLM评判的合成QA对导致记忆估值偏差的问题，提出CMI-Mem，一种基于强化学习的轻量记忆管理器模型，采用混合奖励函数，结合下游QA正确性和条件互信息（CMI）。CMI评估新输入相对于当前记忆状态的信息贡献，无需依赖采样查询。论文提供了代码和模型。
Motivation: 现有记忆管理器依赖LLM-judged合成QA对，记忆估值受限于采样查询和下游阅读器，缺乏泛化性。
Method: 提出CMI-Mem，基于强化学习的轻量记忆管理器，混合奖励函数由下游QA正确性和条件互信息（CMI）组成；CMI计算新输入与当前记忆状态的条件互信息，不依赖特定查询。
Conclusion: CMI-Mem通过引入不依赖于查询的CMI奖励来补充QA grounding，可能提升记忆管理的泛化性。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Weight Decay: Exploring Grokking Acceleration via Attention Specific Heat
papers.abstract_en: Grokking -- the delayed generalization of neural networks long after they have memorized their training data -- wastes thousands of training epochs and is notoriously unpredictable. Building on the recent result that Transformer attention is formally isomorphic to a thermodynamic system, we treat the variance of attention logits as a specific heat Cv and show that its peak reliably precedes the generalization transition. We introduce CvAdamW, a drop-in AdamW variant that monitors Cv online and injects thermal energy by dynamically scaling weight decay when a phase transition is detected. Through a strictly iterative development process we identify three failure modes -- initialization noise, mini-batch micro-ripples, and slingshot blinding -- and resolve them with a memorization gate and an exponential-moving-average shock absorber. On modular arithmetic (a+b mod 97), CvAdamW enables grokking at epoch 2802 in a 4000-epoch budget where the baseline never groks. We further propose a scale-invariant z-score reformulation that removes task-specific hyperparameters, and evaluate it across 10 paired seeds. A paired analysis shows the cold-start variant reduces mean grokking latency by 257 epochs (6.0%; median 166 epochs; Wilcoxon p=0.049, Cohen's d=0.68, bootstrap 95% CI [53,489]), improving 8 of 10 seeds; on this single task Cv peaks before grokking in all 10 seeds. Our results indicate that neural networks may expose detectable precursors of impending generalization transitions, and that a physically motivated, proportional intervention can facilitate generalization within a fixed compute budget. Code and data are public.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现Transformer注意力的方差可作为比热容（specific heat Cv），其峰值可靠地预示泛化转变（grokking）的发生。作者提出CvAdamW优化器变体，通过在线监控Cv并在检测到相变时动态调节权重衰减来加速grokking。在模算术任务上，CvAdamW使模型在2802个epoch内实现grokking，而基线在4000个epoch内从未grok。进一步提出尺度不变的z-score重述，在10个种子上平均减少257个epoch的grokking延迟（6.0%），且所有种子中Cv均在grokking前达到峰值。
Motivation: 神经网络在训练数据过拟合后很久才出现泛化（grokking）的现象浪费了数千个训练周期，且难以预测，亟需可解释的加速方法。
Method: 利用注意力机制与热力学的形式同构，将注意力logits的方差视为比热容Cv；提出CvAdamW优化器，在线计算Cv并在检测到相变时动态放大权重衰减，同时通过记忆门和指数移动平均缓冲器解决初始化噪声、小批量微扰和弹弓盲点三个失败模式。
Result: 在模算术（a+b mod 97）任务上，CvAdamW在4000个epoch预算内于第2802个epoch实现grokking，而基线从未grok；10个种子的配对分析显示冷启动变体平均减少257个epoch（6.0%）的grokking延迟，Wilcoxon p=0.049，Cohen's d=0.68，95%置信区间[53, 489]；所有种子中Cv峰值均出现在grokking之前。
Conclusion: 神经网络可能暴露泛化转变前的可检测前兆，基于物理意义的适度干预可在固定计算预算内促进泛化；该方法目前仅在单一模算术任务上评估，未来需推广到更复杂任务。

papers.title: SenCos-GEM: SENet-Calibrated and Law-of-Cosines-Constrained Geometry-Enhanced Molecular Representation for Property Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Effective molecular representation learning is crucial for accurate molecular property prediction. Recently, numerous self-supervised learning (SSL) approaches leveraging 3D GNNs have been developed to capture comprehensive 3D structural information for drug discovery. However, existing methods lack explicit physical constraints and are highly susceptible to geometric noise induced by coarse empirical force fields during large-scale pre-training.Furthermore, they overlook dynamic feature modulation during downstream adaptation, often resulting in catastrophic forgetting and negative transfer. To address these limitations, we introduce SenCos-GEM, a novel explicitly decoupled geometry-enhanced molecular representation learning framework that incorporates SENet-calibrated and law-of-cosines-constrained enhancements. SenCos-GEM employs a physics-guided geometric consistency loss based on the law of cosines to derive high-fidelity and mathematically invariant 3D spatial priors. In addition, lightweight Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) modules are integrated into the backbone as task-specific adapters, while a dual-modulation prediction head combines Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) and SENet mechanisms to enable dynamic feature recalibration. SenCos-GEM demonstrates highly competitive performance across diverse classification and regression tasks on MoleculeNet benchmark, establishing new state-of-the-art results specifically on 3D conformation-sensitive regression tasks, such as FreeSolv, Lipophilicity, and QM9, achieving relative error reductions of 12.9% (RMSE), 5.3% (RMSE), and 8.2% (MAE), respectively. Moreover, our model exhibits superior capability in distinguishing stereoisomers and discriminating conformational perturbations, underscoring its robust spatial modeling performance. Collectively, SenCos-GEM represents a significant breakthrough in accurate molecular property prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SenCos-GEM 框架，通过引入 SENet 校准和基于余弦定律的几何一致性损失，增强分子表示学习，用于属性预测。在 MoleculeNet 基准上，回归任务（FreeSolv、Lipophilicity、QM9）取得新 SOTA，误差分别降低 12.9%、5.3%、8.2%，且能有效区分立体异构体和构象扰动。
Motivation: 现有基于 3D GNN 的自监督学习方法缺乏显式物理约束，易受粗粒度经验力场生成的几何噪声影响，且在下游微调时忽视动态特征调制，导致灾难性遗忘和负迁移。
Method: 提出显式解耦的几何增强分子表示框架：利用余弦定律构建物理引导的几何一致性损失，获得高保真且数学不变的 3D 空间先验；在主干网络中集成轻量 SENet 模块作为任务适配器，并设计双调制预测头（FiLM + SENet）实现动态特征重校准。
Result: 在 MoleculeNet 分类和回归任务中表现优异：FreeSolv 的 RMSE 降低 12.9%，Lipophilicity 的 RMSE 降低 5.3%，QM9 的 MAE 降低 8.2%；在区分立体异构体和构象扰动方面超越现有方法。
Conclusion: SenCos-GEM 通过显式物理约束和动态特征调制，为精确分子性质预测提供了有效方法，是对现有自监督 3D 分子表示学习的重要改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond SBDD: Geometric Deep Learning in Polypharmacology and Multi-target Drug Design
papers.abstract_en: The traditional "one drug, one target" paradigm of structure-based drug design (SBDD) frequently proves inadequate for treating multifactorial diseases such as cancer and neurodegenerative disorders, owing to compensatory signaling pathways and the emergence of drug resistance. While polypharmacology offers a synergistic therapeutic strategy, the rational design of ligands capable of simultaneously satisfying the geometric constraints imposed by multiple targets remains a major computational bottleneck. This review positions geometric deep learning (GDL) as a powerful integrative approach to overcome these limitations. We systematically survey GDL architectures ranging from invariant graph neural networks to SE(3)-equivariant diffusion models that harness non-Euclidean molecular data to capture intrinsic three-dimensional (3D) structural interdependencies. We critically analyze GDL applications across three core dimensions, including the characterization of shared binding pockets via geometric embeddings, multi-target bioactivity prediction through heterogeneous graph fusion, and de novo generation of dual-target ligands. Particular emphasis is placed on emerging structure-conditioned generative algorithms that integrate diffusion models with reinforcement learning to autonomously resolve complex geometric conflicts between competing binding sites. Furthermore, we evaluate the pivotal role of multimodal omics integration and specialized geometric benchmarking infrastructures in validating these models. By synthesizing these methodological advances, this review elucidates the paradigm shift in drug discovery from serendipitous exploration to rational, structure-driven polypharmacological molecular engineering, thereby providing a clear, structured guide for navigating the complexities of next-generation therapeutics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，系统回顾了几何深度学习（GDL）在多靶点药物设计（polypharmacology）中的应用。传统单靶点药物设计对癌症、神经退行性疾病等复杂疾病效果有限，而多靶点策略能应对抗药性和信号补偿，但设计同时满足多个靶点几何约束的配体是计算瓶颈。文章总结了从不变图神经网络到SE(3)-等变扩散模型的GDL架构，并分析了其在共享结合口袋表征、多靶点活性预测和双靶点配体生成三大方向的应用，特别关注结构条件生成算法结合扩散模型与强化学习以自动解决靶点间的几何冲突。
Motivation: 多因素疾病中，单靶点药物常因信号补偿和耐药性失效，多靶点药物设计成为必要，但现有方法难以同时满足多个靶点的三维几何约束，存在计算瓶颈。
Method: 系统梳理了GDL架构，包括不变图神经网络、SE(3)-等变扩散模型等，用于共享结合口袋的几何嵌入、多靶点活性预测的异构图融合，以及双靶点配体的从头生成。重点介绍了结构条件生成算法，该算法将扩散模型与强化学习结合，自动解决竞争性结合位点间的几何冲突。
Result: 作为综述，本文未报告具体数值结果，但总结了GDL在多靶点药物设计中的潜在能力，并强调了多模态组学整合和几何基准验证的重要性。
Conclusion: 综述认为，GDL正推动药物发现从偶然探索转向理性、结构驱动的多靶点分子工程，为下一代治疗剂的设计提供了结构化指南。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SevDiff: Severity-Conditioned Diffusion for Long-Tail Conflict Trajectory Generation
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory datasets used in ADAS evaluation are heavily biased toward routine driving; genuine vehicle-to-vehicle conflict events are rare, and the rarer the event, the higher the cost when an ADAS system fails to handle it. Existing generative approaches address this imbalance by conditioning on scene-level properties - spatial goals, agent structure, or natural-language adversarial objectives - but none can accept a target Time-to-Collision (TTC) value as input and be held to producing it within a measurable error. This paper introduces SevDiff, a severity-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) that accepts a requested minimum TTC value as a scalar conditioning signal and generates paired vehicle interaction trajectories whose realized conflict severity matches the request, evaluated through a hit-rate metric. Trained on 468 interaction windows extracted from the UTE SQM-W-1 expressway weaving-section dataset (1,041 vehicles, 822,691 observations after smoothing), SevDiff achieves 100% hit-rate within +/-0.5 s for TTC targets of 0.5-1.5 s and 97-99% at 2.0-2.5 s, with graceful degradation to 39% at TTC = 5.0 s. Generated kinematic features are physically plausible, with a maximum out-of-range rate of 4.7% across 12 features and no negative speed or gap values in more than 96.5% of samples. The hit-rate degradation pattern is physically interpretable as the strength of the conditioning signal relative to the training prior, making it a precision characterization of the generator rather than a pass/fail result.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SevDiff，一种基于严重性条件扩散模型（DDPM）的轨迹生成方法，能够根据用户指定的最小碰撞时间（TTC）生成车辆交互轨迹。在UTE SQM-W-1高速公路交织段数据集上训练，SevDiff在TTC目标0.5-1.5秒范围内达到100%命中率（±0.5秒误差），在2.0-2.5秒时命中率97-99%，在5.0秒时降为39%。生成的运动特征物理合理，12个特征中最大超出范围率为4.7%，96.5%以上样本无负速度或间隙值。
Motivation: 现有ADAS评估中的轨迹数据集严重偏向常规驾驶，车辆间冲突事件稀少且越罕见成本越高。现有生成方法通过场景级属性条件化，但无法接受目标TTC作为输入并可控生成。
Method: 提出严重性条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），以标量形式的最小TTC作为条件信号，生成配对车辆交互轨迹，并通过命中率指标评估实际冲突严重性与请求的匹配程度。
Result: 在包含468个交互窗口的UTE SQM-W-1数据集上，对于TTC目标0.5-1.5秒，命中率（±0.5秒误差）达100%；2.0-2.5秒时97-99%；5.0秒时39%。生成轨迹的物理合理性良好，最大超范围率4.7%，96.5%以上样本无负速度或间隙。
Conclusion: SevDiff能够精确控制生成轨迹的冲突严重性，命中率退化模式可物理解释为条件信号相对于训练先验的强度，提供了生成器的精确表征而非简单的通过/失败结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SOAP, Muon, and Beyond: Pushing LLM Pretraining Scales
papers.abstract_en: Higher-order optimizers such as Muon and SOAP offer faster convergence than AdamW, but their computational cost and numerical stability challenges have limited adoption at scale. In this work, we adapt and enhance preconditioned gradient methods to overcome the practical challenges of large-scale LLM pretraining. We first identify instabilities in SOAP at large batch sizes and propose algorithmic modifications including per-step QR orthogonalization and improved preconditioning strategies that eliminate loss spikes and enable stable training in these regimes. We then present a unified empirical study of SOAP, Muon, and AdamW using update-RMS matching to ensure fair learning rate transfer across optimizers. As part of this analysis, we empirically evaluate the orthogonalization quality of Muon. Our experiments on multi-billion-parameter models trained on trillions of tokens reveal that SOAP and Muon consistently outperform AdamW at the scales we tested. Notably, at batch sizes of up to 100M tokens for next-token prediction, these optimizers maintain training stability and quality while AdamW degrades. To enable efficient training at large scale, we introduce a layer-wise distributed optimizer compatible with Megatron-LM. Our implementation balances memory and hides communication while avoiding approximations to the optimizer computations, thus retaining their convergence benefits. Additionally, we identify and build specific system-level improvements to further accelerate our layer-wise implementation. To support the research community, we release a codebase that contains emerging algorithms for optimization: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Emerging-Optimizers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模语言模型预训练中高阶优化器（如Muon和SOAP）的计算开销和数值稳定性问题，提出了算法改进和系统优化。作者发现SOAP在大批量下存在不稳定，通过引入每步QR正交化等修改消除了损失尖峰，并统一了SOAP、Muon与AdamW的更新RMS匹配。实验表明在数十亿参数、数万亿token的规模下，SOAP和Muon一致优于AdamW，特别是在高达1亿token的批大小下仍保持稳定性。为实现高效训练，还提出了与Megatron-LM兼容的逐层分布式优化器，并开源了代码库。
Motivation: 高阶优化器如Muon和SOAP理论上收敛更快，但实际大规模LLM预训练中面临计算开销大和数值不稳定问题，限制了其应用。
Method: 通过每步QR正交化改进SOAP的数值稳定性；采用更新RMS匹配实现优化器间公平的学习率转移；提出层间分布式优化器以平衡内存并隐藏通信。
Result: 在数十亿参数、数万亿token的预训练中，SOAP和Muon一致优于AdamW；在批大小高达1亿token时仍保持稳定，而AdamW性能下降。

papers.title: Conflict Resolution under Degraded Surveillance in Air Corridors Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Safe Advanced Air Mobility operations require aircraft to maintain separation when surveillance information is noisy, delayed, incomplete, or temporarily unavailable. This study develops a Deep Q-Network-based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning framework for decentralized conflict resolution among heterogeneous small unmanned aerial vehicles and electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft operating within a structured three-dimensional corridor. Separate policies are trained for the two aircraft categories using local observations and a 14-action space that includes maintaining course, turning, vertical maneuvering, landing, and speed control. The simulation incorporates aircraft-specific dynamics, energy use, corridor constraints, observation noise, communication delay, information dropout, wind disturbance, actuator uncertainty, and model uncertainty. The trained policies are evaluated across 90 combinations of traffic density and minimum separation thresholds. Loss-of-separation frequency and duration generally increase with traffic density and separation requirements, although most events are resolved within 1s. Under safe conditions, agents maintain their motion approximately 79% of the time. During conflicts, turning accounts for 33% of actions, followed by maintaining motion at 29%, speed control at 25%, and vertical maneuvers at 13%. Six Pareto-optimal configurations reveal trade-offs between safety and corridor capacity. The framework supports the simulation-based evaluation of safer AAM conflict-resolution strategies under degraded surveillance conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对先进空中交通（AAM）中因传感器噪声、延迟、丢包或暂时失效导致的监视退化问题，提出基于深度Q网络（Deep Q-Network）的多智能体强化学习框架，用于三维走廊内异构飞行器（小型无人机和电动垂直起降飞行器）的分布式冲突消解。为两类飞行器分别训练策略，动作空间包含14种动作（保持航向、转向、垂直机动、着陆、速度控制等），仿真中集成了飞行器动力学、能耗、走廊约束、观测噪声、通信延迟、信息丢失、风扰、执行器不确定性和模型不确定性。训练后的策略在90种交通密度与最小间隔阈值组合下评估，结果表明冲突频率与时长随密度和间隔要求增加而增加，但多数冲突在1秒内解决；安全条件下约79%时间保持运动；冲突时转向占33%、保持运动29%、速度控制25%、垂直机动13%。帕累托最优配置揭示了安全与走廊容量之间的权衡。该框架支持在退化监视条件下评估更安全的AAM冲突消解策略。
Motivation: 现有冲突消解方法多假设完美感知和通信，而实际AAM运行中监视信息可能噪声、延迟、不完整或暂时缺失，需要鲁棒的分布式策略。
Method: 采用多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架，基于深度Q网络（DQN）为两类异构飞行器训练分散式策略，使用局部观测和14维动作空间，仿真中综合考虑噪声、延迟、丢包、风扰等多种退化因素。
Result: 在90种场景下评估，冲突频率和持续时间随交通密度和间隔要求增加，但大多数冲突在1秒内解决；安全时79%动作保持运动，冲突时转向占33%、保持运动29%、速度控制25%、垂直机动13%。发现6种帕累托最优配置。
Conclusion: 该MARL框架能在退化监视条件下有效实现分布式冲突消解，但需注意安全与容量间的权衡，未来可扩展到更复杂场景。

papers.title: StrideDiffusion: Accelerating Diffusion Models for Time-series Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have become competitive generators for time series, but their practical use is limited by the large number of sequential denoising steps required at inference time. Existing fast samplers typically use fixed or generic timestep schedules, overlooking a distinctive property of time-series diffusion: different spectral bands evolve at different rates during the reverse process. We introduce StrideDiffusion, a training-free spectral-aware sampler that adaptively selects the denoising stride from band-level activity. At each step, StrideDiffusion monitors relative band energy, log-power drift, and phase velocity to identify whether high- frequency dynamics remain active or whether the trajectory is dominated by stable low-frequency structure. It then takes fine steps when rapidly varying bands are active and larger jumps once only coarse components remain. A bandwise stability analysis shows that inactive frequency bands change only linearly with the jump size under deterministic affine reverse updates, providing a local justification for spectral activity as a step-size indicator. Across six unconditional time-series generation benchmarks, StrideDiffusion uses only 14-66 function evaluations instead of 500/1000 denoising steps, achieving up to 18.9x wall-clock speedup while preserving or improving generation quality. On conditional imputation and forecasting, it further delivers 5-14x average acceleration with comparable predictive accuracy. These results show that spectral evolution provides a practical and principled signal for fast time-series diffusion sampling. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/stridediff-ts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StrideDiffusion 是一种无需训练的频谱感知采样器，用于加速时间序列扩散模型的推理。它通过监测频带能量、对数功率漂移和相位速度，自适应调整去噪步长：在快速变化的高频分量活跃时细步长，在仅剩低频稳定结构时大步长。在六个无条件时间序列生成基准上，仅需14-66次函数评估（原需500/1000步），实现最高18.9倍加速并保持或提升生成质量；在条件插补和预测任务上达到5-14倍加速，预测精度相当。
Motivation: 扩散模型生成时间序列时需要大量顺序去噪步骤，推理缓慢。现有快速采样器使用固定或通用时间步调度，忽略了时间序列扩散中不同频谱带在逆过程中演化速率不同的特性。
Method: 提出 StrideDiffusion，一个训练免费的频谱感知采样器，在每个去噪步骤监测相对频带能量、对数功率漂移和相位速度，以判断高频动态是否活跃，从而动态调整步长；并基于频带稳定性分析，证明不活跃频带在确定性仿射逆更新下仅随跳步大小线性变化，为频谱活动作为步长指标提供局部理论支持。
Result: 在六个无条件时间序列生成基准上，StrideDiffusion 使用14-66次函数评估替代500/1000步，实现最高18.9倍实际加速，生成质量保持或提升；在条件插补和预测任务上平均加速5-14倍，预测精度相当。
Conclusion: 频谱演变为快速时间序列扩散采样提供了实用且原则性的信号，StrideDiffusion 是一种有效且无需训练的加速方法。

papers.title: When RLVR Shrinks the Reasoning Boundary: Diagnosing Pass@k Inversion
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve one-sample accuracy while making a model worse under repeated sampling. We study this pass@k inversion: after training, the policy may solve fewer distinct problems than its base model at large $k$. The failure concentrates on boundary prompts, where the base model contains rare correct trajectories that are recoverable by sampling but too sparse to reliably appear in finite RLVR rollout groups. We argue that a two-mode account explains this as an absence-of-evidence failure: rare correct trajectories may disappear before RLVR samples and reinforces them often enough. The main contribution is this diagnostic and mechanistic framing. Per-Problem Base Anchoring (PBA) is a deliberately simple proof-of-concept: sharpen prompts with sufficient frozen-base correct evidence, and anchor risky prompts to the base distribution. Across three training seeds on Omni-MATH-Test, with MATH500 as a secondary high-coverage validation benchmark, PBA improves both \PassK{1} and high-budget coverage over matched GRPO. A 3000-prompt regime-controlled diagnostic study is consistent across seeds with the expected signature: ordinary GRPO loses base-solvable boundary prompts, while PBA preserves rare verifier-positive trajectories. We use mathematical verifiers as a controlled testbed for verifier-guided optimization; the same pass@k inversion risk applies to ECCV-relevant vision-language agents when repeated visual, spatial, or chart-reasoning attempts are checked by external tools or verifiers. Reasoning post-training should decide not only how strongly to optimize, but which prompts are safe to optimize.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中的pass@k反转现象：训练后模型在多次采样下能解决的独特问题反而少于基座模型。该现象集中在边界提示（boundary prompts）上，基座模型包含罕见正确轨迹但采样稀疏。作者提出诊断框架和一种简单证明方法PBA（Per-Problem Base Anchoring），通过锚定基座分布保留罕见验证器正例。在Omni-MATH-Test上用GRPO对比，PBA同时提升pass@1和高采样预算覆盖率。
Motivation: RLVR虽然提升单样本准确率，但在重复采样下可能降低模型覆盖的独特问题数量，这一pass@k反转现象未被深入诊断和理解。
Method: 提出Per-Problem Base Anchoring（PBA）方法：对足够基座正确证据的提示进行锐化，对高风险提示锚定至基座分布，并在数学验证器控制环境下与GRPO对比。
Result: 在Omni-MATH-Test上，PBA在三个训练种子下均优于GRPO，同时改善pass@1和高采样预算覆盖率；3000提示的诊断研究证实PBA保留了基座可解的边界提示。
Conclusion: 推理后训练不仅应决定优化强度，还应决定哪些提示可以安全优化；pass@k反转风险同样适用于ECCV相关的视觉语言智能体。

papers.title: Improving Access to Essential Medicines via Decision-Aware Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: A critical challenge in healthcare systems in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) is the efficient and equitable allocation of scarce resources, particularly essential medicines. This problem is complicated by limited high-quality data, which restricts the applicability of traditional data-driven techniques. We propose a novel decision-aware machine learning framework for essential medicines allocation, which additionally leverages multi-task learning to ensure sample efficiency and catalytic priors to ensure equitable allocation. In collaboration with the Sierra Leone national government, we performed a staggered, nationwide deployment of our system as a decision support tool. Our econometric evaluation finds an estimated 19% increase in consumption of allocated products in treated districts, demonstrating its efficacy at improving access to essential medicines. Our tool was subsequently scaled nationwide, covering an estimated 2 million women and children under five. Our work demonstrates how machine learning methods can improve efficiency at very low cost in resource-constrained global health settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低收入和中等收入国家基本药物分配效率低下的问题，提出了一种决策感知机器学习框架，结合多任务学习和催化先验，在数据有限的情况下实现高效且公平的分配。与塞拉利昂政府合作进行全国范围部署，评估显示治疗区分配产品消费量增加约19%，工具最终覆盖约200万妇女和儿童。
Motivation: 低收入和中等收入国家医疗资源稀缺，高效公平地分配基本药物面临挑战，且缺乏高质量数据限制传统方法应用。
Method: 提出决策感知机器学习框架，采用多任务学习保证样本效率，并引入催化先验促进公平分配。
Result: 在塞拉利昂全国范围内部署后，计量经济学评估发现治疗区分配产品消费量预计增加19%，工具覆盖约200万妇女和五岁以下儿童。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了在资源受限的全球卫生环境中，机器学习方法能以极低成本提升效率，并已实现全国规模推广。

papers.title: HypNO: A Graph-Based Neural Operator with Physics-Informed Message Passing for Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
papers.abstract_en: We introduce HypNO, a graph-based neural operator for scalar hyperbolic conservation laws. HypNO operates directly on a space-time graph of finite-volume cells and uses adjacency-factored, physics-informed message passing to respect upwinding and entropy admissibility near shocks. We benchmark the architecture on the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards (LWR) and Aw-Rascle-Zhang (ARZ) traffic-flow models, a stress test for operator-learning methods because of their simultaneous global transport and shock formation. HypNO predicts solution snapshots accurately across a range of initial conditions while capturing the shocks and discontinuities of the solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HypNO 是一种基于图的神经算子，用于标量双曲守恒律，直接在有限体积单元的空时图上操作，通过邻接因子的物理信息消息传递尊重上风和熵可接受性。在 LWR 和 ARZ 交通流模型上评估，能准确预测不同初始条件下的解快照并捕捉激波和不连续性。
Motivation: 现有算子学习方法在处理同时具有全局传输和激波形成的双曲守恒律时面临挑战，需要一种能尊重物理特性的架构。
Method: HypNO 构建空间-时间图，使用基于相邻关系的物理信息消息传递，确保消息传递方向与上风方向一致，并满足熵可接受性条件。
Result: 在 LWR 和 ARZ 交通流模型上，HypNO 准确预测解快照，成功捕捉激波和不连续性。
Conclusion: HypNO 通过图结构和物理信息消息传递，有效处理双曲守恒律中的激波和间断，是算子学习方法的有效架构。

papers.title: From Atoms to Entropy: Optimal Noise Allocation for Diffusion Training in the Convex Regime
papers.abstract_en: How should a diffusion model decide which noise levels to train on, and how much? Despite the importance of this choice, current noise schedules are based largely on heuristics or empirical tuning. Here, we develop a general statistical framework for studying asymptotically optimal noise-level allocation in diffusion training. Our first main result concerns the fully coupled regime, where information can spread between different time points. Under convexity or Polyak-Lojasiewicz-type assumptions, we show that the optimized training schedule admits an atomic minimizer, concentrated on finitely many noise levels. Our second main result specializes this framework to an idealized independent-learner regime, intended to model temporal specialization in neural networks. Under an additional feature-noise decoupling condition, a random-matrix analysis leads to an information-theoretic proxy: the decoupled sampling density is proportional to the square root of the generative entropy rate, the rate at which conditional entropy grows along the forward process. We test these predictions in controlled settings where the coupled objective can be optimized directly, including Dirac mixtures, low-dimensional manifolds, and MNIST. In these settings, the optimized schedules are consistently finite-support, while the smooth entropic proxy closely tracks the atomic optimum in neural-network models and breaks down mainly in the fully coupled parametric case, as the theory suggests. We then evaluate the entropic schedule in larger-scale experiments, where full schedule optimization is currently intractable. The results indicate that square-root entropy scheduling can substantially improve training efficiency on discrete domains and remains competitive with standard EDM-style heuristics on continuous images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文为扩散模型的噪声层级分配提供了统计优化框架。在凸性或Polyak-Lojasiewicz假设下，最优训练调度具有原子性，即集中在有限噪声层级上。在独立学习器场景中，通过随机矩阵分析推导出解耦采样密度与生成熵率的平方根成正比。实验在Dirac混合、低维流形和MNIST上验证了原子最优调度，并在大规模实验中发现平方根熵调度能提升离散域训练效率，与EDM在连续图像上竞争力相当。
Motivation: 当前扩散模型依赖启发式或经验调优的噪声调度，缺乏理论指导，需要研究噪声层级分配的最优策略以提升训练效率。
Method: 发展通用统计框架，利用凸优化和随机矩阵分析，分别针对完全耦合和平行学习两种情形，推导出原子最小化解和信息论代理（平方根熵率）。
Result: 理论上证明最优调度具有有限支撑；控制实验中原子调度与熵代理一致；大规模实验中平方根熵调度显著提升离散域训练效率，与EDM在连续图像上竞争力相当。
Conclusion: 平方根熵调度可作为扩散模型训练的有效策略，但完全耦合情况下的全优化仍具挑战。

papers.title: Leveraging Biokinetic Knowledge Priors for Data-Scarce Bioprocess Modeling
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning has accelerated drug discovery, its impact on biomanufacturing has been considerably more limited. The reason is data scarcity. Bioreactor experiments are high-cost, take days to weeks, and are rarely shared in public form, leaving each research work with only a handful of experiments. The domain itself, however, is rich in prior knowledge. Biokinetic ordinary differential equation (ODE) models have described microbial growth for decades, yet how to inject this knowledge into a neural network has not been studied systematically. We present the first systematic study of how to inject this ODE knowledge into a neural network, comparing a data-level prior that pre-trains a generic decoder on simulated ODE curves against an architecture-level prior that embeds the ODE inside the decoder. Both consistently outperform no-prior baselines across 11 datasets and 7 microbial species. Our central finding is that the two are substitutable. A generic decoder pre-trained on simulation matches a fully bio-structured decoder trained on real data. Simulation pre-training therefore offers a simple, data-efficient recipe for deep learning under bioprocess data scarcity.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生物制造中数据稀缺的问题，系统研究了如何将生物动力学常微分方程（ODE）先验知识注入神经网络。比较了两种注入方式：在模拟ODE曲线上预训练通用解码器（数据级先验）和将ODE嵌入解码器内部（架构级先验）。在11个数据集和7个微生物物种上，两种方法均优于无先验基线，且两者可互相替代，模拟预训练提供了一种简单、数据高效的深度学习方法。
Motivation: 生物制造领域因实验成本高、周期长、数据共享少而面临数据稀缺问题，但该领域拥有丰富的先验知识（生物动力学ODE模型），如何系统地将这些知识注入神经网络尚未被研究。
Method: 提出两种注入ODE先验知识的方法：数据级先验（在模拟ODE曲线上预训练通用解码器）和架构级先验（将ODE嵌入解码器内部），并在多个数据集上进行对比实验。
Result: 在11个数据集和7个微生物物种上，两种先验方法均一致优于无先验基线，且两者性能相当，表明模拟预训练可替代结构化生物解码器。
Conclusion: 模拟预训练提供了一种简单、数据高效的生物过程深度学习方案，可缓解数据稀缺问题。

papers.title: Codec-Gauge: Learning Compression-Friendly Gauges for Transformer KV Caches
papers.abstract_en: Long-context Transformer inference increasingly relies on KV-cache compression or quantization. Prior rotation and transform-coding results suggest that the channel basis of each key/value vector affects how faithfully a fixed backend preserves model behavior. We introduce Codec-Gauge, a post-training cache-coordinate layer that learns small orthogonal channel transforms around existing compression and quantization backends. Its frequency-distribution objective combines a token-channel DCT spectral-centroid loss with a smooth rate proxy to concentrate KV energy in low-frequency codec-facing layouts. We evaluate actual compression and decompression using measured bytes and rolling compressed-history scoring. Across six models at $3$, $4$, and $6$ bits/value, learned gauges reduce zfp KL divergence by $44.0\%$ on average relative to raw coordinates and outperform random, Hadamard, DCT, and PCA/KLT controls. The same gauges improve quality preservation for block-uniform and KIVI-style quantization. Experiments on a 27B model and long-context task prompts reproduce the quality trend, while serial storage and timing measurements validate the implemented compressed-cache paths. These results establish cache-coordinate geometry as a practical post-training variable for improving compression fidelity without changing model weights, attention semantics, or backend coding rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Codec-Gauge 是一种后训练 KV 缓存坐标变换层，通过学习小规模正交通道变换，将键值向量的能量集中到低频分量，从而提升现有压缩和量化后端的保真度。在 3、4、6 bits/value 下，该方法使 zfp KL 散度平均降低 44.0%，并优于随机、Hadamard、DCT 和 PCA/KLT 基线。实验在 27B 模型和长上下文任务上验证了质量趋势，且存储和时间测量确认了压缩缓存路径的有效性。
Motivation: 长上下文 Transformer 推理依赖 KV 缓存压缩或量化，但现有方法未考虑通道基对压缩保真度的影响，导致模型行为可能被扭曲。
Method: 提出 Codec-Gauge，一个后训练缓存坐标变换层，学习正交通道变换，优化目标结合 token-channel DCT 谱质心损失和平滑率代理，以集中 KV 能量在低频布局中。
Result: 在 3、4、6 bits/value 下，Codec-Gauge 使 zfp KL 散度平均降低 44.0%，优于随机、Hadamard、DCT 和 PCA/KLT 基线；同样改善了块均匀和 KIVI 风格量化的质量。实验在 27B 模型和长上下文任务上复现了质量趋势。
Conclusion: 缓存坐标几何作为一种实用的后训练变量，能够在不改变模型权重、注意力语义或后端编码规则的情况下提升压缩保真度。

papers.title: ReliableTableQA:How Much Supervision Does Reliability Annotation Need?
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ReliableTableQA, a framework for training an LLM to annotate the statistical reliability of tabular QA results, not whether the query is answerable, but whether the computed answer is statistically meaningful. In real enterprise analytics, a syntactically correct SQL query can return a value that is based on too small a sample, has an excessively wide confidence interval, or is too confounded to support action. Existing systems answer confidently in all such cases, a failure we quantify as the Unreliable Confident Answer Rate (UCAR). We contribute (1) a ten-category reliability taxonomy (R1-R10) covering hazards such as small-sample aggregates, multiple-comparison inflation, and distribution-tail mismatch; (2) a program-first data pipeline that generates 50,000 reliability-labeled training examples from a context-free grammar over public retail schemas, with schema-stratified SFT/GRPO splits; and (3) a controlled study of how much supervision calibrated reliability annotation actually requires. We find that a small, schema-stratified SFT set is remarkably sufficient: 200 examples raise reliability-flag F1 from 0.61 to 0.98 and parse rate from 0.52 to 1.00, drive UCAR to zero, and yield a model that generalizes to an unseen retail domain (Rel-F1 0.997 on held-out H&M). Against this strong SFT baseline, GRPO, commonly assumed to be essential, helps only when SFT is under-trained (+0.06-0.16 exact-flag-set match at 100 examples, in- and out-of-distribution) and provides no measurable benefit once SFT is adequate, a null result we confirm across a hard compound-flag slice, a strict exact-match metric, and out-of-distribution evaluation. Our findings reframe reliability annotation as a data-efficiency problem and delineate precisely when reinforcement fine-tuning does and does not pay off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReliableTableQA是一个框架，用于训练LLM对表格问答结果的统计可靠性进行标注。该框架构建了一个十类可靠性分类法（R1-R10），并通过程序化数据管道生成5万个标注样本。研究发现，仅需200个SFT样本即可将可靠性标记F1从0.61提升至0.98，UCAR降至零，且模型能泛化到未见过的零售领域。GRPO仅在SFT训练不足时提供微小收益，一旦SFT充分则无额外帮助。
Motivation: 现有表格问答系统对基于小样本、宽置信区间或混杂严重的统计不可靠结果也会自信地回答，导致不可靠的自信回答率（UCAR）问题。需要量化并标注统计可靠性。
Method: 提出ReliableTableQA框架，包括：(1) 十类可靠性分类法（R1-R10）；(2) 基于上下文无关文法的程序化数据管道，生成5万条可靠性标注的训练样本；(3) 使用schema分层的SFT和GRPO进行训练。
Result: 200个SFT样本将可靠性标记F1从0.61提升至0.98，解析率从0.52提升至1.00，UCAR降至零，并在H&M数据集上达到Rel-F1 0.997。GRPO在SFT不足时提升0.06-0.16的精确标记集匹配率，但SFT充分时无额外收益。
Conclusion: 可靠性标注本质上是一个数据效率问题，少量分层的SFT数据即可达到高精度；GRPO仅当SFT不足时才有用，否则无显著收益。

papers.title: AppWorld-UL: Benchmarking Diverse Agent-User Interactions for Tool-Use
papers.abstract_en: Tool-use agents that address day-to-day digital tasks such as ordering groceries must not only operate applications, but also interact with the user, e.g., to ask clarification questions, prompt for confirmation, and inform the user when the instruction is infeasible. However, current benchmarks for evaluating agent-user interactions do not capture the diversity of such interactions. Further, they operate in small environments with few, often non-state-changing, APIs. To address this gap, we introduce AppWorld-UL, a ``user-in-the-loop'' benchmark of 516 challenging tasks requiring diverse agent-user interactions. Building upon the AppWorld framework with 9 popular simulated apps like Amazon and Spotify, we systematically modify original tasks to introduce ambiguities and constraints that necessitate various types of agent-user interaction. User behavior is simulated by an LLM prompted to respond with carefully designed knowledge boundaries, offering more reliable simulation than the unconstrained or overly rigid alternatives used in prior work. Our evaluation reveals that a state-of-the-art LLM, Claude Opus 4.7, achieves only 48.6% success on AppWorld-UL, and only 35.7% on the harder, compositional subset. On the stricter, scenario-level metric, compositional task performance drops to only 21.3%. Our analysis reveals that correct user-interaction is crucial for success. This demonstrates the benchmark's difficulty and its potential to advance research on user-in-the-loop tool-use agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AppWorld-UL 是一个面向工具使用智能体的“用户参与”基准，包含 516 个需要多样化智能体-用户交互的挑战性任务。该基准构建于 AppWorld 框架（含 9 个流行模拟应用）之上，通过引入歧义和约束来模拟用户交互。评估表明，当前最先进的 LLM（Claude Opus 4.7）在整体任务上成功率仅 48.6%，在组合性子集上更低至 35.7%，且场景级指标下组合任务成功率仅 21.3%。分析表明正确的用户交互对任务成功至关重要。
Motivation: 现有基准未能充分捕捉工具使用智能体中用户交互的多样性，且通常在小环境、少 API 的非状态变更场景下运行。
Method: 基于 AppWorld 框架，系统性地修改原始任务以引入需要多种智能体-用户交互的歧义和约束；用户行为由 LLM 模拟，并配备精心设计的知识边界，以提供比先前工作更可靠的模拟。
Result: Claude Opus 4.7 在整体任务上成功率为 48.6%，在较难的组合性子集上为 35.7%，场景级指标下组合任务成功率仅 21.3%。

papers.title: A Graph Neural Network approach to zero-shot Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Traditional Predictive Digital Twins often remain geometrically rigid, requiring extensive retraining or fine-tuning whenever the underlying physical domain or boundary conditions change. To overcome this limitation, we present a novel framework for \textit{Zero-Shot Digital Twins} that seamlessly couples real-time visual perception with a geometry-agnostic, physics-informed reasoning engine. At the core of our architecture is the Thermodynamics-Informed Graph Neural Network architecture, a Geometric Deep Learning solver grounded in a metriplectic thermodynamic formalism that enforces energy conservation and non-negative entropy production locally through graph message passing. The framework integrates an auxiliary Graph Neural Network to infer unobservable fields (such as stress tensors or velocity and energy distributions) directly from sparse initial visual boundaries, mitigating numerical start-up transients. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, we implement a continuous closed-loop data assimilation mechanism; the pipeline tracks macroscopic deformations and free-surface fluid boundaries in real-time using deep segmentation networks combined with sparse optical flow, dynamically correcting the autoregressive simulation rollout and eliminating numerical drift. To test the validity of our approach, we demonstrate the extreme generalization capabilities of our approach across two disparate physical regimes: the large deformations of a viscoelastic beam and the non-linear sloshing of a viscous fluid. In both scenarios, the unified framework instantiates physically accurate simulations on novel, unseen geometries without case-specific retraining, operating well within real-time latency budgets (approximately 25 ms per frame) and enabling the direct projection of latent mechanical variables via Augmented Reality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于零样本数字孪生的框架，结合实时视觉感知与几何无关的物理推理引擎。核心是热力学约束的图神经网络（GNN），通过图消息传递保证能量守恒和熵增；另设辅助GNN从稀疏视觉边界推断不可观测量（如应力、速度分布），减少数值启动瞬变。通过闭环数据同化机制（深度分割网络+稀疏光流）实时校正模拟轨迹，消除数值漂移。在粘弹性梁大变形和粘性流体非线性晃动两个不同物理场景上验证了极端泛化能力：无需重训练即可在新几何体上运行，延迟约25ms/帧，支持增强现实投影。
Motivation: 传统预测数字孪生通常依赖固定几何，当物理域或边界条件变化时需要大量重训练或微调，缺乏灵活性和实时性。
Method: 提出零样本数字孪生框架，包含热力学约束GNN求解器（基于度规-辛几何形式）、辅助GNN初始推断不可观测场、以及基于深度分割和光流的连续闭环数据同化机制。
Result: 在两种不同物理问题（粘弹性梁大变形、粘性流体晃荡）上，框架可在未见过的几何体上直接生成准确的物理仿真，无需针对特定情况重新训练，达到实时性能（约25ms/帧）。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了零样本数字孪生的可行性和强泛化能力，为无需重训练的实时物理仿真提供了新范式，但当前仅限于结构力学和流体力学中的连续介质问题。

papers.title: Grounding Investor Views: Neural Predicates in the Black-Litterman Model
papers.abstract_en: Portfolio construction under the Black-Litterman model requires investors to specify views on asset returns alongside explicit uncertainty estimates -- a process that remains largely subjective and difficult to scale. We propose a formal approach in which neural predicates serve as a structured, probabilistic mechanism for view generation. In our formulation, structured financial analysis data is processed through a compositional hierarchy of neural predicates whose outputs -- probability distributions over market stances -- are mapped to the pick matrix $\mathbf{P}$, the view return vector $\mathbf{q}$, and the view uncertainty matrix $\boldsymbolΩ$ of the Black-Litterman model. View confidence is derived from predicate output distributions, providing a data-driven alternative to subjective uncertainty elicitation. The resulting approach is interpretable, in the sense that any portfolio weight can be traced back through the predicate's logical chain to the underlying data, and fully differentiable, enabling end-to-end learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在Black-Litterman模型中使用神经谓词（neural predicates）生成投资者观点，将结构化金融分析数据通过谓词层次结构映射为概率分布，进而填充观点矩阵P、观点收益向量q和观点不确定性矩阵Ω，实现数据驱动的观点生成和端到端可微的资产组合构建。
Motivation: Black-Litterman模型要求投资者主观指定观点及不确定性，难以规模化且主观性强。
Method: 提出神经谓词层次结构，将结构化金融数据转换为关于市场立场的概率分布，并映射到Black-Litterman模型的参数中，同时保持可解释性和可微性。
Result: 该方法是可解释的（权重可回溯到数据和谓词逻辑链）且完全可微，支持端到端学习。
Conclusion: 提供了一种系统化、数据驱动的投资者观点生成方式，替代传统主观不确定性启发方法。

papers.title: Position: Stop Reactively Patching Your Model Every Time and Start Proactive Test-Driven AI Development
papers.abstract_en: Many modern AI systems are designed to operate under diverse, open-ended, use-cases. To help generalize deployed systems, many deployed-system maintenance pipelines use a reactive AI flywheel that observes emerging feedback from user behavior (errors) and patches the model accordingly. However, when used as the primary maintenance mechanism, these flywheels often ignore the broader context of these errors within the system's objectives, failing to preempt potential future edge cases, which leads to more unnecessary flywheel iterations. Also, it is statistically increasingly difficult to collect remaining errors due to the long-tail nature of open-world use-cases. This position paper argues that a proactive test-driven flywheel is required to address reactive flywheel's limitations and to approach a generalizable system. We advocate for creating a "test space" to technically map feedback data to task objectives, evolving the flywheel from reactive to proactive. We augment our position by mathematically proving a proactive one achieves better long-term scaling with fewer iterations than the reactive flywheel.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Position Paper Track. 18 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，批评当前AI系统维护中广泛使用的反应式（reactive）flywheel——即被动收集用户错误并修补模型——的局限性，主张转向主动式测试驱动开发（proactive test-driven flywheel）。作者提出通过构建“测试空间”将反馈数据与任务目标关联，并从数学上证明主动式flywheel在长期扩展中能以更少迭代达到更好的泛化性能。
Motivation: 反应式flywheel作为主要维护机制时，往往忽略错误在系统目标中的上下文，无法预判未来边缘情况，导致不必要的迭代；同时，由于开放世界用例的长尾分布，收集剩余错误在统计上越来越困难。
Method: 提出创建“测试空间”（test space）技术，将用户反馈数据系统性地映射到任务目标，从而将flywheel从反应式转变为主动式；并通过数学证明支持该方法的长期有效性。
Result: 数学上证明主动式flywheel在长期扩展中需要更少的迭代次数，且能达到更优的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为，为了实现真正泛化的AI系统，必须用主动式测试驱动开发替代当前主流的被动修补范式。

papers.title: DynamicMCPBench: A Trace-Grounded, Effect-Scored Benchmark for LLM Agents over Live MCP Servers
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed over Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, yet the benchmarks used to evaluate them score the final answer or a fixed "ground-truth" list of tools, both of which are fragile once the underlying data is live and stateful. We present DynamicMCPBench, a reusable framework rather than a fixed dataset. A practitioner can run it on their own MCP servers to test models on their own tasks, or let it collect servers automatically to measure a model's general ability to solve agentic tasks. Given the servers and any set of models, it generates realistic goals, pursues each one live to record a successful trajectory, distills that trajectory into path-agnostic effect checkpoints, and scores an agent on whether it reproduces those effects, never on the final answer. To show what the framework reveals, we run it at scale: 24 models over 121 servers and 750 tasks spread evenly over 15 task categories (50 each), where each category targets a distinct tool-use challenge of the generated questions. Each task is scored by pass^3: it counts as solved only if all three independent attempts succeed. Even the strongest agents solve only about half of the tasks, 31% of tasks are solved by no model at all, and accuracy collapses as the required tool chain grows longer (from 39% on the shortest chains to 13% on the longest). A human validation study confirms the automatic scoring is reliable (chance-corrected agreement of 0.76). DynamicMCPBench thus turns benchmark construction into something practitioners can rerun on their own servers and models, while exposing a consistent inability of current agents to handle long, multi-step agentic tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynamicMCPBench 是一个可复用的框架，用于评估 LLM 代理在实时 MCP 服务器上的表现。它通过生成真实目标、记录成功轨迹、提取路径无关的效果检查点，并使用 pass^3 评分（三次独立尝试均成功才算通过）来打分。在 24 个模型、121 个服务器和 750 个任务上的大规模测试显示，最强模型仅解决约一半任务，31% 的任务无任何模型能解，且准确率随工具链长度增加而急剧下降（从 39% 降至 13%），人类验证确认自动评分可靠（经机遇校正的一致性为 0.76）。
Motivation: 现有基准依赖最终答案或固定工具列表，在实时、有状态的动态环境下脆弱且无法复用。
Method: 提出一个框架，可在用户自己的 MCP 服务器上运行：生成现实目标、追踪成功轨迹、提炼为效果检查点，然后基于是否重现这些效果（而非最终答案）进行评分，并使用 pass^3 指标。
Result: 最强模型仅解决约一半任务；31% 的任务无模型能解；短链任务准确率 39%，长链任务降至 13%；人类验证显示自动评分可靠（一致性 0.76）。
Conclusion: DynamicMCPBench 使基准构建可复现，并暴露了当前 LLM 代理在处理长多步任务时的系统性不足。

papers.title: CLOE: Christoffel Loss Autoencoder for Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised anomaly detection plays a key role in diverse fields such as process monitoring, healthcare, and finance. However, lightweight methods often struggle with high-dimensional data and typically require careful tuning of multiple hyperparameters. Among existing approaches, Christoffel Function--based methods are attractive due to their simplicity, requiring at most a single hyperparameter. They also benefit from a well-established theoretical foundation that yields several interesting results for data science. However, their main limitation is poor scalability to high-dimensional settings. In this paper, we introduce CLOE, a new method that combines an autoencoder for dimensionality reduction with a Christoffel Function--based detector applied in the latent space. To better align representation learning with anomaly detection, we design a novel loss function that leverages the Christoffel Function to guide the autoencoder toward representations that better capture the support of the normal data distribution. We further propose a principled procedure to set the detection threshold and an efficient strategy to tune the single remaining hyperparameter. Experiments on multiple high-dimensional tabular anomaly detection benchmarks demonstrate that CLOE achieves superior performance compared to existing methods, while preserving the lightweight and low-tuning advantages of Christoffel Function--based approaches.
papers.journal_ref: The 16th International Conference on Information Science and Technology, University of Coimbra; City University of Hong Kong, Oct 2026, Coimbra, Portugal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CLOE，一种将自编码器（autoencoder）与克里斯托费尔函数（Christoffel Function）相结合的半监督异常检测方法。通过设计基于克里斯托费尔函数的新型损失函数，引导自编码器学习正常数据分布的支撑集表示，并在潜在空间中进行检测。实验表明，CLOE在高维表格异常检测基准上优于现有方法，同时保持了轻量级和低调参优势。
Motivation: 现有轻量级异常检测方法在高维数据上表现不佳且需精细调参；而基于克里斯托费尔函数的方法虽简单、理论坚实，但难以扩展到高维场景。
Method: 结合自编码器降维与克里斯托费尔函数检测器：设计一种利用克里斯托费尔函数的新损失函数，使自编码器学习更好地捕获正常数据分布支撑集的表示；提出基于原则的阈值设定和单超参数调优策略。
Result: 在多个高维表格异常检测基准上，CLOE取得了优于现有方法的性能，同时保留了克里斯托费尔函数方法的轻量级和低调参优势。
Conclusion: CLOE通过将克里斯托费尔函数嵌入自编码器训练，有效解决了高维异常检测的可扩展性问题，并保持了理论简洁性。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Trust Estimation for Multi-LLM Systems via Structured Expert Judgement
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) ensembles are increasingly used to improve reliability by combining predictions from multiple LLMs. However, existing aggregation methods typically assume that all models are equally trustworthy, overlooking differences in uncertainty quality. This assumption is poorly suited to heterogeneous LLMs, whose reliability and capability vary significantly, making naive aggregation vulnerable to unreliable or adversarial experts. In this work, we formulate multi-LLM aggregation as a problem of uncertainty-aware trust estimation. We adapt structured expert judgment from decision theory, using context-aware calibration questions to estimate expert reliability based on the quality of its probabilistic predictions. Specifically, we employ Cooke-style log weighting, which penalises overconfident incorrect predictions and favours well-calibrated experts. We evaluate our approach on MMLU and MMLU-Pro across homogeneous, heterogeneous, and contaminated expert panels. Results show that while aggregation methods perform similarly in homogeneous settings, Cooke weighting becomes critical under heterogeneity and contamination. It achieves a superior accuracy-reliability balance and remains robust when unreliable experts are introduced. These findings suggest that Multi-LLM aggregation requires not just combining predictions, but calibrating trust under uncertainty.

papers.title: PromptPack: Scaling LLM Annotation Agents for Online Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Online recommendation platforms increasingly use Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract structured features from ad creatives. While deploying a single-call LLM annotation agent yields significant Click-Through Rate (CTR) improvements in our live production environment, per-creative prompting is prohibitively expensive to scale. The redundant system instructions sent in every request account for 94% of billed input tokens. To break this cost bottleneck, we introduce PromptPack, a scalable, high-throughput LLM annotation agent. PromptPack achieves this scale via in-context batching, combining a shared system prompt, a strict XML structural envelope, and an output correction layer to ensure deterministic, pipeline-ready feature extraction across multiple creatives simultaneously. We evaluate PromptPack via an offline retrieval benchmark using a downstream logistic-regression ranker. To deeply profile the agent's behavior, we measure AUC and introduce Volume-Weighted Absolute Lift (VWAL), a novel metric capturing the signal quality of the generated features. Compared to our live, unbatched production baseline, PromptPack at batch size 20 cuts our LLM costs by 89% and accelerates throughput by 2.5x while fully preserving AUC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PromptPack，一个可扩展的高通量LLM标注代理，通过上下文批量处理（in-context batching）降低在线推荐系统中广告创意特征提取的成本。PromptPack在保持AUC不变的前提下，将LLM成本降低89%，吞吐量提升2.5倍。
Motivation: 在线推荐平台使用LLM提取广告创意特征时，单次调用的成本高昂，其中94%的输入token来自冗余的系统指令，限制了规模化部署。
Method: PromptPack通过上下文批量处理，组合共享系统提示、严格XML结构封装和输出校正层，实现对多个创意同时进行确定性特征提取。
Result: 在离线检索基准测试中，PromptPack以20的批量大小将LLM成本降低89%，吞吐量提升2.5倍，同时完全保持AUC指标。
Conclusion: PromptPack有效解决了LLM标注代理在在线推荐场景中的成本瓶颈，为大规模特征提取提供高效方案。

papers.title: Evaluating and Guarding Citation Faithfulness in Agentic Scientific Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Agentic LLM systems such as OpenScholar and PaperQA2 read the scientific literature and return cited answers, and both they and their benchmarks already check whether those citations hold, with a fixed attribution model or human graders. Neither audits the reliability of that check itself. We show it is not reliable, and that this matters. On identical agent outputs the measured unsupported-citation rate ranges from about 3% to about 18% depending only on the verifier's strictness, and although verifiers agree on which citations are supported, they disagree on which to flag (negative-specific agreement 0.27 to 0.30), so no single flag set is trustworthy and cross-paper comparison is invalid without a named verifier and protocol. We present a gold-anchored evaluation protocol and a deployable guard that make this behavior measurable and bounded. The protocol validates the verifier, measures re-attribution, and calibrates a guarantee against human gold rather than another model's verdict; the verifier is a swappable instrument chosen on cost (recall 0.94 on the supported class, held out), and re-attribution is a commodity step where a deterministic BM25 matches the best open generator. The guard adds a split-conformal layer placing a distribution-free, finite-sample bound on truly unsupported citations that slip past a chosen flagging rule, a guarantee on catch rate rather than conclusion correctness. The bound holds on held-out gold, and we identify and quantify the condition governing its transfer to deployment, calibration-negative difficulty, with a concrete recalibration recipe, left untested by prior conformal-factuality work. Validated across four open 27-35B models and three agentic pipelines on public benchmarks (SciFact, QASA, PubMedQA), with confidence intervals on every headline number, the protocol and guard ship as an open single-GPU kit.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. Includes supplementary material (Appendices S1-S6). Open single-GPU reproducibility kit included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究智能体科学文献合成系统（如OpenScholar、PaperQA2）中的引用忠实性评估问题。发现现有验证器之间对同一输出的检测结果不一致，无支持的引用率从3%到18%不等，且负面特异性一致性低（0.27-0.30）。提出了基于人工标注的评估协议和可部署的防护机制，使用分裂共形预测对漏检的无支持引用提供分布自由的有限样本保证。在四个27-35B开源模型和三个基准上验证，置信区间完整。
Motivation: 现有智能体文献合成系统及其基准虽然检查引用的忠实性，但未审计验证器本身的可信度。不同验证器的严格程度导致测量结果差异巨大，无法进行跨论文比较。
Method: 提出一个基于人工标注的评估协议，包括验证器验证、重归因（re-attribution）和校准保证。防护机制采用分裂共形预测（split-conformal prediction），对漏检的无支持引用提供分布自由、有限样本的保证，并量化了校准困难性（calibration-negative difficulty）这个转移条件。
Result: 在相同输出上，不同验证器测量的无支持引用率差异显著（约3%到18%），且负面特异性一致性低（0.27-0.30）。所提协议和防护在SciFact、QASA、PubMedQA等基准上验证，召回率达0.94（支持类别）。
Conclusion: 该协议和防护机制使引用忠实性可测量、可保证，以开源单GPU工具包形式发布。提出了此前共形事实性工作未测试的重校准方案。

papers.title: ConfidenceBench: Evaluating Confidence Calibration in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where fluent but incorrect answers can be costly. In these settings, accuracy alone is insufficient: models must also know when they are likely to be wrong. We present ConfidenceBench, a calibration benchmark that evaluates verbalized confidence estimates in 15 frontier LLMs using the Brier score, a proper scoring rule that incentivises truthful probability reporting. Confidence is elicited via prompting, requiring no access to model logits and making the framework applicable to both closed-source and open-source systems. The benchmark comprises 200 private multiple-choice questions across four categories: spatial reasoning, high-precision mathematics, word lookup, and unknowable questions. Across three independent runs, Claude Opus 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview achieve the lowest Brier scores, both reported as 0.103. Both substantially outperform the calibrated-random baseline of 0.1875, while Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite scores 0.367, indicating severe miscalibration. Accuracy and calibration diverge substantially across model families: the most accurate model is not the best-calibrated, and several models perform worse than the calibrated-random Brier baseline despite reasonable accuracy. These results show that verbalized confidence calibration is a distinct and practically important axis of LLM reliability, complementary to standard accuracy-based evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ConfidenceBench，一个评估大语言模型（LLM）口头置信度校准的基准，使用Brier分数在15个前沿模型上测试。基准包含200道四类多选题（空间推理、高精度数学、单词查找、不可知问题），通过提示而非logits获取置信度。结果显示Claude Opus 4.6和Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview的Brier分数最低（0.103），大幅优于校准随机基线（0.1875），而Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite为0.367，表明严重失准。准确率与校准度在模型家族间存在显著分歧，最准确模型并非最优校准模型。
Motivation: LLM在生成流畅但错误回答的场景中代价高昂，仅依靠准确率不足以评估可靠性。需要评估模型是否知道自身可能出错的能力，即置信度校准，而现有评估大多依赖logits访问，不适用于封闭源模型。
Method: 提出ConfidenceBench基准，包含200道私有多选题，涵盖空间推理、高精度数学、单词查找和不可知问题四类。通过提示（prompting）获取模型口头置信度，使用Brier分数（proper scoring rule）衡量校准质量，无需访问模型logits，适用于开放和封闭源系统。
Result: 在15个前沿LLM上，Claude Opus 4.6和Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview的Brier分数均为0.103，超过校准随机基线0.1875；Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite得分为0.367，校准严重不足。多个模型虽准确率合理但Brier分数低于基线，表明校准与准确率是独立维度。
Conclusion: 口头置信度校准是LLM可靠性中一个独特且重要的维度，与标准准确率评估互补。现有模型在校准上表现差异大，需更多关注。

papers.title: Autonomous disproofs of the sum-product conjecture over $\mathbb R$ with GPT-5.5 Pro
papers.abstract_en: OpenAI's recent disproof of the Erdős unit distance conjecture marked a milestone for AI in mathematics. It also inspired another breakthrough: a human disproof of the Erdős--Szemerédi sum-product conjecture over $\mathbb R$. In this paper, we present a simple agent built on GPT-5.5 Pro. Using a problem-agnostic, three-stage prompting pipeline -- proof-plan proposal, proof construction, and review -- the agent autonomously generated correct proofs that the sum-product conjecture is false over $\mathbb R$ in 7 of 8 independent trials; in the remaining trial, it identified an unresolved gap in its argument. The seven proofs are diverse: some are close to existing unit-based constructions, while others avoid units by using $L^p$-type regions of algebraic integers. The system used an average of 132.4k reasoning tokens per trial. We release the code, intermediate outputs, and generated proofs, providing a reproducible, data-contamination-free case study in autonomous proof generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于GPT-5.5 Pro构建了一个简单代理，通过问题无关的三阶段提示流程（证明计划提议、证明构建、审查），在8次独立试验中7次自动生成了sum-product猜想在实数域上为假的正确证明，另一次识别了论证中的未解决漏洞。证明具有多样性，部分接近基于单位的构造，部分使用代数整数的L^p型区域避免单位。系统平均使用132.4k推理token。
Motivation: 受OpenAI对Erdős单位距离猜想的反驳启发，针对Erdős–Szemerédi sum-product猜想在实数域上的真实性，探索AI自动生成数学证明的能力。
Method: 基于GPT-5.5 Pro的问题无关三阶段提示流水线：proof-plan proposal（证明计划提议）、proof construction（证明构建）、review（审查）。
Result: 在8次独立试验中，7次生成了正确的sum-product猜想反例证明，1次识别出论证中的未解决漏洞。生成的证明具有多样性。
Conclusion: 提供了一个可复现的、无数据污染的自动证明生成案例，展示了基于大语言模型代理在数学猜想反证中的潜力。

papers.title: Attention Degradation, Function Token Anchoring, and the Limits of Attention-Based Intervention in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Mean cross-positional attention degradation is widely reported in transformer interpretability, yet whether it causally limits contextual retrieval remains untested. We present six coordinated experiments across GPT-2, LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, OPT-1.3B, and distilgpt2. We first characterise short-term (5-100 token) attention degradation, finding a universal exponential-then-plateau pattern whose rate is inversely correlated with depth, with distinct layer-wise entropy signatures per architecture. Function token anchoring proves architecture-dependent: OPT-1.3B (absolute positional encoding) shows distance-dependent preposition specificity, GPT-2 shows uniform non-specific dependence, and LLaMA (RoPE) shows reversal at long distances. Strategic comma insertion at clause boundaries causally reduces prediction degradation in the 40-80 token range, with the benefit tied to syntactic boundary alignment rather than token density. We then test the mechanism causally: Relay-Aware Attention (RAA), which biases attention logits toward function token positions, verifiably increases attention mass by 16-24% yet yields null effects on GPT-2 and LLaMA-1B, preliminary harm on LLaMA-3B, and a mixed effect on OPT-1.3B that nets to approximately zero. Multi-fact retrieval probes further show that degradation rate does not predict retrieval accuracy across models. We conclude that mean attention degradation is largely descriptive rather than prescriptive: function tokens contribute through what their hidden states compute, not through the attention they receive -- with implications for interpretability methodology and attention-score-based inference optimisations such as KV-cache eviction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过六个协调实验，系统研究了Transformer中平均跨位置注意力退化现象是否因果性地限制上下文检索。发现注意力退化呈指数-平台模式，速率与深度负相关，函数token锚定依赖架构（如OPT-1.3B对位置编码敏感，LLaMA在长距离反转）。因果干预（Relay-Aware Attention）虽增加注意力权重16-24%，但对预测性能无显著改进，表明注意力退化是描述性而非约束性。
Motivation: 平均跨位置注意力退化在可解释性中被广泛报道，但其是否因果性地限制上下文检索尚未被检验。
Method: 在GPT-2、LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B、OPT-1.3B和distilgpt2上执行六个实验，包括短程退化表征、函数token锚定分析、逗号插入干预、Relay-Aware Attention因果测试及多事实检索探测。

papers.title: Do Active SAE Feature Planes Carry More Holonomy? A Preregistered Reversal in Gemma
papers.abstract_en: This paper tests whether holonomy concentrates on active sparse-autoencoder (SAE) feature planes in Gemma 2 2B, a concrete operationalization of the broader semantic-concentration prediction. Holonomy is measured at the final-token layer-12 to layer-13 residual-stream readout by carrying a local frame around small loops using the instrument's restricted-Jacobian transport rule, then normalizing the resulting rotation by enclosed area. The design, materiality threshold, analysis, and verdict rules were preregistered and frozen before the analysed measurements were inspected. The prediction was falsified in reverse: active-feature planes carried less holonomy than matched mixed-feature controls, with an adjusted log contrast of -0.29439 and 95% interval [-0.43989, -0.14889]. A magnitude-only explanation was not supported in this design, while the three-way ordering across random, mixed-feature, and active-feature planes was undefined at matched magnitude because common support failed. Post-freeze diagnostics at the same readout supported the area law on a small validation subset, bounded matched-center displacement under a simple paired regression, and identified transport distortion as a live mechanism or confound. The result is therefore a narrow, auditable operational reversal, not a causal claim that meaning suppresses holonomy. The cause remains open, with activation-strength geometry, degree of feature engagement, dictionary geometry, matched-center displacement, activation-manifold proximity, and transport shear as live alternatives.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 5 figures. Preregistered confirmatory study; frozen experiment record archived at Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.20960027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文在 Gemma 2 2B 模型上预注册实验，检验活跃稀疏自编码器特征平面是否承载更多和乐性，结果相反：活跃特征平面比混合特征平面携带更少和乐性，调整后对数对比度为 -0.29439。作者强调这是窄的操作性反转，而非因果声明。
Motivation: 检验和乐性是否集中在活跃 SAE 特征平面上，作为语义集中预测的具体操作化。
Method: 在 Gemma 2 2B 的最终 token 层12到13残差流读取点，使用受限雅可比传输规则局部帧绕小环，归一化旋转面积测量和乐性。设计、阈值、分析和裁决规则均预注册。

papers.title: Generative Bayesian Filtering for State Estimation
papers.abstract_en: The state of a dynamic system evolves over time, switching among several latent modes that govern its observable behavior. Filtering methods infer the latent state from observations. Classical filtering approaches, including Kalman filters, typically rely on simple observation models, such as linear-Gaussian models, that are incapable of characterizing the increasingly nonlinear and heterogeneous patterns in high-dimensional sensor signals. To tackle the challenge, we propose Generative Bayesian Filtering (GBF), a filtering framework that replaces restrictive observation models with pretrained conditional generative models parametrized by conditional variational autoencoders (CVAE). For online inference, GBF performs a Bayesian prediction-update recursion in which the measurement update is formulated as a posterior sampling problem that combines the dynamical prior with the CVAE-induced likelihood. The resulting filtering problem is then transformed into a score-based sampling problem, which naturally inherits the flexibility from generative models and the uncertainty quantification capabilities from ensembling. Experiments on synthetic datasets and real-world applications involving manufacturing system monitoring and arrhythmia diagnosis demonstrate that GBF improves state estimation accuracy and robustness relative to baseline approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成贝叶斯滤波（GBF）框架，用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）代替传统滤波中的线性-高斯观测模型，将测量更新转化为后验采样问题，并通过基于分数的采样实现灵活的不确定性量化。在合成数据和实际应用（制造系统监测、心律失常诊断）中，GBF 相比基线方法提升了状态估计的准确性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 经典滤波方法（如卡尔曼滤波器）依赖线性-高斯观测模型，难以刻画高维传感器信号中的非线性和异质模式，限制了其在复杂动态系统中的应用。
Method: 提出生成贝叶斯滤波（GBF）：利用预训练的CVAE作为条件生成模型，将测量更新形式化为后验采样问题，并通过基于分数的采样求解，融合动力学先验和CVAE诱导的似然。
Result: 在合成数据和真实场景（制造系统监测、心律失常诊断）上，GBF 在状态估计精度和鲁棒性方面优于基线方法。
Conclusion: GBF 通过生成模型灵活表征观测分布，同时通过集成保持不确定性量化能力，为复杂动态系统滤波提供新范式。
Relevance: 0
