papers.title: Representation Robustness Under Executable Reasoning Constraints in Large Language Models for Mathematical Problem Solving
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated on mathematical problem solving, yet prior work often treats representationally equivalent formulations as interchangeable and conflates reasoning errors with interface failures. This paper investigates representation robustness in LLM-based mathematical problem solving by systematically varying surface representations of the same underlying problems, including story problems, word-equations, symbolic equations, and isomorphic paraphrases. Using a curated dataset of mathematically equivalent problems, we evaluate five contemporary LLMs under a direct answer generation condition. We find substantial representational sensitivity: models frequently change correctness across equivalent formulations, with nontrivial flip rates across story, symbolic, and word-equation variants. We also observe systematic regressions under isomorphic reformulations, showing that even subtle paraphrase-level changes can degrade performance despite preserved mathematical structure. We then evaluate a code-augmented condition in which models externalize reasoning as executable Python code that is run locally for validation. This interface reveals strong latent reasoning capability in some models that perform poorly under direct prompting, but it does not uniformly improve robustness. Instead, failures shift across interaction layers, from opaque reasoning errors to protocol violations and execution failures. Even when executable reasoning succeeds, representation sensitivity often persists. Overall, our results show that reasoning scaffolds do not eliminate representational brittleness, but expose new tradeoffs among correctness, reliability, latency, and cost. We argue that representation should be treated as a first-class interface design variable in LLM evaluation and deployment, especially for AI-assisted problem-solving systems.
papers.comment: presented at the 28th International Conference on Human-Computer Interaction (2026), Montreal, Canada
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型在数学问题求解中的表示鲁棒性。通过构造数学等价但表面形式不同的问题（故事题、文字方程、符号方程、同构改写），发现模型在不同表示间经常改变答案，且同构改写也会导致性能下降。代码增强推理虽能揭示部分模型的潜在能力，但并未消除表示脆弱性，而是将错误转移到协议违反和执行失败等新层面。
Motivation: 现有评估往往将表示等价的问题视为可互换，忽略了表面形式变化对模型正确性的影响；同时常将推理错误与界面失效混为一谈。需要系统探究表示变化带来的鲁棒性问题。
Method: 构建数学等价问题数据集，包含故事题、文字方程、符号方程及同构改写；在直接回答和代码增强（Python执行验证）两种条件下评估五个当代LLM。
Result: 模型在等价表示间频繁改变正确性，存在可观的正负翻转率；同构改写导致系统性性能退化。代码增强虽然能暴露一些模型潜在推理能力，但并未整体提升鲁棒性，反而引入新的错误类型（协议违反、执行失败）。
Conclusion: 推理脚手架不能消除表示脆弱性，而是在正确性、可靠性、延迟和成本之间产生新的权衡。表示应被视为评估和部署中的一阶接口设计变量。

papers.title: Adaptive Depth in Looped Transformers: Diagnosing Learned Halting Gates and Trajectory Readouts
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers increase test-time computation by repeatedly applying a shared recurrent block. Learned halting objectives in looped Transformers typically use a single exit distribution both as the inference-time stopping rule and as the training-time weighting of per-depth losses. This entangles exit selection with trajectory formation: the gate not only chooses which recurrent state to use, but also determines how strongly each intermediate state is supervised. Consequently, poor adaptive-compute performance can arise from the readout, the induced trajectory, or their interaction. We study adaptive depth in looped Transformers through this trajectory--readout lens, across controlled synthetic tasks (modular arithmetic and binary parity) and large-scale Ouro-1.4B and 2.6B checkpoints. We find that fixed-prior depth supervision, which shapes the trajectory without an input-dependent halting policy, produces difficulty-aware trajectories whose intermediate states expose useful stopping signals, and that simple post-hoc confidence readouts often match or outperform learned linear and MLP gates. Fitting gates on frozen trajectories localizes the failure: it appears to stem mainly from the trajectory induced by joint gate training rather than from limited gate expressivity. The same pattern is present in Ouro evaluations, where pretrained ponder gates are competitive but not uniformly Pareto-optimal, and measured latency confirms that the resulting reductions in average exit depth translate into practical inference-time savings. Our systematic diagnostic evaluation reframes adaptive depth in looped Transformers as a joint problem of trajectory formation and exit readout, rather than gate learning alone, highlighting a distinction that prior learned-halting work has often left implicit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过轨迹-读出视角研究循环Transformer中的自适应深度，发现固定先验深度监督能产生难度感知的轨迹，且事后置信度读出常优于学习到的门控。实验表明联合门训练导致的轨迹问题而非门表达力不足是主要失败原因，并在Ouro模型上验证了平均退出深度减少带来实际推理加速。
Motivation: 循环Transformer中学习到的门控同时用于推理停止规则和训练深度权重，导致退出选择与轨迹形成纠缠，难以诊断自适应计算性能差的根源。
Method: 提出轨迹-读出分析框架，在模块算术、二元奇偶性等合成任务及Ouro-1.4B/2.6B检查点上，比较固定先验深度监督与不同读出机制（线性、MLP、后验置信度），并通过冻结轨迹拟合门控来定位失败原因。
Result: 固定先验深度监督产生难度感知轨迹且后验置信度读出匹配或超越学习门控；联合门训练诱导的轨迹而非门表达力不足是主要瓶颈；Ouro评估中门控并非一致帕累托最优但平均深度减少带来实际加速。
Conclusion: 循环Transformer自适应深度应视为轨迹形成与退出读出的联合问题，而非单纯门学习，该区分在先前工作中常被隐含。

papers.title: CANN Bench: Benchmarking Agent Generated Kernels against Real NPU and Algorithmic Limits
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are now capable of writing, compiling, and iteratively optimizing low-level operator kernels on different hardware platforms. Existing benchmarks, however, focus almost exclusively on CUDA and Triton, leaving hardware ecosystems with less-exposed programming models without a common evaluation baseline. We present CANN Bench, an open benchmark for AI-generated operator code on Huawei's Ascend NPU. The current release covers 53 operators and 1060 test cases organized into four difficulty tiers -- from simple elementwise primitives to MoE dispatch and FlashAttention kernels -- spanning FP16, BF16, FP32, and INT8 precision formats. Evaluation adopts a \textbf{three-dimensional weighted composite score} that treats compilation, functional correctness, and performance as independent axes, providing a principled reward signal for kernel-generation agents. Performance is graded against an out-of-the-box PyTorch-on-Ascend baseline and an analytical per-case Hardware-Anchored Performance (HAP) limit on real NPU hardware, ensuring scores reflect genuine optimization headroom rather than measurement artifacts. The evaluation harness is designed to resist reward hacking from the ground up. CANN Bench is versioned within the official CANN repository and is designed for long-term community co-construction, providing the Ascend ecosystem with a quantitative, reproducible, and sustainably maintained yardstick for AI operator-authoring capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍CANN Bench，一个针对华为Ascend NPU上AI生成算子代码的开放基准测试，涵盖53个算子、1060个测试用例，采用三维加权综合评分（编译、功能正确性、性能），并与PyTorch-on-Ascend基线和硬件锚定性能上限（HAP）对比。旨在为Ascend生态提供可重复的算子编写能力度量。
Motivation: 现有基准主要聚焦CUDA和Triton，缺乏对华为Ascend等非CUDA生态的统一评估标准，导致AI代理在不同硬件上的算子生成能力难以比较。
Method: 构建包含53个算子、1060个测试用例的基准，按难度分四层，支持多种精度。评估采用三维加权综合分数，并引入基于真实NPU硬件的硬件锚定性能上限（HAP）作为性能评估参考。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但框架设计能反映真实优化空间，并防止奖励黑客攻击。
Conclusion: 基准已版本化纳入官方CANN仓库，旨在长期社区共建，为Ascend生态提供可量化、可复现、可持续维护的AI算子编写能力度量标准。

summary_sections.method: 构建包含53个算子、1060个测试用例的基准，按难度分四层，支持多种精度。评估采用三维加权综合分数，并引入基于真实NPU硬件的硬件锚定性能上限（HAP）作为性能评估参考。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但框架设计能反映真实优化空间，并防止奖励黑客攻击。

papers.title: Multimodal CoLRAG-TF: Triple-Filtered Retrieval for Complex PDFs
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over heterogeneous PDF collections remains challenging due to multimodal content, domain-specific terminology, and the need for multi-hop reasoning across dispersed evidence. We present Multimodal CoLRAG-TF, a four-axis fusion architecture that integrates dense text embeddings, BM25 keyword matching, knowledge-graph triple filtering, and image-based similarity for robust retrieval over complex documents. Our system constructs a multimodal index of 2,403 blocks extracted from 43 Japanese disaster lesson PDFs, supported by a hybrid OCR pipeline and LLM-based caption generation. To enhance compositional reasoning, we extract 11,414 OpenIE triples and index them with FAISS, enabling sub-second triple lookup and hierarchical propagation of relevance signals. A HippoRAG2-inspired coarse-to-fine retriever (volume $\to$ chapter $\to$ block) narrows the search space before final fusion scoring. Bayesian optimization over fusion weights reveals that the triple axis must dominate ($α_\text{triple} = 0.44$) to counteract lexical bias and sustain multi-hop retrieval quality. Evaluated on a 457-pair benchmark, Multimodal CoLRAG-TF achieves a Retrieval Recall of 0.9909 and a 71.6$\%$ improvement in multi-hop answer similarity over single-hop queries. An image-to-lesson pipeline using a vision LLM further demonstrates the applicability of the approach to visual inputs. These results show that triple-filtered multimodal fusion is essential for structured reasoning over noisy, heterogeneous PDFs and provides a general framework applicable beyond the disaster domain.

Motivation: 异质PDF集合（如灾害文档）中的多模态内容、领域专有术语和多跳推理需求使得现有RAG方法面临挑战。
Method: 提出四轴融合架构，集成密集文本嵌入、BM25、知识图谱三元组过滤和图像相似度；采用HippoRAG2启发的粗到细检索（卷→章→块），并通过贝叶斯优化确定融合权重（三元组轴权重0.44）。

papers.title: Scaling Closed-Loop Feature Channel Configuration with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Promising initial results in closed-loop large-language-model-based channel-configuration search demonstrated that neural-network widths can be optimized directly through executable code generation and accuracy feedback. However, those results were obtained from a relatively sparse set of valid evaluations, leaving open whether the observed optimization behavior transfers to a denser sampling regime and whether additional architectural regularities emerge when more generated networks are evaluated. To test this, the same search setting is scaled to 250 candidate networks per fine-tuning cycle. The analysis covers 2000 generated candidates from 8 complete cycles, yielding 462 verified CIFAR-100 evaluations after task and metadata filtering. Per-cycle mean accuracy exhibits a positive linear trend with slope 9.87e-4 (p=0.043), while the high-performing frontier improves more strongly: the best observed accuracy increases from 0.3144 to 0.3676, and both the top-5 and top-10 cycle-level means exhibit positive trends. The scaled run also reveals improved parameter efficiency. The best model reaches 0.3676 with 11.8M parameters, compared with an early high-performing model at 0.3144 with 166.5M parameters. Beyond accuracy, the larger sample exposes architectural regularities that were difficult to assess from sparse observations. Non-power-of-two channel widths occur in 41.8% of verified candidates, and the strongest models share structured channel-allocation patterns characterized by moderate early widths and expanded middle or later blocks. These findings indicate that the channel-search signal observed in the initial study transfers

TL;DR: 本文在闭环大语言模型（LLM）通道配置搜索中，将每轮微调的候选网络数扩展到250个，共8轮产生2000个候选，经筛选得到462个CIFAR-100验证结果。每轮平均准确率呈正线性趋势（斜率9.87e-4, p=0.043），最佳准确率从0.3144提升至0.3676，且参数效率显著改善（最佳模型11.8M参数达0.3676，早期最佳模型166.5M参数仅0.3144）。大规模采样还揭示了架构规律：41.8%的候选使用非2的幂次通道宽度，最强模型具有适中的早期宽度和扩大的中间或后期块的通道分配模式。
Motivation: 此前基于LLM的闭环通道配置搜索仅基于稀疏有效评估，观察到的优化行为是否适用于更密集的采样以及是否出现额外架构规律尚不清楚。
Method: 将相同搜索设置扩展到每轮微调250个候选网络，共8轮，产生2000个候选，经任务和元数据过滤后获得462个CIFAR-100验证评估。
Result: 每轮平均准确率呈正线性趋势（斜率9.87e-4, p=0.043）；最佳准确率从0.3144提升至0.3676；参数效率提升（最佳模型11.8M vs 早期166.5M）；41.8%的候选使用非2的幂次通道宽度；最强模型具有适中的早期宽度和扩大的中间或后期块的通道分配模式。
Conclusion: 结果表明初始研究中的通道搜索信号在密集采样下仍成立，大规模采样揭示了更多架构规律，支持该方法的有效性。

papers.title: Reliability-Aware LLM Alignment from Inconsistent Human Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is critical for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, its efficacy is often compromised by the inherent inconsistency and subjectivity of human annotations. Existing preference optimization frameworks, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), typically treat ambiguous pairs with high annotator disagreement identically to those with unanimous consensus, forcing models to overfit to inconsistent supervision signals and leading to suboptimal alignment. In this work, we propose Reliability-Guided Preference Optimization (RGPO), a robust framework designed to mitigate the impact of inconsistent human feedback. RGPO estimates annotator reliability and infers latent ground truth labels from noisy human feedback to identify robust preferences. Furthermore, we introduce a reliability-aware consistency optimization that dynamically modulates the training objective based on the consensus level of annotations, ensuring the model prioritizes high-consensus supervision signals. Extensive experiments on LLM alignment benchmarks demonstrate that RGPO effectively reduces inconsistency and noise in training data and achieves superior performance compared to widely adopted RLHF baselines. Our code and configurations are available at https://github.com/GenieHuang/RGPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人类反馈中的不一致性和主观性，提出可靠性引导的偏好优化（RGPO）框架，通过估计标注者可靠性并推断潜在真实标签来识别稳健偏好，并引入可靠性感知的一致性优化动态调整训练目标。实验表明RGPO在LLM对齐基准上优于现有RLHF基线。
Motivation: 现有RLHF方法（如DPO）将存在标注者分歧的模糊对与一致同意的对同等对待，导致模型过拟合不一致信号，对齐效果次优。
Method: 提出RGPO框架，包括估计标注者可靠性并从噪声反馈中推断潜在真实标签以识别稳健偏好，以及可靠性感知的一致性优化动态调整训练目标，使模型优先学习高共识信号。
Result: 在LLM对齐基准上的实验表明，RGPO有效减少训练数据中的不一致性和噪声，性能优于广泛采用的RLHF基线。
Conclusion: RGPO通过显式建模标注者可靠性和共识水平，能够缓解不一致人类反馈的负面影响，提升对齐效果。

papers.title: The Active Ingredient in Muon's Grokking
papers.abstract_en: The Muon optimizer reaches the grokking threshold on modular arithmetic faster than AdamW. Prior work attributes this to "spectral-norm constraints plus orthogonalized momentum" but does not isolate which mechanism matters. To better understand Moun's behavior, we run multi-seed and multi-learning-rate sweeps to decompose and stress-test the effect. First, an ablation shows the speedup comes from orthogonalization (the Newton-Schulz iteration): orthogonalize-only matches full Muon, whereas spectral-only is no faster than AdamW and is unreliable, and this verdict holds across learning rates. Second, a mechanistic analysis finds that orthogonalizing optimizers reach generalization at roughly 3x lower spectral norm and, controlling for how much the embedding actually moves, settle into a lower-norm solution rather than simply perturbing the embedding less. Third, reducing the Newton-Schulz iteration count from five to one accelerates reaching the threshold but makes the grokked solution fragile, prone to transient collapse, with fragility that grows with learning rate; a single iteration is fast and stable only at small learning rate, while the canonical five iterations are the learning-rate-robust choice. We also show spectral scaling can be dropped at no measured cost. A methodological thread runs throughout: under a stability-aware metric, "faster" claims about grokking optimizers can invert, so we report both first-crossing and sustained-grok times. To support reproducibility, we release our full training and analysis code at https://github.com/louiswang524/muon-grokking-frontier
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过消融实验和机制分析，揭示了Muon优化器在模算术任务上比AdamW更快达到grokking的关键成分是正交化（Newton-Schulz迭代），而非谱范数约束。正交化优化器在约3倍低的谱范数下达到泛化，减少迭代次数可加速但导致解脆弱，五次迭代是学习率鲁棒的选择。作者提出稳定性感知度量，并发布代码。
Motivation: 先前工作将Muon的加速归因于谱范数约束加正交化动量，但未隔离哪个机制关键，本文旨在分解并理解其核心机制。
Method: 进行多种子多学习率扫描，通过消融（orthogonalize-only vs spectral-only）和机制分析（比较谱范数、嵌入移动量）及Newton-Schulz迭代次数研究来分解效果。
Result: 正交化单独匹配完整Muon，谱范数约束不比AdamW快且不可靠；正交化优化器在约3倍低谱范数下泛化；减少迭代次数加速但解脆弱，脆弱性随学习率增大；单次迭代仅在小学习率稳定，五次迭代鲁棒；谱缩放可丢弃。
Conclusion: 在稳定性感知度量下，'更快'的声称可能反转，因此报告首次跨越和持续grok时间。代码开源。

papers.title: SiGMA: Sign-Guided Merging and Adaptation for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) is crucial for adapting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to evolving a sequence of downstream tasks. Prior methods mostly utilize Mixture of Experts or expansion merge approach, primarily focusing on catastrophic forgetting, yet they still suffer from negative interference during inference, where newly learned updates overwrite useful prior knowledge and degrade overall performance. To address this, we propose SiGMA (Sign Guided Merging and Adaptation), a simple yet effective framework that mitigates negative interference with two components: sign guided adaptive tuning during training and sign guided merging at inference. Sign guided adaptive tuning reduces collisions with past knowledge and learns the current task with minimal drift, mitigating severe forgetting. Sign guided merging further improves consolidation by selectively scaling salient parameters to preserve and amplify useful task specific knowledge. Experiments on UCIT and DCL benchmarks show that SiGMA significantly reduces negative interference and outperforms state of the art MCIT methods. Our code is available at SiGMA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SiGMA 框架，通过符号引导的适应（训练）和符号引导的合并（推理）来缓解多模态持续指令微调中的负干扰问题。在 UCIT 和 DCL 基准上，该方法显著减少了负干扰并超越了现有 MCIT 方法。
Motivation: 现有 MCIT 方法主要利用混合专家或扩展合并策略来缓解灾难性遗忘，但在推理时仍存在负干扰，即新学习到的更新会覆盖有用的先验知识，降低整体性能。
Method: SiGMA 包含两个组件：训练阶段的符号引导自适应调优（减少与过去知识的冲突，以最小漂移学习当前任务）和推理阶段的符号引导合并（通过选择性缩放显著参数来保留和放大有用的任务特定知识）。
Result: 在 UCIT 和 DCL 基准上，SiGMA 显著减少了负干扰，并取得了优于现有最先进 MCIT 方法的性能。
Conclusion: 符号引导的方法能有效缓解多模态持续指令微调中的负干扰问题，为相关领域提供了简单有效的框架。

papers.title: Telco-GAIA: Bilingual Benchmark for Agents in Telecom Domain
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Telco-GAIA, a bilingual, multi-modal benchmark for evaluating tool-using agents on the data of a real-world telecommunications operator. Telco-GAIA comprises 100 human-verified question-answering tasks, in English and Arabic, that each demand multi-hop reasoning (4.2 hops on average) over three heterogeneous sources: a static website snapshot (HTML, images, and linked PDFs), a synthetic relational SQL database, and external web archives, spanning text, image, and tabular modalities. The benchmark is delivered as a sandboxed Docker environment and scored by normalized exact string matching, making evaluation objective, deterministic, and reproducible over time without any LLM-as-a-Judge. Evaluating a purpose-built reference agent across twelve commercial and open LLMs, we find Telco-GAIA challenging: even the strongest model solves only 71% of tasks; under a moderate cost budget, this falls to about 40%, and the visually grounded categories remain the weakest, where the average backend scores below 30%, leaving substantial headroom in document and image understanding. Telco-GAIA offers a rigorous, reproducible testbed for enterprise agents and a template for constructing closed-domain benchmarks.

papers.title: MiniCache: Reusable Program Caching with Small Model Interfaces for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for program-aided reasoning, agentic decision making, and structured task execution, but these applications often incur high inference cost. We present MiniCache, a reusable program caching framework that transforms Program-of-Thought (PoT) programs into parameterized cache objects, enabling reusable computation across structurally similar requests. MiniCache reuses the same small model for semantic variable extraction on cache-hit requests and speculative drafting during target-LLM generation, reducing expensive target-LLM invocations while preserving task quality. Experiments on shopping-style request datasets, WebShop, Formula, and CodeTAT-QA demonstrate that MiniCache improves the trade-off between inference latency, cache reuse, and accuracy, achieving up to 3.1x lower latency and 2.8x higher throughput under parallel serving. These results show that small models are most effective not as replacements for large models, but as lightweight interface models that enable reliable and efficient reusable program caching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiniCache 是一个可重用程序缓存框架，将 Program-of-Thought (PoT) 程序转化为参数化缓存对象，在结构相似的请求间复用计算。它使用同一小模型进行缓存命中的语义变量提取和目标 LLM 生成时的推测草稿，减少昂贵的目标 LLM 调用，同时保持任务质量。实验在购物类请求数据集、WebShop、Formula 和 CodeTAT-QA 上显示，MiniCache 改进了推理延迟、缓存复用和准确率之间的权衡，在并行服务下实现了高达 3.1 倍的延迟降低和 2.8 倍的吞吐量提升。
Motivation: LLM 用于程序辅助推理、智能体决策和结构化任务时推理成本高昂，现有方法未能有效利用程序结构中的可复用计算。
Method: 将 PoT 程序转化为参数化缓存对象，使用同一小模型同时处理缓存命中时的语义变量提取和目标生成时的推测草稿，实现可重用程序缓存。
Result: 在多个基准上实现高达 3.1 倍延迟降低和 2.8 倍吞吐量提升，且不牺牲任务质量。
Conclusion: 小模型最有效的用途不是替代大模型，而是作为轻量级接口模型，实现可靠高效的可重用程序缓存。

papers.title: Optimizing Hypergraph-Based RAG: Toward Better Fact Extraction and Chunk Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: GraphRAG enables deeper reasoning by structuring knowledge as graphs but struggles with n-ary facts. HyperGraphRAG uses hypergraphs for richer semantics, improving accuracy, yet relies on error-prone LLM extraction and inefficient standard chunk retrieval. We address this by employing self-consistency prompting to improve the extraction, and Personalized PageRank algorithm over hypergraph to enhance chunk retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 GraphRAG 在处理 n-ary 事实时的不足，提出基于超图（Hypergraph）的 RAG 方法 HyperGraphRAG。通过自一致性提示（self-consistency prompting）改进 LLM 的事实提取，并利用超图上的个性化 PageRank 算法增强块检索（chunk retrieval），以提升准确性。
Motivation: GraphRAG 将知识组织为图结构，但难以处理多元事实（n-ary facts）；HyperGraphRAG 虽使用超图丰富语义，但依赖错误的 LLM 提取和低效的标准块检索。
Method: 采用自一致性提示（self-consistency prompting）提高事实提取的可靠性，并引入超图上的个性化 PageRank（Personalized PageRank）算法优化块检索。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的定量结果，仅声称方法提升了事实提取和块检索的效果。
Conclusion: HyperGraphRAG 通过结合自一致性提示和超图上的个性化 PageRank，能够在知识密集型任务中实现更准确的事实提取与检索。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HERMES: Heterogeneous Edge-Relational Multi-Head Embedded SSM Attention for Traffic Conflict Prediction at Signalized Intersections
papers.abstract_en: Surrogate safety measures (SSMs) enable proactive traffic safety assessment, but many existing methods evaluate pairwise interactions independently or flatten multi-agent scenes into fixed feature vectors, limiting their ability to represent heterogeneous interaction structure and evolving scene-level risk. This study formulates traffic conflict assessment as temporal heterogeneous scene-graph classification and proposes HERMES, a heterogeneous edge-relational graph neural network with SSM-informed multi-head attention. Vehicles and pedestrians are represented as heterogeneous nodes, while vehicle-vehicle, vehicle-pedestrian, and pedestrian-pedestrian interactions are encoded as relation-specific edges with continuous kinematic and surrogate-safety descriptors. Relation-specific attention, dynamic node-edge updates, safety-aware graph pooling, and temporal sequence learning are jointly used to estimate scene-level conflict probability. HERMES was evaluated using 109,028 trajectory-derived sequences from a signalized urban intersection and tested on an independently collected comparable intersection dataset. Enhanced HERMES achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.9898 +/- 0.0013, an AUC-PR of 0.9412 +/- 0.0067, and an F1 score of 0.8449 +/- 0.0103. At a 5% false-alarm rate, it detected 95.7% of conflict sequences, outperforming the strongest Transformer baseline and XGBoost. In zero-shot external evaluation, HERMES achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.9752 and an AUC-PR of 0.7829. Joint source-target training further improved target-site performance with limited target-site data. These findings show that preserving heterogeneous interaction topology, safety-informed edge semantics, and short-term temporal evolution improves scene-level conflict classification and supports transferable roadside safety monitoring at signalized intersections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HERMES，一种异质边关系图神经网络用于信号交叉口的交通冲突预测。将冲突评估建模为时间异质场景图分类，使用关系特定边、SSM感知多头注意力、动态节点边更新和安全感知图池化等模块。在109,028条轨迹序列上评估，增强版HERMES达到AUC-ROC 0.9898，AUC-PR 0.9412，F1 0.8449，在5%误报率下检测出95.7%的冲突序列，优于Transformer和XGBoost。零样本迁移测试也表现良好。
Motivation: 现有交通安全评估方法多独立评估配对交互或将多智能体场景扁平化为固定特征向量，无法充分表示异质交互结构和场景级风险的动态演化。
Method: 提出HERMES，一种异质边关系图神经网络，集成SSM感知的多头注意力。包含关系特定注意力、动态节点-边更新、安全感知图池化和时序学习，共同估计场景级冲突概率。
Result: 在信号交叉口数据集上，增强HERMES的AUC-ROC达0.9898±0.0013，AUC-PR达0.9412±0.0067，F1得分0.8449±0.0103；5%误报率下检测95.7%冲突序列，优于Transformer和XGBoost。零样本外部评估AUC-ROC为0.9752，AUC-PR为0.7829。
Conclusion: 保留异质交互拓扑、安全感知边语义和短期时间演化可提升场景级冲突分类性能，并支持可迁移的路边安全监测。

papers.title: LeanFlow: A Case Study in Workflow-Driven Lean Autoformalization
papers.abstract_en: We present and evaluate LeanFlow, an LLM agent system specialized for translating mathematical papers into buildable Lean projects. Recent verifier-in-the-loop systems show that large formal artifacts can be produced, but it remains unclear which runtime mechanisms affect completion, auditability, or efficiency in document-to-project formalization. We study this question through case studies on two previously unformalized mathematical papers in number theory and measure theory, using model, proof-workflow, and toolset ablations with Kimi2.6 and GPT5.5; we report task outcome, API calls, input tokens, and output tokens. With Kimi2.6, the full workflow completes both document-level projects within the 2000-call budget, while no-queue variants reach the budget limit; with GPT5.5, all document-level variants complete, and the full workflow has the lowest or tied-lowest input-token cost on both sources. As complementary calibration, LeanFlow reaches 75.7% BEq+ on the PFR slice of RLM25 and solves all five ICML 2026 AI for Math TCS challenge projects in our GPT5.5 runs.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, ICML 2026: AI for Math Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了LeanFlow，一个专门用于将数学论文自动形式化为可构建Lean项目的LLM代理系统。通过两篇未形式化的数论和测度论论文案例研究，使用Kimi2.6和GPT5.5进行模型、证明工作流和工具集的消融实验，报告了任务完成情况、API调用和token消耗。结果表明，完整工作流能在预算内完成项目，且GPT5.5变体输入成本最低；此外，LeanFlow在RLM25的PFR切片上达到75.7%的BEq+，并解决了所有五个ICML 2026 AI for Math TCS挑战项目。
Motivation: 现有验证器在环系统虽能产生大型形式化产物，但文档到项目的自动形式化中，哪些运行时机制影响完成、可审计性或效率尚不明确。
Method: 提出LeanFlow，一种工作流驱动的自动形式化系统，包含队列管理、错误恢复等机制，并通过Kimi2.6和GPT5.5的消融实验（含无队列变体）评估其效果。
Result: 在数论和测度论论文上，Kimi2.6完整工作流在2000次调用预算内完成项目，无队列变体超限；GPT5.5所有变体完成，且完整工作流输入token成本最低或并列最低。此外，LeanFlow在RLM25的PFR切片上达到75.7% BEq+，并解决所有五个ICML挑战项目。
Conclusion: 摘要表明工作流驱动的自动形式化方法能够高效完成完整数学文档的形式化，且不同模型和机制对成本和成功率有显著影响。

papers.title: Inducing Comparability of Factorised Probability Distributions
papers.abstract_en: To allow for principled comparison between two probabilistic graphical models defined over non-identical variable sets, they have to be lifted to a common measurable space. To this end, we propose an extension scheme for any two given models and establish the formal foundation: Unmatched components are completed using conditionally uniform (Laplace) extensions such that the resulting joint distributions differ from the original ones only by multiplicative constants and coincide under projection. This preserves the probabilistic semantics while enabling the application of well-defined distributional discrepancy measures. We establish the invariance of the induced joint under projection and use the extensions to provide a minimal structural extension of two factor graphs to the smalles common measurable space as well as to a common graphical structure by a deterministic algorithm. In addition, we discuss structural and measure-theoretic properties and identify promising criteria for comparison methodologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种扩展方案，使得两个定义在不同变量集上的概率图模型可被提升到公共可测空间，从而进行有原则的比较。通过条件均匀扩展完成不匹配组件，保持概率语义，并允许应用分布差异度量。
Motivation: 现有概率图模型比较方法要求模型定义在相同变量集上，限制了跨不同变量集模型的直接比较。
Method: 提出条件均匀扩展方案，将两个模型扩展至公共可测空间，保证投影一致且仅差乘法常数。给出确定性算法将两个因子图扩展为最小公共图结构。
Result: 建立扩展后联合分布在投影下的不变性，提供最小公共可测空间和公共图结构的构造方法。
Conclusion: 该扩展为不同变量集上的概率图模型比较提供了理论基础，可推广至多种分布差异度量。

papers.title: MKEvolve: A Modular Multi-Agent Framework for Kernel Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in LLM-based code generation, writing correct and performant kernels for hardware accelerators remains a key bottleneck in scaling modern ML workloads. We present MKEvolve (Modular Kernel Evolve), a framework that iteratively co-evolves a modular decomposition of complex PyTorch modules and the LLM-generated kernel for each submodule, refining the decomposition by splitting and fusing across iterations while independently improving each subkernel via LLM-driven beam search. The resulting kernels are programmatic compositions of independently verified subkernels, making them configurable (subkernel implementations are swappable), interpretable (errors and speedups are traceable to specific subkernels), and readily adaptable to related model architectures. Experiments with Triton on KernelBench L2 and L3, spanning multi-operator sequences and full model architectures, show that MKEvolve improves both correctness and speedup over end-to-end direct synthesis baselines while reducing LLM token usage by up to 35%.

papers.title: FlowEdit: Information-Theoretic Control of LLM Reasoning Flows for Ill-posed Problems Involving Conflicts
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly on well-specified reasoning tasks with a feasible answer. However, problems encountered in the open world can become ill-posed due to inconsistent conditions, conflicting statements, or mutually incompatible requirements, admitting no valid responses. We argue that reasoning of such ill-posed problems involving conflicts require novel LLM capabilities to make hidden conflicts explicit, maintain competing hypotheses via multiple reasoning branches, and generate alternative responses in a single pass, all of which are challenging due to the limitation of the next-token prediction mechanism in LLMs. To this end, we propose FlowEdit, a novel framework that leverages information-theoretic principles to quantify and regulate internal reasoning flows of LLMs, for generating a full set of alternative responses under valid hypotheses. FlowEdit can be viewed as enforcing a branch-aware reasoning process using two dual information-theoretic objectives on the model's internal reasoning representations: maximizing the information flow from each selected hypothesis to the branch outcome, while minimizing the overlap and conditional dependence across sibling branches, to provide a diverse, informative set of responses with broad coverage. We show that this is achieved through tractable variational bounds under boundary embeddings being ε-sufficient, optimizing the underlying conditional mutual information in LLM reasoning process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlowEdit outperforms leading proprietary models, improving exact-set-match accuracy by 68%, while boosting overall response informativeness by 24%. We further show that flow regulation surfaces in the token stream as a redistribution of next-token entropy that concentrates inside each branch, amplifies at flow boundaries, and scales with the number of flows the problem requires.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowEdit框架，利用信息论原理量化并调控大型语言模型（LLM）的内部推理流，以处理因不一致条件、冲突陈述或不兼容要求而导致的病态问题（ill-posed problems）。该框架通过最大化选定假设到分支结果的信息流，同时最小化姐妹分支间的重叠和条件依赖，生成一组多样化的备选响应。实验表明，FlowEdit在精确集合匹配准确率上提升68%，响应信息量提升24%。
Motivation: 现有LLM在解决包含冲突的病态问题时能力不足，因为这类问题需要显化隐藏冲突、通过多个推理分支维持竞争假设并一次性生成备选响应，而LLM的下一词元预测机制限制了这一能力。
Method: 提出FlowEdit框架，基于两个对偶的信息论目标：最大化选定假设到分支结果的信息流（Maximizing Information Flow），同时最小化姐妹分支间的重叠和条件依赖（Minimizing Overlap and Conditional Dependence）。通过边界嵌入的ε-充分性下的可计算变分界来优化推理过程中的条件互信息。
Result: 广泛实验显示，FlowEdit超越了领先的专有模型，精确集合匹配准确率提升68%，响应信息量提升24%。流调节表现为下一词元熵的重新分布：熵集中在每个分支内部，在流边界处放大，并随所需流数量增加而缩放。
Conclusion: FlowEdit通过信息论调控LLM推理流，有效处理冲突病态问题，生成多样且覆盖度高的备选响应。实验验证了其性能优势，并揭示了词元熵的动态变化规律。

papers.title: ExecuGraph: A Multi-Agent, Execution-Grounded Framework for Reliable Backend Code Synthesis with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models generate plausible backend code, but a single-pass paradigm provides no guarantee of correctness or runtime reliability. We present ExecuGraph, a multi-agent framework that places execution-based validation at the center of backend code synthesis. Six specialized agents (Planner, Code Generator, Logical Reviewer, Evaluator, Optimizer, and Explainer) are coordinated by a typed directed workflow with a bounded retry budget, implemented on LangGraph with locally hosted models (Ollama) and an optional retrieval layer for algorithmic technique recall. A subprocess-isolated sandbox with a wall-clock timeout guards every evaluation. We evaluate on a curated 30-problem DSA suite (internal-30), HumanEval (n=64), and an APPS-introductory subset, contrasting ExecuGraph against a single-agent one-shot baseline and a single-agent execution-retry baseline (a Reflexion-style ablation that isolates the contribution of multi-agent decomposition). On internal-30, the three conditions are statistically indistinguishable (n=30; paired Wilcoxon p=0.59 MF vs. SO, p=0.08 SR vs. SO); 95% bootstrap confidence intervals on all pairwise mean differences include zero. On HumanEval, multi-full edges ahead by +3.1 pp. The strongest signal is cross-model: with DeepSeekCoder V2 Lite, graph-category accuracy improves from 57.5% (oneshot) to 80.0% (multi-full), a +22.5 pp jump that supports a scaling hypothesis: the value of multi-agent decomposition grows with base-model capability. The framework's primary contribution is methodological: a single codebase that collapses by configuration into one-shot, execution-retry, and per-agent ablation conditions, enabling controlled measurement of each lever's marginal contribution. A per-agent ablation, retry-budget sweep, error-class taxonomy, and test-source audit are reported.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ExecuGraph是一个基于执行验证的多智能体框架，用于可靠的后端代码合成。它协调六个专用代理（规划器、代码生成器、逻辑审查器、评估器、优化器和解释器），通过有界重试预算的类型化有向工作流进行协作，并使用LangGraph框架实现。在内部30题DSA套件上，多智能体方法与单智能体基线无显著差异；在HumanEval上多智能体方法领先+3.1个百分点。使用DeepSeekCoder V2 Lite时，准确率从57.5%（单次）提升至80.0%（多智能体满配置），提升22.5个百分点。
Motivation: 大语言模型生成的后端代码缺乏正确性和运行时可靠性保证，单次生成范式无法确保代码质量。
Method: 提出ExecuGraph框架，包含六个专用代理（Planner, Code Generator, Logical Reviewer, Evaluator, Optimizer, Explainer），通过类型化有向工作流协调，具有有界重试预算。在LangGraph上实现，使用本地托管模型（Ollama）和可选的检索层。评估在子进程隔离沙箱中进行，设有墙钟超时。
Result: 在内部30题DSA套件上，多智能体方法与单智能体基线和带执行重试的基线无显著统计差异。在HumanEval上，多智能体方法领先+3.1个百分点。跨模型对比中，使用DeepSeekCoder V2 Lite时，多智能体方法准确率从57.5%提升至80.0%（+22.5个百分点）。
Conclusion: 框架的主要贡献是方法论上的：提供单一代码库，可通过配置切换为单次、执行重试和逐代理消融条件，从而控制测量每个杠杆的边际贡献。还报告了逐代理消融、重试预算扫描、错误分类学和测试源审计。

papers.title: AISE-Bench: A Full-Cycle Curated Benchmark for Information Seeking on Academic Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) augmented with tools are emerging as autonomous agents capable of using Web engine, APIs, and code to solve complex, long-horizon tasks. Current tool-using benchmarks for information seeking on academic graphs rely on synthetic templates, simplified solution spaces, or narrow tasks such as paper-centric tasks, leaving key challenges underexplored - realistic user intent, complex multi-step API planning, rich parameter filling for APIs, grounded answers with references, and comprehensive evaluation of both the process and the outcome. We introduce AISE-Bench, a real-world, full-cycle annotated benchmark for information seeking on academic knowledge graphs. AISE-Bench release contains 1,133 QA pairs, including query taxonomies, full API execution trajectories, validated parameters, and source-grounded answers with reference links. To support high-quality annotation, we design a customized agent workflow to enable annotators to plan, execute, and revise complex API workflows efficiently. We develop a comprehensive evaluation protocol measuring answer quality, reference grounding, API-planning correctness, and execution success. Among the 14 evaluated methods, even the strongest model (PLAY2PROMPT with Gemini-3-Pro) achieves only moderate performance and often struggles with API planning and execution. AISE-Bench establishes a challenging new testbed for quantitatively evaluating and improving the stepwise correctness, grounded summarization, and traceable reasoning of multi-step API-using LLM agents. Our code and data are available at https://aise-bench.github.io/.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD '26), August 09-13, 2026, Jeju Island, Republic of Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AISE-Bench，一个针对学术知识图谱信息检索的真实世界全周期标注基准，包含1133个QA对，提供查询分类、API执行轨迹、验证参数和参考答案。对14种方法评估表明，即使最强模型性能也仅为中等，尤其在API规划与执行方面存在挑战。基准旨在评估多步API调用LLM代理的逐步正确性、有依据的摘要和可追踪推理。
Motivation: 现有学术图谱信息检索基准依赖合成模板、简化解空间或狭窄任务，无法覆盖真实用户意图、复杂多步API规划、丰富参数填充、带参考文献的答案以及过程和结果的全面评估。
Method: 设计定制化代理工作流，使标注者能高效规划、执行和修改复杂API工作流。开发综合评估协议，衡量答案质量、参考依据、API规划正确性和执行成功率。
Result: 14种评估方法中，最强模型PLAY2PROMPT with Gemini-3-Pro仅达到中等性能，在API规划和执行上常遇到困难。
Conclusion: AISE-Bench为多步API使用LLM代理的逐步正确性、有依据的总结和可追踪推理提供了具有挑战性的新测试平台。

papers.title: From Errors to Rules: Iterative Prompt Optimization for Text Classification
papers.abstract_en: Prompt optimization for text classification spans diverse approaches, from demonstration selection to exploration-based search to error-driven diagnosis, each with known but incompletely characterized strengths and limitations. We conduct a comprehensive empirical study across diverse classification benchmarks (2 to 150 classes) comparing these paradigms through both quantitative evaluation and qualitative analysis of optimization traces, revealing that each paradigm excels on structurally different task types and that no single method dominates. Guided by these insights, we propose Error-Guided Optimization (ERGO), an error-driven method that iterates over the full training set in non-overlapping batches, diagnoses classification failures, and generates targeted decision rules through a diagnose-prescribe-rewrite feedback loop. ERGO achieves the best accuracy on tasks where errors concentrate in specific confused label pairs (which we term boundary-learnable tasks): TREC: 90.0%, CLINC150: 94.4%, converges in 3-5 iterations, and produces interpretable decision rules. While ERGO does not achieve the highest overall average, it fills a complementary role: demonstration-based ICL wins on coverage-dependent tasks, exploration-based search wins on many-class intent, and ERGO wins where decision boundaries are learnable from error patterns. We provide a complementarity framework linking task characteristics to optimal paradigm selection, offering practical guidance for practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过综合实证研究比较了文本分类中多种提示优化范式（演示选择、基于探索的搜索、错误驱动诊断），发现每种范式在不同任务类型上各有优劣。基于此，提出错误引导优化（ERGO）方法，通过诊断-处方-重写循环在非重叠批次上迭代训练集，生成针对性决策规则，在边界可学习任务上达到最优，例如TREC 90.0%和CLINC150 94.4%。ERGO收敛快（3-5次迭代）且产生可解释规则，但总体平均并非最高。
Motivation: 现有提示优化方法各有优劣但缺乏系统比较，且没有通用方法适用于所有文本分类任务，需要理解不同任务特性与最优范式的匹配关系。
Method: 首先进行大规模实证研究，比较演示选择、基于探索的搜索和错误驱动诊断范式；然后提出ERGO方法，在非重叠批次上迭代，通过诊断-处方-重写循环从分类错误中生成决策规则。
Result: ERGO在边界可学习任务上达到最佳准确率（TREC 90.0%，CLINC150 94.4%），收敛于3-5次迭代；演示选择在覆盖依赖任务上最优，基于探索的搜索在多类别意图任务上最优。
Conclusion: 提供任务特性与最优范式选择的互补框架，为从业者提供实践指导，但ERGO不适用于所有任务类型。

papers.title: Workload-Aware Caching for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems decompose complex tasks into directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of specialized agent executions, creating natural opportunities for caching intermediate results across queries. However, existing cache eviction policies treat all cached entries uniformly based on access history, ignoring structural and workload signals uniquely available in agentic execution environments. We present a workload-aware eviction policy that combines three signals, namely recomputation cost, DAG dependency count, and agent invocation frequency, into a unified scoring function that retains the most valuable entries under memory constraints. Evaluated across three multi-agent benchmarks spanning diverse reuse regimes, our policy reduces latency by up to 64.7% relative to the uncached baseline and achieves on average a 31.1% latency reduction over the next best finite-capacity baseline, while approaching the performance of an unbounded cache and maintaining accuracy on par with or exceeding all competing finite-capacity methods. We further show that workload-aware content caching is complementary to other agentic system optimization methods, including plan-level caching and parallel agent execution, with each technique targeting a distinct efficiency bottleneck in multi-agent pipelines.

papers.title: Isolating LLM Alignment from Regex: Zero Coverage and Metric-Dependent Divergence Under Adversarial Mutation
papers.abstract_en: Production LLM applications commonly stack a regex filter in front of model-side alignment; prior work found no measurable coverage gain from adding a live Gemini backend behind an active regex filter. We ask whether that ceiling holds when the corpus is \emph{designed to bypass the regex}. We introduce $L_5$-no-regex -- identical to $L_4$-real (Gemini-2.5-flash, token-budget cap, rate limit, output scrub) but with the nine-pattern filter disabled -- and evaluate it against $N{=}45$ adversarial probes across three sub-corpora (carry-forward, regex-bypass, alignment-isolate), amplified by Gemini paraphrase and PAIR to ${\sim}1{,}555$ probe-run pairs over $N{=}5$ replications. Under the primary substring classifier, H1 is refuted: $L_5$ block rate is $0,%$ across all five OWASP LLM Top-10 categories ($Δ\text{pp}{=}0$ vs.\ $L_0$, $p{=}1.00$; Wilson upper bound ${<}5,%$). A secondary LLM-judge metric on PAIR variants shows $56$--$100,%$ block rates ($p{<}0.01$), revealing alignment does respond to adversarially-framed probes -- but produces refusals too nuanced for substring matching. The sub-corpus differential prediction is not supported ($p{=}1.00$). Alignment's contribution is \emph{metric-dependent}: on natural-language harmful-request probes, it adds zero observed coverage beyond the regex; on adversarially-framed variants, an LLM judge detects refusals the substring classifier misses. The locked corpus, mutation artifacts, and export scripts are released for replication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在生产LLM应用中，正则表达式过滤器与模型对齐（alignment）的交互。实验设计了与L4-real相同的L5-no-regex设置（禁用9种模式过滤器），在45个对抗性探针上测试。结果表明，在主要子字符串分类器下，L5的拦截率为0%（所有OWASP LLM Top-10类别），而使用LLM判断指标在PAIR变体上显示56-100%的拦截率，说明对齐对对抗性框架探针有反应，但产生的拒绝过于细微，无法被子字符串匹配捕获。对齐的贡献是度量依赖的。
Motivation: 先前工作发现，在活跃的正则表达式过滤器后添加实时Gemini后端没有可测量的覆盖增益。本文探讨当语料库被设计为绕过正则表达式时，这个上限是否仍然成立。
Method: 引入L5-no-regex设置，禁用正则表达式过滤器，与L4-real对比。使用N=45个对抗性探针，通过Gemini paraphrase和PAIR扩增至约1555个探针-运行对，进行5次重复实验。评估使用主要子字符串分类器和次级LLM判断指标。
Result: 主要子字符串分类器下，L5在所有五个OWASP LLM Top-10类别中的拦截率为0%（Δpp=0 vs L0, p=1.00; Wilson上界<5%）。次级LLM判断指标在PAIR变体上显示56-100%拦截率（p<0.01）。子语料库差异预测未得到支持（p=1.00）。
Conclusion: 对齐的贡献是度量依赖的：对自然语言有害请求探针，对齐在正则表达式之外没有增加可观测覆盖；对对抗性框架变体，LLM判断能检测到子字符串分类器遗漏的拒绝。

papers.title: Attention-based Experience Replay Framework for Continual Learning of Agnostic Time Series Forecasting Models
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has led to remarkable progress in artificial intelligence, particularly in robotics, imaging and sound processing. However, a major limitation of neural networks remains their strong dependence on large and stationary datasets. In many real-world applications, these conditions are rarely met due to evolving and dynamic environments where data distributions change over time. Continual learning aims to address this challenge by developing models capable of adapting incrementally while maintaining a balance between stability and plasticity under computational constraints. In this work, we introduce a novel framework for continual time series forecasting, designed to extend existing static forecasting models commonly used in the literature by incorporating an Experience Replay strategy guided by Attention mechanisms. This approach allows the model to adapt dynamically to new contexts while preserving prior knowledge, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting. The framework is evaluated on standard forecasting benchmarks as well as on a piezometric dataset exhibiting diverse temporal behaviors. Results show that our approach effectively increases or maintains predictive performance over time while reducing retraining costs and data requirements, thus facilitating the deployment of forecasting models in dynamic and real-world settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列预测中的持续学习问题，提出了一种基于注意力机制的经验回放框架，使静态预测模型能够动态适应新上下文并缓解灾难性遗忘。在标准预测基准和压水数据上的实验表明，该方法可维持或提升预测性能，同时降低重训练成本和数据需求。
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型依赖大规模、静态数据集，在数据分布随时间变化的动态环境中难以适应；持续学习需要平衡稳定性和可塑性，但现有方法在时间序列预测上效果有限。
Method: 提出一个持续学习框架，通过注意力机制指导的经验回放 (Experience Replay) 策略，选择性地重放记忆样本，使模型在适应新数据的同时保留旧知识。
Result: 在标准预测基准和具有多种时间行为的压水数据集上，方法能维持或提升预测性能，并减少重训练成本与数据需求。
Conclusion: 该框架可扩展现有静态时间序列预测模型，促进其在动态真实场景中的部署，缓解灾难性遗忘。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: PhantomFill: When the Form Demands an Answer, Language Models Invent One
papers.abstract_en: Language models in production do not write prose. They fill forms: JSON fields, function arguments, extraction templates. We show that the form itself causes hallucination. We ask thirteen models the same question about the same input and change only the answer format. The inputs are built so the question cannot be answered: a viral post showing 12,400 likes but no visible replies, a support ticket whose call was never transcribed. In free text, GPT-5.5 answers honestly. It says there is no reply data, 98% of the time. Given a required JSON field for sentiment, the same model invents an answer 40 times out of 40. It fabricates the mood of crowds it never saw and quotes customers it never heard. The pattern holds with force. Required fields drive fabrication to 100% in ten of thirteen models. An explicit "insufficient evidence" option rescues only the frontier: all nine open-weight models ignore it. A direct instruction, do not infer sentiment, is overridden by the schema in four of six models. Resistance does not come with scale: within a single model family, the smallest model refuses, the mid-sized model fabricates, the largest refuses again. Honesty under format pressure is a training outcome that no one is measuring. The fabrication hides exactly where hedging is impossible: in required enums and minimum-count arrays, fields where no disclaimer fits. We release PhantomFill, a benchmark with deterministic scoring and two reportable numbers: the Coerced Fabrication Rate and the Escape Utilization Rate. The fix we test is one line of schema. The failure we measure is everywhere.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在表单填充（如JSON字段、函数参数）时被迫生成答案的幻觉现象。在无法回答的问题上，自由文本模型90%以上诚实，但强制格式要求导致十三个模型中有十个的捏造率达到100%。即使是显式的“证据不足”选项也被开源模型忽略，直接指令也被重写。作者发布PhantomFill基准和两个可报告指标：强制捏造率和逃脱利用率。
Motivation: 现有研究关注语言模型在开放文本中的幻觉，但忽视了生产环境中的表单填充场景，其中必需字段迫使模型提供答案，即使没有数据。
Method: 构建一系列问题（如无回复的社交帖子、未转录的工单），对比相同输入下自由文本与多种格式（JSON、枚举、数组）的回答。测试十三个模型，引入强制字段、显式“证据不足”选项和直接指令。
Result: 强制格式将捏造率从自由文本的2%以下提升至多个模型的100%；仅前沿模型能利用“证据不足”选项；直接指令被六个模型中的四个忽略；同系列内小模型拒绝、中型捏造、大型再次拒绝。
Conclusion: 语言模型在格式压力下的诚实性是一个未被评估的训练结果，需要的修复是简短的架构修改（一行schema），而当前失败普遍存在。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DFAH-Bench: Benchmarking Observable Agent Instability in Financial Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Standard evaluation benchmarks measure what a tool-using agent decides, not whether it arrives at that decision through the same process each time. We introduce DFAH-Bench, a replay benchmark that measures observable behavioral instability in financial agent decision-making across three channels -- tool-call trajectories, evidence contacts, and decision concentration -- none of which require access to hidden reasoning text. Across 8,127 replay episodes spanning 10 models and 3 financial tasks, we find that outcome agreement alone is an incomplete stability signal: frontier models can agree on decisions 95% of the time while following the same tool path only 77% of the time -- an 18-percentage-point gap (95% CI: [0.14, 0.22]) that outcome-only evaluation misses entirely. Among frontier-model case groups with high decision agreement, over 55% exhibit meaningful trajectory divergence. We identify three behavioral profiles: pattern matchers that achieve near-perfect agreement by collapsing to a single output regardless of input, stable executors with relatively consistent tool-use processes, and trajectory divergers that reach the same conclusions through materially different tool paths and evidence contacts. The benchmark code, metric scripts, replay logs, benchmark card, dataset README, and release manifest are released in the accompanying repository.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Code, replay logs, one-command reproduction (make reproduce-paper), and an interactive results explorer: github.com/ibm-client-engineering/output-drift-financial-llms
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DFAH-Bench，一个用于衡量金融决策中agent行为不稳定性的重放基准，通过工具调用轨迹、证据接触和决策集中度三个通道评估。在8127次重放实验中，发现前沿模型在决策一致率95%时，工具路径一致性仅为77%，存在18个百分点的差距。识别出三种行为模式：模式匹配器、稳定执行器和轨迹发散器。
Motivation: 现有评估基准只测量agent的决策结果，而不检查决策过程是否稳定。本文旨在通过可观察的行为指标揭示决策过程中的不稳定性。
Method: 提出DFAH-Bench基准，包含三个可观察的稳定性通道（工具调用轨迹、证据接触、决策集中度），无需访问隐藏推理文本。在10个模型和3个金融任务上进行8127次重放实验。
Result: 发现前沿模型在95%的决策一致率下，工具路径一致性仅为77%，差距18个百分点；超过55%的高决策一致率案例存在轨迹发散。识别出三种行为模式。
Conclusion: 单纯基于结果的一致性评估会遗漏过程不稳定性；DFAH-Bench提供了更细粒度的行为稳定性度量。代码和数据集已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CRAWO: Custom Resources for Adaptive Workload Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Edge Intelligence has emerged as a key paradigm for enabling real-time applications in smart cities by shifting computation from centralized cloud data centers to the network edge, thereby reducing latency and bandwidth consumption. However, deploying Artificial Intelligence (AI) pipelines across heterogeneous edge infrastructures remains challenging due to the wide range of device capabilities, from low-power microcontrollers to accelerator-equipped systems. Existing edge orchestration platforms primarily focus on deployment automation and infrastructure management, but these approaches are often inefficient and limit the ability to adaptively allocate resources under dynamic conditions. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces CRAWO (Custom Resources for Adaptive Workload Orchestration), an architectural framework for coordinating AI pipelines across distributed edge environments. CRAWO follows a control-loop-based model that separates allocation intelligence from execution by managing placement decisions, state management, and inter-stage data flows while instantiating services on edge nodes. The framework incorporates a hardware-aware allocator with a pluggable multi-criteria decision layer that leverages real-time infrastructure metrics to enable adaptive workload placement. The reference implementation adopts a microservices architecture deployed on a lightweight Kubernetes distribution (K3s), using Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) for domain modeling and a dedicated operator for state reconciliation. Evaluation in a vehicle surveillance scenario using license plate recognition demonstrates improved workload distribution and reduced reliance on centralized cloud processing in latency-sensitive environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CRAWO，一种用于边缘环境协调AI管道的架构框架，采用控制循环模型分离分配与执行，包含硬件感知分配器和可插拔多准则决策层，基于K3s和CRD实现。在车辆监控场景中评估，显示改善了工作负载分布并减少了对中心云的依赖。
Motivation: 现有边缘编排平台在动态条件下难以自适应分配资源，部署AI管道效率低。

papers.title: EvoSQL: Memory-Augmented Critic-Generator Co-Evolution for Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-SQL has advanced rapidly with large language models, but complex database queries still require reasoning beyond one-shot generation, including multi-step decomposition, execution-based diagnosis, and targeted correction. We present EvoSQL, a co-evolution framework that formulates SQL synthesis as an iterative interaction between a generator and a critic. EvoSQL maintains a contextualized candidate memory, verifies SQL candidates with both execution signals and LLM-based critique, and updates its memory through utility-guided aggregation. To strengthen the underlying generator-critic pair, we further introduce a Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) fine-tuning stage that injects execution-aware supervision into modern coding LLM backbones. Experiments on Spider and BIRD show that EvoSQL consistently improves open-source models over Maj@16 baselines, with particularly large gains on BIRD-Dev, ranging from +1.37% for Qwen3-4B to +9.19% for Qwen2.5-Coder-3B. SDPO initialization further improves selected backbones on Spider-Test and BIRD-Dev. These results suggest that memory-grounded co-evolution is an effective path toward more reliable and generalizable Text-to-SQL systems. Code is available at https://github.com/valleysprings/EvoSQL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoSQL 是一个用于 Text-to-SQL 的协同进化框架，将 SQL 合成建模为生成器与评论者之间的迭代交互。它维护一个上下文候选记忆，通过执行信号和 LLM 评论验证 SQL 候选，并通过效用引导聚合更新记忆。此外，引入自蒸馏策略优化 (SDPO) 微调阶段，将执行感知监督注入编码 LLM 骨干。在 Spider 和 BIRD 数据集上的实验表明，EvoSQL 在 Maj@16 基线上持续改进开源模型，尤其是在 BIRD-Dev 上，改进从 Qwen3-4B 的 +1.37% 到 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B 的 +9.19%。
Motivation: 复杂数据库查询需要超出一次性生成的推理，包括多步分解、基于执行的诊断和针对性纠正；现有方法在可靠性和泛化性上仍有不足。
Method: 提出基于记忆的生成器-评论者协同进化框架 (EvoSQL)，包含上下文候选记忆、执行信号与 LLM 评论的验证机制、效用引导的记忆更新，以及自蒸馏策略优化 (SDPO) 微调。
Result: 在 Spider 和 BIRD 上，EvoSQL 持续改进 Maj@16 基线；BIRD-Dev 上 Qwen3-4B 提升 +1.37%，Qwen2.5-Coder-3B 提升 +9.19%。SDPO 初始化进一步改善 Spider-Test 和 BIRD-Dev 上的部分骨干模型。
Conclusion: 记忆引导的协同进化是实现更可靠、更泛化 Text-to-SQL 系统的有效路径。

papers.title: Autonomous Topology Mutation: Safe Runtime Restructuring for Multi-Agent LLM Systems with Capability, State, and Shadow Invariants
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM frameworks typically fix their team topology at boot time. When an individual agent becomes overloaded at runtime, for example by mixing too many action categories, accumulating tool errors, or queueing behind too many calls, the system has no mechanism to restructure itself. We introduce Autonomous Topology Mutation (ATM), a runtime team-mutation mechanism for multi-agent LLM frameworks. ATM combines telemetry-driven overload detection with three safety invariants that gate each structural change: capability monotonicity, state-routing completeness, and shadow-before-live validation. ATM monitors a six-signal Bottleneck Index that includes queue depth, context thrash, tool-error rate, role entropy, retry-loop rate, and cross-agent wait time. When a warmup-calibrated threshold is breached for multiple consecutive ticks, ATM factorises the overloaded agent into specialised sub-agents and hot-swaps the parent into a coordinator role while preserving its external identity. State transfer is controlled by privacy-level-aware routing: each memory atom is routed only to a permitted child set, or explicitly dropped with a logged reason. No candidate topology receives live traffic until it has passed a shadow validation window. On 720 DeepSeek-V3-driven task runs with deterministic tool stubs across four ablation conditions and three workloads, the ATM factoriser split lifts code-task success from 3.3% to 61.7%. The full rail-and-distillation system reduces detected high-privacy memory exposure under a regex classifier from 2.0 to 0.0 events per task while preserving task quality. The runtime rails carrying ATM's invariants add less than 500 microseconds of p99 latency on the agent hot path. A small live-tool probe with real Python execution is included as an external-validity check. The implementation, benchmark harness, and traces are open-sourced.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 tables. Code and benchmark harness available at https://github.com/sidikbro/jiuwen_atm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Autonomous Topology Mutation (ATM) 机制，允许多智能体 LLM 系统在运行时动态重组团队拓扑，通过瓶颈检测和三个安全不变性（能力单调性、状态路由完备性、影子验证）保证安全。实验在 DeepSeek-V3 驱动的任务上，将代码任务成功率从 3.3% 提升至 61.7%，并降低隐私泄露事件。
Motivation: 现有多智能体 LLM 框架的团队拓扑在启动时固定，无法应对运行时单个智能体过载（如混合过多动作类别、累积工具错误等），缺乏自我重构机制。
Method: 提出 ATM 机制，包括基于六信号（队列深度、上下文抖动、工具错误率、角色熵、重试循环率、跨智能体等待时间）的瓶颈指数监测，结合三个安全不变性（能力单调性、状态路由完备性、影子验证）的拓扑突变，通过因子化分解过载智能体为子智能体，并热替换为协调者角色，状态路由受隐私级别控制。
Result: 在 720 个 DeepSeek-V3 驱动任务中，ATM 因子化分解将代码任务成功率从 3.3% 提升至 61.7%；完整系统将高隐私内存暴露事件从每任务 2.0 降至 0.0，同时保持任务质量；运行时开销小于 500 微秒 p99 延迟。
Conclusion: ATM 机制证明了运行时拓扑突变在多智能体 LLM 系统中的可行性和有效性，通过安全不变性保证了结构变化的可靠性和隐私保护。

papers.title: Directional Hallucinations: Ideological Drift in News-Grounded LLM Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer questions about political information, including in election-adjacent information settings where factual errors and ideological distortions are high-stakes. We present a reproducible measurement framework that treats hallucinations, unsupported statements in document-grounded QA, as diagnostic signals of ideological drift. Using 21,727 expert-labeled U.S. political news articles from QBias spanning left, center, and right sources, we (i) generate an article-specific question, (ii) elicit document-grounded answers from three open-weight LLMs and one proprietary model, (iii) detect sentence-level hallucinations via reference-based comparison, (iv) classify the ideological valence of hallucinated sentences with a fine-tuned stance classifier, and (v) probe output logits to relate token-level uncertainty to hallucination and drift. Hallucination rates vary substantially across models and concentrate in contentious topics, while source-ideology differences in hallucination frequency are modest. In contrast, hallucination content exhibits robust leftward drift: a majority of hallucinated sentences are classified as left-leaning, including among hallucinations generated from right-leaning sources. Logit-level analysis shows hallucinations arise in high-entropy generation contexts, and in some models uncertainty also predicts leftward drift, consistent with an "uncertainty to guessing" mechanism. We discuss implications for auditing AI-mediated political information and for designing safeguards in election-relevant deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可复现的测量框架，将文档问答中的幻觉（hallucinations）视为意识形态漂移的诊断信号。使用QBias数据集的21,727篇美国政治新闻文章，对四个LLM进行实验，发现幻觉率因模型和话题而异，但幻觉内容呈现稳定的左倾漂移，且与生成不确定性相关。
Motivation: LLM在选举等高风险政治信息场景中的事实错误和意识形态失真需要系统测量，现有工作缺乏对幻觉内容意识形态偏向的量化分析。
Method: 构建五步框架：(i) 为每篇文章生成特定问题，(ii) 获取文档问答答案，(iii) 基于参考检测句子级幻觉，(iv) 用微调立场分类器标注幻觉句子的意识形态倾向，(v) 分析输出logits以关联token级不确定性与幻觉和漂移。
Result: 幻觉率在不同模型和争议话题中差异显著，但来源意识形态差异较小；幻觉内容呈现稳健的左倾漂移，包括来自右倾来源的幻觉；logit分析表明幻觉出现在高熵生成上下文，部分模型的不确定性也预测左倾漂移。
Conclusion: 本文表明幻觉内容可作为意识形态漂移的诊断信号，并讨论了审计AI政治信息和设计选举相关部署安全措施的意义。

papers.title: OPTScientist: Multi-Agent Discovery of Typed Optimizer Programs for Transformer Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Designing optimizers for modern deep learning remains a challenging scientific problem, requiring the joint consideration of optimization geometry, state dynamics, numerical stability, implementation constraints, and empirical generalization. Existing automated optimizer discovery methods typically search either over unconstrained code spaces or within narrowly parameterized optimizer families. The former is flexible but often produces invalid or uninterpretable programs, while the latter is stable but limits novelty. We introduce OPTScientist, a theory-guided multi-agent framework for optimizer discovery in a typed domain-specific language (DSL). OPTScientist formulates optimizer design as a constrained scientific search process, where candidate updates are expressed through direction, scaling, preconditioning, regularization, state, and grouping modules. Four role agents, Theorist, Designer, Engineer, and Reviewer, collaborate within a single orchestration loop to propose hypotheses, synthesize DSL candidates, compile and evaluate optimizers, and critique results. To overcome the limitations of a fixed search space, OPTScientist combines evolutionary search over optimizer programs with a second-stage mechanism that proposes small DSL extensions when repeated failures reveal representational bottlenecks. Using this framework, we discover RS-MR, a reduced-state matrix optimizer that improves transformer pretraining over strong baselines under our native evaluation protocol. Our results suggest a path toward automated optimizer science grounded in theory, typed programs, compiler validation, and closed-loop experimentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OPTScientist，一个理论引导的多智能体框架，用于在类型化领域特定语言（DSL）中自动发现优化器程序。通过四个角色智能体（Theorist, Designer, Engineer, Reviewer）协作，结合进化搜索和DSL扩展机制，发现了RS-MR优化器，在Transformer预训练中取得改进。
Motivation: 现有优化器自动发现方法要么在无约束代码空间搜索导致无效或不可解释的程序，要么限于窄参数化族限制新颖性。需要一种既能保持灵活性又能产生有效可解释优化器的方法。
Method: 提出OPTScientist框架，将优化器设计表达为方向、缩放、预处理、正则化、状态、分组六个模块的约束科学搜索。四个智能体在一个编排循环中协作，结合进化搜索和DSL扩展机制，当重复失败表明表示瓶颈时提出小扩展。
Result: 发现RS-MR优化器，一种减少状态的矩阵优化器，在作者的原生评估协议下改进Transformer预训练，优于强基线。
Conclusion: 结果表明了一条通向理论指导、类型化程序、编译器验证和闭环实验的自动化优化器科学的路径。

papers.title: Expectation Alignment of Language Models for Real-World User Expectations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on standard benchmarks, yet it remains largely unexplored whether they truly meet user expectations. Existing evaluation approaches, relying on model heuristics, expert rubrics, or user simulation, fail to capture the diversity and subtlety of real human expectations, causing models to appear competent while misaligning with what users actually seek. We present the first systematic study of user expectations in real-world LLM interactions, proposing a principled procedure to extract semantically rich expectations and introducing ExpectBench, a benchmark grounded in real user expectations. Analyses reveal that current LLMs struggle to satisfy and anticipate what users hope to obtain, highlighting a fundamental source of misalignment. Building on these observations, we propose LENS, a lightweight latent expectation-aware response generation framework. LENS enables models to internalize user expectations and generate better-aligned responses, consistently improving expectation satisfaction and underscoring the importance of explicitly modeling user expectations for realistic human-AI alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究用户对LLM的真实期望，提出期望提取流程和ExpectBench基准，发现当前LLM难以满足和预测用户期望。提出LENS框架，让模型内化用户期望并生成更对齐的回复，提升期望满意度。
Motivation: 现有评估方法依赖模型启发式、专家评分或用户模拟，无法捕捉真实用户期望的多样性和细微差别，导致模型看似优秀但实际与用户需求错位。
Method: 提出LENS（轻量级潜在期望感知响应生成框架），使模型内化用户期望并生成更对齐的回复，使用真实用户期望构建的ExpectBench进行评估。
Result: 当前LLM难以满足和预测用户期望；LENS框架一致性地提升了期望满意度，表明显式建模用户期望对于人机对齐的重要性。
Conclusion: 强调显式建模用户期望是实现符合现实人类期望的对齐的关键，LENS框架有效。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有评估方法依赖模型启发式、专家评分或用户模拟，无法捕捉真实用户期望的多样性和细微差别，导致模型看似优秀但实际与用户需求错位。

papers.title: The Devil is in the Spectrum: Mitigating Representation Collapse in LLMs via Topologically Regularized Side-Path
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are fundamentally limited by representation collapse, a bottleneck that severely degrades long-context performance. We identify that existing approaches risk drifting into one of two pathological extremes: homogenization collapse (e.g., attention sinks causing rank deficiency) and isolation collapse (e.g., local attention causing context disconnection). Through spectral analysis of attention dynamics, we derive an intrinsic trade-off between mixing efficiency (spectral gap) and information capacity (effective rank) that standard mechanisms struggle to balance. To resolve this dilemma, we propose the Topologically Regularized Side-Path (TRSP), a non-invasive architectural intervention that achieves spectral balance. TRSP employs a parameter-free Triangular Box mechanism, scaled by a lightweight, length-aware gate, to regularize the token interaction topology. By integrating proximal coupling to preserve effective rank and distal propagation to support non-degenerate mixing, TRSP promotes a geometrically healthier transition operator without altering core attention. Experiments show significant improvements across general capabilities and long-context benchmarks. Notably, on NoLiMa at $8\times$ the training length, TRSP retains $83\%$ accuracy and surpasses the Differential Transformer and Gated Attention by approximately 30 and 50 percentage points, respectively. Code available at: https://github.com/Eziotao-tyd/TRSP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出大语言模型面临表示崩溃问题，表现为同质性崩溃和孤立性崩溃两种极端，通过注意力谱分析发现混合效率与信息容量之间存在内在权衡。提出拓扑正则化侧路径（TRSP），一种非侵入性架构干预，采用参数自由的三角盒机制和轻量级长度感知门控来正则化token交互拓扑，实现谱平衡。实验表明在长上下文基准上显著提升，如NoLiMa在8倍训练长度上保持83%准确率，分别超过Differential Transformer和Gated Attention约30和50个百分点。
Motivation: 现有方法在长上下文中易陷入同质性崩溃（如注意力沉没导致秩不足）或孤立性崩溃（如局部注意力导致上下文断连），标准注意力机制难以平衡混合效率与信息容量。
Method: 提出拓扑正则化侧路径（TRSP），包含参数自由的三角盒机制和轻量级长度感知门控，通过近端耦合保持有效秩、远端传播支持非退化混合，不修改核心注意力模块。
Result: 实验表明在通用能力和长上下文基准上均有显著提升，NoLiMa在8倍训练长度上准确率83%，超越Differential Transformer约30个百分点、Gated Attention约50个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调TRSP通过拓扑正则化实现谱平衡，是一种非侵入性方法，有效缓解表示崩溃，提升长上下文性能。

papers.title: Tractable Hierarchical Control of Autoregressive Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Constraining the generation of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) is an important component of integrating language models into formal systems. In the generation of code and data for tasks like program synthesis, ensuring that language models produce syntactically valid output is a prerequisite for processing such output. These languages (such as SQL or JSON) are often designed as $LR(k)$ context-free grammars. By distilling the LLM to a tractable probabilistic model, its autoregressive generation can be steered and masked to incorporate the probability of satisfying logical constraints, ensuring high quality output that is guaranteed to be valid. This paper demonstrates that the satisfaction of any $LR(k)$ grammar of finite duration can be calculated in polynomial time, an improvement over the exponential time of applying previous methods to such grammars. This result enables efficient constraint and steering of LLM generation towards output that better satisfies formal syntactic constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了对任意有限持续时间的LR(k)上下文无关文法，其满足性可在多项式时间内计算，这比先前方法的指数时间有改进。该结果可应用于约束自回归大语言模型生成满足语法约束的高质量输出。
Motivation: 在程序合成等任务中，需要确保语言模型生成语法有效的输出，但现有方法对LR(k)文法处理需要指数时间，效率低下。
Method: 通过将语言模型蒸馏为可处理概率模型，利用LR(k)文法的多项式时间可满足性计算，对自回归生成进行引导和掩码，以整合逻辑约束的概率。
Result: 证明了对任意有限持续时间的LR(k)上下文无关文法，约束满足可在多项式时间内计算。
Conclusion: 该方法能高效地约束和引导语言模型生成更符合形式语法约束的输出，且计算效率优于指数时间方法。

papers.title: PersonaTrail: Benchmarking Personalized Web Agents through Browsing Trails
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models have enabled web agents to autonomously execute complex tasks. In practice, users frequently provide underspecified instructions, requiring agents to infer the missing context from their raw browsing histories. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this form of personalization, as they either restrict tasks to fully explicit prompts or abstract web interaction history into simplified forms. To bridge this gap, we introduce PersonaTrail, a benchmark for personalized web agents operating in a managed open web environment. By leveraging realistic browsing trajectories as user history, PersonaTrail evaluates an agent's ability to infer user preferences and recall information from past browsing sessions. We further propose Preference-Aware Contextual Memory (PACMem), a framework that decomposes raw browsing histories into two types of structured memory: factual memories that summarize individual sessions and preference memories that distill recurring behavioral patterns. At inference time, the agent retrieves the most relevant entries from these memories to guide personalized navigation. Extensive experiments show that PACMem consistently outperforms existing memory-based baselines on both tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PersonaTrail，一个针对个性化网页代理的基准，利用真实浏览历史评估代理推断用户偏好和回忆信息的能力。同时提出PACMem框架，将浏览历史分解为事实记忆和偏好记忆，在推理时检索相关条目指导导航。实验表明PACMem优于现有记忆基线。
Motivation: 现有网页代理基准无法捕获用户提供不明确指令时需要从浏览历史推断上下文的个性化场景，通常使用完全显式提示或简化历史。
Method: 构建PersonaTrail基准，包含真实浏览轨迹。提出PACMem框架，将原始浏览历史分解为事实记忆（总结单次会话）和偏好记忆（提炼重复行为模式），推理时检索最相关记忆。
Result: PACMem在PersonaTrail的两项任务上持续优于基于记忆的基线方法。
Conclusion: 该基准填补了个性化网页代理评估的空白，PACMem展示了结构化记忆在个性化导航中的有效性。

papers.title: Routing Without Training: Controllable-Ratio LLM Offloading via Reliability Gating
papers.abstract_en: Local-cloud collaboration is a practical way to deploy large language models under resource constraints, but existing methods often rely on trained routers or collaboration-aware finetuning that tie routing behavior to a particular operating regime. In this work, we show that such training may be unnecessary: the local model's own inference-time agreement across sampled responses already provides a strong signal for deciding when to trust local execution and when to offload to a stronger cloud model. We propose CARGO, a training-free routing framework that estimates this agreement through prompt-varied sampling, applies Bayesian early stopping for sample-efficient uncertainty control, and supports arbitrary target collaboration ratios through lightweight deployment-time calibration. Across diverse reasoning and question-answering tasks, multiple local LLM families and scales, and both pretrained and finetuned local models, CARGO consistently outperforms other training-free baselines and in several settings surpasses supervised learned routers. These results suggest that effective and adaptable local-cloud collaboration can emerge directly from the local model's intrinsic response behavior, without requiring an additional trained router.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CARGO，一种无需训练的LLM本地-云端卸载路由框架，通过本地模型自身对采样响应的推理时一致性判断是否卸载。该方法使用提示变体采样估计一致性，结合贝叶斯早停优化采样效率，并通过轻量级校准支持任意目标协作比例。在多种推理和问答任务、多个LLM家族及规模下，CARGO持续超越其他无训练基线，并在多个设置下优于有监督路由器。
Motivation: 现有本地-云端协作方法通常依赖训练路由器或协作微调，导致路由行为固定于特定运行模式，缺乏灵活性和适应性。
Method: 提出CARGO框架，包括：1）通过提示变体采样估计本地模型输出的一致性作为卸载信号；2）采用贝叶斯早停控制采样效率；3）通过部署时校准支持任意目标协作比例，整个过程无需额外训练。
Result: 在推理和问答任务上，使用多种本地LLM（预训练和微调）评估，CARGO在所有设置中优于其他无训练基线，并在多个设置中超越有监督路由器。
Conclusion: 有效且可适应的本地-云端协作可直接从本地模型的内在响应行为中涌现，无需额外训练路由器，表明基于一致性的轻量级路由是可行的。

papers.title: Enabling Scalable Topology Inference in Distribution Systems via Constrained Multi-Source Inference
papers.abstract_en: Accurate distribution system topology is essential for outage localization, voltage analytics, and operation of distribution grids, yet maintaining reliable connectivity records remains challenging in practice due to heterogeneous and imperfect utility data. Existing topology identification methods often rely primarily on electrical similarity or spatial records alone, which become unreliable in dense feeders and under inconsistent metadata conditions. This paper formulates distribution topology identification as a constrained inference problem that refines a utility-provided base topology using heterogeneous evidence while enforcing spatial feasibility and physical operational constraints. Instead of reconstructing connectivity from scratch, the proposed framework detects inconsistent assignments, performs localized reconnection within constrained neighborhoods to ensure scalability, and iteratively enforces physical feasibility to produce operationally consistent topology estimates. In addition, a falsification-driven reliability metric evaluates how strongly each inferred connection is supported relative to alternative feasible assignments, enabling utilities to prioritize verification efforts while preserving system-wide observability. The framework is validated using operational data from three feeders comprising more than $8{,}000$ AMI meters in collaboration with a large U.S. utility. Results demonstrate over $95\%$ topology reconstruction accuracy while significantly reducing computational effort compared with global inference approaches. The study further shows that correlation-based methods alone produce ambiguous assignments in dense urban feeders, whereas combining electrical measurements with spatial and operational constraints enables robust and scalable topology recovery under realistic deployment conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种约束多源推断框架，将配电系统拓扑识别问题视为利用异构证据（电气测量、空间记录、操作约束）对公用事业提供的基础拓扑进行精细化推理。方法通过检测不一致分配、在约束邻域内局部重连并迭代强制执行物理可行性，实现了可扩展的拓扑推断。在三个馈线（超过8000个AMI表计）的真实数据上验证，拓扑重建准确率超过95%，且计算量远低于全局推断方法。
Motivation: 现有拓扑识别方法常单独依赖电气相似性或空间记录，在密集馈线和元数据不一致条件下不可靠，难以维护准确的配电系统连接记录。
Method: 将拓扑推断建模为约束推理问题：利用异构证据（如电气测量）细化基础拓扑，同时强制空间可行性和物理操作约束；通过检测不一致分配并在约束邻域内局部重连实现可扩展性；提出基于伪造的可靠性指标评估推断连接的支持强度。
Result: 在三个馈线（超过8000个AMI表计）上验证，拓扑重建准确率超过95%，计算量显著低于全局推断方法；仅基于相关性的方法在密集城市馈线中产生模糊分配，而结合电气测量与空间和操作约束能实现鲁棒恢复。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能在实际部署条件下，通过结合电气测量与空间及操作约束，实现鲁棒且可扩展的配电系统拓扑恢复。

papers.title: Beyond Liars' Bench: The Impact of Lie Typology, Depth, and Sparsity on Deception Detection in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Training probes to detect deceptive outputs from large language models is still an open problem. Recent work has demonstrated that detection probes fail especially in out-of-domain scenarios -- training on one type of lie does not transfer well to deception scenarios involving other types of lies. In this work, we conduct a systematic study on how various factors impact detection performance: representation depth, probe expressivity, sparse feature representations, and the lie typology of the training data. To this end, we augment standard benchmark training data with a supplementary dataset containing diverse types of deception, including fabrication, omission, and exaggeration examples. Analyzing these factors across seven probe types, our experimental results show that the optimal representation depth is highly dataset-dependent, more expressive probes provide only selective gains over linear baselines, and sparse autoencoder features perform similarly to dense hidden states. Ultimately, we demonstrate that the choice of training data and lie typology substantially changes detectability, highlighting that deception detection is a highly representation-dependent problem.
papers.comment: Presented at the AI Transparency Conference 2026, forthcoming in the AI Transparency Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了影响LLM欺骗检测性能的因素，包括表示深度、探测表达性、稀疏特征表示以及训练数据中的谎言类型。实验发现，最优表示深度高度依赖数据集，更复杂的探测仅在线性基线上有选择性提升，稀疏自编码器特征与密集隐藏状态表现相似。最终表明训练数据与谎言类型显著改变可检测性，欺骗检测是高度表示依赖的问题。
Motivation: 现有欺骗检测探测在跨场景泛化上表现不佳，尤其是训练于一种谎言类型时难以迁移至其他类型。需要系统理解影响检测性能的关键因素。
Method: 在标准基准训练数据上补充包含捏造、遗漏、夸大等多样欺骗类型的辅助数据集，跨七种探测类型分析表示深度、探测表达性、稀疏特征表示和谎言类型的影响。
Result: 最优表示深度高度数据集依赖；更复杂的探测仅选择性优于线性基线；稀疏自编码器特征与密集隐藏状态性能相近；训练数据和谎言类型的选择显著影响可检测性。
Conclusion: 欺骗检测是高度表示依赖的问题，未来需关注训练数据的多样性与表示选择。

papers.title: Verifier-First Evaluation of Agentic LLMs for Infrastructure-as-Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) generation from natural language requires satisfying provider schemas, dependency planning, and organizational policy constraints, not merely producing syntactically plausible configurations. We present a verifier-first empirical study of seven agentic strategies for Terraform generation evaluated on IaC-Eval v2, a modernized 186-task AWS/Terraform benchmark with Rego v1 intent policies. Our evaluation separates failures into three verifier stages (terraform validate, terraform plan, opa eval) and applies McNemar's test with Wilson confidence intervals on all pairwise comparisons (n=186, alpha=0.05). We report five principal findings. (1) Active retrieval via ReAct agents with MCP or ChromaDB-backed RAG raises Qwen2.5-Coder 7B from 14.0% to 45.7% pass@1 (p<0.0001), primarily by reducing VALIDATE_FAIL from 144 to 66 tasks. (2) Iterative refinement with verifier feedback achieves 62.9% (Qwen 7B) and 84.4% (GPT-4o) pass@1, exhibiting binary convergence -- tasks either resolve in one retry or exhaust the budget. (3) GEPA reflective instruction optimization raises the Active RAG baseline by +7.5 pp (p=0.026) using only 80 verifier-guided rollouts, providing evidence that prompt optimizers can improve verifiable IaC generation without weight updates. (4) SIMBA teacher-free demonstration injection achieves performance equivalent to Active RAG (p=1.0) without retrieval infrastructure, but fails to address the dominant SELF_DEFINED_PROPERTY error class (50% of failures). (5) A diagnostic Rego-injection experiment shows that 79% of post-refinement OPA failures are information-gap failures resolvable when policy text is visible (p=0.016), motivating policy
papers.comment: 26 pages, 3 figures, 17 tables. Benchmark dataset available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/iac-eval-v2/iac-eval-v2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对七种用于Terraform基础设施即代码生成的智能体策略进行了基于验证器的实证研究，使用包含186个任务的IaC-Eval v2基准测试和Rego v1意图策略。通过McNemar检验和Wilson置信区间对配对比较进行分析，报告了五个主要发现，包括主动检索、迭代细化、GEPA反射优化、SIMBA注入和诊断性Rego注入实验的结果。
Motivation: 基础设施即代码生成需要满足提供者模式、依赖规划和组织策略约束，而不仅仅是产生语法正确的配置。现有方法缺乏对这些约束的严格验证，因此需要一种验证器优先的评估方法。
Method: 提出了一个验证器优先的实证研究框架，将失败分为三个验证阶段（terraform validate、terraform plan、opa eval），并使用McNemar检验和Wilson置信区间进行所有配对比较。
Result: 主动检索将Qwen2.5-Coder 7B的pass@1从14.0%提升到45.7%；迭代细化达到62.9%（Qwen 7B）和84.4%（GPT-4o）；GEPA反射优化将基线提升+7.5个百分点；SIMBA性能与主动检索相当但无法解决SELF_DEFINED_PROPERTY错误；79%的后细化OPA失败是信息缺口失败。
Conclusion: 验证器优先的评估揭示了不同智能体策略在IaC生成中的优缺点，强调了提供策略可见性对于解决信息缺口失败的重要性。

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Text-Attributed Graph Distillation
papers.abstract_en: {\em Text-Attributed Graphs} (TAGs) have emerged as an expressive data model for integrating graph topology with rich textual semantics. Existing representation learning methods over TAGs suffer from severe scalability bottlenecks, particularly together with {\em Large Language Models} (LLMs). While data distillation offers a promising data-centric solution, existing methods fail to capture the complex interplay between graph and text modalities, struggle with the label scarcity inherent in semi-supervised settings, and lack the ability to produce the human-readable textual attributes required for downstream LLM-based tasks. To address these challenges, we propose \algo{}, a unified semi-supervised framework guided by the {\em Wasserstein Distance} (WSD). Grounded in our empirical findings on real TAGs, \algo{} introduces a graph-text collaborative encoding module that utilizes dual-pathway encoders (graph-aware and -free) within a collaborative self-training scheme to harvest reliable pseudo-labels and fuse complementary graph-text features. Furthermore, we develop a theoretically grounded WSD-based graph sketching algorithm and a cost-effective LLM text synthesis module, which leverages cluster-based keyword extraction to generate coherent, human-readable summaries for condensed nodes. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that \algo{} achieves a state-of-the-art performance-compression trade-off in terms of both GNN- and LLM-based downstream tasks, enabling effective and efficient TAG learning or analytics.
papers.comment: Technical report for the paper "Semi-Supervised Text-Attributed Graph Distillation" accepted KDD2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种半监督文本属性图蒸馏框架SS-TAG（基于Wasserstein距离），通过图-文本协同编码模块和伪标签策略，结合图素描算法和LLM文本合成模块，在保持性能的同时显著压缩图规模，适用于大规模TAG的GNN和LLM下游任务。
Motivation: 现有TAG学习方法在结合LLM时存在可扩展性瓶颈，且现有数据蒸馏方法未能有效捕获图与文本的交互，在标签稀缺的半监督设置下表现不佳，也无法生成可读的文本属性。
Method: 提出SS-TAG框架，包含图-文本协同编码模块（双路径编码器与协同自训练）、基于Wasserstein距离的图素描算法，以及利用聚类关键词抽取的LLM文本合成模块，用于生成简洁连贯的节点摘要。
Result: 在基准数据集上，SS-TAG在GNN和LLM下游任务中实现了性能-压缩权衡的最优结果。
Conclusion: 该框架有效解决了TAG的扩展性和标签稀缺问题，适用于实际大规模TAG学习与分析。
Relevance: 5
