papers.title: LLM-INSTRUCT at UZH Shared Task 2026: Constraint-Aware Retrieval and Selective Debate for Paragraph-Level Argument Mining
papers.abstract_en: We present LLM-INSTRUCT, the winning system for the UZH Shared Task at ArgMining 2026 on paragraph-level argument mining in UN and UNESCO resolutions. The task requires paragraph-type classification, prediction of a subset of 141 official tags, and directed relation prediction under a strict JSON schema setting using only open-weight models up to 8B parameters. We frame the task as constrained structured prediction. The system first narrows the candidate tag space with metadata-aware dense retrieval, then applies constrained decoding with per-dimension caps, escalates only uncertain cases to a three-agent debate branch, and finally validates the output schema. On the official leaderboard, LLM-INSTRUCT ranked 1st overall, with 1st in F1 and 5th in LLM-as-a-Judge. During development, our configuration search further improved Task 1b Micro-F1 from 35.83% to 40.08% while keeping the internal Task 2 score at 4.421. The main lesson is simple: reducing the decision space before generation improves both accuracy and submission robustness. Our code and supporting scripts are publicly available at: https://github.com/LLM-Instruct-at-UZH-Shared-Task-2026/Method
papers.comment: Accepted to the 13th Workshop on Argument Mining (ArgMining 2026) at ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 LLM-INSTRUCT 系统，用于 UZH 共享任务中的段落级论点挖掘，该系统通过元数据感知的稠密检索缩小候选标签空间、约束解码、以及选择性三智能体辩论机制，在 UN 和 UNESCO 决议文本上实现结构化预测，最终在官方排行榜上获得总分第一。
Motivation: 段落级论点挖掘任务需要处理严格的 JSON 格式约束、141 个官方标签的子集预测以及有向关系预测，且只允许使用不超过 8B 参数的开源模型，现有方法难以兼顾精度与格式合规性。
Method: 提出约束感知的检索与选择性辩论流水线：先用元数据增强的稠密检索缩小候选标签集，再对每个维度上限进行约束解码，仅对不确定样本触发三个智能体的辩论分支，最后验证输出 schema。
Result: 在官方排行榜上总体排名第一，其中 F1 第一、LLM-as-a-Judge 第五。开发阶段进一步将 Task 1b Micro-F1 从 35.83% 提升至 40.08%，同时保持 Task 2 内部得分为 4.421。
Conclusion: 核心经验是：在生成前缩小决策空间能同时提高准确率和提交鲁棒性。所有代码已公开。

papers.title: More Is Not More: What Matters for Diversity in LLM Opinions?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate diverse human opinions in open-ended tasks such as synthetic surveys, focus group modeling, and public opinion prediction. However, LLM outputs exhibit systematic opinion homogenization. Practitioners have explored various interventions to increase diversity, but the landscape remains fragmented: different methods are evaluated in isolation with incomparable metrics, and in practice they are typically deployed and upgraded simultaneously, making it difficult to attribute gains to specific components. To advance a more scientific understanding of LLM output diversity, we design a factorial experiment that separates two primary intervention dimensions: input conditioning (operationalized through persona depth) and interaction architecture. We evaluate all conditions on 100 real-user open-ended questions across 7 models, measuring diversity with multiple complementary metrics. Our findings challenge several common assumptions. First, more persona detail does not monotonically increase diversity. The initial step of persona conditioning already captures the majority of the gain, while further elaboration with demographic detail does not consistently improve and can reduce diversity on some models. Second, rather than seeking a single best interaction architecture, we find that different architectures explore largely non-overlapping opinion regions. Combining multiple architectures yields broader coverage than optimizing any one. Third, commonly attempted low-cost alternatives such as raising sampling temperature and adding diversity instructions produce negligible effects compared to structured interventions. Overall, our work demonstrates that diversity is not a product of scaling along any single dimension, but is highly sensitive to the structural form and combination of interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过析因实验系统研究LLM输出多样性的两个干预维度：输入条件（人格深度）和交互架构。在7个模型、100个真实用户开放式问题上，发现增加人格细节并不能单调提升多样性；不同交互架构探索非重叠的意见区域，组合多个架构比优化单一架构更好；低成本的温度调整和多样性指令效果微弱。
Motivation: LLM在模拟人类意见时存在系统性意见同质化，现有干预方法评估碎片化，难以归因具体组件效果，缺乏对多样性驱动因素的科学理解。
Method: 设计2×2析因实验，分离输入条件（人格深度）和交互架构两个维度，在7个模型上评估100个真实用户开放式问题，使用多互补指标测量多样性。
Result: 人格深度增加不单调提升多样性，初始人格条件已获得大部分增益，进一步添加人口统计细节无一致提升甚至降低多样性；不同交互架构探索非重叠意见区域，组合比优化单一架构覆盖更广；温度调整和多样性指令效果远弱于结构性干预。
Conclusion: 多样性不是单一维度扩展的结果，而是高度依赖于干预的结构形式和组合。

summary_sections.result: 人格深度增加不单调提升多样性，初始人格条件已获得大部分增益，进一步添加人口统计细节无一致提升甚至降低多样性；不同交互架构探索非重叠意见区域，组合比优化单一架构覆盖更广；温度调整和多样性指令效果远弱于结构性干预。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多样性不是单一维度扩展的结果，而是高度依赖于干预的结构形式和组合。

papers.title: Is MoE Routing a Huffman Code? Discovering the Frequency-Diversity Law in Chain-of-Thought
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts architectures have revolutionized scaling, yet the underlying logic of their routing remains a black box. In this paper, we uncover a fundamental governing principle: MoE routing is not merely selection, but a manifestation of Huffman Coding. We introduce the Frequency-Diversity Law, revealing that state-of-the-art models, such as Phi-3.5-MoE and Gemma-4-27B-A4B, spontaneously act as information-theoretic engines. These models allocate sparse expert resources for common tokens while invoking high-diversity expert committees for rare, complex tasks found in chain-of-thought trajectories. However, we identify a critical redundancy trap in Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: when effective sparsity (k/E_eff) is sufficiently low, load-balancing inadvertently imposes functional redundancy, masking the underlying Huffman efficiency signal. To bridge this gap, we propose Subset Difference Pruning, a surgical strategy to eliminate functional duplicates. We demonstrate that pruning does not degrade reasoning; instead, it unleashes the model's latent Huffman efficiency, forcing the logic to collapse into streamlined, high-density paths. Our findings suggest that the next generation of MoEs should move beyond forced load-balancing toward Minimum Description Length (MDL) optimality, assigning shorter expert-routing codes to high-frequency information and longer, more diverse codes to low-frequency information, thereby transforming routing from a heuristic into a principled compression engine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现混合专家模型（MoE）的路由机制本质上是哈夫曼编码的体现：高频词（常见token）分配稀疏的专家资源，而低频复杂任务（如链式思维轨迹中的罕见token）则调用多样化的专家委员会。作者提出频率多样性定律，并揭示强制负载均衡可能导致功能冗余，进而提出子集差分剪枝来消除冗余，释放潜在的哈夫曼效率。
Motivation: MoE路由的底层逻辑仍是一个黑箱，作者希望揭示其背后的原理，并指出当前强制负载均衡可能掩盖高效的路由信号。
Method: 通过理论分析和实验，提出频率多样性定律；针对冗余陷阱，提出子集差分剪枝策略，去除功能重复的专家。
Result: 发现Phi-3.5-MoE和Gemma-4-27B-A4B等模型自发表现出哈夫曼编码行为，而Qwen3.5-35B-A3B在低有效稀疏度下存在冗余；剪枝不损害推理能力，反而提升路由效率。
Conclusion: 建议下一代MoE应转向最小描述长度最优性，将路由从启发式方法转变为有原则的压缩引擎。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knowledge Injection Exists in MoE? Exploring Expert-Aware Contrast Decoding in MoE for Mitigating LLMs'Hallucinations
papers.abstract_en: Existing LLM hallucination mitigation methods, including prompt engineering and model optimization, either hardly alter models'internal knowledge or have poor cross-domain generalization. Contrastive decoding mitigates hallucinations by using layer-wise differences in LLMs. However, prior studies only explore transformer-based models (e.g., GPT), ignoring other effective frameworks like mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. Since MoE alters the traditional transformer architecture, we conduct empirical studies to investigate whether similar layer-wise differences exist in MoEs. Our results show that they do not exist in MoE with shared experts; nevertheless, across different MoEs, higher layers exhibit distinct expert activation patterns between factual and non-factual outputs. Building on these, we propose EAACD, an expert-aware adaptive contrast decoding that uses expert differences in MoE's higher layers to mitigate hallucinations on QA tasks. EAACD splits high-layer experts into a higher-reliability group and several lower-reliability groups based on their confidence and consistency. It contrasts the higher-reliability group's prediction with each lower-reliability group's prediction to calibrate the model's original predictions. To strengthen this contrast, EAACD amplifies hallucinations from lower-reliability experts via attention and masking to provide stronger negative references. EAACD outperforms all baselines on four datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM幻觉缓解问题，探索混合专家模型（MoE）中的知识注入现象，并提出专家感知自适应对比解码（EAACD）。实验发现MoE中高层专家在事实与非事实输出上存在激活模式差异，EAACD通过将专家分组并对比高可靠与低可靠组的预测来校准输出，在四个QA数据集上超越基线。
Motivation: 现有对比解码仅研究Transformer结构，忽视了MoE框架；且需要验证MoE中是否存在类似层间差异以用于幻觉缓解。
Method: 提出EAACD，根据置信度和一致性将MoE高层专家划分为高可靠组和低可靠组，通过对比两组预测校准原始输出，并利用注意力和掩码放大低可靠专家产生的幻觉以增强负参考。
Result: 在四个问答数据集上，EAACD在所有基线方法中取得最优性能。
Conclusion: EAACD有效利用MoE专家间的差异缓解幻觉，但论文未讨论跨领域泛化或计算开销等局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Attention to Frequency: Integration of Vision Transformer and FFT-ReLU for Enhanced Image Deblurring
papers.abstract_en: Image deblurring is vital in computer vision, aiming to recover sharp images from blurry ones caused by motion or camera shake. While deep learning approaches such as CNNs and Vision Transformers (ViTs) have advanced this field, they often struggle with complex or high-resolution blur and computational demands. We propose a new dual-domain architecture that unifies Vision Transformers with a frequency-domain FFT-ReLU module, explicitly bridging spatial attention modeling and frequency sparsity. In this structure, the ViT backbone captures local and global dependencies, while the FFT-ReLU component enforces frequency-domain sparsity to suppress blur-related artifacts and preserve fine details. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that this architecture achieves superior PSNR, SSIM, and perceptual quality compared to state-of-the-art models. Both quantitative metrics, qualitative comparisons, and human preference evaluations confirm its effectiveness, establishing a practical and generalizable paradigm for real-world image restoration.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 18th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART 2026), Volume 2, Marbella, Spain, March 5-7, 2026, pp. 1810-1820. SCITEPRESS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种双域架构，将Vision Transformer（ViT）与频域FFT-ReLU模块结合，用于图像去模糊。ViT骨干网络捕获局部和全局依赖，FFT-ReLU通过频域稀疏性抑制模糊相关伪影并保留细节。在基准数据集上，该方法在PSNR、SSIM和感知质量上均优于现有技术，并通过定量、定性和人类偏好评估验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有基于CNN或ViT的去模糊方法在处理复杂或高分辨率模糊时存在局限，且计算开销大，亟需一种能兼顾空间注意力与频域稀疏性的高效架构。
Method: 提出一个双域架构：将ViT作为空间域主干建模长程依赖，同时引入FFT-ReLU模块在频域施加稀疏约束，通过抑制低频模糊伪影并增强高频细节来提升去模糊效果。
Result: 在标准去模糊基准数据集上，该方法在PSNR、SSIM和感知质量指标上均超越当前最先进模型，且人类偏好评估也证实其视觉质量更优。
Conclusion: 该架构为真实图像恢复提供了一个实用且可泛化的范式，表明融合空间注意力和频域稀疏性可有效提升去模糊性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deblurring in the Wild: A Real-World Image Deblurring Dataset from Smartphone High-Speed Videos
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the largest real-world image deblurring dataset constructed from smartphone slow-motion videos. Using 240 frames captured over one second, we simulate realistic long-exposure blur by averaging frames to produce blurry images, while using the temporally centered frame as the sharp reference. Our dataset contains over 42,000 high-resolution blur-sharp image pairs, making it approximately 10 times larger than widely used datasets, with 8 times the amount of different scenes, including indoor and outdoor environments, with varying object and camera motions. We benchmark multiple state-of-the-art (SOTA) deblurring models on our dataset and observe significant performance degradation, highlighting the complexity and diversity of our benchmark. Our dataset serves as a challenging new benchmark to facilitate robust and generalizable deblurring models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了最大的真实世界图像去模糊数据集，利用智能手机慢动作视频构建，包含超过42,000对高分辨率模糊-清晰图像对，场景数量是现有数据集的8倍。通过评估多种SOTA去模糊模型，发现性能显著下降，表明该数据集的复杂性和挑战性。
Motivation: 现有真实图像去模糊数据集规模小、场景有限，难以训练鲁棒且泛化的去模糊模型。
Method: 从智能手机慢动作视频中提取240帧/秒的序列，通过平均帧模拟长曝光模糊，以时间中心帧作为清晰参考，构建大规模模糊-清晰图像对。
Result: 数据集包含42,000+图像对，规模约为现有数据集的10倍，场景数量为8倍；SOTA模型在该数据集上性能显著下降，表明其高复杂度和挑战性。
Conclusion: 该数据集可作为新的基准，促进更鲁棒和泛化的真实世界图像去模糊模型的发展。
Relevance: 0
